rjes su srungatuba'i chos dang / mi g.yo bar 'dug pa dang / so sor rtogs nas skal ba can du mi 'gyur ba dang / mi bskyodasapa'i chos dang / shes rab kyis〈rnam par grol ba dang / gnyis ku'i cha las rnam par grol ba 'di dag ni mi slob pa dgu zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces gsungs so/ /bde bar gshegs pas de skad gsungs nas/ ston pas yang gsungs pa/ lus dang ngag yid drang por gyur pa yi/ /slob dang mi slobasnyi'ajig rten 'di na bzhugs/ /de dag sbyin zhing mchod par 'os pa ste/ /mchod pa'i zhing rab der byin 'bras bu che/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin durgan rims kyi mdun du 'dug ste/ brjod paphubaskos nas 'phags pa brjod pa'i tshe 'di skad du gang bcom ldan 'das kyishenyan thos kyi dge 'dun la sbyin par rigs pa/rab tu sbyin par rigs pa/ thal mo sbyar bar rigs pa/ phyag bya bar rigs pa/ bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi yon gnas su gyur pa gang yin pa de dag la gos 8'di dag 'bul gyis 8ci bder bzhes shig ces gsung shig /de nas dge slong rjod par byed pa des rgan rims kyi mdun du 'dug la 'di skad du gson cig /btsun pa'i dge 'dun rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun sbyin par rigs pa/ rab tu sbyin par rigs pa/ thal mo sbyar bar rigs pa/ phyag bya bar rigs pa/ bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing / 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gang yin pa de dag la gos rnyed pa 'di dag 'bul gyis ci bder bzhes shig ces brjod do/ /de nas dge slong 'dod chags dang bral ba zhe sdang dang7bral ba gti mug dang bral ba gang yin pa de dag ni 'di snyam du gyur to/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 13—206

ni 'di skad du brjod de/ gang bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun sbyin par rigs pa/ rab tu sbyin par rigs pa/ thal mo sbyar bar rigs pa/phyag bya bar rigs pa/ bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi yon gnas de dag la gos rnyed pa rnams 'bul gyis7ci bder bzhes shig ces brjod de②/ bdag cag ni bla na med pasayin pas na bdag0gis rnyed pa 'di dbang mod kyis⑤/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag khyed kyis dge ba rnams ni bcab par bya'o/ /sdig pa rnams ni ༷bsgrag par bya'o zhes gsungs na⑦/bdag cagasnyegos rnyed pa'i phyir bdag nyid brjod pa lta ga la rung / bdag cag ni 'dod chags dang bral ba/ zhe snang dang bral ba/ gti mug dang bral ba'o zhes smras nas cang mi zer bar 'khod do/ /kun tu sbyor ba'i lhag ma dang bcas pa gang yin pa de dag kyang 'di snyam du/ bla na med pa la bsngos pas na bdag cag ni kun tu sbyor ba'i lhag ma dang bcas pa yin pas bdag cag ni mi dbang ngo snyam bsams nas cang mi zer bar 'khod do/ /bcing ba thams cad kyis bcings pa gang yin pa de dag ni 'di snyam du/ bla na med pa la de 'bul lo snyam du bsams nas de dag cang mi smra bar 'khod do/ /kun tu sbyor ba'i lhag ma dang bcas pa dag kyang cang mi zer bar 'khod do/ /bdag cag ni bcing ba thams cad kyis bcings pas na/ bdag cag ni thams cad kyi thams cad du mi dbang ngo snyam du bsams nas de dag kyang cang mi smra bar 'khod do/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gos phul ba de dag dge slong gcig gis kyang ma blangs pa dang / de yang 'di snyam du bdag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dag gis 0lhung bzed khas phub par ma gyur grang snyam du bsams nas/13—207

de'i lus skya bo bseng bseng7po rid cing skemasal rmya bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste drung du phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis don de bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / sangs rgyasasnyeni mkhyen bzhin du 'dri ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bosrel/ kun dga' bo0khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin pas dge slong dag la gos sbyar te byin0na/ ci'i phyir ma blangs zhes rmasalgepa dang / des7btsun pa khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis/ 'di skad du gang bcom ldan 'das kyi7nyan thos kyi dge 'dun sbyin par rigs pa/ rab tu sbyin par rigs pa/ thal mo sbyar bar bgyi ba nas de dag cang mi mchi bar ()mchis so zhes bgyi ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin brjod de/de ltar na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis stsal ba dge slong gcig gis kyang ma blangs so zhes gsol pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la kun dga' bo song la mnyan du yod pa na dge slong ji snyed gnas shing 'khod pa de dag thams cad 'dun 8khang du sdus 0shig /ces bka' stsal pa dang / btsun pa de bzhin bgyi'o zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das las mnyan te/ mnyan du yod pa na dge slong ji snyed gnas shing 'khod pa de dag thams cad 'dun khang du bsogasalgenas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste7phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ btsun pa bcom ldan 13—208

'das da dus la bab par dgongs shig /mnyan du yod pa na dge slong ji snyed gnas shing mchis pa de dgashethams cad 'dunakhukhung du 'dus shing tshogs so zhes de skad ces gsol pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das 'dunakhukhang gang na ba der gshegs te byon pa dang / gdan bting ba la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal te0/ dge slong khyedakyikhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gos mang po bsdus te byin na ci'i phyir ma blangs zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong rnams cang mi zer bar 'khod do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni mkhyen bzhin du 'dri ba ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la yang kun dga' bo dge slong rnams ci'i phyir mi 0smra bar 'khod ces rmas pa dang /de ltar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das la yang rgyas par gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed nga'i drung du mya ngan las 'da' bar bsams te rab tu byung ngas/ btsun pa de bzhin no zhes gsol to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na nga'i drung du mya ngan las 'da' bar bsams te rab tu byung ba de la ni ⑨ba na 4)phrag stong ri ba'i gos dang /mig lnga brgya yod pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang / ro sna brgya dang ldan pa'i zas rnams rjes su gnang ngo / /dge slong dag tshul khrims nyams pa dag ni dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba la rkang7pa'i rting pa gcig tsam yang yongs su spyad pa mi gnang ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshul khrims nyams pa'i gang zag la ni nyes pa'i dmigs 'di bcu yod de/ bcu gang zhe na/ tshul khrims kyis bdag smad pa dang / gzhan dang lha dang ston pas smad pa dang / tshangs pa mtshungs 13—209

par spyod pa mkhas pa dang / chos nyid kyis smad pa dang / phyogs phyogs su sdig pa mi snyan pa'i sgra dang tshigs su bcad pas grags par 'gyur ba dang / ma rtogs pa rnams rtogs par mi 'gyur ba dang / rtogs pa rnams nyams pa dang /sngon thos pa0rnams brjedasapar 'gyur ba dang / rnam par 'gyodasabazhin dukhudus byed pa dang / lus dang bral nas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan 'gro ngan song du log par ltungakunas sems can dmyal bar skye'o/ /'on kyang dge slong dag gis spyad pa ni bzhi ste/ bdag po med cing yongs su spyod pa dang / byin pas yongs su spyod pa dang / gnang bas yongs su spyod pa dang / bu lon gyisasnyeyongs su spyod pa'o/ /de las dge slong 'dod chags dang bralanya/ zhe snang dang bra'atsho/ gti mug dang bral ba de dag ni bdag po med cing yongs su spyod pa'o/ /kun tu sbyor ba'i lhag ma dang bcas pa dag ni byin pas yongs su spyod pa'o/ /so so'i skye bo dge ba can bsam gtan dang klog pa la zhugs pa rnams ni gnang bas yongs su spyod pa'o/ /le lo can dag ni bu lon gyis yongs su spyod pa'o/ /tshul khrims nyams pa ni yongs su spyod pa thams cad mi gnang ngo / /de lta bas na rnyed pa zhig yod na dge 'dun gyis mnyam par bgo ⑩bar bya'o/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'o// //mdor na/ bting ba dang ni ma bting btso/ /phyung ba dang yang ma phyung btso/ /de bzhin mtshams kyi phyi rol gnas/ /thos pa yi rang bsamasalgepas so//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe 13—210 ra

dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun gyis gtan⑥pa bting bsnyedage slong gis shin tu myong ②bzhin du gtan pa bting ④bar mi ⑤'gyur bar rjomachis sam/ u pā li yod de 'di lta ste/ dge 'dun gyi gtan pa 'ding ba'i tshe dge slong des dad pa mnyebyin la gnyid kyis7log ste/ dge 'dun gyi gtan pa bting bar 'gyur ro/ /u pā li de ltar na dge slong gtan pa shin tu myong bzhin tsogatan pa bting bar mi 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa dge 'dun gyi gtan pa shin tu ma myong 0bzhin du yigatan pa thonye bting bar ⑩'gyur ba mchis sam/u pā li yod de/ dge slong zhig gis dge 'dun gyi gtan pa bting ba'i tshe dad pa byin la nyal la dge 'dun gyis tsogatan pa yang bting bar 'gyur yite/de ltar na dge 'dun gyi cigatan pa bting ba shin tu ma myong ba yang ⑥gtan pa bting bar 'gyur ro/ /u pā li de bzhin du dge slong gis dge 'dun gyi gtan pa 'ding ba'i tshe dad pa byin pa la gnyid kyis log gam snyoms par zhugs pa stetsho/shin tu ma myong yang gtan pa bting bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi ⑥gtan pa 'byin pa'i tshe myong bar gyur 9kyang gtan pa ma phyung bar 'gyur ba mchis sam/ u pā li yod de/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong gis dge 'dun gyi gtan pa 'ding ba'i tshe dad pa ma byin la gnyid kyis log gam snyoms par zhugs pa ste/ u pā li de ltar na dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gtan pa 'byin pa'i tshe myong bar gyur kyang gtan pa ma phyung bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa dge slong zhig gis dge 'dun gyi gtan pa 'byin pa'i tshe myong bar ma gyur kyang gtan pa phyung bar 'gyur ba mchis sam/ u pā li yod de/ 'di ltar dge slong gi byadage 'dun gyis gtan ⑥pa 'byin pa'i tshe dad pa byin la 13—211

gnyid kyis log gam snyoms par zhugs sam/ mtshams kyi phyi rol tu song yang rung ste/ dge 'dun gyis gtan pa phyung ngo zhes thos te/ thos nas kyang legs par phyung ngo7/ /shin tu phyung ba'o zhes rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa'o// //mdor na/ bslabalgepa byin dang tshul shing dang / /gang la las rnams bya ba dang / /bcu gnyis rnams la slar 'khyal dang / /mi gtsang ba dang mi brtsanasapa/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa ④na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bslab pa stsal bas/tshul shing brim zhing las bgyirakhurung ngam/ u pā li mi rung ngo / /ma ning dang za ma dang / dge slong ma sun phyung ba dang / pha bsad pa dang / ma bsad pa dang / dgra bcom pa bsad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba dang / mu stegasakhucan dang / mu stegs7can du song ba dang / rkun gnas dang / so sor gnas pa dang / mi gnas pas tshul shing brim zhing las bgyir rung ngam/ u pā li mi rung ngo / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gang7la las bya ba de slar 'khyal yang mi brtsan no zhes gsungs na/ btsun pa gang la chos bzhin ma lags par las bgyis pa de ltar 'khyal na yang mi brtsan par 'gyur ram/ u pā li de ni brtsan no/ /btsun pa gang zag gis yilas bcu gnyis bskos 0pa'i tshe de dag 'di skad du nged cag la ma bsko shig ces mchi na/ ci de dag de ltar 'khyal ba yang mi brtsan nam/ u 13—212

pā li0brtsanasheno/ /de ni ngas chad pas gnasalgepa rnams kyi phyir bsams te gsungs so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis mi gtsang ba rnams slaraca'akhyal na mi btsanasnyino zhes gsungs na/ btsun pa ji tsam gyis na mi gtsang ba zhes bgyi0/ u pā li de ni gang la phas pham pa bzhi'i nang nas gang yang rung ba zhig byung bar gyur pa ste/ de tsam gyis na mi gtsang bar 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi'ishesgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa'o// //mdor na/ bslab pa byin dang las byed dang / /rkunasnyeganas kyang ni de bzhin te/ /bsnyen rdzogs mtshams kyi phyi rol dang / /mngags te gtang bar mi bya ba'o⑩/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa natswadze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa las bgyid pa bslab pa stsal bas las bgyisalgen/ bgyis pa zhes bgyi'am/ 'on te ma bgyis pa zhes bgyitsho/ u pā li ma byas pa zhes bya ste/ slar yang bya dgos so/ /de bzhin du ma ning dang za ma dang mi gnas pa'i bar du snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ /gleng gzhi ⑩ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong gzhan zhig la dge slong zhig ⑥bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod nas des bsnyen par rdzogs par 0bya ba'i dge slong rnams spran te/ des bsnyen par rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir des dge tshul pha de khrid debya/ dkyil 'khor du dong nas dge slong dag dang lhan cig tu dkyil 'khor du phyin nas/ de mtshams kyi phyi rol du mngags te btang ba dang / de gnyen dag gis khrid de song ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa de dag rab 13—213

tu 'byunganyezhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas dge slong gi⑧dngos por gyur pa'i⑧bar chad du gyur pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / sangs rgyasasrebacom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsalasapa/de lta0bas na dge slong dag gis bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa de mtshams kyi phyi rol du ma mngags7shig /'di lta ste/ dge slong dag 'khor los sgyurasheba'i rgyal po'i bu rab tsodabang bskur ⑩ba'i rigs pa dbang ma bskur na ⑩rgyal tshab 'thob pa de rab tu bsrung bar bya ba dang / rab tu bskyang bar bya ba de bzhin du dge slong gis bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa de yang rab tu bsrung zhing bskyang ba'i rigs so/ /de lta bas na dge slong dag gis bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa'i dge tshul pa 8de rnams ⑩mi thos pa'i nye 'khor tsam ⑩du spangs la/ mthong ba'i nye 'khor tsam du thal mo sbyar te mngon du lta bzhin zhog shig /de ltar na nyes pa'i dmigs su mi 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa'o// //mdor na/ bzod pa gsol bar byed dang mtshams/ /spu bsnyal ba yang de bzhin no/ /thab mo rgod pa bsdigs pa dang / /smad par bya dang rigs sun pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bsdigs pa'i las bgyis pas bzod pa gsol cig ces gsungs na/gang du bzod pa gsol bar bgyi/ u pā li de ni mtshams kyi nang du'o0/ /ji 13—214

ltar bzod pa ①gsol bar bgyi/ spu langs shing rab tu langs pa las dge 'dun la spu nyal bar byed pa byungakhubar sngo'al/ phyag 'tshal ba mngon du ston cing / thab0mo rgod pa de yang slar gtong ba'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis thabasremo rgod pa'i dge slong dag la bsdigs pa'i las byos shig ces gsungs na/ de ste btsun pa de la bsdigs pa'i las bgyid pa'i tshe ma rangs par gyur na/de la thabs ji ltar(bgyi/ u pā li de'i yo byad dang rdzas las kha cig gis lhung bzed dang chos gos khyer cig /kha cig gis ni bar bur gyi snod dag khyer la phyi rol du phyung ste bor cig /de ste ka ba la 'jusasnyen yang ka ba chod cig /de ste sgo skyes la 'jus7na yang sgo skyes phyung la de la ngo zlog mi phod pa ma byed cig /de slar sus bcos par bgyi/ dgene'adun gyis so/ /su la bcos pa'i yo byad dgug /sbyin bdag la slongs la de ste ma 'byor na dge 'dun thams cad kyi nor las byos shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /de ste btsun pa dge slong ma zhig thab mo rgod par gyur na de la yang bsdigs pa'i las bgyi'am/ u pā li de la yang bsdigs pa'i las bya'o/ /de ste ma rangs par gyur na zhes pa nasabya/the tshom ma byed cig ces bya ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin no/ /btsun pa de ste dge slob ma dang / dge tshul pha dang / dge tshul ma zhig thab mo rgod par gyur pa dang / de dag la yang bsdigs par bgyi'am/ de la the tshom du ma byed cig ces bya ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin no/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs sun pa'i dge slong la bskrad pa'i las byos shig ces gsungs na/ de ste btsun pa de la bskrad pa'i las bgyid pa'i tshe de ma rangs par gyur na de la ji ltar bgyi/ u pā li de la yo byad rnams zhes bya ba nas/ the tshom ma byed cig ces bya 13—215

ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin no/ /de bzhin du dge slong mas rigs sun pa ①dang /dge slobatsam dang / dge tshul pha dang / dge tshul ma dag la yang bskrad pa'i las bgyi'am/ de la the tshom du ma byed cig ces bya ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin no/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa drug pa'o// //'dul ba gzhung dam pa/ bam po sum bcu rtsashegasum pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis tshul khrims nyams pa'i dge slong skyod cig ces gsungasalgen/ bus bskrad par bgyi / de ni dge 'dun gyis bskrad par bya'o/ /de'i yo byad lasakha cig gis7lhung bzedagyedang chos gos khyer/ kha cig gis ni bar bur gyi snod dag khyer te phyi rol tu phyung la bor cigayi /de ste ka ba la 'jus na ka ba chod cig /sgo skyes la 'jus na sgo skyes kyang phyung la de la ngo zlog mi phod par ma byed cig /slar sus bcos par bgyi/ dge 'dun gyis so/ /'chos pa'i yo byad su la dgug /yon bdag la bskul lo/ /des kyang ma 'byor na dge 'dun thams cad kyi nor gyis slar bcos par bya ste/ de la the tshom du ma byed cig /tshul khrims nyams pa'i dge slong la ji lta bar dge slong ma dang / dge slob ma dang / dge tshul pha dang / dge tshul ma dag kyang de bzhin no/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim pa la smod par byed pa'i dge slong de la slar bsdum pa'i las byos shig ces gsungs na/ btsun pa de snye dge slong mas kyang khyim pa la smad par gyur na de la yang slar bsdum pa'i las bgyi'am/u pā li de yang slar bsdum pa'i las byed du chug shig /dge slob ma dang /dge tshul pha dang / dge tshul ma la yang de bzhin no/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 13—216

'das kyis dge slongakhukhyim pa la smod na⑧bsdum pa'i las byed du chug shig ces gsungs na/ dge slong gis dge slong la smod na de la yang slarakhubasdum pa'i las bgyi'am/ u pā li de la yang slar bsdum pa'i las bya'o/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma dang / dge slob ma dang / dge tshul pha dang / dgesatshul mkhuyang de bzhin du bya'o/ /dge slob mas dge slong ma dang / dge slong dang /dge slob ma dang / dge tshul pha dang / dge tshul ma la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /dge slob mas dge slob ma dang / dge slong dang dge slong ma dang / dge tshulasapha dang / dge tshul ma la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /dge tshul pas dge tshul pha dang / dge slong dang / dge slong mashedang zha dge slob ma dang /dge tshul ma la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /dge tshul mas dge tshul ma dang / dge slong dang / dge slong mnyedang / dge slobasnyem dang / dge tshul pha la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo bzhin du rgyas par brjod do/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa'o// //mdor na/ dge tshul dag dang bsdigs pa dang / /lnga las nyung ba mi gnas dang / /u pā lis ni ji ltar dris/ /nub mo lnga yang byin pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na 'dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa dge slong gis bsdigs pa'i las bgyis pa'i dge tshul pha bsnyen par rdzogs par7bgyis na/ de bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes bgyi'am/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa zhes bgyi/ u pā li bsnyen 13—217

par ni rdzogs mod kyi/ bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa ni 'das pa dang bcas pa'o/ /bzod pa ni gsol ba zhes bya'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis lo lnga lon la chos rnam pa lnga dang ldan na gnas ma bcas kyang gzhongs7spyad pa spyod du gnang ngo zhes gsungs na/ btsun pa lo bzhi lon la chos rnam pa lnga dang ldan na/ de yang gnas ma bcas par gzhongasakhuspyad pa spyod du gnang ngam/ u pā li mi gnang ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lo lnga mashelon pa mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /de ste0lo drug gam lo dgu lonasal/ de yang chos lnga dang mi ldan na de gnas ma bcas par gzhongs0spyad pa spyod du gnang ngam/ u pā li mi gnang ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos lnga dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /btsun pa dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo gsum lon la de yang sde snod gsum dang ldan pa/rig pa gsum dang ldan pa dri ma gsum dang bran rgyan de yang gzhan la ⑧gnas bca' bar bgyi'am/ u pā li de yang de bzhin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/bcas pa'i tshul du bya ba'i phyir ro/ /ji srid du gnas ma bcas pa la rnyed pa stsal bar bgyi/ u pā li de mngashen yang zhag lnga'i bar du ste/ de yang gnas bca' ba tshol zhing sbyor ba ma btang ba'o/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa'o// //mdor na/ mthun pa dag dang mi mthun pa/ /tshad gzung du yang med pa dang / /bcabs pa dang ni ma bcabs pa/ /de bzhin ming dang rigs kyang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pane na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi〈nyekun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 13—218

'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa7nongs pa mthun pa zhes kyang bgyi/ mi mthun pa zhes kyang bgyi na/ btsun pa nongs pa mthun pa gang lags/ mi mthun pa gang lags/ u pā lishepas pham pa rnams ni phas pham par mthun gyi gzhan dang mi mthun pa'o/ /dge 'dun gyi lhag ma ni dge 'dun gyi lhag mar mthun no/ /ltung ba ni ltung b.rasnyemathun no/ /so sor bshags pabaso sor bshags par mthun no/ /nyes byas ni nyes byas su mthun no/ /btsun pa nongs pa tshad dang ldan pa zhes kyang bgyi/ nongs pa tshad dang mi ldan pa zhes kyang bgyi na/ btsun pa tshad dang ldan pa ni gang lags/ mi ldan pa ni gang lags9 u pā li gang zhag gi mtha'akhudang nyes7pa'i mtha' dran par 'gyur bsheste tshad dang ldan zhes bya'o/ /gang zhag dang nyes pa'i mtha' mi dran par gyur pa de ni tshad dang mi ldan7zhes bya'o/ /btsun pa nongs pa bcabs pa zhes kyang bgyi/ ma bcabs pa zhes kyang bgyi na/ btsun pa bcabs pa gang lags/ma bcabs pa gang lags/ u pā li de ni rnam pa gnyis kyis bcabs pa ste/sems kyis bcabs pa dang / zhag tu bcabs pa'o/ /de la7zhag tu bcabs pa gang yin pa de ni ma bcabs pa'o/ /sems kyis bcabs pa gang yin pa de ni bcabs pa zhes bya'o/ /btsun pa nongs pa rnams kyi ming dang rus zhes bgyi ba/ btsun pa ming gang lags/ rus gang lags/ u pā li phas pham pa rnams ni ming ngo / /de las byung ba ni rus so/ /dge 'dun gyi lhag ma zhes bya ba ni ming ngo / /de las byung ba ni rus so/ /nyung ba dang so sor bshags pa dang / nyes byas rnams ni ming ngo / /de las byung ba ni rus so/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa'o// //13—219

spyad de/ /de dag la ni dad mi sbyin/ /dge slong byed dam mi len to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa nashedze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag dge 'dun gyi lhag ma rnamasaXbyung bar gyur nas/ de dag chad pas bcad pa dang / de dag ra ba'i nang du dkyil 'khor byas nas chad pa byed do/ /de dag la dge slong dag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag ci zhig byed ces de dag gis smras pa dngakhu/ chad pa byed do zhes smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis 'di ni slar bcabs pa yin gyis chad pa ma yin no zhes smras pa dang / de dag spa gong nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gangasnyen dge slong gcig purasheganas pa der chad pa'i las ma byed cig ces bka' stsal to/ /gang dge slong gnyis sam gsum gnas pa der yang dge slong dag gis chad pa'i las ma byed cig /gang na dge slong bzhi'am/ de las lhag pa yang rung balgeganas pa der dge slong dag gis chad pa dang / gzhi nas bslang ba'i chad pa dang / gzhi nas slar bslang ba dang / yid mgu bar bya ba dang / gzhi nas bslang ba'i yid mgu bar bya ba dang / gzhi nas slar bslang ste yid mgu ba dag byos shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang na dge slong bzhi'am de las lhag par gnas pa de dag tu dge slong gis chad pa dang / gzhi nas bslang ba'i chad pa dang zha gzhi nas slar bslang7ba dang / yid mgu bar bya ba dang / cigazhi nas bslang ba'i yid mgu 13—220

bar bya ba dang / gzhi nas slar bslang ste yid mgurkyu ba dgakhubyos shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong phasadag gis bslab pa byin pa'i dge slong bzhi la chad pa byed pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bslab pa byin pa'i dge slong bzhi la yang chad pa byed du mi gnang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa byin pa'i dge slong bzhi la chad pa byed du mi gnang ngo zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis bslab pa byin pa gsum dang / tshul bzhin gnas pa gcig la byed do/ /bslab pa byin pa gnyis dang / tshul bzhin gnas pa gnyis la byed do/ /bslab pa byin pa gcig dang / tshul bzhin gnas pa gsum la chad pa byed do/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bslab pa byin pa bzhi la yang chad pa ma byed cig /bslab pa byin pa gsum dang /tshul bzhin gnas pa gcig la yang ma byed cig /bslab pa byin pa gnyis dang / tshul bzhin gnas pa gnyis la yang ma byed cig /bslab pa byin pa gcig dang / tshul bzhin gnas pa gsum la yang chad pa ma byed par yongs su dag pa bzhi'am/ de las mang ba rnams la chad pa byos shig /chad pa gcadakyipa la ji lta bshe chad pasagazhi nas bslang ba dngashe/ gzhi nas slar bslang ba dang / yid mgu bar byed pa dang / gzhi nas bslang ste yid mgu bar byed pa dang / gzhi nas slar bslang ba'i yid mgu bar byed pa7rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la u pā lis zhus pa/ tsobaslab pa stsal ba la dad pa stsal du rung ngam/ u pā li mi rung ngo / /chos nyid la reg na ni rung ngo / /btsun pa bslab pa stsal ba las dad pa blang du rung ngam/ u pā li de 13—221

la dge slong du 'du shes bzhag na gdod rung ngo / /gleng gzhi'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu panyerdzogs te7sgo gnyis pa rdzogs sto// //mdor bsdus pa ni②/ dkyil 'khor lhung bzed dugs khang dang / /dud pa btung dang kharakhuphor dang / /lcags skra shing rta'i lte ba dang / /gdang shing sgron ma mchod rten no/ /mdor na/ dkyil 'khor lha yi gnas dang ni/ /phyedasadang gsum dang gnas mi 'cha'/ /lhung bzed med par rab tu byung / /lhung bzed la yang mi bri ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal skyabs med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag gis gar bab bab tu lhung bzed bkrus pa dang / sa phyogs der sbrang ma dag gis gang ste mi sdug par gyur pa bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gis mthong nas ci 'phags pa dag gis phyogs 'dir bshang gci bgyis sam zhes smras pa dang /de dag gis bzhin bzangs 'dir bshang gci dag ni sus kyang ma byas kyi nged kyis lhung bzed bkrus so zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis 'phags pa khyed kyis 'dir dkyil 'khor bya ba'i rigs so zhes smras pa dang / de dag spa gong nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de dag 'phya ste/ dge sbyong shākya'i bu dag ni mi gtsang ba ste/ gar bab bab tu lhung bzed 'khru'o⑧zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa0/ bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'phya ba ni yus kyis de bas na gar bab bab tu lhung bzed ma 'khru bar dge slong dag gis lhung bzed gang du bkrus pa'i gnas der dkyil 'khor byos 13—222

shig ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dkyil 'khor byos shig ces gsungs nas dge slong dag gis lhung bzed bkrus pa'i gnas der dkyil 'khor zlum por byas pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gtsug lag khang du 'ongasashete gnas kyi bar na mar dkyil 'khor yod pa dag mthong nas/ kye〈'di ci zhig ces dris pa dang / kha cig gis yang kye 'di lta la shes pasnyebyar ci yod/dge sbyong shākya'i bu dag ni nyi ma la dad do zhes smras so/ /gzhan dag gis kye de bzhin te/ dge sbyong shākya'i bu dag ni nyi ma la dad pa bden no zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na nyi ma 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis nyi ma dang0'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor ma byed cigakhuces gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis zla ba kham pa 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor byas so/ /der bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gis yang gtsug lag khang du lhags nas/ kye dge sbyong shākya'i bu dag ni zla ba la dad do zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ debalta bas na zla ba 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor kyang ma byed cig /dge slong dag gru bzhir byed pa la zhugs pa dang /gtsug lag khang der bram ze dang khyim bdag dag yang lhags nas/ kye dge sbyong shākya'i bu dag ni ba lang la dad do zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pashenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis7de lta bas na dkyil 'khor gru bzhi dang / rnam pa gnyis ltar ma byed par mdung rtse dang rnga 'dra bar byos shig ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong rnams de cis bya 13—223

ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ba lang gi lci ba'am sa'am chus byug par gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dkyil 'khor rnam pa gnyis byos shig /ces gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la de 'dra'itudakyil 'khor rnam pa gnyis byas te/ desashemagu bar gyur pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das lasagasol nasadu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dkon mchog gsum la ni nyi ma'am/ zla ba'am/ ji ltar dad pa rnam pa thams cad dus byas teX/de la the tshom ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sbyin par byed pa dang / sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtor ma len pa'i lha dag la rnam pa gsum gyis dus dus su yang dag par mgu bar bya/ yang dag par mchod par bya/ yang dag par bde bar bya'o/ /gsum gang zhe na/ dus dus su gtsang ma'i byi bdar dang / dus dus su gtor ma'i las kyang byed/ dus dus su byin⑧pa'i yon kyang bsngo'o/ /dge slong dag sbyin par byed pa dang / sbyin bdag gis gtor ma len pa'i lha dag la dus dus su yang dag par mgu bar bya/ yang dag par mchod par bya/ yang dag par bde bar byas na sbyin par byed pa dang / sbyin bdag rnams la yid dge bas slar brtse bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bde bar gshegs pas de skad gsungs nas yang ston pas gsungs pa/ skyes bu gang zag dad pa dag /gang gis lha rnams mchod byed pa/ /ston pa'i bka' bzhin byed pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang de la bsngags / /13—224

sa phyogs gang na shes rab can/ /mkhas pa tshul khrims ldan 'khod pa/ /bshos gsol sbyin rabs bsgraganyepar bya/ /de dag rjed pas rjedasapar 'gyur//mchod pasabyas pas mchod par 'gyur/ /de nas 'di la snying brtse ba ma yis ji ltar0bu lasnyibazhin/ /lhasalgerjes brtse ba'i mi rnams kyis/ /bde zhing bzang po mthong bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis skyes bu gang zagakhudad pas lha rnams la mchod na ston pa'i bka' bzhin byas pa yin te/ sangs rgyas dag gis kyang bsngags so zhes gsungs pa dang / drug sde dgashegis ra ba'i lha dang / nags kyi lha dang / bzhi mdo'i lha dang / sum mdo'i lha dang /'jig rten gyi lha ⑩dag la sogs te/ thams cad mchod pa yibyed pa dang /dad pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa rnams 'phags pa 'di dag dge bar gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung na 'di ltar gnod pa sha dang khrag dang / rkang dang / tshil dag za zhing gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa dag la mchod de/bdag cag dge bsnyen gyis kyang ring du spangs na/ 'di dag ni mchod pa byed do zhes nyes pa ngor brjod dpyas 'dogs shing mi snyan par zer nas de dag dge slong dag gis zlog pa dang / ci'i phyir tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ni gang skyes bu gang zag dad pa dag gis lha dag la mchod par byas na ston pa'i bka' bzhin du byas pa yin te/ sangs rgyas dag gis kyang bsngags so zhes ma gsungs sam/ ci nged cag dad pa ma yin nam/ ci'i phyir na mi mchod ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas khyim pa la dgongs te gsungs kyis dge slong dag la ma yin gyis de lta 13—225

bas na dge slong dag gis lha rnams la mchod par ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag lha rnams la mchod par ma byed ciganyeces gsungs pa dang / drug sde dag gis de dag la gnod par byed pa la zhugs pa dang / dge slong de dag gi rmi lam du nged kyikhunyes pa ci byas na nged la gnod par byed ces ston to/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag ma dad pa dag kyang 'phags pa rnams 'di dag gis khyed cag la gnod pa ci zhig byas na 'di dag ma rung bar byed ces 'phya'o / /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das lakhugasol nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis de la mchod par yang ma byed cigadu /gnod par yang ma byed cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde dag lam du zhugs te/ 'dong ba'i tshe lha dag gi rten mthong ba dang byol te lam mthon dman dang tsher ma can du dong ba dang / de na dge slong kha cig ni 'jag mas non⑦/ kha cig ni tsher masasazug /kha cig ni dredakunas lhung ngo / /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lam 'byol te ma 'dong bar lam drang por deng la/ lha dag gi rten la se gol gyi sgra phyung la zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bklag par bya ste/ de la the tshom ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis lhan cig spyod pa dang / nye gnas kyi dge slong gis mkhan po dang / slob dpon la dus gsum du ltar song shig ces gsungs 'kho/ mtshams chen ponyedapag tshad phyed dang gsum du chod cig ces kyang yigasungs na/ btsun pa de lta na 0slob 13—226

dpon dang mkhan po dpag tshad phyed dang gsum na ①mchis na ②de dag gis ji tsam na blta bar bgyi②/ u pā li de dag gis zla ba phyed phyed cing ltar song shig /de ste de dag rgyang grags ldan gnas na de dag gis zhag bdun nam brgyad na ltar0song shig /de tshun chad ni ji ltar dus su ltarabasong shig /'dom lnga brgya na gnas na ni de dag gisasnyedus gsum du ltarashesong shig /de ltar ma song na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bo la rab tu 'byung bar 'dod pa zhig 'ongs nas des de lhung bzed med par rab tu phyung ngo / /de'i tshe na dge slong dag gis lhung bzed bkrus nas lhung bzed bzhag pa'i sar bzhag ste/ mchod rten la phyag byas nas bdag bdag gi lhung bzed blangs te zas za7ba'i gnas su 'khod do/ /gang gi tshe dge slong dag zas za ba'i tshe 0lhung bzed dag bkrus nas mchod rten la phyag byed pa la zhugs ④pa dang / gsar du rab tu byung ba de yang de dag dang lhan cig tu phyag byas nas gang gi tshe dge slong dag mchod rten la phyag byas te lag pa bkrus pa dang /gsar du rab tu byung ba des kyang gnas brtan kun shes kauṇḍi7rgya'i lhung bzed blangs pa dang / des slar bzlog go/ /de nas gang po dang / ming chen dang / ma 'gags pa dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu dang / 'od srung dang / kun dga' bo dang / re ba ti la sogs pa'i lhung bzed blangs te/ de dag gis kyang slar bzlog pa dang / de mchi mas mig gang bzhin du phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i dge slong dag 'di ltar lhung bzed dag med par sus rab tu phyung0zhes phyas 'dogs so/ /kha 13—227

cig gis ni nye dga' bo yin no zhes smras nas/ de dag gis nyes pa sbom po la spyod pa de ma gtogs par gzhan su zhig de ltar byed ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong 'dinyernams 'phya ba ni lus te/ de'ubs na dge slong dag gis ②lhung bzed med par rab tu ma dbyung bar dang por lhung bzed dag tsholakyil gdodasarab tu phyung shig /de ste mi 'byor na bdag gis0lhung bzed chung ngu byin cig /dge slong gis lhung bzed med par rab tu phyung na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gagasalgepa la nye gnas gzhin nu lhung bzod 'dzin pa zhig yod pa des de'i lhung bzed dang /bdag gi lhung bzed gnyi gshebakrus te/ lhung bzed de gnyis kyang 'dra ba zhig nas bdag gi gang yin/ slob dpon gyi gang yin pa mi shes nas/ phyi zhig na des tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags sprepa'i lhung bzad la slob dpon ma 'gagasalgepa'i lhung bzed ces yi ge bris so/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams khyim du bshos la spyan drangs te/ khyim bdag de la sngon yongs su spyad pa'i smad 'tshong ma zhig yod de/ des de la bzang mo ngas sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dag bshos la spyan drangs kyis 0khyod kyang tshur shog la rang gi lag gis kyang brim par byos shig ces springs pa dang / de yang brel ba'i rkyen cig byung nas der ma 'ongs so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dag bshos tsogasol/ sbyin rabs gsungs nas slar bzhud pa dang / tshe dang ldan 13—228

pa ma 'gags ①pa'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa ②gzhon nu de khyim de nyid du lhung bzed bkrus te 'gro'o snyam du bsams nas 'dug pa dang / khyim bdag des 'phags pa lhung bzed skad cig g.yar/ mdza' ba zhig la lhung bzed kyi lhag ma zhig bskur ro zhes smras pa dang / des bdag gi nisnyem byin gyi/ tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa'i lhung bzed byin pa dang / khyim bdag des de'i nang du bza' ba dang / bca' ba gtsang ⑤mas bkang nas ༷smad 'tshong ma de la bskur te/ phrin0du bzang mo ngas ni kha zas〈'di lta bus sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams tshim par byas kyisayi/ khyod kyis de la rjes su yi rang skyed cig ces spring ngo / /des kha zas de dag byo ba dang / lhung bzed kyi zhabs la yi ge 'dug pa mthong nas/ bud med kyi bu ni rnam pa bcwa brgyad la mkhas te/ des bklagasalgepa dang / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa'i ming mthong nas des 'di snyam du bdag gis 'phags pa lha dang mis mchod pa'i lhung bzed de 'di bzhin du bskur ba'i mi rigs so snyam du bsams nas des lhung bzed de dris phyis te/ de nas me tog bsung zhim pos bkang nas khri'u tshon gyis bris pa'i steng du bzhag ste/ de'i drung du btud nas pog por gyis bdug cing 'dug pa dang / de nas skyes pa gzhan zhig kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya dang / dri dang phreng ba dag khyer te de'i drung du 'ongs nas/ bzang mo ci byed kun tu spyod kyis 'dong ngo zhes smras pa dang / lhung bzed la mchod pa byas skad cig sdod cig /des lhung bzed 'di gang nas 'ongs su'i yin zhes smras pa dang / mos ji ltar gyur pa zhib tu smras so/ /des khyod kyis ya mtshan can thams cad dag la yang sbyin pa gtong ste/ rab tu byung ba dag kyang 13—229

ma shor to zhes smras pa dang / de rna ba bkab nas sdig pa de lta bu ma byas kyisatu sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyur gyur ta re zhes smras so/ /mos de skad smras kyang des log par byed pa de ma btang ngo / /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/dge slong gang mi bri ba bris pa de ni nyes pa'i dmigs su 'gyur gyisasnyede bas na dge slong dag mi bri ba ma bri0shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag la mi bri ba ma 'drisashig ces gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis gang mi bri ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi bri ba rnam pa lnga ste/ so sor thar pa thams cad dang / so sor thar pa dngasaldan pa dang / 'dul ba thams cad dang / 'dul ba thams cad du ldan pa dang / gang zag so so'o/ /mtshan ma can du bya ba ni nyes pa med do/ /gleng gzhi'i7sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dang po'o// // rimador na/ dge tshul gyis ni lhung bzed bcag /lhung bzed ji ltar bsreg par bya/ la /sreg 'gebs gnang bar bya ba ste/ /drang srong chen pos rjes su gnang / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal skyabs med pa la zas sbyin pa'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong gzhan zhig gis chadage tshul pha lhung bzed 'dzin pa de la des 0lhung bzed 'khrur bcug pa dang / dge tshul pha de yang dran pa nye bar gnas pa ma yin pa zhig nas de'i lag nas lhung ste chag go/ /dge slong de phongs par gyur te/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom 13—230

ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ dge slong dag gang cunganyezad dge slong dag gis dge tshul pha la lhung bzed 'khrur bcug na nyes pa'i dmigs su 'gyur te/ de bas na dge slong dag gis dge tshul pha dgasalhung bzed 'khrur ma gzhug shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag lhung bzed dge tshulasa'akhrur ma gzhug shig ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i dge tshul pha tsun dbazhes bya ba lhung bzed 'dzin te/ des mkhan po lhung bzod tshur stsol cig bkru'o zhes smras pa dang / des bu bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa'i gnas bcas te/dge slong gis dge tshul pha dag la lhung bzed 'khrur ma gzhug shig ces gsungs kyisasnying nyid 'khrus0khyod phar song shig ces smras pa dang / des mkhan po ci bdag gis kyang nyes pa'i dmigs su 'gyur ram zhes smras pa dang / des bu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi bdag po bas na ngas ji ltar bya zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge tshul pha dran pa nye bar gnas pa de dag la ni 'khrur gzhug ste/ de la the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong dag lhung bzed du zan zos nas de yang ma bcos pas btsas khyer nas rdol to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhung bzed bsreg par byos shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis lhung bzed sregs shig ces gsungs nas/ dge slong dag gis lhung bzed shing gis bsregs pa dang / lhung bzed ma rung bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shing gis sreg⑧par ma byed cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis 13—231

〈tudang sog ma dag gis g.yogs te bsregs pa dang / de nyid nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rtswa dang sog mas g.yogs te sreg par ma byed cig ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong dag gis ji ltar bsreg pakhumi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lhung bzed kyi sregashe'agebs sbyor cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis lhung bzed kyi sreg0'gebs ji ltar sbyor0mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sregakhu'agebs la rnam pa gnyis te/ slob dpon gyis byas pa dang / bdag gis byas pa'o/ /de la slob dpon gyis byas pa ni bum pa lta bu'o/ /bdag gis byas pa ni phru ba'am rdza ma yang rung ste/ thal bas bkang la rdza ma ji tsam ran pa phrisheshig ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis gyo mo'i nang du de bzhin du bsregs pas de nyid nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyi rol du ni 'jim pa dang phub mar bsresalgepas yugs la nang du til gyi7tshigs ma'am/ ba lang gi lci bas yugs te de skams pa dang /sa gzhi byi bdar gyis la 'og tu phub ma dang ⑪/ til gyi tshigs ma dang /gzhan yang byad bzang du 'gyur ba dag thing ste/ rtswa dang / lci ba dang /sog ma dag gis g.yogs la ci nas dud pa ma shor bar byos la sregs shig /de'i g.yas g.yon chag chag thob la skyong nul gyis shig /ci nas srog chags dag bde bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ /bsregs pa de grangs pa dang / lhung bzed phyung la khrus te'/ nam kha dog zhen par gyur gyi bar du bsreg par byos0shig /de bas na lhung bzed sreg 'gebs dang yo byad dag rjes su gnang ngo / /gleng gzhi'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'o// //13—232

mdor na/ gcig la gcig dang dugs khang dang / /khyim pa gsum pa de bzhin te/ /gding ba dang ni de bzhin tsho/ /lci bas byas pa kun thos pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasalgemanyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gisasnyedage 'dun gyi phyir dugs khang zhig byas so/ /de nas drug sde dag gis gos gcig pus smad g.yogs byas te/ gcig la gcig las byed cing 'khod pa dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dag phyogs der lhags pa dang /de dag gis de mthong nas/ kye 'di lta bu dag tu byed pa su zhig ces smras pa dang / de na kha cig gis ni mu stegs can dag yin no zhes smras0/ yang kha cig gis 'di dag ni mu stegs can ma yin gyi/ dge sbyong shākya'i bu'o zhes smras pa dang / de dag 'phya ba la zhugs te/ kye ston pa ni ngo tsha ba dang ldan na/ci'i phyir 'di dag ngo tsha ba dngaphukhril med ces smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'phya ba ni yus kyis0/ de lta bas na dge slong dag dugs khang du gos gcig pu gon te gcig la gcig las ma byed cig /dge slong dag gis gos gcig pu gon te dugs khang du las byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste0/ mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis dge 'dun gyi phyir dugs khang zhig byas pa dang / der dge slong dag gis 'bru mar gyis byugs te/ rkang pa la reg nas mgo bo la reg /13—233

mgo bo la reg nas kha la reg /kha la reg nas lag pa dang rkang pa la reg /lag pa dang rkang pa la reg nas slar yang khatul reg cing gos ngan pa zhig gis smad g.yogs te 'dug pa dang / ji tsam zhig na khyim pa ma dad pa zhig phyogs der 'ongs nas/ des dge slong dag mthong ba dang / desashe'aphya ba la zhugs te / dge sbyong shākya'i bu dag ni mi gtsang ba ste/ 0rkang pa la reg pa kha la reg par byas nas gos ngan pas smad g.yogs byas te/ gcer bur skye bo dag gi nang na 'dug go zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'phya ba ni yus kyis④/ de bas na dugs khang du khyim pa ma gzhug shig ma dad pa yang las byed du ma gzhug shig /dugs khang gi sgo ba dge slong rnams skosasnyil de dag gis khyim pa dag nang du ma gtangakyishig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dugs khang du khyim pa ma gtang7shig /las kyang byed du ma gzhug ⑧shig ces gsungs pa dang / de nas dus phyi zhig na dugs khang du zhugs pa'i tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin der 'ongs pa dang /dge slong sgo bas smras pa/ khyim bdag nang du ma 'gro bar 'dugasheshig /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim pa dugs khang du ma gtang shig ces bka' stsal to/ /des 'phags pa dag ci kho bo yang gzhan du 'gyur ram/ kho bos ni nges par 'phags pa dag ginyelas bya'o zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas8/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gang dad pa dag ni dugs khang du thong / las kyang byed du chug shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dad pa dag ni dugs khang du 13—234

thong la las kyang byed du chug shig ces gsungs pa dang / de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin nang du 'gro ba na de dang lhan ①cig tu bram ze zhig kyang 'ongs nas de ma btang ba dang / des 'phags pa ci'i phyir nakhukhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ni nang du btang la bdag ni mi gtong zhes smras pa dang /dge slong gis de la smras pa/ bram ze khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ni dad pasalgenang du btang ngo / /des smras pa/ 'o na bdag kyang dad par gyur na nang du gtongaXngam zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de ste dad par gyur na nang du thong shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis de skyabs gsum du btang nas nang du btang ngo / /des yang dge slong dag rkang pa la reg nas kha dang mgo la reg cing gos ngan pas smad g.yogs nas sgren mor 'dug pa mthong ba dang / de ma dad de 'phya ba la zhugs so/ /dge sbyong shākya'i bu ni mi gtsang0ba ste/ rkang pa la reg pa kha dang mgo bo la reg cing gos ngan pas smad g.yogs nas sgron mor 'dug go zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rab tu dad pa dag ni dugs khang gi nang du thong shig /dad pa chung ba ni ma gtangasashig/ // 'dul ba gzhung dam pazha bam po sum bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dag dugs khang du spyan drangs te/dge slong dag nang du zhugs pa dang / de na dgra bcom pa'i dge slong zhig gis 13—235

tshul khrims nyams pa'i dge slong zhig la las byed cing 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das7kyang nang du gshegs nas des las byed pa gzigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong khyed cag gis dge slong 'di la dge slong 'dis las byed pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong ngo zhes gsol pa dang / dge slong las byed pa 'di ni dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa'o/ /gang la las bya ba 'di ni tshul khrims nyams pa sdig pa'i chos can/ khong rul ba/zags pa/ gsog tu gyur pa/ dung dgra0lta bur spyod pa/ dge stongasnyem yin pa dge sbyong du yi dam 'dzin pa/ tshangs par spyod pa ma yin pasatshangs par spyod par yisnyidam 'dzin pa ste/ de bas na dge slong dag seng ge lta bus wa 'dra ba'i las ma byed cig /byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis seng ge 'dra bas wa lta bu'i las ma byed cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhigade dang rigs mnyam pa las chung ma zhig blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse dga' yongs su spyod do/ /des0rtse dga' yongs su spyad pa las dus phyi zhig na chung ma sems can dang ldan par gyur nas/ de lasazla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das pa dang bu btsas nas bu pho zhig byung ste/ de gzugs legs pa blta7na sdug cing mdzes pa yan lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston chen po byas nas ming btags so//de bsrings bskyed nas cher gyur pa dang / de dus phyi zhig na dze ta'i tshal du song ste/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas de mdzod gsum dang ldan par gyur te/ des 'di snyam du bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag bu'i pha ma ni dka' bar bya ba byed de/ phan par byed pa'o/ /gso bar byed 13—236

pa'o/ /skyed par byed pa'o/ / nu ma7snun par byed pa'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling sna tshogs pa ston par byed pa yin te/ bus phrag⑧pa gcig la ni ma/ gnyis pa la ni pha khyer te lo brgya tshang gi bar du khyer ramanya/ yang na sa gzhi chen po nor bu dang / mu tigashedang / bee ḍūryasadang / dung dang / shel dang /gser dang / dngul dang / a sma gar ba0dang / spug dang / g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba de lta bu dag gis dbang por bcug gam dbang phyug tu bcug kyang des ni pha dang ma la bus phan btags pa'am nye bar phan btags par mi 'gyur gyi/ gang gis phashem dad pa med bsnyedad pa phun sum tshogs par byas sam/ yang dag par bskul tam/ dul bar byas sam/ 'jug par byas sam/ so sor bkod dam/ tshul khrims ngan pa las tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par/ ser sna can las gtang ba phun sum tshogs par/ shes rab 'chal ba las shes rab phun sum tshogs par yang dag par bskul/ dul bar byas/ zhugs par byas/ so sor bkod na de lta bu ni bus pha dang ma la phan btags pa dang / nye bar phan btags par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so snyam du bsams nas/ bdag gis kyang ci nas pha ma la phan gdags pa cung zad cig bya'o snyam nas ji srid dga' ba'i bar du gzhongs spyod ⑩cing 'dug nas mnyan du yod pa gang na ba de 8logs su gzhongs 8spyod cing song ngo ⑫/ /mthar gyis spyad pa spyod cing mnyan du yod par phyin to/ /des de gnyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gnas la rab tu bkod do/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na des pha'i drung du nor las bsod nams su bya ba'i dngos po bdun po'i yon tan rgyas par brjod pa dang / des 'phags pa bdag gis kyang nor sna bdun 13—237

las bya ba'i ①bsod nams kyi dngos po cung zad cig bya'o zhes smras pa dang /des bgres7po de bzhin legs kyisasagyis shig ces smras pa dang / ci zhig bya/dugs khang zhigakhugyis shig /des dugs khang byas te/ khyim bdag de rang gi dugs khang du rang gis las bya ba la zhugs te/ shin tu ngal bar gyur nas bkru ba'i yo byad dang / 'bru mar dang phye la sogs pa mang du lhag go/ /de nas des bu bdag rab tu ngal bar gyur gyis byanga'i rgyab cung zhig nyes 0shig ces smras pa dang / des yab bcom ldan 'das kyis seng ge lta bus wa lta bu dag la bsnyen bkur ma byed cig ces bka' stsal te ma gnang ngo / /zhes smras pa dang /des bu seng ge dang washegang zhes smras pa dang / yab bdag ni seng ge dang 'dra/khyod ni wa dang 'dra'o/ /bu de ci'i phyir zhes smras pa dang / yab bdag ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa'o/ /khyod ni tshul khrims ngan pa dang ldan pa'o/ /bu de ltar wa dang 'dra ba nga lta7bu las seng ge dang 'dra ba khyod lta bu skyes sam zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rigs gang na pha ma la yang dag par mgu bar byed/ yang dag par mchod par byed/ yang dag par bde bar skyong bar byed pa'i rigs de ni tshangs pa dang bcas pa'o⑩/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu pha ma la chos bzhin byed/ tshul bzhin byed pa ni tshangs pa zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag rigs gang na pha ma la yang dag par mgu bar byed/ yang dag par mchod par byed/ yang dag par bde bar bsnyen bkur byed pa de ni slob dpon dang bcas pa'o/ nade ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bus pha ma la chos bzhin byas na slob dpon lta bur 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 13—238

rigs gang na pha ma la yang dag par mgu bar byed/ yang dag par mchod par byed / yang dag par bde bar bsnyen bkur byed pa'i rigs de ni sbyin par rigs par bya'o①/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi busalgepa ma la chos bzhin du byas na sbyin par rigs pa'o/ /dge slong dag rigs gang na pha ma la yang dag par mgu bar byed/ yang dag par mchod par byed/ yang dag par bde bar bsnyen bkur byed na rigs de ni mesadang bcas pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rigs kyi bus pha ma la0chos bzhin du byas na mesalta bu'o/ /dge slong dag rigs gang na pha ma la yang dag par mgu bar byed/ yang dag par mchod par byed/ yang dag par bde bar bsnyen bkur byed na rigs de ni lha dang bcas pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bus pha ma la chos bzhin du byas na lha lta bur 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces0bka' stsal pa dang /bde bar gshegs pas de skad gsungs nas ston pas yang gsungs pa/ pha dang ma gnyis tshangs pa ste/ /slob dpon lha yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar me yi7lha bran bzhin/ /bu yi sbyin pa'i gnas yin no/ /de bas de gnyis phyag bya zhing //phyi bar bya zhing bkru ba dang / /rkang pa gnyis kyang bkru bar bya/ /de bzhin mkhas pas bsnyen bkur bya/ /yang na bza' ba btung ba dang / /bgo ba mal stan de bzhin te/ / de gnyis pha dang ma gnyis la/ /mkhas pas bsnyen bkur bcas byed na/ /'dir ni mnar bar mi 'gyur te/ /song nas mtho ris dga' bar 'gyur/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde gsungs pa de'i tshe na dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis pha dang ma 13—239

dang / bla ma la ni rim gro bgyid pa'i yon tan brjod pa ni ngo mtshar7che'o zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di la ci zhig ngo mtshar cher yod/ da7ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod chags med/zhe sdang med/ gti mug med / skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngagasakyi'adon pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi dga'akhub dang / 'khrug pa rnams med bzhin du pha ma la rim gro bya ba'i yon tan brjod pa pas sngon 'das pa'i dus na nga 'dod chags dang bcas/ zhe snang dang bcas/ gti mug dang bcas/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smresasngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi dga'asheb dang / 'khrug pa rnams las yongs su ma grol ba na yang ma la gnod pa cung zad zhig byas nas sdug bsngalanyechen po rjes su myong ngo / /phan pa cung zad zhig byas nas kyang bde ba chen po rjes su myong bar gyur te/ de dag legs par shin tu yid la byos shig dang bshad par bya'o/ /sngon byung ba ni dge slong dag sngon 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa srinen ded dpon mdza' bo zhes bya ba phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba8/ gnas rgya che zhing yangs pa zhig ste/ ngal bso po'i nor dang 'dra btso/ ngal bso po'i nor la 'gran pa zhig yod de/ des rigs mnyam pa'i chung ma zhig blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse dga' yongs su spyod do/ /de la rtse dga' yongs su spyad pa las bu pho rnams byung yang shi nas de bu med de bu 'dod pas lha gu lang dang / ba ru ṇa dang / ngal bso po dang / ba sa ba la7sogs pa lha stong la gsol kyang de'i bu gson par ma gyur te/ de la 13—240

gzhan zhig gis de ste khyod la bu pho zhig btsas na bu mo'i ming du thogs shig dang yun ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro zhes bsgo'o/ /de7dus phyi zhig na de dang lhan cig tu rtse dga' yongs su spyadakhudo/ /des rtse dga' yongs su spyadasapas de'i chung ma sems can dang ldan par gyur nas/ zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon nas khye'u zhig btsas te/ de gzugs legs shing blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bu/ mgo gdugs 'dra ba/ lag pa ring ba/dpral ba'i dbyes che ba dang / kos ko ring ba/ smin ma snyoms pa/ sna mtho zhing yan lag dang nying lag thams cad du ldan pa zhig btsas te/ de btsas pa'i btsas ston chen po byas nas ming gdags par brtsams te/ mdza' bo'i bu de bu0mo'i ming du btagasalgepas na khye'u 'di'i ming bu mo mdza' mor gdags so/ /ci0tsam na khye'u bu mo mdza' mo zhes bya ba de cher gyur pa dang / de'i phasheyang rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs te/ de de nyid du shi bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo mdza' mos/ ma la bdag gi⑧pa sngon gyi las7'bras bu gang gis 'ami/ bdag kyang phyis de bzhin du bsgrub bo zhes smras pa dang / mas bsams pa/ sngon rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du 'jug pa'i tshong pa yin no zhes 'di la smras na ni 'di nyid kyang rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs te de nyid du shi bar 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas/ des bu khyod kyi pha ni sngon 'bru 'tshong7ba byed byed de/ khyod kyang dga' na 'bru 'tshong ba gyis shig ces smras pa dang /des 'bru'i tshong khang brtsigs te/ thog ma'i nyin par kār ṣā pa ṇa bzhi rnyed de/ des de dag ma la byin no/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na gzhan zhig gis de la khyod kyi pha ni sngon dri 'tshong ba'o zhes smras pa dang / des 'bru 'tshong ba btang 13—241

ste/ dri 'tshongatuba'i tshong khang brtsigs so/ /de nas nyi ma dang po'i tshe kār ṣā pa ṇa brgyad rnyed nas des yang de dag ma la byin no/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na gzhan zhig gis de la khyod kyi ②pha ni gser 'tshongakhub yin no zhes smras pa dang /des yang dri 'tshong0ba btang ste/ gser 'tshongasnyib la zhugs pa dang / de'i nyi ma dang po la kār ṣā pa ṇa bcu drug rnyed pa dang / des yang de dag ma la byin no/ /phyi de nyin mo des kār ṣā pa ṇa sum bcu rtsa gnyis rnyed pa dang / desalgede dag ma la byin no/ /de nas gser 'tshongasab phrag dog can dag gis grong khyer thams cad kyi gser 'dis bsdus so snyam du bsams nas/ bu mo mdza' mo la khyod7'di lta bu byed cing 'tsho ste ci rung / khyod kyi pha ni sngon rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa'i yitshong pa yin na khyod sus 'di 'dra ba ngan pas 'tsho 'ab la 'jug tu7bcug ces smras pa dang / de gser 'tshong ba dag gi tshig des bskul bas de ma'i thad du song ste/ ma bdag gi pha ni 'di ltar sngon rgya mtsho chen po'i tshong pa'o zhes thos na rjes su gnong shig dang / bdag kyang rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs la mchi'o zhes smras pa dang / mas de la bu de ni bden mod kyi khyod ni gzhon la bu gcig pu ste/ kho mo bor la7rgya mtsho chen por ma 'gro shig ces smras pa dang / de nas bu mo mdza' mos ma'i tshig ma mnyan te/bdag gis ⑩grong khyer du gang rgya mtsho chen por zhugs shing 'dong du dad pa rnams 'dong ngo zhes des0bdag nyid ded dpon du bsgrags so/ / de nas tshong pa lnga brgyas bskor te dong ba dang / de ma'i snying du sdug pas dkrugs te/make mchi mas brnangs0bzhin rkang pa gnyis la bzung ste/ bu kho mo bor te rgya mtsho chen por zhugs la ma 'gro shig ces byas pa dang / de 'di ltar snying rje 13—242

zhing mi dga' ste/ dal gyis smras pa la khros nas ma'i mgo bo rkang pas phulanyete/de 'gron pasamang po dang 'grogs te song ngo / /mas bu khyod la las 'di rnam par smin par ma gyur cig ces smras pa dang / de nas desagrong dang / grong khyer dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rnams la lta zhing rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du phyin pa dang / des dong tshe rnying pa lnga brgyas gru bo che nyos te/ gru'i nang du 'jugashepa dang / 'byin pa dang / mnyan pa dang / nyag thag 'dzin pa dang / phyogs rtogashepa'i mi dag la glasabyas nas des7dril chen po lan gsum du bsgragasalgenas rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs te song ba dang / ji tsam zhig na chu srin nya'i rigs kyis gru ma rung bar byas nas/ bu mo mdza' mo gru tshal zhig la 'jus nas mthar phyin to/ /de nas skam la song ba dang / dga' ba zhes bya ba'i grong khyer de mthong ste/ de der song nas de na lha'i bu mo gzugs legs shing blta na sdug pa bzhi byung stetsho/ der 'ongs nas bu mo mdza' mo bde bar 'ongs sam/ 'di ni bdag cag gi zas kyi khang pa dang / btung ba'i khang pa dang / gos kyi khang pa dang / nyal ba'i khang pa dang 9 nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bee ḍūrya dang / dung dang / 8shel dang / byi ru dang / gser dang / dngul gyis gang ba yin gyis de bzhes shig /tshur spyon bdag cag dang lhan cig bzhugs so zhes smras nas/ de dang lhan cig lo du ma/ lo brgya du ma/ lo stong du ma/ lo brgya stong du mar ji ltar7sems can bsod nams byas pa/ dge ba byas pa/ rdzu 'phrul chen po/ mthu chen pos rang gi bsod nams la myong bar gyur pa0bzhin myong bar gyur tosgro/ /de dag gis lho phyogs kyi lam du ma 'gro shig ces bsgo ba dang / de lho phyogs kyi 13—243

lam du ma btang yang der 'gro bar 'then te/ de7phyi zhig na lho phyogs su song ba dang / des7rtag tu ra ro ba zhes bya ba'i grong khyer mthong nas de'i sgor phyin pa dang / de nas kyang lha'i bu mo de bas kyang gzugs legs pa/ de bas kyang blta na sdug pa/ de bas kyang mdzes pa brgyad byung stenya/ de dag gis bu mo mdza' mo tshur spyon bde bar byon tam/ bdag cag gi zas kyi khang pa 'di dang /skom0gyi khang pa dang / gos kyi khang pa dang / nyal ba'i khang pa dang / nor bu dang zha mu tig dang / bee ḍūrya0dang / dung dang / shel dang / byi ru dang / gser dang / dngul dag gis gang bar yod kyisakhutshur spyon lhan cig bzhugs so zhes smras nas/ de dgashedang lhan cig lo du ma/ lo brgya du ma/ lo stong du ma/ lo brgya stong du mar ji ltar sems can bsod nams byas pa/ dge ba byas pa/ rdzu 'phrul chen po mthu chen pos myong ba bzhin myong bar gyur to8/ /de dag gis kyang de la lho phyogs kyi lam du ma 'gro shig ces bsgo'o/ /de lho phyogs kyi lam du ma 'gro shig ces bsgo na je thur 'then te 'gro 'dod nas ji tsam zhig nas lho phyogs kyi lam du song ba dang / dga' ba can zhes bya ba'i grong khyer mthong nas de'i sgor phyin pa dang / de nas yang lha'i bu mo de bas kyang gzugs legs pa/ de bas kyang blta na sdug pa/ de bas kyang mdzes pa bcu drug byung ste/ de dag gis bu mo mdza' mo bde bar byon tam/bu mo mdza' mo tshur spyon/ bdag cag gi zas kyi khang pa 'di dang / skom gyi khang pa dang / gos kyi khang pa dang / nyal ba'i khang pa dang / nor bu dang zha mu tig dang / bee ḍūrya dang / dung dang / shel dang / byi ru dang / gser dang dngul dag gis gang ba yod kyis tshur spyon lhan cig 13—244

bzhugs so zhes smrasanyenas/ de dgashedang lhan cig lo du ma/ lo brgya du ma/lo stong du ma/ lo brgya stong du mar ji ltar sems can bsod nams byas pa/dge ba byas pa/ rdzu 'phrul chen po/ mthusachen pos myong bar gyur pa bzhin myong bar gyur to/ /de dag gis kyang de la lho phyogs kyi lam du ma 'gro shig ces bsgo'o/ /de la lho phyogs kyi lam du ma 'gro shigasnyebasgo yang je thur 'then0cing 'gro bar 'dod nas de ji tsam zhig na lho phyogs kyi lam du song ba dang / bla ma'i tshangs pa zhes bya ba'i khang pa bzang po zhig mthong nas de'i sgor 'ongs pa dang / de'i nang nas lha'i bu mo de bas kyang gzugs legs pa/ de bas kyang blta na sdug pa/ shin tu bzang mo sum bcu rtsa gnyis shig byung nas de dag gis bu mo mdza' mo tshur spyon/ mdza' mo bde bar byon tam/ bdag cagashegi⑧zas kyi khang pa 'di dang / skom gyi khang pa dang / gos kyi khang pa dang / nyal ba'iXkhang pa dang / nor bu dang kha mu tig dang / bee ḍūrya7dang /dung dang / shel dang / byi ru dang / gser dang / dngul la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gang ba yod kyis tshur spyon lhan cig tu bzhugs so zhes smras nas/ de dag dang lhan cig7lo du ma/ lo brgya du ma/ lo stong du ma/ lo brgya stong du mar ji ltar sems can bsod nams byas pa/ dge ba byas pa/mthu chen po/ rdzu 'phrul chen pos myong ba bzhin myong bar gyur to/ /de dag gis kyang lho phyogs kyi lam du ma 'gro shig ces bsgo'o/ /de lho phyogs kyi lam du ma 'gro shig ces bsgo yang je thur 'then cing 'gro bar 'dod nas ji tsam zhig na lho phyogs kyi lam du song nas de phyi phyir zhing dad pa skyes te/ de rim gyis sto phyogs su song ba dang / lcags las byas pa'i grong khyer zhig mthong ste de der 13—245

zhugs so/ zhazhugs ma thag tu de'i sgo yang slar bcad par gyur to/ /de nas yang nang du song ba dang sgo yang de bzhin du bcad do/ /de nas yang nang du song ba dang sgo yang bcad par gyur te/ ji tsamakhun skyes bu rab tu lus che ba zhig de nas byung ste/ de'i spyi bo la lcags kyi 'khor lo 'bar ba rab tu 'bar ba/ shin tusa'abar ba/ me0lce gcig tu gyur pa zhig0'khor zhing 'dug ste/ de'i mgo las rnag khrag byung ba ni zas su za bar mthong ngo de nas bu mo mdza' mos skyes bu de la khyod ci'i phyir de ltar gyur ces dris pa dang /des ngas ni ma la gnod pa byas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes skyes bu des de skad du smras ma thag tu bu mo mdza' mo de'i las kyang mngon du smin par gyur te/ bdag gis kyang ma la gnod pa byas nas de'i las kyis 'dir khrid de 'ongs so snyam dukhubasams pa dang / de ma thag tu nam mkha' las sgra 'di skad du gang bcings pa de ni thar/ gang ma bcings pa de ni bcings pa'o zhes sgra de byung ma thag tu skyes bu7de'i spyi bo na 'khor lo yod pa de ni med par gyurayi/ bu mo mdza' mo'i spyi bor 'khor lo byung ngo / /de nas bu mo mdza' mo rab tu sdug bsngal bar skyes bu des mthong nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ rtag tu dga' dang dregs byed cing / /skyid pa byed pa bor byas te/ /tshangs pa bla ma'i khang pa nas/ /ci yi phyir ni khyod 'dir 'ongs/ /bu mo mdza' mos smras pa/ rtag tu dga' dang dregs byed cing / /skyid pagyibyed pa bor byas te/ /tshangs pa bla ma'i khang pa nas/ /'dir ni 'ong bar 'dod gyur pa/ /yun ring po yi las kyis gnyer/ /las kyis ring nas gnyer nas kyang / /gang du las kyis gnyer ba der/ /las kyang rnam par smin par gyur8/ /las gang rnam par smin pas 13—246

na/ /'khor lo 'bar dnganyerab 'bar ba/ /bdag gi⑧srog la gnod gyur te//klad la 'khor lo 'bar bar gyur/ /mi des smras pa/ khyod kyis ngan pa'i sems bskyed de/ / dka' bsabyed pa'i ma yi mgoraX/ /khyod kyis rdog pa brgyabasnyepas na/ /de yi las kyi0'bras bu yin/ / bu mo mdza' mos smras pa/⑦'khor lo 'bar ba rab 'bar ba/ /bdag gi⑧srog la gnod byed pa/ /lo grangs stong phrag ji srid du/ /nga yi klad na 'khor bar 'gyur⑩/ /mi des smras pa/ lo grangs stong phrag drug bcu dang / /lo grangs brgya yi bar du ni/ /'bar ba'i lcags kyi 'khor los kyang / /khyod kyi mgo la 'jog par byed/ /de nas bu mo mdza' mo des mi de la kye skyes bu gzhan dag kyang 'dir 'ong ba lta yod dam zhes smras pa dang / mi des smras pa/ gang gis las 'di lta bu byas pa dag ni 'dir 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bu mo mdza' mo sdug bsngal gyis mngon du gzir ba dang / sems can rnams la snying rje ba bskyed nas mi de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye skyes bu ngas sems can thams cad kyi phyir 'khor lo 'di mgo la bzod par byasatso/ gzhan gang gis 'di 'dra ba'i las byas pa de dag 'dir ma 'ong 8shig ces smras ma thag tu bu mo mdza' mo byang chub sems dpa' de'i mgo las 'khor lo de shing ta la bdun tsam du nam mkha' la 'phags nas 'dug pa dang / de yang dus 'das te dga' ldan gnam gyi lha'i khams su skyes so zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i dus na bu mo mdza' mo zhes bya ba de ni nga nyid yin te/de'i tshe ngas tshong byas te/ kār ṣā pa ṇa ma la byin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas ni grong khyer chen po rnam pa bzhir rab tu bde ba myong bar gyur to/ /13—247

de nas ngas ma la gnod pa cung zad cig byas pa de'i ①las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pas ni rnam pa 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong bar gyur to/ /de ltakhubs na dge slong dag de bzhin du bslab par gyis shig /pha dang ma la phan gdagasashepar bya'i0/ gnod pasnyim byed cig dang de lta bu'i gnod pa mi myong bar 'gyur ba ni ji ltar bu mo mdza' mo so so'i0skye bo'i tshe na myong ba bzhin te/ yon tan mang por yang 'gyur zhing de yang de bzhin gshegs pa yin te/ dge slong dag de bzhin du bslab par byos shig /dge slong dag desnyebs na tshul khrims rab tu nyams par gyur kyang rnam pa lnga la nye g.yog bya bar gnang ste/ lnga gang zhe na/pha dang / ma dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / nad pa rnams so/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nyi ma ni shar/ bya rog ni zer/ zhing pa ni rmo rko byed/ ma lus par sku ba rnams ni du'o/ /dge slong dag de ni dper byas te/ don de mi shes pa'i phyir don de yang bstan par bya ste/ dge slong dag nyi ma shar ces bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /bya rog zer ro zhes bya ba ni chos kyi snod gang zag rnams kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /zhing pa zhing rmed ces bya ba ni sbyin par byed pa dang /sbyin bdag rnams kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /ma lus par rku ba rnams ni du'o zhes bya ba ni bdud kyi 'khor gyi tshig bla dgas so/ /de lta bas na dge slong dag ston pa ni nyan thos dag la thugs brtse bas thugs rje'i don ston pa/ phan par dgongs pa/ thugs rje bzhin pas na khyod la don byas kyis khyod kyis da bya ba'i rigs so/ /de 'di ltar dgon pa dang / shing drung dang / khang stong 13—248

dang / ri dang / grog po dang / ri phug dang / sog ma'i phung po dang /bla gab med pa dang / dur khrod dang / nags tshal gyi phyogs dang / bas mthar gnas par bya7ste/ dge slong dag bag med par ma byed cig /phyis 'gyod par gyur ta re/ ngas bstan pa 'di ni ngas rjes su bstan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgon par gnas parakhugasungs pas na / phyis 'gyod par gyur ta re/ 'di ni ngas bstan pa'o zhes gsungs pa'i bar du snga ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag dgon pa dang / nags tshal gyi phyogs dang / bas mtha' la gnas shing bsam gtan byed pa la zhugs so/ /mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis dgon pa la gnas pa'i dge slong dag gi phyir dgon par khyim brtsigs te/ ji tsam zhig na bsod snyoms pa gzhan zhig gzhongs spyad pa spyod cing mnyan du yod par phyin nas rjode yang slar khyim du 'ongs te 'dug pa dang / de dus phyi zhig na de'i skra dang kha spu ring por gyur nas snga dro'i dus na sham thabs bgos te/ lhung bzed dang chos gos khyer te song ba dang / de la khyim bdag des 'phags pa skra dang kha duspu ring ngo zhes smras pa dang / des bzhin bzangs 'bregashemakhan med do zhes smras nas/ khyim bdag gis 'phags pa de ltarasnyen bzhud cig dang / bdag gis 'breg mkhan gtang7ngo zhes smras pa dang / des bsod snyoms bslangasalgenas slar song ba dang / des 'breg mkhan yang btang ngo / /bsod snyoms pa de rab tu le lo can zhig ste/ de gding ba'i steng du 'dug bzhin skra bregs pa dang / skra yang gding ba'i steng du lhung bas zad par 'dor ma nus so/ /khyim bdag des bsams pa/'breg mkhan khyod song la dge slong de'i skra dang kha spu dag bregs sam ma bregs 13—249

ltos shig ces smras pa dang / de der song ngo7/ /song nas gding ba'i⑧steng du 'dug pa dang / de'i gos la spa dag chags nas khyim bdag des bsod snyoms pa de la mgukhub dag byas nas slar khyim du song ba dang / de'i chung mas jo bo'i sras ci khyod 'breg0mkhan gyi khyim na 'dug 'dug gamakha/ des gos la bltasalgen skra chags shing 'dug pa mthong nas des bsams pa/ bsod snyoms pa de gding ba'i steng du 'dug bzhin du spa ma bregs grang zhes de bltar 'gro'o snyam bsams nas/ yider song ste bltas pa dang / de'i gding ba spa dag gis gang zhing 'dug pa mthong nas/ 'phags pa gding ba'i steng du skra mi 'breganyepa tsam yang mi shes sam zhes nyes pa ngor brjod pa dang / bsod snyoms pa de gnong nas spa gong ste ngo tsha nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim bdag de dag 'phya ba ni yus te/ de bas na dge slong gding ba'i steng na 'dug cing skra ma 'breganyeshig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gding ba'i steng na 'dug cing spa ma 'breg0shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis gnas khang dang /bkad sa dang / sgo khang du skra bregs nas de nyid nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dge 'dun gyi0phyag dar byed pa'i gnas der skra ma 'breg shig /bregs naphu'adas pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang dge 'dun gyi phyag dar bya ba'i gnas der skra ma 'breg0shig ces gsungs pa dang / dge slong kha cig rgas shing 'khogs la rid par gyur/ kha cig ni na bar gyur te/ phyi rol du 'gro mi nus/ mi na ba 13—250

dag kyang tsha zhing char pa bab par gyur pa dang / de dag kyang phyir 'byungatumi nus nas gnod par gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dge slong dag rgas shing 'khogs la rid par gyur pa dang / na ste mi bde ba dag ni snga gangasadu spasabreg par gyis shig /mi na ba dag tsha zhing char pa bab par gyur te/ phyi rol du 'byung du mi bde na de yang snga gangasadu skra breg par gyis shig /sa'i dngos po thams cad du yang sa gzhi byi bdar byal/ yang na ni byed du chug shig /skra ni bsdusashel phyag dar khrod du bor cig /sen mo gcod pa yang go rims 'di bzhin no/ /gang mi bde bar gyur pa de la rjes su bcas kyi mi bde ba med pa de dag ni de ltar ma byed cig /byedagyen 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro// cigleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ de'i tshe na dge slong zhig na bar gyur nas7des rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / 'dabalgem dang / 'bras bu rnams kyi sman gyis gsos kyang de'i nad sos par ma gyur nas/ ji tsam zhig na sman pa gtsug lag khang du 'ongs pa dang / de la dge slong dag gis bzhin bzangs dge slong 'di 'dra bar na bar gyur na sman dpyad kyi thabs ston ④ces smras pa dang / des 'phags pa phyi dro phye zo shig dang sos par 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis bzhin bzangs phyi dro phye bza' bar bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang na nged cag gis thonyeji ltar phyi dro phye bza' bar bya zhes smras pa dang /des 'phags pa khyed cag gi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin 0gyis ciganang bar 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 13—251

gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ba lang7rgan po so med pa dag gis nas ji ltar zos pa de bzhin du 'byung ba yod de/de lta bas na rjes su gnang ba ni ba langasargan pos zos pa'i nas las phyer thogs tekhubyin cig /de la the tshomasam byed cig /de la phye de byin kyang sos par ma gyur nas/ dge slong dag gis sman pa la zhib tu smras pa dang / des 'phags pa dag de ni ro yal bas mi phan te/ nas gzhan las phye byos la byin cig ces smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gzhan gyis ma zos pa'i nas las phyer ༷byos te tshags kyis tshogs la byin cig ces bka' stsal pa dang /dge slong dag gis de bzhin du byin yang sos par ma gyur nas/ dge slong dag gis sman pa la zhib tu smras pa dang / des 'phags pa 'de gu byos la byin cig dang sos par 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dgasnyedage slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nasal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de ste sman pas bsgo na phye la 'de gu byos la byin cig /de bzhin du phye las zan du byas pa dang / de nyid kyang rung ste thams cad byin cig /de la the tshom ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na dge slong gzhan zhig na bar gyur nas/ des rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / 'dab ma dang 'bras bu'i sman rnams kyis gsos kyang sos par ma gyur nas phyi zhig na sman pa gtsug lag khang du 'ongs pa dang / dge slong dag gis dris pa/ bzhin bzangs dge slong 'di na ba'i thabs 'di lta bu zhig na 0sman dpyad ston cig 13—252

ces smras pa dang / desatu'aphags pa dag phyi dro khu sha byin cig dang sos par 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis bzhin bzangs phyi dro za bar bcom ldan 'das kyis ②ma gnang na de la phyi dro khu sha ji ltar bza' zhes smras pa dang /des 'phags pa dag khyed kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin ②gyis duganang bar 'gyur ro zhes smras0so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dred mo zhes bya ba'i srog chags zhig yod de/ des sha ji ltar zos pa de bzhin du 'byung gis de lta bas na rjes su gnang ba ni dred mos zos pa'i sha las khu shar byos te byin cig /de la the tshom ma byed cig /de dag gis dred mos zos pa'i sha las khunyeshar byas te byin yang sos par ma gyur nas/ dge slong dag gis sman pa la zhib tu smras pa dang / des 'phags pa dag de ni ro yal zin pas sha sar7pa las byas pa byin cig dang sos par 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste sman pas sha sar pa las khu shar byos la byin cig ces bsgo na ni de lta bas na rjes su gnang ba ni sha sar pa las khu shar gyis la dar gyis tshogs te byin cig /dge slong dag gis de bzhin du byin yang sos par ma gyur nas/ dge slong dag gis sman pa la zhib tu smras pa dang /des 'phags pa dag snag tshogs byos la byin cig ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste sman pas snag tshogasacabyin cig ces bsgo na ni byin cig /de la sogs te gtubs pa dang / skam po thams cad kyang byin 13—253

cig /de la the tshom ma byed cig /gleng gzhi'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad7pa gsum pa'o// //mdor na/ dud pa btung dang seng ras dang / /snar blugs pa dang phor bu dang / /khab ral dang ni mig byug pa/ /drang srong chen pos gnang ba 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa nasnyidze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pasabacom ldan 'das kyis0dud pa btung ba'i sbubasabu chongs sheg ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu bcang bar bgyi/u pā li rin po che las byas pa ma gtogasakyiso/ / btsun gshebacom ldan 'das kyis seng ras chongs shig ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu bcang bar bgyi/ bal las7byas pa dang / zar ma las byas pa dang / ras las byas pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis sna'i nang du blugs pa chongs shig ces gsungs na ji lta bu bcang bar bgyinya/ u pā li rin po che las byas pa ma gtogs so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes bzhin btung ba'i phor bu chongs shig ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu bcang bar bgyi/ u pā li de ni rin po che ma gtogs pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis khab ral chongs shig ces gsungs na/ji lta bu bcang bar bgyi/ u pā li de ni rin po che las byas pa ma gtogs so9/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis byamig byug pa'i sman gyi snod chongs shig ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu ⑩bcang bar bgyi0/ u pā li de ni rin po che las byas pa ma gtogs pa'o/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad 13—254

pa bzhi pa'o// //mdor na/ phor bu dang yang skud ris dang / /rkang gnas pa dang rkang rten dang / /bkru0sman —dag dang rngan pa dang / /shi bar gyur pa'i chos gos so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na⑧ma ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis sman gyi phor bu chongs shig ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu bcang bar bgyi/ u pā li de ni rin po che las byas pa ma gtogs pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis skud ris chongs shig ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu bcang bar bgyi②/ u pā li skud pa bdun las0byas pa ste/ bal dang / ldum bu sha nakhuka dang /ras bal dang / gso0ma dang / rtswa du gu lakhudang / ldum bu ko tam pa dang /srin bal gyi skud pa las byas pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis rkang rtenasachongs shig ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu bcang bar bgyi/ u pā li de ni rin po che las byas pa ma gtogs pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis khri dang rkang rten chongs shig ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu bcang bar bgyi/ u pā li de ni rin po che las byas pa ma gtogs pa'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig na bar gyur nas des sman pa la dris pa bzhin bzangs bdag tshund 'di 'dra ba zhig gis btab na sman dpyad kyi thabs (7ston cig ces smras pa dang /des khyim bdag snum bag sngar zo shig dang phyis bkru sman gtang ngo zhes smras pa 13—255

dang / de snum bag za ba la zhugs so/ /ji tsam zhig na de'i grong du nye bar 'gro ba'i dge slong deratu'ongs nas des khyim bdag ci byed cing 'dug ces smras pa dang / des ji ltar gyur pa zhib tu smras so/ /des khyim bdag kho bo bkru sman gtong ba ②rab tu mkhas kyisashesman pa la sbyin pa de kho bo la byin cig dang /ngas khyod la bkru0sman btang ngo zhes smras pa dang / khyim bdag des legs kyis0de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes smrasakyinas des de bkru sman btang nas gtsug lag khang du langs te song ngo / /khyim bdag de'i bkru sman mchod nas de'i nye du dag song stesnyisman pa la dris pa/ khyim bdag de bkru sman mchod na thabs ji lta bur bgyi zhes smras pa dang / de la bkru sman sus blud/ de dag gis 'phags pa 'di zhes bya bas blud do zhes smras pa dang / de khros nas de nyid kyi gan du song la dris shig ces smras so/ /de dag gis de de'u shi ba las sos nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal7pa/ de lta bas na dge slong dag gis rngan pa len cing sman ma gtong shig /de ste bkru sman btang na yang gud du ma 'gro shig /de 'dra ba'i rkyen cig byung na yang sman dpyad ston la song shig /de bzhin du ma byas par song na yang 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro// gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ nor bdag gis nor chags pa bzung ste / des de la dus 'di tsam zhig na byin cig ces dus btab nas btang ngo / /des bsams pa/ de ltar dus btab tu zin kyang ngas dus bzhin du gzhal bar mi nus kyis ji nas dus la bab na bros te 'gro'o snyam du bsams sonya/ /phyis yang bsams pa/ yul dang bral te 'gro ba yang rab tu sdug bsngal gyis ji bya13—256
