nas nor bdag de gsad do snyam bsams nas de dze ta'i tshal du 'gro ba'i lam du des de bsad do/ /ji tsam zhig na drug sde dag gis de mthong nas de dag gis bsams pa/ bdag cag gis phyag dar khrod kyi gos rnyed do snyam bsamasalgenas/desasnye bshu bar brtsamasalgepa dang / de'i gnyen dag gnas der 'ongs nas de dag gis de mthong ste ngu ba la zhugs nas khyed cag gis bsad do zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis nged kyis ni ma bsad kyi gdon mi za bar dgras bsad do zhes smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de'i gnyen rnams dogs pa skyes pa ni yus te/ de bas na dge slong dag gis de 'dra ba'i phyag dar khrod ni ma len cig /gang gi tshe na skye bo mang po dag gis rtogs par gyur pa de'i tshe na blang ①bar bya ste/ de ltar ma byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ⑤ro/ / gleng gzhi'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa'o// //'dul ba gzhung dam pa/0 bam po sum bcu rtsa lnga pa⑦/ mdor na/lcags kyi gongasabu gzar bu dang / /rgyab khur rked pa mgo bo dang / /pha dang ma la gos dang zas/ /spu can chos gos gsum pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis lcags kyi gong bu lcags thag gis thogs shig ces gsungs na/ lcags thag ji lta bur gdags par bgyi/ u pā li de ni rin po che las byas pa ma gtogs pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 13—257

sman gyi gzar bu chongs shig ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu bcang bar bgyil/ u pā li de ni rin po che las byas pa ma gtogasalgepa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag rgyab dang rked pa dang mgo la khur ma khyer cig ces gsungs na/ btsun pa dge slong masadag gis0kyang rgyab dang rked pa dang mgo la khur mi bkur bar bgyi'am/ u pā li dge slong ma dag gis ①kyang rgyab dang rked pa dang mgo la khur ma khyer cig /de ste khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis rigs mnyam pa las chung ma zhig blangs te/ de dang lhan cig rtse dga' yongs su spyod do/ /de dang lhan cig tu rtse dga' yongs su spyadakyinas dus phyi zhig na de'i chung ma sems can dang ldan par gyur nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang / de la bu gzugs legs pa blta na sdug pa/bzang ba/ yan lag thams cad dang ldan pa'i khye'u zhig btsas te/ de dag gis skyes pa'i skyes ⑤ston chen po byas nas ming btags so/ /de bsrings ⑨bskyed de cher gyur pa dang / ji tsam dus phyi zhig na pha ma la ma ⑩gsol bar bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /de snga dro sham thabs bgos nas lhung bzed dang chos gos khyer te mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / de'i pha rgan pos mthong nas bu khyod rab tu byung na nged cag sus gso bar 'gyur zhes smras pa dang / de spa gong nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag pha dang ma ni bu'i dka' ba byed 13—258

pa yin te①/ de lta bas na busarab tu byung yang phasam gnyis kyi bza' ba dang bgo ba dag sbyor bar rjes su gnang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyisakhurab tu byung yang pha ma gnyis kyi bza' ba dang bgo ba dag sbyor cig ces gsungs pa dang /dge slong dag gis ji ltar sbyar ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang lhung bzed dang chos gos lhag par gyur pa des sbyar bar byos shig /de ste med na sbyin bdag las slongs0te sbyor cig /de ste dge 'dun du gtogs la dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa dbang bar gyur na de'i phyed byin cig /de ste bsod snyoms pa zhig na bsod snyoms kyisaphyed sbyin par gyis shig /de ltar ma byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan du yod pa nas mi ring ba zhig na ri brags kyi grong zhig yod de/ ri brags kyi grong de na gtsug lag khang zhig yod pa de'i nang na rgan zhugs gzhan zhig gnas te/ de nas dus phyi zhig na mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba'i phyir mnyan du yod par song ngo / /drug sde rnams ni chos kyis kyang drug sde'i nang na gcig gis ni dze ta'i tshal gyi sgo srung bas na tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bo sgo na 'dug pa des mgo dkar la smin ma ring ba zhig rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba mthong nas des bsams pa/ dge slong gnas brtan gang zhig 'dir 'ong bsur 'gro'amanyesnyam bsams te/ de sngar song ba dang / des gnas brtan bde bar 'ongs sam zhes smras so/ /des slob dpon phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bos bsams pa/ rgan zhugs 'dis slob dpon yang mi shes/ mkhan po yang mi shes par rig nas des rgan zhugs tshur shog /gtsug lag khang du 'dong ngo 13—259

zhes smras sonya/ /des gtsug lag khang du khrid nas ngal bsorakhubacug pa dang / de cungasazad cig 'dug nas slob dpon bdag ni mchodabarten la phyag 'tshal du mchi'o zhes smras pa dang / nye dga' bos sdod cig dngasa'adu ba'i dus lababab pa dang bya'o zhes smras pa dang / des slob dpon bdag gis chos gos gsum ga yang khyer te ma 'ongs pas 'gro'o zhes smras pa dang / nye dga' bos rgan zhugs sdod cig dang / 'dir chos gos gsum byin gyis brlab par bya'o zhes smras nas/ ji tsam na 'dus par gyur pa dang / des de la par thang ni mthang gos su byin gyis brlabs/ la ba ni stod g.yogs su byin gyis brlabs/be'u ras ni sbyar mar byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas la ba dang be'u ras gnyis phrag pa la bzhag nas par thangasagis dkris pa'i steng du the gus dkris te dam du bcings nas de nas 'dus pa'i nang du btang ba dang / dge slong dag gis mthong nasal/ dge slong kun tu bcings pa kha cig ni nyes pa ngor brjod do/ /kha cig gis ni rgan zhugs pha bi yi ci'i phyir smyon thabs byed ces smras pa dang /des tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di ni kho bo'i chos gos gsum yin te/ kho bo ni glo bur du 'ongs na gang du gzhag ces smras pa dang / de dag gis chos gos gsum de 'dra ba yin nam zhes smras pa dang / des gang la med pa de ci 'dra bar 'gyur zhes smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur pa de ni dge slong dag gis spu ring po las chos gos gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ de lta bas na dge slong dag gis spu ring po las chos gos gsum du byin gyis brlab par mi gnang bar dgongs nas bka' stsal pa/13—260

dge slong dag dge slong rnams nyes pa ngor brjod pa ni lus te/ nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur pa de ni spu ring po las chos gos gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ de lta bas na dge slong dgashespu ring posnyelas chos gos gsumakhubyin gyis ma brlabasheshig /de ste byin gyis brlabs na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag spu ring po las chos gos gsum du byin gyis ma brlabasashig ces gsungs pa dang / dad pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag gis la ba dang phrug stan dang be'u ras dag phul ba dang / dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas ma blangs pa dang / des 'phags pa dag nam sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du mi 'byung ⑦ba'i tshe na ni mu stegs can dag yon gnas lags na/ da ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung bas khyed cag yon gnas yinasate/ da khyed kyis ma blangs na bdag cag gishedage ba'i zong med bzhin du 'jig rten pha rol du ji ltar 'gro zhes smras pa dang / de dag cang mi zer bar gyur to0/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dad pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag zer ba ni bden te/ de lta bas na ngas rjes su gnang gis long la spu thung rnams ni lhag pa'i gos su byin gyis rlobs shig /spu ring po rnams ni yon bdag gir byin gyis rlobs la bcang bar gyis shig /gleng gzhi'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa drug pa'o// //mdor na/ dbu dang sen mo'i mchod rten dang / /kha dog dkar po mar me dang / /khyim dang mar me snod dag dang / / bal glang btsun mo rta babs 13—261

so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa natum ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ni chos kyis nang par sngar langs nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du 'gro'o/ /ji tsam dus phyi zhig na bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can gyi bsod nams kyi don bstan ②pa'i phyir 'breg ③mkhan bkug nas skra dang kha0spu yangasabregs pa dang / de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dze ta'i tshal du song nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang na bdag gis dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten brtsig par bgyi zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na khyim bdag ngas rjes su gnang gisakhurtsigs shig /des gzhi yangs pa'i gnas zhigashetu mdza' bo dang / phu nu dang /gnyen dag dang lhan cig tu rim gro cher byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu spa ⑩dang sen mo'i mchod rten yang skye bo thams cad kyis blta na sdug pa zhig brtsigs na rdo thal gyis ma byugs pas mi mdzes par gyur nas/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song nas/ zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten skye bo thams cad kyis blta na sdug pa zhig brtsigs na rdo thal gyis ma byugs kyi bar du mi mdzes par gyur na/ ci de la bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang bar mdzod cig dang / bdag gis rdo thal gyis byug par bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na khyim bdag ngas rjes su gnang gis7rdo thal gyis skus shig /des rdo thal gyis bskus nas dri 13—262

dang / bdug pa dang / me tog gis mchod pa byas so/ /mtshan mo mar me med pas mi mdzes par gyur nas/ de yang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra ①dang sen mo'i mchod rten rdo ②thal gyis bskus nas dri dang /byug pa dang / me tog dag gis mchod pa bgyis na/ mtshan mo zhugs mar mashemachis te mi mdzes par gyur na/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang na/bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi0dbu spasadang sen mo'i mchod rten0mchod pa bgyis lasamatshan mo zhugs mar gyi phreng ba bud do zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na khyim bdag ngas rjes su gnang gis7de la mchod pa gyis te/ nub mo dbu sparnyedang sen mo'i mchod rten gyi steng du mar me'i phreng ba bus shig /de nas mar zags nas mchod rten gyi kha dog dkar po yang ma rung bar gyur te/ des bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mar me'i phreng ba 'og tu zhog shig /des mar me'i phreng ba 'og tu bzhag pa dang / khyis mar me 'thungs nas snod kyang khyer ro/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra skyodang sen mo'i mchod rten gyi 'og tu zhugs mar gyi phreng ba bzhag na/ khyi byadag gis mar 'tshal nas zhugs mar gyi snod kyang 'tshal te mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang bar mdzod cig dang /bdag gis zhugs mar gyi khang bu bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 13—263

kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bas na khyim bdag ngas rjes su gnang gis7de ltar byos shig /des mar me'i khang bu dag kyang byas so/ /dbu spasadang sen mo'i mchod rten la ba langasnyedag gis bsnyogasalgepa dang / de yang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas zhabs la phyag byas 0te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra0dang sen mo'i mchod rten brtsigs pa la ba lang dag gis bsnyogasalgepar gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la rjes su gnang bar mdzod cig dang / bdag gis stegs bus bskor bar bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na khyim bdag ngas rjes su gnang gis7bskor bar byos shig /des stegs bus bskor na rta babs med pa dang / mi mdzes par gyur te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten gyi tha ma stegs bus bskor na stegs bu de'i rta babs ma mchis te mi mdzes na/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang bar mdzod cig dang / bdag gis stegs bu'i rta babs bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na khyim bdag ngas rjes su gnang gis7byos shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / des rta babs byas te yo byad thams cad bsogs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la mdza' bo dang phu nu dang gnyen dag bsogs nas mchod pa chen po byas so/ /skye bo mang po dag de lta bu mthong nas rab tu mos te/ de dag dad pa skyes nas de dag gis kyang rnam pa de lta bur bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra 8dang sen mo'i mchod rten dag 13—264

gnas gnas su brtsigs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na ji srid dgyes pa'i bar du bzhugs nas ①rgyal po'i khab gang na ba der gzhongs ②spyad pa spyod cingasargyal po'i khab tu byon to/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das dbus 'gyurakhu'achang nas gzhongasakhuspyad pa spyod cing rgyal po'i khab tu byon to/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da7ka gnas pa na bzhugs par thos te thos nas rgyal po'i mthu chen po dang / yo lang chen pos nang gi btsun mo dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / nang gi skye bo dag dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal bsnyedang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos de lta bu bshad de/ de7thos pa dang rgyal po gzugs can snying pos lha stong phrag brgyad bcu dang lhan cig tu 'jig tshogs su lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /des bden pa mthong nas lha stong phrag brgyad bcu dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das la dus gsum du ltar 'dong ngo / /des dus phyi zhig na dpyid kyi dus la babalgepas shing rtsi dag kyang me tog rgyas/ ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang /rma bya dang / ne tso dang / skeg dang / ko ki la dang / dzi ba dzi ba ka la sogs pa yang skad 'byin par byed pa'i nags stug po de na nang gi btsun mo dag gis bskor cing 'dug 'dug pa las/ de la nang gi btsun mo dag gis gsol 13—266

pa/ lha bdag cag gis nyin re re zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal lta zhing mchi bar mi nus na lhaphunang gi btsun mo dag gi dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra7dang sen mo'i mchod rten zhig brtsig⑧par mdzod cig dang / de la bdag cag gis rim gro bskyed de me tog dang / dri dang / byug pa dang / spos dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis mchod par bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / des bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi0dbu skra0dang sen mo stsol cig dang / bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra rjodang sen mo'i mchod rten nang gi btsun mo ⑦ dag gi ⑧dbus su brtsigashego zhes gsol pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dbu skra nyedang sen mo stsal nas des bste stang dang rim gro cher byas te/ nang gi btsun mo dag dang lhan cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra skyidang sen mo'i mchod rten nang gi btsun mo'i dbus su brtsigs nas/ de la nang gi btsun mo dag gis mar me dang / spos dang / me tog dang / dri dang / byug pa dag gis rab tu mchod pa byas so/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po ma skyes dgra la mi dge ba'i bshes gnyan lha ⑩sbyin gyis sbad nas pha chos can chos bzhin du rgyal po byed pa 'tsho bsnyedang yongs su phral nas bdag nyid rgyal por zhugs so/ /de'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la chos kyi ⑩sbyin pa thams cad gcad par khrims bcas pas sus kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la bya ba mi byed do/ /gang gi tshe bco lnga'i skabs 'byed pa'i dus la bab pa de'i tshe na yang dudabu skra )dang sen mo'i mchod rten la su yang phyag dar dang /mar me dang / me tog dag gis mchod pa mi byed do/ /de nas btsun mo dag 13—266

gis dbu skra ①dang sen mo'i mchod rten la rnam pa de lta bu mthong nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po dran te de dag mi dga' ste/ mya ngan byed cing kyi hud chos kyi rgyal po dang bral bar gyur nas bdag cag gi bsod nams kyang zad par gyur to zhes zer zhing ngu bar gyur to/ /de'i nang nas btsun mo dpal gyi blo gros ma zhes bya ba zhig gis 'tsho ba la ma bltasalgepar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dranasanas dbu skra0dang sen mo'i mchod rten gyi phyag dar byas te mar me'i phreng ba dag phul lo/ /ji tsam na ma skyes dgra khang steng du byung ste bltasalgepa dang snang ba chen po byung ba mthong nas mkhubi ci zhig ces dris pa dang / gzhan zhig gis dpal gyi blo gros mas dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la zhugs mar gyi phreng ba phul lo7zhes smras pa dang / dpal gyi blo gros ma bos nas ci'i phyir rgyal po'i khrims las7'gal bar bya zhes smras pa dang / btsun mos kho mos rgyal po'i khrims dang7'gal mod kyi/ 'on kyang kho mos chos kyi rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i khrims las ma 'gal lo zhes smras pa dang / de khros te 'khor lo 'phangs nas de 'tsho ba dang phral ba dang / de bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon par dad bzhin du dus las 'das pa dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lha'ichaganas bzang por skyes so/ /de'i tshe na lha rnams 'dun sar 'dus so/ /de nas lha'i bu mo dpal gyi blo gros ma dpag tshad kho ra khor yug tu snang ba'i 'od kyis lus bskor nas lha'i 'dun sar song ngo / /de nas brgya byin lha'i dbang pos dpag tshad kho ra khor yug tu rgya cher snang ba'i 'od mthong nas dris pa/ gser gyis lus la su yis bskus/ /pad mo utpal7bzhin 'dra ba/ /dpal ldan mi mtshungs ci las byung / /khyod las 'dir ni 'od byung ba/ /ci phyir khyod 13—267

gdong pad mo kha 'busatu'adra/ /khyod ni gser gyi 'od 'dra ba/ /ci yisa'abras busalha mo bdag la smros/ /gang gi las la byung ba spyod/ /lha mos smras pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ni/ /skye bo rnams kyi mar me ste/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi mtshan mthong bas/ /mun sel de la mar me phul/ /nyon mongs mun pa sel la phul/ /zla ba'i 'odabazer 'dra ba'i 'od mthong nas/ /thub pa gsal ba'i dngos po ste/ /ston pa'i 'od mthu mthong bas na/ /gsung ba mchog la phyag byas pasadu/ /de yi las kyis 'dir skyes te/ /bdag la rab tu gsal zhing mdzes/ /bdag gdong blta na sdug⑥pa ni/ /pad mo zla bzhin rnam par dag /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ e ma'o zhing 'di yon tan can/ /nyes pa thams cad rnam spangs la/ /mtho ris gang du skye ba yi/ /khyod kyis sa bon der btab po/ /gser bzhin spungs la dkar ba yinya/ /rnam pa mchog la sus mi mchod/ /sangs rgyas pad mo kha 'byis bzhin/ /gang du lhag pas bskyed pa7pad mo spyan/ /yan lag mchog rnams 'bar ba ste/ /spyan ni me tog ka ma la dang 'dra0/ /chos nyid kyis lha'i bu pho'am lha'i bu mo yang rung ste/ sum bcu rtsa gsum du skyes nas ring po ma lon par gang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes pa dang / las gang yin pas skyes pa stedzo/ sems 'di gsum skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu mo dpal gyi blo gros mas bdag gang nas shi 'phos zhes bltas na mi las so/ /gang du snyam pa dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i khams bzang por skyes par mthong ngo / /las gang yin zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das la sems rab tu dad pa'o snyam du sems nas/ de nas dpal gyi blo gros mas 'di snyam du bdag gis zhag lon lanyebacom ldan 'das kyi zhal blta b.ralo13—268

mi rigs kyi ci nas bdag gis zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la blta0ba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam bsams nas/ de nas lha'i bu mo dpal gyi blo gros mas dri ma med pa'i⑧'tsher ba'i rna chasani thogs/ lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan te/ lha'i me tog 0la dang / pad mo dang / ku mu da dang / puṇḍa 'isnyika dang / man rākhur ba la sogs pa'i me tog dag gis pang pa bkang nas 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da rgyaka gnas pa ⑧rgya chen pos thams cad 'od kyis ①snang bar byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis mngon par gtor nas chos nyan pa'i phyir song ba dang / yibacom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas ji ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rab tu rtogs par 8'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad de thos nas/lha'i bu mo dpal gyi blo gros mas 'jig tshogs su lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /des bden pa mthong nas brjod par tsobya ba rnam gsum brjod sau/ /btsun pa bdag la 'di ltar ni pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lhas kyang ma bgyis/ sdug pas kyang ma bgyis/ phu nu dang gnyen gyis kyang ma bgyis/ tshe snga ma la ma bgyis/ bram ze dang dge sbyong gis kyang ma bgyis te0/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi⑥mchi ma dang khrag gi rgya mtsho ni bskams⑥/ rus pa'i ri las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo ni bkumatsho/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo ni phye ste bdag ni lha dang mi'i gnas su gzhag go zhes gsol to/ /smras pa/ khyod kyi mthus ni rab gsal ba/ /ngan song lam ste nyes mang po/ /mtho ris bsod nams sgo yang phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam 13—269

yang bdag gis thob/ /khyod la brten nas nyes pa rnams kyang spangs/ /bdag gis rtag tu rnam dag mig kyang thob/ /'phags pa dga' zhing zhi ba'i lam yang thob/ /sdug bsngal mtsho las pha rol bdag rgalatunas/ /'gro ba na yang lha mi rnams kyis mchod/ /skye go⑧'chi ba'i nyes pasnyedang bral brjo/ /srid pa stong du'ang rab tu mthong bar dka'/ /de ring thub pa'i zhal mthong 'bras bu thob/ /btung nas se mo do yang rab tusa'aphyang / /zhabs gnyis la yang phyag byas dga' ba skyes/ /rgyal la g.yas kyi0phyogs nas bskor byas nasal/ /lha yi 'jig rten khams su mngon du song / /de nas lha'i bu mo dpal gyi blo gros ma tshong pasnyikhe rnyed pa bzhin/ zhing pa lo legs pa bzhin/ dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba bzhin/ nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin/ longs spyodakugang dang ldan pas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du 'ongs pa'i longs spyod de nyid dang bdag gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag srod dang tho rangs mi nyal zhing thub pa la brtson zhing 'khod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi der 'od rgya cher snang ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ ci bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das la zhal lta7ba'i phyir tshangs pa 'khor gyi bdag po'am/brgya byin lha'i dbang po 'amanya/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'am/ gang zhig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal ltar mchis zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag tshangs pa 'khor gyi bdag po yang ma yin/ brgya byin lha'i dbang po yang ma yin/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi la sogs pa lhags pa'ang ma yin mod kyi rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i chung ma dpal gyi blo gros ma zhes bya ba zhig gis 8bdag gi 'tsho ba la ma bltas te/ de bzhin 13—270

gshegs pa'i dbu skra ①dang sen mo'i mchod rten la ②mar me'i phreng ba phul ba dngas/ de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras 'khor lo 'phangs te 'tsho ba dang phral lo//de nga la sems mngon par dad bzhin du dus 'das nas sum bcu rtsa gsum du gnas bzang po'i lhar skyes so/ /de nub mo nga'i drung du 'ongs te de la ngas chos bshad nas des bden pa mthong ste bdag gi gnas su song ngo / /de lta bas na dge slong dag bsod nams la 'jigs par ma byed cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni bde ba'ikhutshig bla dgas so/ /mos pa dang / sdug pa dang / shin tu sdug pa dang / yid du 'ong bar gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ bsod nams so/ /dge slong dag khyed cag gis bsod nams ma yin0pa la 'jigs par gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sdug bsngal gyi tshig bla dgas so/ /ma mos pa dang /mi sdug pa dang / shin tu mi sdug pa dang / yid du mi 'ong ba ni 'di lta ste/bsod nams ma yin pa'o/ /dge slong dag ngas yun ring posnyenas kyang mngon par mthong ste/ yun ring po nas bsod nams byas pa/ rnam par smin pa la7mos pa dang / sdug pa dang / shin tu sdug pa dang / yid du 'ong ba dag myong bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag ngas lo bdun gyi bar du byams pa'i sems bsgoms pas bskal pa 'jig pa dang rtas pa7bdun gyi bar du 'jig rten 'dir ma 'ongs so/ /'jig rten 'jig pa'i tshe kun snang ba'i lha'i ris su skyes so/ /rtas pa'i tshe tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang stong par skyes nas der yang ngas tshangs pa dang tshangs chen gyi bdag por gyur nas ngas zil gyis gnon gyi gzhan gyis ma yin no/ /sems can brgya phrag bcu la dbang sgyur7te/ sems can gyi nang na mchog tu bsngags so/ /stong phrag sum bcu rtsa drug gi bar du brgya byin lha'i 13—271

dbang por gyur to/ /brgya phrag grangs med pa'i bar du 'khor los sgyuratuba'i rgyal por gyur te/ mtha' bzhi btul nas rin po che bdun dang ldan no/ /rin po che sna bdun ni rnam pa 'di lta bu yin te/ 'di lta ste/ 'khor lo rin po che dang / bal glangakhurin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / chung masarin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / dmag mi rin po che dang bdun no/ /nga la bu yang stong tshang nas de dag kyang dpa' ba dang / nus pa dang / gzugs su ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde tshar gcod pa ste/de yang ngas 'di ltar rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun chad sa chen po 'di chos kyis btul gyi / dbyug pa dang mtshon gyis gnon cing mi bde ba med par gnas so/ /de'i tshe yang nga 'di snyam du las gang gi 'bras bu rnam par smin pas bdag 'dir mthu che rdzu 'phrul che bar gyur snyam bsams nasaX/ yang 'di snyam du las 'di'i 'bras bu gsum dang las 'di'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa gsum gyis bdag 'di ltar mthu che rdzu 'phrul che0bar gyur te/ gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sbyin pa dang / gdul ba dang / dul ba'o snyam du bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skadashegasungasasnyenas yang ston pas 'di skad gsungs7so/ /dge zhing bde bar 'dod pa yitsho/ /bsod nams rnam par smin la ltos/ /lo bdun bar du dge slong dag /byams par byed pa'i sems bsgoms pas/ /bskal pa 'jig cing rtas 'gyur btso/ /bdun du 'jig rten 'dir ma 'ongs /'jig pa'i tshe na bdag nyid ni/ /'jig rten kun snang dang bar gnas/ /rtas nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na/ /tshangs chen dbang sgyur gnas su yang / /lan bdun gyi ni bar du gnas/ /sum bcu rtsa drug bar du ni/ /lha yi rgyal po 13—272

byas par gyur/ /brgya phrag grangs med bar du yang / /rgyal po rab tu 'jigasatugrags byas/ /rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bor blugs/ /'dzam bu gnas kyi dbang por gyur/ /dbyug dang mtshon gyis ma yin par/ /'jig rten 'di yang thul bar byas/ /chos nyid kyis ni rkyen med par/ /yang dag rjes su slob par gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nas/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor 'di dag tu/ /phyug cing longs spyod che ba der/ /de 'dra'i rigs su nga yang skyes/ /nor rdzas thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /rin chen sna bdun de bzhin te/ /nor dang yo byad mang por ldan/ /rgyal po grags shing 'jigs par gyur②/ /mthu chen de yi rgyu yis ni/ /gang du skyes pa'i mchog tu gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten phan pa can/ /de yis 'di ltar bshad pa 'o/ /ngo mtshar che ba 'disheshes pa/ /de yang rdzu 'phrul chung ma yin/ /mkhas pa gang gis dad mi 'gyur/ /de ste rigs ni dma'asagyur kyang / /de la phan par 'dod pa dang / /mthu rnams chen por mngon 'dod pa/ /dam pa'i chos la bla mar byos/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dran par gyis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad gsungs pa dang /dge slong dag yid mgu ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par ⑦dga'o/ /gleng gzhi'i ⑧nang nas sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa'o// //mdor na/ khyim rmang rta babs bcas pa dang / /ba gam stegs bu7bcas pa ste/ /ka ba mtshal gyis byugs pa dang / /rtsig pa rgya skyegs ri mo britsho/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas 13—273

sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin patubacom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad du de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang na bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu spa ②dang sen mo'i mchod rten la mtha' ma dri gtsang khang gis bskor la rta babs kyang gzugs par bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na khyim bdag rjes su gnang gisakhubyos shig /yang bcom ldan 'das de ste rjes su gnang na bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la ba gam bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khyim bdag de lta bas na ngas rjes su gnang gis byos shig /de nas yangasnyebacom ldan 'das kyis ⑥ de ste rjes su gnang ba ⑦na bdag gis ba gam gyis bskor ba bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na khyim bdag ngas rjes su gnang gis7byos shig /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis7de ste rjes su gnang na bdag gis ka ba dag mtshal gyis byug go zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na rjes su gnang gis byos shig /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de ste rjes su gnang na bdag gis rtsig ngos rgya skyegs kyis bri bar bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na rjes su gnang gis7bris shig /gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa'o// //13—274

mdo ra na/ ba lang so dang tha gu dang / /phreng ba rin chen phreng ba can/ /g.yogatum dang ni snying po dang / /snying po yi ni sgo yang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na⑧ma ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dbu spa'udang sen mo'i mchod rten la mchod pa dang / bkur sti byos shig ces gsungs na/ dge slong dag gis mchod rten la mchod pa byed pa na phur bu0btab nas me tog gi phreng ba btags pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa dag gis mthong nas ci'i phyir 'di ltar dge slong dag gis ston pa'i mchod rtenas phur bu med pa la phur bu btab ces phyas 'dogs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bram ze dang khyim bdag 'phya ba nisprelus te/ de lta bas na mchod rten la phur bus ma btab par ba lang gi so lta bu chung ngus thob shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis ba lang gi so lta bu chung ngus thob shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis mchod rten la khung bu brkos te ba lang gi so lta bu 'dzugs pa la zhugs pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mchod rten la khung bu brkos〈nyete ba lang gi so lta bu ma gzugs par mchod rten rtsig pa'i tshe na tshugs shig ces bka' stsal to//dge slong dag mchod pa byed pa na mchod rten la 'jogs nas me tog gi phreng ba rnams mgur chu'i bre la 'dogs pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gis mthong nas ci'i phyir 'di ltar dge slong dag gis 'di ltar 0ston pa'i mchod rten la rdog pas ri7zhing 'dong zhing 'dong zhes 'phyas 'dogs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 13—275

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'phya ba ni yus te/de lta bas na dge slong dag gis ston pa'i mchod rten la rdog pas rdzi ①zhing ma 'dong shig /de ste mchod pa'i phyir na ni khyim pas 'dzegs shig /de med na dge tshul pas rkang pa gnyis khrus la dris byugakhugam gos kyis dkrisashete 'dzegs shig /de dag kyang med na dge slong gis ston par 'du shes zhog la dus la bab par soms ⑤te de ltar de bzhin du 'dzegs la dri'i duri mo byos shig /mchod rten che ste 'dzeg mi nus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/thag pas thogasashete 'dzegs shig /dbu spasadang sen mo'i mchod rten la me tog gi phreng ba dbul ba7phul ba dang / de dag rnyis te mi mdzes par gyur nas/ khyim bdag skyabs med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la me tog gi phreng ba phul ba dang de dag rnyis 8te mi mdzes nas/ de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la rin po che'i phreng ba dbul lo zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na khyim bdag gnang gis phul cig /dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la bya rog la sogs pa bya rnams 'khod de de dag gi rtug pas mchod rten ma rung bar gyur pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la dbu skra tsodang sen mo'i mchod rten la bya rog la sogs pa bya rnams mchis shing rtug pas mchod rten ma rung bar bgyis na/ de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra0dang sen mo'i mchod rten la g.yog pa'i snying pos g.yog go zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag de lta bas na gnang 13—276

gis g.yoganyepa'i snying pos g.yogs shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / des g.yog pa'i snying pos g.yogs so/ /g.yogs pa de dbyar 'brul zhing mun pas mi snang bar gyur pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la bdag gis dbu skra7dang sen mo'i mchod rten la g.yog⑧pa'i snying pos g.yogs pa de da ltar dbyar gyi chab kyis rul te mun par gyur nas ④mi mngon na de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis chab sgo gdod do ⑤zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na khyim bdag gnang gis0sgo thod cig /gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa'o // //mdor na/ khar ba la sogs mchod rten bya/ /gser dang dngul la sogs pa dang / /rgyal mtshan gyis su 'di la bskor/ /'bru mar la sogs chag chag gdab/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa nashedze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces ⑨bcom ldan 'das kyis de ste gnang na bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi khar ba'i mchod rten bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na gnang gis〈nyebyos shig /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de ste gnang na gser gyi mchod rten bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na gnang gis 13—277

byos shig /de bzhin du dngul las byas pa dang / bee ḍūrya7las byas pa dang /shel las byas pa rgya cher byos shig /de ste yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu thisnyedang sen mo'i mchod rten la rgyal mtshan 'bulasalo zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na gnang gisakyiphul cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal mtshan phul cig ces gsungs pa dang / des ci 'dra ba zhig dbul ba mi shes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal mtshan bzhi ste/ seng ge'i rgyal mtshan dang / chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang / klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / khyu mchog gi rgyal mtshan no/ /de ste yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gisalgebacom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra rjodang sen mo'i mchod rten la 'bru mar gyis chag chag gdab bo zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na khyim bdag gnang gis7chag chag thob shig /yang gsol pa/ de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skrasadang sen mo'i mchod rten la ldong ros kyis byug go zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na khyim bdag gnang gis yugs7shig /ji ltar ldong ros kyis byug pa de bzhin du tsan dan gyis byug pa yang rgya cher byos shig /gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa7ste/gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo gsum pa rdzogs sto// // mdor bsdus par na(ste/ sgo leb dang yang de ltar dbyar/ /drug sde dag dang btso blag mkhan/ /gzhong pa gtan pa de bzhin te/ /kun tu rgyu dang 13—278

skyin po dang / /chag chag btab paturung ba dang / /de bzhin mdo rnams bsdus par brjod②/ /mdor na/ sgo leb dang ni pus 'khyudasnyedang / /dra ba dang yang gzugs 'khor dang / /zhing dang 'bras dang skye ba dang / /nor las skyes dang gos rnams so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis sgo leb la lag gzungs byos shig ces0gsungs na ci 'dra ba las bgyi / u pā li rin po che ma gtogs pa'o/ /yang gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis ⑦lus 'khyud ②chongs shig ces gsungs na/ ji ltar7bcang bar bgyi0 / u pā li skud pa sna bdun te/ bal gyi dang /ldum bu sha na ku'i dang / ras kyi skud pa dang / zar ma'i dang / rtswa du gu la'i dang / ko tamanyeb ma'i dang / srin bal rnams so/ /yang gsol pa/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dra ba byos shig ces gsungs na ji lta bu las bgyi/u pā li rnam pa bzhi ste/ rtswa mun dza'i7dang / bal ba dzasnyidang / zar ma'i dang / ras kyi skud pa las so/ /yang gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dra ba'i gzugs 'khor byos shig ces gsungs na/ ji lta bu las bgyi/ u pā li rin po che ma gtogs pa'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan ⑩du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig dad cing des〈nyel dge bar sems pa zhig 'dug ste/ de na gcer bu pa'i dge bsnyen pa'i bu mo chung mar blangs te des de la bzang mo sangs rgyas ni ston pa/ chos ni rgyal mtshan/ dge slong ni yon gnas te/ de dag la bya 13—279

ba byos shig ces bsgo ba dang / de g.yos kun tu spyod de g.yo med pa ltar jo bo'i sras legs kyis7de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes smras pa dang / khyim bdag de'i khyim du nyin gcig bzhin dge 'dun gyis bskos pa'i dge slong rnams bshos gsol lo/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na khyim bdag de ri brags kyisagrong gzhan zhig tu don cungasazad cig yod par gyur te/ des chung ma de la bsgo ba/ bzang mo kho bo yul 'di zhes bya ba'i ri ①drung gi grong du don cung zad cig yod par gyur te der 'grosage/ khyod kyis de bzhin du sbyin gnas rnams la bshos gsol cig ces byas pa dang / de g.yos kun tu spyod de/ g.yo med pa ltar jo bo'i sras legs kyis bshos gsol lo zhes smras jo9/ /de song nas bdag gisashechung ma la bsgo zin na dge slong la yang bsgo'o snyam du sems te de gtsug lag khang du song nas/ dge skos kyi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te smras pas/ 'phags pa bdag yul 'di zhes bya ④ba'i ri brags kyi ⑩grong der don cung zad cig mchis par gyur te bdag der mchis khyod kyis de bzhin du dge 'dun gyis bskos pa'i dge slong gtang bar gsol/ des khyim bdag de bzhin du legs kyis gtang ngo zhes smras so/ /de nas khyim bdag des ston pa dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la phyag byas te ri brags kyi0grong der song ngo / /dge 'dun gyis bskos pa'i dge slong dag phan tshun tshe dang ldan pa khyim bdag de'i chung ma ma tedad pas gdugs tshod las snga zad du 'dong ngo zhes gtam byas na de dag gdugs tshod las sngar dong ba dang / khyim bdag de'i chung mas mthong nas 'phags pa khyed ③ha cang sngar byon te ci de dag cigi sug las gzhan ma mchis sam zhes nyes pa ngor brjod pa dang / de dag spa gong nas cang mi zer 13—280

bar gdugs tshod bab kyi bar du 'khod nas zan zos te dong ngo / /des phyi de nyin mo zas dag snga zad du7sbyar te stan bting nas bya ra byed cing 'dug go/ /dge slong dag gdugs tshod bab khar dong ba dang / desalgemathong nas dpyasashepa dang / dge slong dag gcig lasnyigacig tshe dang ldan pa gnyis kur yang 'phyas⑤/ ji lta bu yang rung zos la dong nas tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la bsgo ste phyin chad 'dir ni dge slong dag kyang mi 'dong bar bya'o zhes smras nas zan zos te gtsug lag khang du dongasnyingo / /dge slong deshedag gis ji lta bur gyur pa bzlas pa dang / dge slong dag phyis der mi 'dong bar gyur to/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag de slar 'ongs nas bzang mo yon gnas dag bsgo ba bzhin du bshos gsol tam zhes dris pa dang / des jo bo'i sras nyi ma gnyis shig /gshegs te bshos gsol nas ma gshegs par gyur to zhes smras pa dang / de skad thos nas gtsug lag khang du song ste/ 'phags pa ci'i slad du dge 'dun gyis bskos pa'i dge slong rnams ma btang zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis ji ltar gyur pa thams cad bzlas so/ /des 'phags pa de ltar na bdag gi zhing las skye ba'i bya'abras tsode 'phags pa rnams la dbul gyis tsokhyed 'dir gsol cig cesanesmras pa dang / des khyim bdag mi 'tshal lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ma btsos pa'i 'bru len par bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo zhes smras pa dang /de cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis dge 'dun gyi phyir 'bras long la the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste 'a/ mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan 13—281

zhig gis gang zag gzhan ①zhig gi ②phyir gnas khang zhig brtsigs te bzhag ⑧nas de'i nang du mal stan dag kyang mang du(phul te bzhag pa dang / dge slong dag gis mdzod chen po'i nang du gcig tu bsdus te bzhag giX/ /dge slong des khyim bdag de la smras pa dang / des 'phyas 'dogs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim bdag de 'phya ba ni lus te/ de bas na mal stan ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin du spyad par bya ste/ der gang dag gnas pa de nyid dbang ngo / /de nas yang khyim bdag des gnas khang der gos kyi rnyed pa mang zhig phul ba dang / de la mal stan 'ged pasashedage 'dun gyi rnyed pa'i nang du brubs pa dang / dge slong des khyim bdag de la smras so/ /de yang 'phyas 'dogs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim bdag de 'phya ba ni yus te/ yon bdag gi nidabang du byas long ⑨la dge slong dag khyim gyi ⑩rnyed pa de ni der gang gnas pa de dag nyid dbang ngo / /de dag gis dge slong de la 'thob pa gzhan dag ma byin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / der yang (7dge 'dun gyir chagatogs pa'i rnyed pa de dag las kyang byin cig /des kyang de la longs spyod du gyis la the tshom du ma byed cig /gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dang po'o// // 'dul ba gzhung dam pazha bam po sum bcu tsasngo)drug pa/ mdor na/gang zhig gang du gnas pa dang / /dge slong des kyang de rung ba/ /las kyang 13—282

sar7pa'i yo byad dag /zas dang mar me rung ba 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis gtsug lag khang du gnas khang dag brtsigs nas der mal stan kyang phul/ rnyed pa dag kyang bcas pa dang / dge slong dag mal stan de dag kyang dge 'dun gyi nang du brubs te rnyed pa yang spyir bgos so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dngos po nges par 'gyur ba la ma bskyodakhucig /de na nges par gnas pa gang yin pa de dag gis spyadakhupar bya ste/ rnyed pa yang bdag gir byos shig /dge slong dag gis de la rnyed pa gzhan ma byin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnyi ga yang byin la ci bder spyod par bya ste/ 'on kyang dge slong rnams la ji ltar rgan rims su bskokhubar bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan du yod pa na 0khyim bdag gzhan zhig 'dug pa de'i drung du bsod snyoms pa gzhan zhig der song nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gnas la bzhag go/ /dus phyi zhig na yang nor las bsod nams su bya ba'i dngos po bdun po'i yon tan brjod pa dang /khyim bdag de rab tu dad par gyur nas/ 'phags pa bdag gis kyang nor las byas pa'i bsod nams kyi dngos po cung rgyazad cig bgyi'o zhes smras pa dang /bsod snyoms pa des/ khyim bdag de bzhin du byos shig ces smras pa dang /'phags pa ci zhig bgyi/ dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang byos shig /'phags pa bdag la kār ṣā pa ṇa nisnyemachis na/ bsod nams bya ba'i grogs dag ma 13—283

mchis so/ /khyim bdag kār ṣā pa ṇa khyer te shog shig /ngas khyod kyi bsod nams kyi grogs bya'o zhes smras pa dang / des kāratuṣā pa ṇa rnams byin nas las sar7pa byed pa yang bskos so/ /des kār ṣā pa ṇa rnams gnas khang gi nang du bcug ste bzhag nas las cung zad tsam yang ma brtsams so/ /khyim bdag des 'di snyam du bdag gi gtsug lag khang ci 0tsam zhig byas pa ltar ④'gro'o zhes bsams nas de der 'ongs na/ cung zad tsam yang ma byas par mthong ngo / /des bsod snyoms pa la ⑤'phags pa ci'i phyir las dag ma brtsams zhes dris pa dang / las sar pa byed pas 'dir yo byad dag dgos so zhes smras pa dang / khyim bdag gis bdag gis kār ṣā pa ṇa phul ba de la las sar pa0bya ba'i yo byad dag ci'i phyir mi sbyaral/ des smras pa/ khyim bdag ngas phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi rdzas ma rung bar ji ltar bya zhes smras pa dang / 'phags pa de la nongs pa ma mchis kyis7gyis shig /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste khyim bdag gis bsgo na las sar pa'i yo byad de dag las sbyor cig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /des de las sar pa'i yo byad sbyar te/ bsod snyoms pa des las sar pa yang byas nas bsod snyoms slong du song ba dang / khyim bdag des mthong nas 'phags pa khyod ni bsod snyoms spyod na bdag gi gtsug lag khang gi las sar pa su bgyid ces smras pa dang / khyim bdag sems can thams cad ni zas la gnas na ci nga ltogs bzhin du khyod kyi gtsug lag khang gi las sar pa byed dam/ los kyang bsod snyoms la 'jug mod ces smras pa dang / des 'phags pa de lta na las sar pa'i rgyu 13—284

de las bshos su0mdzodakhuces smras pa dang / des7ci'i phyir na ngas phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyir bsngos pa bza' zhes smras pa dang / des 'phags pa de la gnod pa med kyis zo shig ces smras nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'dasasnyel gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / de ste khyim bdag gis bsgophun de nyid la zan du zo shig /de la the tshom du ma byed par bza' bar gyis shig /de nas bsod snyoms pa de zas mi bzang ba zos pas gram par gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis zas ngan pa ma za sheg ces gsungs pa dang / zas bzang dukhuza bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zas bzang por yang ma za bar ji ltar gtsug lag khang gzhan gyi bza' ba'i thang de bzhin du zo shig /snum bgatsam rnyed nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ji ltar gtsug lag khang gzhan na snum bag rnyed pa de ltar bya ste/ de la the tshom du ma byed cig /bsod snyoms pa des las sar ⑩pa'i yo byad dag blta ba'i phyir 'bru mar bsod snyoms su blangs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal payi/ las sar pa'i rgyu las 'bru mar nyos shig /yo byad gzhan rnams jisnyedagos pa yang de las sbyar bar bya ste/de la the tshomacham byed cig /gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'o// //mdor na/ dge 'dun rnams kyi mal stan ni/ /bla gab med par mi bgo dang / /tshon dang lhung bzod las byed mi bgo ste/ /srod 'das mtshan mo mal stan bgo mi bya/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i 13—285

tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyinyekun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis dge 'dun gyi mal stan bgos nas tshon gyi las byed gos 'khru 'tshed/ lhung bzed kyi las byed pasakhugos rnams mes tshig /dri ma can du yang gyur cing /tshon gyis kyang ma rung bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gisaphubacom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi0gos gyon la0tshon gyi las ma byed cig /lhung bzed kyi las dang /gzhan yang shing gsheg pa'i las dag ma byed cig /byas na⑧ 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro// gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ yang drug sde dag gis dge 'dun gyi gos rnams gyon nas bla tsogab med par tshon rtsi'i las byed cing char bab bzhin du 'dug nas gos ma rung bar gyur te/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge 'dun gyi ⑩gos rnams gyon la 8bla gab med par char bab bzhin du tsom 'dug shig /'dug na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ 8drug sde dag gzhongs 8spyad pa spyod pa las ri brags kyi ()grong gzhan zhig tu mtshan mo srod 'das te phyin pa dang /ri brags kyi ⑩grong de na gtsug lag khang zhig yod pa der 'ongs nas dge slong dag gis so sor bshes pa'i gnas su ngal bso ba la zhugs so/ /de dag gis smras pa(nye/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ngal bso ba ni phyis byasayi/ mal stan bged pa bos la rgan rims bzhin du mal stan dang / gnas khang bgos0shig /de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa dge slong kha cig nyal nas srod kyang 'khor na gnod 13—286

par byas te ①ci rung gisal/ gang du bshes pa'i laganas su nyol cig dang /sang nam langs ④nas gnas khang dang mal stan ⑤bgo bar bya'o zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag ston pa bzhugs bzhin du khyed kyis rjobastan pa dag zhigashepar bya'am/ gnas khang dang mal stan dag nged cag dang rgan rims su bgosakhushig ces smras pa dang / mal stan 'ged7pas gnas khang dang mal stan dag 'gede pa la zhugs nas gsar bu rnams la ma bgos par nam nangs nas drug sde dag cung zad cig nyal nas/ nang par sngar langs te mal stan dag slar phul nas dong ba dang / dge slong dag gis ci'i phyir na mal stan dag slar phul/ de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag nged cag mchod rten la phyag 'tshal du 'ongs te da ni slar 'dong ngo zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag de ltar na khyed cag gis mtshan rangs dge slong dag gtses te ci bya zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag bstan pa brtan par bya ba'i phyir byas kyi/ nged la nyes pa ci yod ces smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis dpyas btags so/ /de ltar gyur pa de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na mtshan mo srod 'khor phan chad stan dag ma bgo shig /de ste glo bur du nub mo 'ongs na gang mdza' ba'i gnas su 'dug la/ de ste nam langs nas kyang 'dug par gyur na gnas khang yang bgos shig /mal stan yang byin cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ drug sde dag gzhongs 8spyad pa spyod cing dong nas ri brags kyi grong gzhan zhig tu phyin nas ri brags kyi grong de na 13—287

gtsug lag khang zhig yod pa der phyin nas dge slong dag gis gang mdza' ba'i gnas su bzhag ste/ de nas mal stan bgo bar byed pa na rgan rims kyi khri'u'i steng du de dag nan gyis 'dug nas de dag la rgan rims kyis kyang bslang bar ma nus so/ /gang gi tshe mal stan dag bgos pa dang / de'i tshe rgan rims kyi khri'u de dag lhan cig spyod pa dang / nye gnas rnams la byin nas mal stan ma thob pa rnams 'phya bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong gsar bu rnams 'phya ba ①lus te/ de bas na rgan rims kyi khri'u dag dang /chung ngu na stan dag kyang rgan rims su bgos7shig /gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo bzhisapa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa'o// //mdor na/ snam phyi sa dang bkru ba'i sa/ /gci ba'i sa dang rkang pa bkrus//phyi ba snod dang gzar bu dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' dur ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag ⑤snam phyi sa'i sgo na 'chag cing gtam zer zhing 'dug nas/ dge slong dag la gnod par byed de/ tshe dang ldan pa dag skad cig sdod cig /nged cag rgan rims su bya'o zhes smras nas de dag gis de'i nye 'khor du ston cing kha ton yang byed/ btso blag gi las kyang byed nas/ dge slong dag snam phyi sar 'dong du yang ngo tsha nas bshang gci la sogs pa yang bag yangs su byar med/ ji ltar 'ongs pa bzhin nang du 'jug tu yang med par de dag gis bgags0pa dang / de dag thams cad nad du 13—288

gyur te de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong dag gis snam phyi sar song nas gtam zer zhing ma 'dug shig /de'i nyen koranyedu ston par yang ma byed cig /klog par yang ma byed cig /kha ton yang ma byed cig /btso blag gi las kyang ma byed cig /dge slong dag gis snam phyi sa na gtam zer zhing 'dug gam/ rimakhubazhin du byed dam/ de'i nyen korasadu ston tam/ kha ton byed dam/ klog gam/ btso blag gi las byed na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag bkrus na0'khru zhing 'dug pa ma zin par drug sde dag gis nged rgan no zhes zer nas bslang ngo / /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag gis bkru sar dge slong bkru ba ma zin pa ⑤ma bslang shig /bslang0na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag gci sar song ba dang / phyis drug sde dag der 'ongs te/ nged cag rgan gyis ji ltar rgan rims sushe'ajug go zhes smras pa dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rgan rims su gci sar ma 'jugashepar ji ltar 'ongs pa'i rim bzhin du zhugs shig /dge slong dag gis ji ltar rgan rims bzhin du 'jug na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag rkang pa 'khru zhing 'dug pa la/ bkru ma zin par rkang pa 'khru ba'i 'og gzhi rgan rims su bya'o zhes te khyer ba dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa 13—289

dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge slong dag gi larkang pa bkru ma zin par rkang pa bkru ba'i gzhi ji ltar rgan rims ②bzhin dushem bkur cig /dge slong0gis dge slong gi rkang pa bkru ba ma rin par rkang pa bkru ba'i gzhi rgan rims bzhin du khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag gdong phyi bas gdong phyis ma zin par rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer nas gdong phyi ba khyer ba dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyisarkyubaka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge slong dag gi gdong phyi bsnyem zin par rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slongashegis dge slong dag gi gdong phyi ba ⑩ma zin par gdong phyi ba rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du snod dang / gzar bu dang /kha gzar la sogs pa yang rgyas par sbyar bar bya'o/ /gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa'o// //mdor na/ bume pa dang ni gzhong0khung dang / /lhung bzed nag po btung phor dang / /spu gri'i bdar dang sen bcad patso/ /spang tsher dang ni rkang rten no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'aphur ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag btso5)blag gi las byed pa ma zin par dge 'dun gyi tshon gyi bum pa rgan rims bzhin du bya'o zhes zer te khyer ba dang de dag 'phya bar gyur nas/de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom 13—290 /rtsa

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis btso blag gi las byed pa ma zin par dge 'dun gyi tshon gyi bum pa dag rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slongatugis dge slong dag gi btso blag gi las byed pa ma zin par dge 'dun gyi tshon gyi bum pa rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /bum pa la ji lta ba desabazhin du gzhong khung la yang de bzhin no/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag zas za ba ma zin par lhung bzed nag po rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer nas khyer ba dang de dge 'phya bar gyur nas/ ③dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dugis dge slong dag zan bza' ba ma zin par lhung bzed nag po rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slongasnyigis dge slong dag zan bza' ba ma zin par lhung bzed nag po rgan rims su khyer na de dag 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong deg zan za zhing skom ༷phyed tsam 'thungs pa dang / btung ba'i phor7bu rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer nas khyer te de dag 'phya bar gyur nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dgashegis dge slong dag zan za zhing skom phyed tsam 'thungs pa la btung ba'i phor bu rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slong dag gis dge slong dag zan za zhing skom phyed tsam 'thungs pa la phor bu rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag spa phyed tsam bregs pa dang / spu gri yang rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer te khyer ro/ /de dag 'phya bar gyur nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /13—291

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge slonganyeskra dang kha spu phyed tsam bregs pa la spu gri rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slong dag gis dge slong dag skra dang kha spu phyed tsam bregs pa dang spu gri rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag skra dang kha spu 'breg ②pa'i spu gri rnon por bya ba'i⑧bdarakyil phyed tsam bdarasnyib dang /bdarabargan rims su bya'o zhes zer te khyer ba dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur to//de ltar gyur pa rgyadage slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge slong dag gi⑧spa dang kha spu 'breg pa bdar ⑨la phyed tsam bdar yinas rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slong dag gis dge slong dag yispa dang kha spu 'breg 8pa'i spu gri bdar 0la phyed tsam bdar 8ba la rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag sen mo phyed tsam bcad pa dang /sen mo bcad pa rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer nas khyer ro/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis sen mo phyed tsam bcad ⑩pa la sen mo gcod pa rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slong gis dge slong dag gi sen mo phyed tsam bcad pa las sen mo gcod pa rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag sna spu phyed tsam btogs pa dang / sna spu btog pa'i smang tsher rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer te khyer ro/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sna spu phyed 13—292

tsam btogs pa la sna spu btoganyepa'i spang7tsher rgan rims su ma bkur cig /khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag dge 'dun gyi khri rkang rten du bcas pa la nyal zhing 'dug pa dang / rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer te khyer ba dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge 'dun gyi khri rkang rten can gyi steng du nyal ba la rgan rims su ma bkuranyecig /dge slong dag gis dge slong dag khri rkang rten can gyi steng du nyal zhing 'dug pa la rkang rten rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa'o// // mdor na/ gtanasapa skud pa gnyis pa dang / /gri dang khab dang blang ba dang / /gzhan yang 'di ltar ma zin par/ /bslang bar bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis shing leb kyi steng du sbyar ma dang / stod g.yogs dang / mthang gos dag dge 'dun gyi shing leb kyi steng du phyed tsam bting ba dang / rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer te khyer ro/ /de dag 'phya bar gyur nas/ ⑦dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge 'dun gyi shing leb kyi steng du sbyarasam dang stod g.yogs dang / mthang gos dag phyed tsam bting ba la ⑨dge 'dun gyi shing leb de rgan rims su ma bkur cig /13—293

dge slong dag gis dge slong ①gi dge 'dun gyi shing leb kyi steng du sbyar ma dang /stod g.yogs dang mthang gos dag phyed tsam bting ba lasadage 'dun gyi shing leb rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag gi chos gos dge 'dun gyi skud pas phyed tsam drubs pa dang rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer nas khyer ba dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur te / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong0gis dge slong dag gi chos gos dge 'dun gyi skud pas phyed tsam btsems pa las durgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slong dag gis dge slong dag gi chos gos dge 'dun gyi skud pas phyed tsam btsems pa las durgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag gi chos gos dag tshon las phyed tsam btso blag byas te/ dge 'dun gyi btso blag gi srad bu la bres pa dang / rgan rims bzhin⑧bya'o zhes zer te khyer ro/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge slong dag gi gos phyed tsam btso blag byas nas/ dge 'dun gyi btso blag gi srad bu la bres pa rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slong dag gis dge slong dag gi gos phyed tsam btso blag byas pa dge 'dun gyi btso blag gi srad bu la bres pa rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag gi7chos gos dge 'dun gyisnyigis phyed tsam dras pa dang / rgan rims su bya'o zhes zer te khyer ba dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur te(3/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /13—294

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge 'dun gyi grisatuchos gos phyed tsam dras pa rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slong dag gis dge slongasagi chos gos dge 'dun gyishegris phyed tsam dras pa rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dgasrechos gos dge 'dun gyi khab kyis phyed tsam drubs pa la rgan rims bzhinasabya'o zhes zer nas khyer ba dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur te/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge slong dag gi chos gos dge 'dun gyi khab kyis phyed tsam drubs pa rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slong dag gis dge slongasnyigi chos gos dge 'dun gyi khab kyis phyed tsam drubs pa rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge slong dag spa phyed tsam bregs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi skra bzed pa'i ras rgan rims bzhinashebya'o zhes zer te khyer ba dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge slong dag skra phyed tsam bregs pa dang /dge 'dun gyi skra bzod pa'i ras rgan rims su ma bkur cig /dge slong dag gis dge slong dag skra phyed tsam bregs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi skra bzed pa'i ras rgan rims su khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis gang yang rung ba'i gnas su gzhan dang gzhan gyi las ma zin par dge 'dun gyi stan gyi steng na ⑩'dug pa dang / rgan rims bzhin bya'o zhes zer nas bslang ste btang〈nyenas de dag 'phya bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong 13—295

dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dgatudage slong dag gis gang yang rung ba'i gnas su gzhan dang gzhan gyi rgyalas ma zin par ②dge 'dun gyi stan gyi ༷steng du 'dug pa la rgan rims su bya'o zhes ma bslang shig /dge slong dag gis dge slong dag gang yang rung ba'i gnas su gzhan dang gzhan gyi las ma zin bzhin du dge 'dun gyi stan gyi steng na 'dug pa la rgan rims su bya'o zhes bslang stesnyibatang na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi'ikhunang nas sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa drug pa'o// //mdor na/ mu stegs kun tu rgyu ba dang / /mngon mtshan bdag shi'ubyin pa med/ /yid ches par ni gzung ba lnga/ /gnyer phyir nye7spyod dge slong ma'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi tshe yul mnyam dka'i rgyal po gzugs can snying po mkhas pa can lha stong phrag brgyad bcu dang / yul mnyam dka'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag brgya phrag stong dang bcas te bcom ldan 'das kyis bden pa la bkod panyede'i tshe na rgyal po'i khab tu 'di ltar kye khyed caganyergyal po'i khab na gnas pa dang / yul so so nas lhags pa'i skye bo mang po dag nyon cig /rgyal po nga'i yul na su yang rkun po ma byed cig /gang gis byas pa de ngas yul dang phral te gtang ngo / /nor bdag la ni nga nyid kyi mdzod dang bang ba nas sbyin no zhes dril chen bsgrags so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dar la bab pa lta bu'i mdo sdes 13—296

btul ba de'i tshe na des kyang mnyan du yod paranye'adi ltar rgyal po nga'i yul na su yang rkun po ma byed cig /gang gisakhunga'i yul du rkun po byas pa de chad pa gsadakhupas bcad la/ nor bdag la ni nga nyid kyi bang ba dang mdzodakhunas sbyin no zhes dril chen bsgrags so/ /de'i tshe na gang yul mnyam dka' na gnas pa'i rkun po rnams dang gang yul ko sa la na gnas pa'i rnams de'i sa mtshams kyi bar du dong nas 'khod do/ /yul mnyam dka' na gnas pa'i rkun po rnams dang / yul ko sa la na gnas pa'i0rnams thams cad sa mtshams kyi bar du dong ste 'khod nas/ 'gron pa mang po dag 'dzoms so zhes de skad kyi sgra kun du grags so/ /de dag gisakhuthos nas yul mnyam dka'i7'gron pa mang po bsel dang lhan cig yul ko sa lar 'dong ngo / /yul ko sa la nas kyang yul mnyam dkar de bzhin du 'dong ste/ ji tsam du dus phyi zhig na yul mnyam dka' nas 'gron pa mang po bsel dang bcas te/ yul ko sa lar dong ba dang / de dag gang gi tshe mtshams las 'das nas yul ko sa lar phyin pa de'i tshe de nas ded dpon gyis smras pa/ kye ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ni mi srun la gtum zhing khro ste dpa' zhing mthu dang ldan no zhes grag gisatso/ gal te 'gron pa mang po dang bdag cag rnams bcom na yang bsab par nus kyis0/bsel ba de dag slar khye shig ces smras pa dang / 'gron pa mang po dag gis smras pa/ de ltar na de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes smras nas bsel de dag slar bkye'odu/ /rkun po rnams kyis bya ra btsugs te bsdad pa dang / bya ra bas bsel ba slar log pa mthong nas/ des kye bsel ba rnams slar log gis 'gron pa mang po gzhom mo zhes smras nas 'gron pa mang po de dag shing sā 13—297

la'i dgon par phyin pa dang / bcom mo/ /de la tshong pa kha cig ni bsad/kha cig ni bros so/ /de la bros pas mgo rdul gyis gang bar byas te rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi drung du song nas/ lha la bdag cag ni tshong pa lags na/ khyed kyi yul du phyin na tshong pa ma lags par gyur to/ /ci byas/ lha bdag cag ni rkun pos bcom mo/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis 'phags skyes po la bka' stsal pa/gzhon nu myur du rings par song la rkun po dang nor rnams zung ①la 'on cig ces bsgo ba dang / lha de bzhin du bgyi'o⑧zhes nas dmag dpon 'phags skyes pos yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal las mnyan te/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa bal glang gi tshogs dang / rta'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs rnamasasnyego cha bskon te myur bar rings su shing sā0la'i dgon par dong ba dang / rkun po dag de'isnyibar dgon pa na shing sā0la stug po'i nang du zhugs te bag yangs su nor bgod ⑦cing 'khod pa dang /'phags skyes pos de'i steng du brdzis te/ de dag gisanyerkun po kha cig ni bsad/ kha cig ni bros/ kha cig ni gson por bzung ngo / /de nas rkun po'i g.yul las rgyal te/ rkun po dang ⑨bcom pa'i nor rdzas dag khyer te/rgyal po'i drung du song stekho/ rkang pa la gtugs nas/ lha 'di dag ni rkun po'inyenor ro zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos tshong pa dag la kyenede dag bdag bdag gi nor dag ngo shes par byos la slar khyer cig ces bsgo ba dang / de na mu stegs kun du rgyu ba dang / dge slong dag kyang bcom pa'i nang du gtogs nas rgyal pos de thams cad phrogs pa'i nor rdzas slar byin pa dang / kun du rgyu ba'i rang gi gos btsag gi nang du btsos pa dang / skyo dge slong dag gi yang khyer ro/ /13—298

dge slong dag gis bdag cag gi gos btsag gi nang du btsos pa ngo ma shes nas de dag kun du rgyu ba dang / lhan cig tu7thabakumo byung ba dang / kun du rgyu ba mang po desnyedag gis de dag khyer ba dang / rgyal po'i drung du song ste/ lha bdag cag gi gos btsag gi nang du btsos pa mu stegs can kun du rgyu bas 'tshal te slar mi ster tosazhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos mu stegs kun du rgyu ba de dag bkug stetsho/ kā'ikhu'aphags pa dag gi gos dag ci'i7phyir bkur gyis7slar phul cig ces bsgo ba dang / de dag gis lha btsag gi nang du btsos pa 'di dag ni bdag cag gi gos so zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos 'phags pa dag khyed kyi gang yin pa shes par gyis la khyer cig ces smras so/ /dge slong dag gis gcig nas gcig tunyephyung ste bltas pacadang / kha cig ngo shes te lha 'di dag ni bdag cag gi gos so zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos mu stegs can kun du rgyu ba dag la e ma'o mu stegs can 8kun du rgyu ba 'jab bur〈nyerku ba rkun ma yin na/khyed cag ni rkun po chen po yin no zhes smras pa dang / de dag lan med nas cang mi zer bar 'khod do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ kye 'phags pa khyed cag gis da phan chad chos gos la mngon mtshan bya ba'i rigs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rgyal po de skad zer ba lus te/ de bas na chos gos dgatsomangon mtshan thob shig /kha chag dang 'or thabs su drubs shig /sgro gu yang thogs shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis mngon mtshan thob shig ces gsungs na/ dge slong dag gis mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos gos kyi mthar snag tsha'i thig le byos shig/13—299

gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis de'i rigs mnyam pa zhig las chung ma zhig blangs nas/ de dang lhan cig tu rtse dga' yongs su spyod7do/ /de dang lhan cig tu rtse dga' yongs su spyod pa las de dus phyisazhig na chung ma sems can dang ldan par gyur nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das pa dang / bu khye'u zhig btsas te zhag bdun gsum nyi shusnyegacig gi bar du btsas pa'i btsas ston chen po byas so/ /de rigs dang mthun par ming yang ④btags nas ⑤de bsrings bskyed de cher gyur pa dang / dus phyi zhig na de'i ma dus las0'das so/ /khyim bdag des kyang chung ma zhig blangs nas de dang lhan cig tunyertse dga' yongs su spyod do/ (rtse dga' yongs su spyad pa las dus phyi zhig bu pho gsum zhig btsas te/ de dag kyang rigs dang mthun par ming btags so/ /'di ltar dgra'i7nang na chen chun 'thab pa gcugs che ste/ mos ma shi ba'i bu khye'u chen po de la rtag par gtses pa dang / de ma dran nas yi chad de yul gzhan du song ba las legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ngo / /de nas dus phyi zhig na khyim bdag de na bar gyur nas/ de rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dag gis sman byas kyang de'i nad tha gi bar ma gyur nas/de na ba'i sdug bsngal gyis ring po mi thogs par dus 'da' bar shes nas/des khyim tshes dag bsogs te 'dus nas de'i nang du bu la smras pa bu dag khyed cag gi phu bo7chen po dge sbyong shākya'i sras kyi nang du rab tu byung ba de yang khyed kyis nor skal byin ces smras nas/ bsags pa kun mtha' zad par 'gyur/ /mtho ba'i mtha' ni 'jig par 'gyur/ /'dus pa'i mtha' ni 'gyes par 'gyur//13—300

chos kyi mtha' ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /dus kyi chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /de'i bu ljongs spyod cing 'dug pa des bdag gi pha dusatu'adas so zhes thos7te/ de yang 'di snyamasadu bdag song la ma yar mo dang nu bo dag gi mya ngan bsang gisalgechos bshad du 'gro'o snyam du sems nas/ de ji tsam dga' ba'i bar du gzhongs spyadasnyide/ mnyan du yod pa gang na ba de logs su gzhongs spyod cing song ngo / /rim bzhin du spyod cing mnyan du yod par phyin nas lam gyi ngal bsos te bdag gi khyim du 'ongs pa dang / nang gi skye bo dag gis mthong nas ngus te ngu ba'i〈sgra dag khyim tshes dag gis thos nas de dag 'dus te kha cig ni skad phyung ste ngu / kha cig ni mig mchi mas gang zhing 'dug nas/ so so'i skye bo dag ni 'dod chags dang ldan pas gnyen dang bral bar gyur pasashemya ngan gyis mig mchi mas gang ngo / /de yang ngu ga khyer zhing 'dug go/ /de na rgan mo gzhan zhig gis bu khyod kyi pas ni nor skal byin par nged kun gyis kyang thos na ma ngu shig /skye ba yod na 'chi bar 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang / des cung zad tsam zhig gi bar du sems shing 'dug nas/ des ma yar mo dang nu bo dag la chos bshad do/ /de dag mya ngan cung zad sangs nas/ de dag gis khyod kyi nor skal dag long shig ces smras pa dang / des bsams pa bcom ldan 'das kyis nga 'das nas byin pa ni med do zhes gsungs na/ ji ltar blang snyam du bsams nas/ tshe dang ldan pa dag nga ni rab tu byung ba la nor rdzas kyis byar med pa'i steng du bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang nga 'das nas byin pa med do zhes gsungs kyis / khyed cag nyid khyer cig ces smras pa dang / de dag gis nyes pa ngor brjod pa/ 'phags pa long la sbyin pa yang byin cig /13—301

bsod nams kyang byos shig /de la nyes pa ci zhig yod ces smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag la smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim pa la ni re ba yod/ rab tu byung btul ni re ba med pa'i phyir te/ khyim pa dag la ni nga 'das na byin cig pa gikhukhyim bdag gi ste brtsan⑧rna/ /rab tu byung ba la ni de lta bu med do/ /de bas na khyim pas desabur bsams te byin pa longasashig /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la bya ba'i phyir te de la the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong dgasalci ba'i ri lu dang /so shing dang / bkru ba'i yo byad dang / ba lang gi lci ba rnams 'chag sa dang khyams dang sgo khang dag tu bor nas ljongs spyad pa spyod du 'dong ngo / /de dag la dge slong dag gis the tshom skyes nas mkhuspyad do/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yid gcugs pa rnam pa lnga las ni longasashig /mdza' ba dang /yid 'dres pa dang / bla ma dang / mi 'gyur ba dang / thos na dga' bar 'gyur ba'i7ste/ yid gcugs pa rnam pa de lnga la ni spyad par bya ste/ de la the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma zhig blangs nas/ de dang lhan cig tu rtse dga' yongs su spyod do/ /de la rtse dga' yongs su spyad pa las dus phyi zhig na chung ma sems can dang ldan par gyur nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam 13—302

dgu 'das pa dang / bu mo zhig btsas nas de zhag bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du btsas pa'i btsas ston chen po byas nas rigs dang mthun paratuming btags te②/ de bsrings bskyed de cher gyur pa dang / khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis de bslangs7te/ de rdzangs la sogs pa brdzangs7te btang ngo / /dus phyi zhig na khyim pa de dus 'das nas de khyo dang bral ba'i mya ngan gyis gdungs nas legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ngo / /de dus phyi zhig na mu ge byung nas bsod snyoms ①slong zhing 'dug pa dang / de bsod snyoms spyod pa las srang zhig tu de'i phas mthong nas/ des smras pa/ bu mo da ltar gang na ji ltar 'tsho zhing 'dug ces smras pa dang / des pha mu ge byung nas bdag rab tu bkres shing 'dug go zhes smras pa dang / des bu mo7de ltar na khyod rab tu ma byung na ni ngas khyed la mi 'dod bzhin du sbyin na/ da bsod snyoms ma byed par bdag gi khyim du zan za zhing dbyar mo khang du song zhig /des khas blangs nas7de grogs gcig dang gnyis kyis zos shing dbyar mo khang du song ngo / /zhag du ma zhig gi bar du der zos nas/ bu bsod snyoms pa gnyis ni zas sbyin par mi nus kyis8/ khyod gcig pu 'dir zan zos shing song shig ces smras pa dang / des pha bcom ldan 'das kyis gcig pur grong dune'agro bar ma gnang ngo zhes smras pa dang / de cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong ma dag la smras pa dang / dge slong ma dag gis dge slong la smras nas8/ dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nasaphye/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ltar na ngas gnang gis dus 'di 'dra ba la ni dge slong mas dge slong ma'i dge 'dun la gnyen 13—303

dang / lhan cig 'dre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa gsol7cig /gsol pa ni 'di ltar gyis shig /stan bting ba la gaṇḍikhubardungs7te/ dge slong ma'i dge 'dun dag 'dus shing 'khod pa dang / ji ltar rgan rims su phyag byos la/rgan rims kyi mdun du pha 0gu'am stan nang tshangs can gyi steng du 'dug nas thal mo sbyor la tshig 'di skad ces smos shig /gson cig 'phags ma'i dge 'dun ma rnams bdagakyiming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ 'di 'dra ba'i mu ge'i dus la bab nas bsod snyoms bslang ba7yang mi nus na/ 'phags ma'i dge 'dun ma laltebadag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'phags ma'i dge 'dun ma las gnyen dang lhan cig tu 'dre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa gsol na/ 'phags ma'i dge 'dun mnyedag gis bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gnyen dang lhan cig 'dre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa gsol cig /brtse ba can brtse ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge —slong ma gcig gis gsol ba gyis la las byos shig /gson cig 'phags ma'i dge 'dun ma rnams/ dge slong ma ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di 'di ltar mu ge'i dus la bab ste/ 'phags ma'i dge 'dun ma dag tshulas gnyen dang lhan cig tu 'dre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa gsol na/ de ste 'phags ma'i dge 'dun ma 8rnams kyis dus la bab cing bzod na 'phags ma'i dge 'dun ma rnams kyis gnong 8la/ 'phags ma'i dge 'dun gyis dge slong ma ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di gnyen dang lhan cig tu 'dre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa stsol cig /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las kyang 'di bzhin du bya'o/ /gson cig 'phags ma'i dge 'dun ma rnams/ dge slong ma ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di 'di ltar mu ge'i dus la bab ste/ 'phags 13—304

ma'i dge 'dun mnyernams la gnyen dang lhan cig⑧'dre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa gsol te/ de las 'phags ma'i dge 'dun ma rnamasasakyis dge slongakhum ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di 'di ltar ⑤mu ge'i dus la bab na gnyen dang lhan cig du'adre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa gsol na/ 'phags ma rnams las gang la dge slong ma ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mu ge'i dus la bab ste/ gnyen 'dunasnyedang lhan cig tu 'dre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa stsalashebar bzod pa ni cang ma gsung shig /mi bzod pashāni smos shig /'phags ma'i dge 'dun gyis dge slong ma ming 'di zhes bgyi bas gnyen dang lhan cig tu 'dre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa stsal te de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge slong mas gnyen dang lhan cig tu 'dre bar nye spyod kyi sdom pa dge 'dun ma dag gis byin par gyur na/ gcig pu gnyen gyi khyim du zas za bar gyis la de la the tshom du ma byed cig /nam mu ge'i tshe ni rjes su gnang ngo / /de ma yin par ma gnas shig /mu ge ma byung bar gnas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi'i nang nas sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa'o// //mdor na/ bskyi ba la ni rnam pa gnyisabya/ /ras la yang ni rnam gsum ste/ /nyo bar yang ni 'dod pa dang / /sderaphubasdus par ni gyur pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'abyur ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong gzhan zhig gis khyim bdag cig las kār ṣā pa ṇa zhig bskyis pa dang / de dus kyi mtha' zhig tu ci zhig gis dus 'das nas/ dge slong de ji ltar dus0'das pa khyim bdag des thos so/ /13—305

dge slong de ji ltar dus 'das pa khyim bdag des thos nas gtsug lag khang du song ste shes bzhin du dge slong dag la dris pa/ 'phags pa 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dge slong de gang na mchis/ de dag gis smras pa①/ bzhin bzangs dus 'das so/ /'phags pa des bdag gi kār ṣā pa ṇa zhig bskyis te 'tshal to/ /bzhin bzangs de ni dur khrod du bskyal gyis7der song ste dos shig /'phags pa khyed kyis de'i lhung bzed dang / chos gos bgos na bdag gis ji ltar dur khrod du song ste bda'/ khyodasakyis stsol0cig ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim bdag des ni legs par smras te/de'i nor las bskyis pa dge slong dag gis byin cig /de dag gisasnyigang nas sbyin pa mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos yod pa las byin cig /dge slong de dag gis lhung bzed dang chos gos de dag byin pa dang / lhung bzed dang chos gos0de dag ma 'dod nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshongs la byin cig /dge slong dag gis de dag thams cad byin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ji tsam blangs pa de tsam du byin la lhag ma bgos shig /mnyan⑧du yod pa na dge slong gzhan zhig gis khyim bdag cig las kār ṣā pa ṇa zhig bskyis pa dang /de dus kyi mtha' zhig tu ci zhig gis 'das pa dang / dge slong de dag gis snga ma bzhin du lhung bzed dang chos gos btsongs nas de la byin no/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa der bdag las 'di tsam zhig 'tshal te/bdag la ni 'di las ma stsal gyisabya/ gzhan yang stsol7cig ces smras pa dang /13—306

de lta bur ①gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de la de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos ni 'di las med do zhes sgosashig /de ste yid mi ches na go bar gyis shig /go bar bsgo yang mi btub na de la dge 'dun gyi'am/ gang zag gzhan gyishelas ni ma sbyin cig /rigs kyi gzu bo rnams kyis go bar bsgo lasathong shig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na⑤/ dge slong zhig gis gos 'tshong ba las ras shig rin ma byin par blangs pa las dge slong de dus 'das nas/ dge slong de dus 'das so zhes gos kyi bdag po des thos nas/ de gtsug lag khang du 'ongs te shes bzhin du dge slong rnams la ⑦'phags pa dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di ga la mchis zhes dris pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dus 'das so/ /'phags pa des bdag las ras shig rin⑧sbyin par byas te khyer ro/ /bzhin bzangs de dur khrod du bskyal gyis7der song la dos shig /'phags pa de'i chos gos dang lhung bzed ni khyed rnams kyis bgos na/bdag ci'i phyir dur khrod du song ste bda'/ khyed rnams kyis byin cig de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams gos 'tshong ba 'di smra ba ni bden gyis de ni byin cig /dge slong rnams kyis de'i ras nyid byin pa dngasnyides 'phags pa rnams bdag la des rin thang 'di tsam du 'tshal to zhes smras pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis de nyid tshongs la byin cig ces bka' stsal pa dang /dge slong rnams kyis de btsong bar brtsams pa dang snga ma'i rin thang du ma lon nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhag mtshwa)ni chos gos dang lhung 13—307
