bzed rnams tshongs la byin cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na①/ dge slong zhig gis tha ga pa la ras 'thag pa'i phyir skud pa dang rngan pa byin pa las/ dge slong desnyedus 'das pa dngas/ dge slong rnams kyis tha ga pa la bos te bzhin bzangs khyod la dge slong ming 'di zhes bya bas ras 'thag 0pa'i phyir skud pa dang rngan pa byin pa de slar phul cig ces smras pa dang / des 'phags pa rnams bdag gis de la ras sbyin⑧par byas kyiX/ skud pa dang rngan pa ni ma lags so zhes smras pa dang /dge slong rnams kyis de ji ltar bya ba ma shes nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyisasnyedage slong rnams la bka' stsal pa ⑨tha ga pa smra ba ni bden gyis ⑩ras su long shig ces bka' stsal 8pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis phra mo las bkug pa dang / de la 8'phags pa rnams bdag gis de la sbom po sbyin par byas so zhes smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong de ni dus 'das kyis ji ltar byin pa de lta bu long shig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong zhig gis gos 'tshong ba la kār ṣā pa ṇa byin te/ ras shig byin cig ces smras pa dang / dge slong de dus 'das nas dge slong rnams kyis gos 'tshonganyeb la bos te/ bzhin bzangs khyod la dge slong ming 'di zhes bya bas ras kyi rin zhig byin pa de 'on cig ces smras pa dang / des 'phags pa rnams de la ras su sbyin par bgyis so zhes smras pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis de la ji ltar bya ba mi shes so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 13—308

'das kyis dge slong rnams gos 'tshong ①ba de smra ba ni bden gyis②/ ras su long shigasaces smras pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis phra mo bkug nasashedes 'phags pa rnams bdag gis de la sbom po dbul bar bgyis so zhes smras pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong de ni dus 'das na/ ji lta bu byin pa de bzhin0long shig/ // 'dul ba gzhung dam pazha bam po sum bcu rtsa bdun pa/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ drug sde rnams 'jig rten pa la grags par gyur te/gang su yang rung nyo ba dang / btsong ba de dag de dag gi drung du dong nas/'phags pa dngos po 'dis ci ri zhes 'dri'o/ /de nas mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gnyis shig gcig ni gos nyo/ gcig ni 'tshong ste/ de gnyis rin thang gi gtam smra zhing 'khod pa'i steng du nye dga' bo phyogs der 'ongs pa dang /de gnyis kyis 'phags pa nye dga' bos bcad pa brtsan no/ /gcig na re yang de bzhin du brtsan par bya'o zhes smras nas/ de gnyis kyis tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bo la 'phags pa gos 'di'i rin (nyeji tsam zhes smras (9pa dang /des gcig la gsang ste bzhin bzangs khyod nyo ba'am bya'on te 'tshong ba zhes dris so/ /des bdag ni nyo ba'o zhes smras pa dang / nye dga' bos 'di ni kār ṣā pa ṇa nyi shu ri'o zhes smras nas/ gnyis pa la yang gsang ste/ bzhin bzangs ci khyod nyo ba'am 'on te 'tshong ba zhes dris pa dang / des 'phags pa bdag ni 'tshong ba zhes smras pa dang / nye dga' bos 'di ni kār ṣā pa ṇa bzhi bcu ri'o zhes smras pa dang / de gnyis gsang ste bslus nas yang gnyi ga'i mngon sum du khyed cag ji lta bur legs pa de lta bur byos shig ces smras so//13—309

de la ganganye'atshong ba des 'di ni kār ṣā pa ṇa bzhi bcu ri'o⑧zhes smras pa dang /gang nyo ba desashebadag gisaphudad pa dang yid ches pa las 'di ni kār ṣā pa ṇa nyi shu ri'o⑧zhes smras pa dang / des smras pa/ khyod kyis dad pa dang yid ches pa su yin/ 'phags pa nye dga' bo yin no/ /bdag cag gnyis la des shes bzhin du gtses te/ bdag la des kār ṣā pa ṇa bzhi bcu ri'o zhes smras so/ /des smras pa/ bdag la yang des shes bzhin du gnyis7ka la spurnyuba'i phyir mdor na des gnas ngan len la mtshungs par spyod kyis phyin chad dgos pa yod na yang de la mi 'dri'o zhes smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas7/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams khyim bdag de gnyis 'phya ba ni yus kyisakyi/ de bas na dge slong rnams kyis dngos po gang la yang rin thang ma gcod cig /khyim pa rtsod pa'i drung na ma 'dug shig /dge slong gang gis dngos po la gang yang rin bcad dam/khyim pa rtsod pa'i drung na 'dug na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos po gang la yang dge slong gis rin thang ma gcod cig ces gsungs na/ dge slong gis chos gos dang / gos nyo bar 'dod pa'i phyir tshong dus su song ste/ der khyim pa dang lhan cig tu kār ṣā pa ṇa'agyi/ pa ṇa gcig gam/ pa ṇa bzhi'am/ bzhi cha'i phyed dmazha bzhi cha'i phyed kyi phyed bskyod pa dang / des khros te 'phags pa bdag cag ni spogs pa yin na/khyed cag kyang lhag par spogs byed pa chen po'o zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol tebya/ mo bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams de dag de skad zer ba ni yus kyis / de 13—310

lta bas na dge slong rang gis nyo bar ma byed cig bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rang gis nyo bar ma byed cig ces gsungs pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis ji ltar nyo bar bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gtsug lag khang na gnas pa'i dge bsnyen pha la tshol cig /gtsug lag khang na gnas pa'am/ dge bsnyen dad pa med la nges par nyo bar 'dod par gyur na/gtan la bab pa'i tshig lan gnyis lan gsum du smra bar bya ste/ kār ṣā pa ṇa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis bskyed par mi bya'o/ /dge slong7gis nyo bar 'dod kyang rung nyo bar mi 'dod kyang rungakhuste/ kār ṣā pa ṇa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis tshig lan gnyis lan gsum du 'das par bskyed cing smra na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi phyir rin thang bskyed kyang nyes pa med do/ /gleng gzhi'ishesgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa'o// // mdor na/ rtsa bas 'tsho ba du las par mi ⑤bya ste/ /rnam pa bzhi ni mi bgo lko/ / bsrung bshedang yang mang du bya/ /ca co mang po 'byin pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ⑧ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying pos dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams la bza' shing drung stong dang 0ldan pa'i kun dga'i ⑩ra ba zhig phul ba de'i tshe na/ dge slong rnams kyis 'bras bu zos nas phyal bar bor bas na mda' lta bu'i nags su gyur to/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na rgyal po lam de phyogs su phyin pa dang / des de dag mthong nas/ des blon po rnams la 13—311

mda' lta bu'i nags su gyur pa'i kun dga'i ra ba ①'di su'i ②zhes smras pa dang / blon pos7lhasabaza' shing drung stongasnyedang ldan pa'i kun dga' ra ba dag lhas0'phags pa rnams la phul ba de nyid 'di lags te/ de dag gis 'bras bu zos nas phyal bar bor bas na da ni mda' lta bu'i nags su gyur toshezhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ kye 'phags pa de dag 'di la zhal ta dang las mi byed dam/ des lha de dag bsam gtan dang kha ton la zhugs pas 'di'i sug las dang zhal ta mi bgyid do zhes smras pa dang rgyal po cang mi smra bar 'dug gos/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rtsa bas 'tsho ba la phyal bar ma dor bar las gyis shig /dge slong rnams kyis sus las bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal patso/ gnas 'cha' ba rnams kyis byos shig /de rga bsalgen de dag gis las bya bar mi nus te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun thams cad kyis las byos shig /de las kha cig ni rid rgas 'khogs/ kha cig ni na bas las byed mi nus/drug sde rnams ni byed du mi btub pas na las ma byas pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'khor rnam par dbye bas 'khor rnam par phye la skal skal du gos te las byos shig /dge slong rnams lung nod pa dang / klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa rnams dang sde de la zhugs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de 'ba' zhig la yang 'jug par mi bya ste/ la lar so0shing bza' bar bya/ la lar gdong bkru bar bya/ la lar ni rkang pa bkru bar byas/ dge slong de dag gis de 13—312

bzhin du las byas nas 'bras bu rgyal te smin par gyur pa dang / ji tsam na dge slong dag cig glo bur du 'ongs pa dang / de dag gis7'bras bu rgyalakhuzhing smin pa de dag mthong nas/ de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa'i⑧rnams bdag cag kyang a mra smin pa'i 'bras bu bza' bar bgyi na kho bo cag kyang dbang ngam zhes smras pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis 'di dag ni bdag cag gis sngar bgos na bzar ga la yod ces smras pa dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ glo bur du 'ongs pa rnams la yang0byin cig /dge slong rnams kyis bgos pa'i lhag ma la byin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams rnam pa 'di bzhi ni mi bgo ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun thams cad dbang ba dang / mchod rten thams cad dbang ba dang / nad pasathams cad kyi rung bshedang / rin thangashenar mar bza' ba thams cad do/ /de bas na dge slong rnams kyisalgem bas 'tsho ba rnyed dam/ 'bras bu'am/ me tog la sogs pa gang zag rnams kyis yongs su spyod pa bzhin du yongs su spyod cig /de dag mngon sum du dbang ba yin pas na zhal ta byos la me tog dang 'bras bu rnams ni dge 'dun la brims shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis mngon sum du dbang ba yin pas so sor zhal ta byos la me tog dang 'bras bu rnams dge 'dun la brims7shig ces gsungs pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis de dag zhal ta byas pas me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa dang / de dag yal bar bor nas me tog dang 'bras bu rnams rkun po rnams kyis khyer ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis srung ma zhog shig ces 13—313

gsungs nas/ dge slong rnams kyis nyung ngu zhig bzhag ste/ de nyid nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mang du 'khor la7de dag las phyed nis sngar zan zosazhig /bcom ldan 'das kyis shing thogasa.a mra'i 'bras bu smin pa dge 'dun la brims ⑤sheg ces gsungs pa dang /gang gi tshe smin par gyur pa de'i tshe srin bus zos par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas 'cha' ba rnams kyis so sor brtag par byos shig so sor brtag par byed pa de dag ca co che nas dge slong rnams kyis de las bzlogashekyang de dag mi btub pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'phags pa'i mi smra bas so sor brtag par bya ste ca co ⑧ma smra shig /smra ⑨na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa'o// //mdor na/ rung bar bya dang dge tshul pha/ /bdag gis byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /blangs shing byin len byed pa dang / /yang na de ltar bstan pa dang / /mtshams bcing ba7dang stong pa dang / / thab mo dang ni rdzogs pa 'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis shing thog a mra'i 'bras bu brims shig ces gsungs pa byadage slong rnams sus brim pa mi shes nas0/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rung bar byed pas brims shig /rung bar byed pa med na dge tshul phas byos shig /dge tshul pha med na dge slong rang gis 13—314

lag pa bkrus tenyebyin len byos lasaso sor rung b.ras gyis te brim par byos shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rang gi lag pa khrus la byin len byos te so sor rung bar byos la brims shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / 'bras bu mang pos gang ba'i skonakhubu gcig pus ma theg nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim pas kyang grogs byos la gnyi gas brim par bya stekhya/ gang khyim pas7brims pa de ni byin len du bya'o/ /gang dge slong gis brims pa de ni byin len bya mi dgos so/ /a mra gzhan zhim por grags pa zhig yod na/ de dag bsres la rim la7brims pa dang / thams cad thob par gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag so sor brims shig ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis a mra gang zhim por grags pa so sor brims shig ces gsungs pa dang / drug sde rnams kun dga'i ra bar dong nas de dag gis a mra zhim por grags pa de rang gis blangs nas/ gtsug lag khang du 'ongs te byin len byas shing zos pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag a mra zhim po de dag ma brims na5)ci'i phyir zad dam zhes dris pa dang / srung ma rnams kyis de dag brim du ga la mchis0/ drug sde rnams kyis blangs te gtsug lag khang du dong nas byin len byas te zos so zhes smras pa dang / dge slong rnams 'phya'o rdzu/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ dge slong rnams gang su zhig sngar blangs la phyis byin len byed na nyes pa'i dmigs su 'gyur te/ de bas na dge slong gis sngar blangs pa las (stephyis byin len mi bya'o snyam du mkhyen nas/dge slong dag drug sde rnams kyis duni mi rigs par byas kyis 0de bas na dge 13—315

slong rnams sngar blangs pa las phyis byin len ma byed cig /sngar blangs pa phyis byin len byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong rnams me tog dang /'bras bu dang / bca' bshedang / gzhan yang bza' ba dang / btung ba 'brim ②pa la mdzub ②mos bstan cing 'di byin cig /'di dag byin cig ces smra/ de0yongs su zos pa dang / brimasapa ma snyoms par gyur nas/ 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i dge slong kha cig gis dpyas pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'phya ba ni yus te/ de bas na dge slong gis mdzubashemos 'di byin cig /'di dag byin cig ces bstan cing bza' bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis mdzub mos 'di byin cig 'di dag byin cig ces bstan cing zos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /btungasnyeb med pa ni drod chung bas smin pa 'dod pa dang / ༷drod che bas ma smin pa 'dod pa'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ drug sde rnams ljongs spyad pa spyod pa na ri brags kyi ⑩grong gzhan zhig gi gtsug lag khang zhig tu phyin na 8de'i dge slong deg nyin par spyod pa'i phyir dong ste/ gtsug lag khang de stong par lus pa dang / drug sde po rnams dga' bo dang nye dga' bo gtsug lag khang stong pa mtshams ma bcad pa 'dir bdag cag rnams kyis 'dir gnas na ji ltar gnas par bya/ mtshams bcad kyis tshur shog ces smras nas/ de dag gis legs kyis7de bzhin du bya'o zhes smras nas/ de dag gis mtshams bcad ma thag tu snga na gnas pa'i dge slong dag lhags pa dang / drug sde po rnams kyis de la 13—316

ngal sonyeshig ces byas na/ de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams 'di ltar khyed cag ni glo bur du lhags pa'o/ /nged ni snga nas gnas pas na⑧khyed cag la bdag cag gis ngal sosashig ces bya ba'i rigs so zhes pa dang / drug sde po rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag gis kyang mtshams bcad do/ /de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis kyang0sngar mtshams bcad do zhes smras nas/ dge slong de dag cikhumatshams snga ma brtsanakhunam/ 'on te phyi ma brtsan ⑦zhes te nithe tshom skyes pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong glo bur ba rnams gtsug lag khang du zhugs ma thag tu stong par mthong na yang mtshams gcad par mi bya'o/ / lam gyis ngal bso ste shin tu brtags nas snga na gnas pa med na gdod mtshams gcad par bya'o/ /gzhan du na gcad par mi bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dze ta'i tshal gyi sgor khyim pa gnyis shig thab mo byung ste/ de na dge slong gcig 'dus pa de la gcig gis dbang bcugs nas/ des de la rgyal po'i pho brang du che bzhi byas te cig shos po chad pas bcad pa dang / des0de la 'phya'o/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nasadu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim pa de 'phya ba ni lus kyisaci/ de bas na dge slong rnams thab mo byed pa'i drung na ma 'dug par che bzhi yang ma byed par byol te song shig /dge slong thab mo byed pa'i drung na 'dug cing che bzhi byed na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su 13—317

bcad pa bcu pa'o/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo bzhi pa rdzogs so// //mdor bsdus pa'o①/ /byang chub sems dpa'isnyigazugs rnams dang / /yul bskorasridang ni yon gyi snod/ /kun 'dus pa dang stegs bu dang / /rnga chen 'khor lo tha ma 'o/ /mdor na/ drang srong chen pos gnang bar gsungs pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugasasredang / /stegs bu dang ni rgyal mtshan dang / /ba dan lcags kyi ka ba 'o/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'dasasnyebyang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugs bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gisakhubyos shig /bcom ldan 'das de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i ⑦gzugs la rgyal mtshan gyis bskor ro zhes gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis skorakecig /⑨ bcom ldan 'das7de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis gzugs stegs bus bskor ro zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khyim bdag gnang gis stegs bus bskor cig /yang de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis gzugs la lcags kyi ka bas bskor ro zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis skor cig /yang de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis lcags kyi ka ba'i steng du ba dan gdags par bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag rgenang gis thogs shig /gleng gzhi'i sgo lnga pa'i 13—318

mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dnganyepo'o// //mdor na/ byang chub sems dpa'i yul bskorashedang / /de bzhin rgyan dang byug pa dang / /khyogs dang shing rta ba dan dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan snyan gyi rgyan②/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyis ⑦yul bskor ༷bar bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis skor cig /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan med de mi mdzes nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin pas de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na/ bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs la rgyan 'bul7lo zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis7phul la rkang pa'i rgyan dang rna ba'i rgyan la sogs pa yang phul cig /de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs la dri'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis brgyan par byos shig /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs grong khyer du rkang pas khyer ba dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs khyogs las grong khyer du bkur bar bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis khyer cig /khyogs las khyer yang mi 13—319

mdzes par gyur nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs shing rta las bkur bar bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khyim bdag gnang gis ①de bzhin du byos shig /shing rta yang ba dan dang gdugs7med pas mi mdzes par gyur nas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis shing rta'i steng du ba dan dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas brgyan par bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gisashebargyan par byos shig /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs la me tog gis snyan gyi gong ma brgyan na0mi mdzes par gyur nas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de ste bcom ldan 'das kyisasnyiganang na bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyi dbu'i snyan gyi gong du me tog gi rgyan dbul lo zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis0phul cig /gleng gzhi'i sgo lnga pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'o// //mdor na/ yon phul ba dang yon dbul ba/ /de bzhin phreng ba'i snod rnams dang / /rol mo rnams kyang mi dgag cing / /rgyan tshogs rnams kyang mi gzhigashego/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyi zhabs la yon dbul lo zhes gsol pa dang / bcom 13—320

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis7phul cig /de'i mchod ston ②gyi tshe yul sna tshogs na gnas pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / gzhan yang bltasabar 'dod pa'i phyir phal mo che lhags pa rnams kyis de la yon dbul ba mngasalgepas rnyed pa de sus bkur ba dge slong rnams kyis mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis bkur bar bya'o zhes pa dang / dge slongakyiganas brtan0dag gis khyer ba dang mi dga' ba skyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas bca' bar byed pa dang / gzhan yang gzhon pa dang rgan pa rnams kyis bkur bar bya'o/ /dge slong gnas brtan dang /gnas brtan dag gis ni bsrungasnyibar byos shig /yon phul ba dang / me tog dang / gos la sogs pa shing rta'i thog tu bzhag pa dang / kha cigashe lhung ba ma byin par len pa dag gis thugs thub tu khyer nas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis shing rta'i steng du phreng ba'i snod bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khyim bdag gnang gis byos shig /dge slong rnams kyis rol mo rnams kyang ma zhi/skye bo rnams kyang so sor ma gyes par gzugs kyi rgyan rnams sbas pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa dag gis 'phags pa dag bdag cag ji ltar dad pa de bzhin du ma dad pa yang skyes te/ kye ma'o khyed kyis rol mo rnams kyang zhi la/skye bo mang po yang so sor gyes nas gzugs kyi rgyan rnams bgrol na ci nyes zhes dpyas pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze 13—321

dang / khyim bdag rnams 'phya ba ni lus te/ detubs na rol mo rnams kyang ma zhi/ skye bo mang po yang so sor ma gyes par dge slong rnams kyis gzugs kyi rgyan ma rtulasacig /brtul na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo lnga pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa'o// // mdor na/ kun 'dus pa dang dus ston dang / /dpyid zla tha chungasasnyezhal bsro dang / /lo lnga dang ni drug byas la/ /mchod ston chen po tha ma 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis yul so so na gnas pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang /dge bsnyen ma rnams mthong ba dang / yid dga' ba skyes nas des bsams pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams 'di ltar dus su sbyin pa ni0rnam pa lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ glo bur du 'ongs pa dang / 'dod pa rnams la sbyin pa byin pa 'di ni sbyin pa'i dus dang po'o/ /nad pa dang nad g.yogakhul sbyin pa byin pa 'di ni sbyin pa'i dus gnyis pa'o/ /lo nyes shing phongs brel ba la sbyin pa byin pa 'di ni sbyin pa'i dus gsum pa'o/ /gang su la yang rung ste lo thog gsar pa dang / 'bras bu gsar pa dang / gsar thog de dag des thog mar tshul khrims dang ldan pa yon tan dang ldan pa la byin zhing /de'i 'og tu bdag za ba 'di ni sbyin pa'i dus bzhi pa'o/ /gang su yang rung ste/rlung ldang ba'am/ yul rmugasalgepa'am/ char 'babashepa'am/ grang ba la sogs pa de lta bu'i rnam pas rlung ldang ba dang / yul rmugs pa dang / char 13—322

'babanyepa dang / grang ba la zan nam/ skyo ma'am/ thug pa'4/ skom la sogs pa de dag phyir byung7ste/ dge 'dun la 'bul zhing 'phags pa 'di zos na lus kyang mi gsher/ chos gos la yang char gyis mi phog ste bde ba la reg cing gnas par 'gyur ro zhes sbyin pa 'di ni sbyin pa'i dus lnga pa'o/ /de ltar na 'di ni yul so so na0gnas pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang zha dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma la sogs pa lam gyishengal ba rnams la de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis de dag 'dus pa'i zas sbyar ⑧ro snyam du bsams te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste drung du phyin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go//phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das glo bur du mchi bsheyul so so na gnas pa la sbyin pa byin pa 'di ni sbyin pa'i dus dang po zhes bya ba nas/ snga ma ltar bde ba la reg par gnas par bya ba 'di ni dus kyi sbyin pa lnga pa'o zhes bya ba'i bar du sbyin pa'i dus lngar gsungs na/ da 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i mchod pa chen po la yul so so nas mchis pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma la sogs pa slo7bur du mchis pa lam gyis yongs su gdungs pa de rnams la de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis 'dus pa de dag gi zas sbyar ro zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis sbyor cig /bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das zla ba gang la btsas zhes zhus pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag dpyid zla tha chungs la 13—323

btsas so/ /de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi pho brang gi zhal bsro bar7sbyar ro zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis7sbyor cig /yang bcom ldan 'das lo du lags nas dbu spa bregs zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag lo lnga lon pa na'o/ /de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis bcom ldan 'das lasalo lnga zhing lan gcig mchod ston sbyar roX/ /zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khyim bdag gnang gis0sbyor cig /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gtsug phud lo du lags nas bzhag ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal paX khyim bdag lo drug na'o/ /de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis gtsug phud kyi mchod ston sbyar ro zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis7sbyor cig /yang zla ba gang la bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes mngon du chud ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag dpyid zla tha chungasashela'o/ /de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i grib ma la gzugs bzhugs pa la mchod ston chen po sbyar ro zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis sbyor cig /gleng gzhi'i sgo lnga pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa'o// //mdor na/ rtswa stan dang ni the tshom dang / /snga phyi dag tu 'dug pa dang / /ca co dag dang lam rnams dang / /gnyi dung dang rnga rdung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas 13—324

bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa natum ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'ikhur ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dus pa'i zas sbyor cig ces gsungs pa dang / dge slong mang po rnams stan med par gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rtswa'i stan sbyar te der 'dug la bza' bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rtswa'i stan la 'dug par bya'o zhes gsungasasnyepa dang / dge slong rnams zan zos pa dang the tshom skyes nas rtswa stan te khyer0te dong nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stan khyer te ma 'dong bar phung por byos te zhog la/ gang gi tshe dus ston yongs su rdzogs par gyur bsnyede'i tshe thams cad 'or0cig /dge slong rnams ston mo'i dus la snga phyir 'dug pas gzhan zan zos te song bar gyural/ gzhan gdod 'ongs pasam thob ste brel bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis7go rims ji lta ba bzhin du 'dug shig ces gsungs so/ /dge slong mang po 'dus pa dang ca cor gyur pas dus ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dus brjod par byos shig ces gsungs pa dang / de dag de nyid du dus la bab bo/ /dus la bab bo zhes brjod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gaṇḍi brdung bar byos shig /de ltar yang gzhan dag la gsal bar ma gyur nas/ de la bcom ldan 'das //bye/ //de/ ///mi //lnga/ //// ((skyon//bye/ //sdushā //sa/sa sngar gatha chung ngu rdungs la/ sa ga rdungs ga sa gsungs / /de ltar yang gzhan nyin par gnas par song ba rnams kyis ma thos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dung kha bsdoms te bus la rnga yang rdungs shig ces gsungs so/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo lnga pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa'o// //13—325

mdor na/ der ni rnga yang brdung bar bya/ /de nas shing rta dbyung ba dang / /dngos po byung dang rnyed pa dang / /ji ltar tshul bzhin bsgo bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa nasadze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'akhub na bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gaṇḍikhudang dung kha bsdoms pa dang rnga rdungs shig ces bka' stsal na/ de dag gis gaṇḍikhubardungs pa'i rjes bzhin brdungs pa dang / nad pa dang las la gtogs pa rnams latuganod par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gi tshe nad pa rnams zas mnos zin par gyur la/ las byed pa rnams kyang zas zos zin pa de'i tshe na gaṇḍi7dang dung kha bsdomasalgepa dang / rnga rdungs shig /mchod ston zin kyang so so na gnas pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen tsodang / dge bsnyen tsom la sogs pa so sor ma dong ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis 8shing tsos phyung shig dang de dong nas rang 'dong ngo zhes gsungs pa dang / mchod ston de'i tshe dge slong rnams kyis rnyed pa grub pa de ji ltar bgo ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ji ltar rgan rims su mnyam par gos shig /dge slong mang po 'dus pa de dag ca co byed pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bcu zhing gcig tu bgo bar bya'o / /brgya zhing gcig tu'o0/ /de'i 'og tu stong zhing gcig tu rnyed pa bgo bar byos shig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa gal te bcu'i nang nas gcig dus las 'das na gum pa'i yo byad su dbang zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ u pā li de ste bgo ba'i 0tshe dus 'das na shi ba'i yo byad dge 'dun 'dus pa 13—326

dbang gis spyir gos ①shig /'on te bgos nas ②dus 'das na ni dgu po rnams kyis 'thob bo/ /de bzhin du brgyadasastong sde rnams la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /gleng gzhi'i sgo lnga pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa drug pa'o// //gleng gzhi'i sgo lnga pa rdzogs te/ gleng gzhi rnams rdzogs sto// // rkyang pa'i sgo'i mdor na/ phyag ni thog mar bya ba dang / /gnyis pa'i snod rnams ma nges pa/ /gsum du yo byad rnams kyang ste/ /de ni rkyang ⑤bar btags pa 'oX/ /mdor bsdus pa nargya/ phyag 'tshal ba dang gsing ma dang / /de bzhin 'jog dang nyal dang khyi/ /de bzhin btung phor bu ram shing / /de bzhin mar dang rtsa bsasdong po7rnams/ /mdo rnams bsdus par gsungs pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong gnyis shig rnam par gdon mi za ba'i gtam smra ba las gcig la gcig tshig rtsub ponyesmras nas de la gzhon nus rgan po la rab tu spyos te/ de gnas khang du zhugs te 'dug pa dang / gzhon nus bdag gis rgan pa la rab tu spyos kyis song ste bzod parasnyegasol lo snyam bsams nas/ des de'i gnas khang du song ste rkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas btsun pa bdag gis khyod la rab tu spyos pa bzod par mdzod cig ces bzod pa gsol bar byed pa dang / de cher khros nas gtses te gnod pa byas so zhes smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis thos nas brgyugs te tshe dang ldan pa ci'i phyir 'o dod 'bod ces dris pa dang / des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di 'di ltar bdag gi gnas khang du 'ongs te gnod pa byed pa 13—327

la ltos/ de dag gis de la tshe dang ldan pa ci'i phyir khyod kyis dge slong rgan pa 'di la gtses7zhes smras pa dang / des kyang ji ltar gyur pa smras nas de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /des bsams pa de'i phyir na bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag byos shig par gsungs te/ ji ②nas nga'i nyan thos rnams byams pa'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems dang / brtse ba'i sems kyis rang gi⑧don sgrubasrepar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs nasa'adi ltar 'di ni bdag mthong nas mi dga' ba dang / khros0par gyur na bdag gis 'di la bzod par byas te ci rung gisashe'agro'o snyam bsams nas de song nas phyis de la phyag kyang mi byed na bzod parasnyebyed pa lta ci smos/ de nas dus phyi zhig na dge slong rgan pa deshedage slong gzhan zhig dang lhan cig 'chag cing gtam zer zhing 'khod pa dang / dge slong de yang dge slong dag la phyag 'tshal ba las phyogs der 'ongs pa dang / 'chag pa'i grogs kyi dge slong des de la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di lta bu'i dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa 'di la ci'i phyir bzod par ma byas/ rgan pa des 'di ni 'di ltar sdig pa'i sems khro ba can te/ ltos shig dang da yang khyod la phyag byed kyi nga la mi byed do zhes smras pa dang / de bzhin des phyag byas pa dang / des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis sdig pa'i sems can de mthong ngam/ tshe dang ldan pa mthong ngo / /de nas des de la tshe dang ldan pa bdag gis gzhan du thos na gzhan du mthong ste/ khyod ni ngo tsha zhes 'gyod pa can bslab pa la mos pa'o zhes thos na/ khyod ci'i phyir de ltar ma yin zhes smras pa dang / des btsun pa bdag gis ji ltar bgyi/ tshe dang ldan pa dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa 'di lta bu la khyod kyis ci'i phyir bzod pa mi bya zhes smras pa 13—328

dang / des7ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par smras pa dang / de 'phya bar gyur nas/de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol te②/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnamasasnyedage slong de 'phya ba ni lus kyis④/ gang rnam par 'khon pa de bzod par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang 'khon pa de bzod par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan zhig gisasnyebazod par byas kyang ma bzod nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gang mi spyod pa de nye0spyod du phyin pakhudang phyag byos shig /des kyang nad med cig ces smra'am yang nasaphyag byos shig /de ltar mi byed na gnyis ka la 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khon pa'i dge slong la bzod par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong gnyis shig rnam par gdon mi za ba'i gtam smra ba las7'khrugs pa dang / mtshang 'bru ba dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod par gyur te/ de gnyis las dge slong gzhon pas dge slong rgan pa la tshig drag po mi snyan pas blong zhing khros te smras pa dang / rab tu khros nas gnas khang du zhugs te sgo bcad nas des ngan du smras pa'i tshig de lta bu sgom zhing 'dug go/ /de'i bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi mkhyen pa dang / ma gzigs pa dang / ma chud pa dang / rnam par mi mkhyen pa med de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag ni chos nyid kyis thugs rje chen po can 'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa la zhugs pa/ srung ba gcig pu dpa' ba/gcig pu zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la gnas pa/ gdul ba'i dngos po gsum la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i mthil la rab tu brtan pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis 'jigs pa med pa/ yan lag lnga rab 13—329

tu rnam par spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag tu drug la gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis brgyan pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa ston pa/ mthar gyisasheganas shingakhusnyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur snyan par grags pa/brgya phrag bcu lasasnyedabang sgyur ba'i mchog tu byung bas gang 'gribs⑤/ gang 'phel/ gang sdug bsngal du gyur/ gang dog par gyur/ gang gnod par gyur/gang sdug bsngal dang dog pa dang gnod par gyur/ gang ngan song la gzhol/gang ngan song la 'bab/ gang ngan song la rab tu bstan/ gang ngas ngan songakyilas bton te mtho ris susathar pa'i 'bras bu la so sor dgod par bya/ gang dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa rnams ni7bskyed par bya/ gang gis bskyed pa rnams ni yongs su smin par bya/ gang yongs su smin pa rnams ni rnam par dgrol7bar bya'o zhes nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs shing ye shes snang ba la 'jug go/ /yang gsungs pa/ chu srin gnas pa'i rgya mtsho ni/ /dus las 'da' bar 'gyur srid kyi/ /gdulacabar bya ba'i bu rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus 'da' mi srid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gnas gzhan zhig tu 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe na zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang zha dmar po dang / dkar po la sogs pa byung ste/ la la ni 'og tu 'gro'o⑩/ /la la ni steng du 'gro ste/ de la gang 'og tu song ba des ni yang 'tsho ba dang / thig nag po dang / 'dus pa 13—330

dang / 'o dod 'bod pa dang /① tho dod 'bod pa chen po dang / gdung ba dang / rab tu gdung ba dang / bster med pa dang / chu bur dang / rgyun du chu bur dang / a ṭa ṭa dang / ha ha ba dang / hu hu ba dang 9 utpalasadang / pad mo dang / pad mo chen po la sogs pa'i sems can dmyal bar song ste/ gang tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba la desasrebab pa ni bsil bar gyur/gang grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba de la bab pa 0ni dro bar gyur te/ des sems can de dag de lta bus gzir ba'i khyad par de dag bde bar byas pa dang /de dag 'di snyam du kye bdag cag rnams 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes zhes bsams na/ de dag la rab tu dad pa bskyed0pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis sprul pa btang nas de dag gis sprul pa mthong ba dang / 'di snyam du kye bdag cag rnams 'di nas shi 'phos par gyur pa yang med/ gzhan du skyes pa yang med kyisal/ sngon ma byung ba'i sems can 'di mthong ba'i mthus na bdag cag gzir ba'i khyad par rnams bde bar gyurasato snyam du bsams nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur pa dang / dmyal bas gzir ba'i las zad par byas te gang du bden par gyur pa'i snod du der lha dang mi'i mtshams 'dzin to/ /gang steng du song ba des ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha dang /sum bcu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs chen dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang dang / kun snang dang7/ dge ba dang / tshad med dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / sprin med dang / bsod nams 'phel dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / mi che ba dang /13—331

mi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya nom snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lhar song nas mi rtag pa dnganye/ sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa nyid dang /bdag med pa rnams bsgrags te tshigs su bcad bsnyeganyis kyang brjod do/ /'byung bar bya phyir brtsamasapar byos/ /sangs rgyas bstan la brtson par byos/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde rnamasalgegazhom par byos/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyodasa'agyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar 'byin par 'gyur/ /de nas 'od zer des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyi bzhin du 'brang ngo / /de dag gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las la0lung ston bzhed par gyur na bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyab tu nub bo/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus la lung ston par bzhed par gyur na mdun du nub bol/ /dmyal bar lung ston par bzhed par gyur na zhabs kyi mthil du nub bo/ /byol song du skye bar lung ston par bzhed par gyur na rting par nub bo/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed par gyur na zhabs kyi mthe bor nub bo/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed par gyur na pus mor nub bo/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur 0ba'i rgyal por lung ston 8bzhed par gyur na phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du nub bo/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston bzhed par gyur na phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du nub bo/ /lhar skye bar lung ston bzhed par gyur na lte bar nub bo/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston bzhed par gyur na zhal du nub bo/ /rang byang chub tu lung ston bzhed par gyur na smin mtshams su nub bo/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 13—332

lung stonatubazhed par gyur na spyi bo'i gtsug tu nub bo/ /de nas 'od zer des bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum ②bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ③zhabs kyi rting bar nub pa dang / de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos zhus pa/ ji ltar snang bar byed pa shar ba bzhin/ /zhal gyi nang nas byung ba mang po ni/ /kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs stong ldan pa/ /gang gis phyogs bcu kun tu snang gyur pa'o/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/rgod pa zhumasargyags spangs nas bral gyur pa/ /skye bo rnams kyi0rgyur gyur sangs rgyas te/ /rgyal ba dgra rgyal dung dang pad mo bzhin dkar ba/ /rgyu med 'dzum pa nye bar ston mi mdzad/ /brtan pa'i thugs mnga' de dus rang gis mkhyen mdzod cig /rgyal ba'i dbang la thos 'tshalanyenyan rnams la/ /brtan zhing thub pa'i khyu mchog dam pa yis/ /the tshom byung ba dge bas rnam par bso'akho/ /don med par ni rgya mtsho ri rgyal bstanayi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dzum pa mi ston te/ /brtan pas gang phyir 'dzum pa bstan pa de/ /skye bo mang po 'di dag thos par mos/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de de bzhin te/ de de bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo gang dge slong gzhon pa des dge slong la tshig ngan pas mtshang brus shing smras pas khros pa mthong ngam/ bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /de gnas khang du zhugs te sgo bcad nas de'i tshig ngan du smras pa de phyi phyir sgom zhing 'dug go/ /de khros pas kun tu khebs nas phyi phyir bsgoms pas na zhe sdang gi sa bcu rab tu byung ste/ de dus 'das te shi 'phos 13—333

nas de'i gnas khang de nyid du sbrulanyegadug par skye bar 'gyur phro// // 'dul ba gzhung dam pa/① bam po sum bcu rtsa0brgyad pa/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang lhan cig gtam gsung ba'isnyibar du dge slong de yang tshig ngan du smras pa de lan mang du bsgoms shing shin tu khro bas kun tu khebs te mang du byas pas ༷zhe ⑦snang gi sa bcu po thob pas na ⑧de 'chi 'phos dus 'das te de'i gnas khang nyid du sbrul gdug par skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo skyes bu gti mug can de ni gnas khang de nyid du sbrul gdug par skyes kyis der song la drung du phyin narnyunga'i tshig gis nad med cig ces byos la/'di skad du 'di ltar khyod nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi las gang yang rung dge sbyong gi 'bras bu rtogs par 'gyur ba las da khyod khros pa'i dbang gis na 'dir sbrul gdug par skyes kyis dge slong de la bzod par byos shig /'di las yang dus 'das na sems can dmyal bar skyes sa re zhes sgo shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas dge slong de khrid de dge slong de'i gnas khang du song nas sgo la dal nas bags kyis brdungs te smras pa/ bzhin bzangs khyod la bcom ldan 'das nad med cig ces gsungs te/ 'di ltar khyod nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung la dge sbyong0gi 'bras bu bzhi las gang yang rung dge sbyong gi 'bras bu rtogs par 'gyur ba las da khyod khros pa'i dbang gis na 'dir sbrul gdug par skyes kyis dge slong 'di la bzod par byos shig /'di nas dus byas nas kyang sems can dmyal bar skyes sa re zhes gsung ngo / /13—334

de nas de nyid du khros pa'i dug btanganyenas gnas khang nas phyir ma byungasazhing 'dug pa dang / de nasasnyebacom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la mod gal gyi bu tshur shog /khyod kyis sbrul gdug pa gang na ba der song la phyin pa dang / 'di skad du dge slong de0la bzod par7byos shig ces bka' stsal pa dngakyi/ des kyang der song ste smras pa dang / de lde mig kyogashepo'i bu gasnyenas mgo tsam bstan te phyir nang du zhugs so/ /dge slong gis dge slong la sems kyis gnod par byas pas rang gi gnas khang du sbrul du 0skyes so zhes sgra de lta bu mnyan du yod par kun du grags pa dang / ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal nang gi btsun mo dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / grong mi dang / gzhongs su bcas pas gang sgra de thos pa dang ltad mo lta 'dod pas de'i yid bskyod nas dze ta'i tshal du dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyang nyan thos chen po kun shes kauṇḍi rgya dang / rlangs pa dang / ming chen dang / ma 'gags pa dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu chen po dang /'od snang dang / kun dga' bo dang / nam gru la sogs pas bskor te rgyal po gsal rgyal dang de'i gnas khang du bzhud nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de nyid kyi skad du gsungs pa dang / de rtabs bzhin du gnas khang nas phyir byung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de khrid nas gtsug lag khang nas phyir phyung7ste dze ta'i tshal gyi sgor 'khor brgya /phrag du ma dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi mdun na gdan bting ba de la bzhugs pa dang / de nas sbrul gdug pa de phan tshun kun du skye bo mang po la bltas te skrag nas bcom ldan 'das kyi0gdan logs su rgan rims kyi mthar bcom ldan 'das la lta bzhin du 'khyil te 'dug 13—335

336 bka' 'a ra/ 'dul ba/ 0 1 dze go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs 'di ltar khyod nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi las gang yang rung dge sbyong gi 'bras bu rtogs par 'gyur ba las da khyod 'dir shin tu khro bas7kun tu khebs nas lanakhumang du bsgoms la dge slong la yang sems gdug pa bskyed ②pas da ༷ltar sbrul gdug par skyes te/ 'tshe ba dang gsod pa la chags shing gzhan gyi srog 'phrog cing gzhan 'tsho ba dang phral nas 'tsho bar byed de 'di nas shi 'phos na rgyud gang du skye/ gang du skye bar 'gyur/ gang du mngon par skye bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi tshe de'i rigs dran par byas pa de'i tshe ngu bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ khyod ni byol song skye gnas gyur/ /mi dal bar yang skyes gyur na/ /don med par ni ci phyir ngu / /da ni ci zhig byar yod kyis⑥/ /rgyal ba thugs rje ldan mnga' la/ /sems kyis legs par dad skyes dang / /byol song skye gnas 'disaspangs te/ /de nas mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan pa chud mi zos pas de'i kun du gnas pa de dang bral bar gyur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la bka' stsal pa/ tshur shog dge slong khyod kyis sprul gdug pa de la bzod pa7byos sheg /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ji ltar bzod par bgyi7/ci de'i rkang pa la gtug par bgyi'am zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la ji ltar sngon gyi dge slong yin par mngon du byas te the tshom du mi bya bar bya8/ gtug par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / ston pa'i bka' bzhin des rkang pa la gtugs pa dang / des de'i mgo bo la reg par byas pa dang /13—336

de gnyis nyuskye bo mang pos mthong ba dang rab tu ngo mtshar skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo mang po desnyedag lasade'i phyir de lta bu'i tshul du chos bshad de/de thos pas na srog chags brgya stong du ma rnams kyis ni khyad par chen po rtogs par gyur to/ /sbrul gdug pa de yang bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon par dad nas de dus ④'das pa dang sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i gnas bzang por skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/de bas na dge slong rnams 'di dang gzhan dag kyang khro bas kun tu khebs na nyes pa'i dmigs su 'gyur te/ de bas na dge slong gis khros pa'i dge slong la ji ltar de'i〈khros pas khebs par gnas pa/ rnam par byang bar gnas pa de lta de lta bur gsol lo/ /des kyang sems kyis bzod par byos shig /gang sngalgedro khros pa la des7phyi dro bzod par gsol cig /gang phyi dro khros pa la ni des nub mo'o/ /gang nub mo khros pa la ni des phyi de nyin mo bzod par gsol cig ces gsungs nas/ bcom ldan 'das gdan las bzhengs te nang du yang dag 'jog la 'jug pa'i phyir gtsug lag khang du gshegs so/ /chos nyid kyis lha'i bu'am lha'i 'bu mo yang rung skyes nas ring po tsom lon par gang nas shi 'phos gang du skyes/ las gang yin zhes sems pa rnam pa 'di gsum skyes te⑩/sbrul gdug pa las shi 'phos nas/ sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i ris bzang por skyes te bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon du dad pa bskyed par mthong ngo / /de nas sngon gyi sbrul gdug pa lha'i bu des 'di snyam du bdag 'dir zhag lon te/bcom ldan 'das ltar ci'agro bar mi rigs kyi0/ bdag 'dir zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la ltar0'gro'o snyam du bsams nas/ de nas lha'i bu 13—337

sngon sbrul gdug pa de dri ma med pa'i rna cha 'phyang bzhin du thogs shing do shal dang / se mo dos lus brgyan te/ de nyid kyi nub mo lha'i me tog utpalatudang /pad mo dang / ku mu dasnyedang / puṇḍa 'i⑧ka dang / man dā ra ba la sogs pas pang ba bkang ste snang ba chen pos dze ta'i tshal thams cad du snangakhubar byas nas bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor7te chos nyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang /bag la nyal ba dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de 'dra ba'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yang dag par rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bstan nas lha'i bu sngon gyi sbrul gdug pa des thos pa dang / 'jig tshogs su lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /des bden pa mthong bas dga' ba'i tshig gsum smras te/ btsun mes phan btags pa 'di lta bu ni mas kyang ma bgyis/ phas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lhas kyang ma bgyis/ sdug pas kyang ma bgyis/ bdag gi⑧gnyen mang pos kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/dge sbyong dang bram zes kyang ma bgyis te/ ⑨bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams0/ rus pa'i ri las ni brga'akho/ ngan song gi7sgo ni bcad/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo ni phye nas lha dang mi'i gnas su bzhag go/ /khyod mthus shin tu mi bzad ngan song gi/ /nyes pa mang du ldan pa'i lam rnams bcad/ /mtho ris 'gro ba'i lam phyir bsod nams mchog /mya ngan 'da' lamanyebadag gis de ring thob/ /khyod la brten pas nyes pa med pa yi/ /bdag deng shin tu gtsang ba rnam dag mig /'phags 13—338

pa'i yid du 'ong ba'i zhi gnas thob/ /bdag gis sdug bsngal rgya mtsho pha rol rga'akhya/ /skye bo lha dang lha min mi yis mchod/ /skye rga na dang 'chi las rnam par bral/ /srid pa stong du'ang mthong bar shin tu dka'/ /thub khyod deng bdag mthong bsakhu'abras burarnyubacas/ /de nas se mo do ni0'phyang bzhin dume/ /zhabs gnyis la ni phyag byas dga' ba skyes/ /dgra thul de la g.yas su bskor0nas ni/ /lha yi 'jig rten lha yi yul derashesongasnye/ /de nas lha'i bu sngon sbrul gdug pa de tshong pa(khe thob pa ltar/ chun pa lo legs pa ltar/ dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba ltar/ nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba ltar/ ji lta bu'i longs spyod dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du 'ongs pa de lta bu'i longs spyod dang / rang gi gnas su song ba dang / dge slong dag srod dang tho rangs la mi nyal bar thub par brtson par spyod pa rnams kyis mthong ba bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na rgya cher snang ba mthong nas the tshom du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la bcom ldan 'das ci mdang mtshan mo bcom ldan 'das la tshangs pa 'khor gyi bdag po ltar mchis sam/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dag blta ba'i phyir mchis sam zhes zhus pa dang / dge slong rnams tshangs pa'i 'khor gyi bdag po yang ma yin/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin yang ma yin/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi la sogs pas nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa yang ma yin gyi/ gang sbrul gdug pa dge slong gis bzod par byas pa de nga la sems mngon du dad nas dus las 'das pa dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum ris kyi lha'i gnas bzar por skyes nas de 'di ltar mdang nga'i drung du 'ongs te ngas de la chos bstan pa dang / bden pa mthong nas rang gi gnas su 13—339

song ngo / /de bas na dge slong rnams kyis 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ gang gis bzod par bya ba dang / bzod pa'i yon tan brjod par bya ba de ltar dge slong dag khyed kyis bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces7bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong de dag yid mgu nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga'o/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bsnyen par rdzogs par bgyidakun tshe dang ldan pa rnams bdag la bsnyen par rdzogs par ma byed cig ces mchi bzhin⑧dge slong rnams kyis bsnyen par rdzogs par bgyis na bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes bgyi'am/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa0zhes bgyi/ u pā li bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes mi bya ste/ bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa rnams kyang 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /u pā li de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa nyid kyang bslab pa 'bul na bsnyen par ma rdzogs zhes bya na bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'i tshe lta ci smos/ yang bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge tshul pha rnams lo nyi shu lon nas bsnyen par rdzogs par byos shig ces gsungs na/ dge tshul pha gzhan dag bdag gi lo grangs ni ma 'tshalas/ de lus bong ni che ste/ de dge slong rnams kyis lo grangs ma rtogs pas the tshom skyes te bsnyen par rdzogs par mi bgyid na de dag la ji ltar nan tan bgyi zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ u pā li de lta bu ni mtshan las so sor rtogs la bsnyen par rdzogs par byos shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de ltarabamatshan las rtogs la bsnyen par rdzogs par gyis shig ces gsungs pa dang /13—340

dge slong rnams kyis de gcer bur phyung ①ste mtshan rtog⑧pa la zhugs pa dang /de shin tu ngo tsha nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gcer bur ma dbyung bar ba so'amakhugos kyi gdang la lhung bzed dam chos gos kyi snod zhogakhul 'di phob shig ces smros la/ de ni mchan khungasnyedang mchadakyil rtogs te de ste yod na bsnyen par rdzogs par bya'o/ /de ste med na bsnyen par rdzogs par mi bya'o/ /yang zhus pa/ btsun pa dge slong rnams kyis dge slong la dge slong ma'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs par ⑦bgyis na bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes bgyi'am/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa zhes bgyi/ u pā li bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes ni ⑧bya ste bsnyen par rdzogs par ⑨byed pa rnams ni 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa dge slong ma la dge slong dang / dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong gi las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs par bgyis na bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes bgyi'am bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa zhes bgyi/ u pā li bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ dge 'dun gnyi ga yang 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo dang po'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa thog ma'o// //mdor na/ gsing ma grong dang bsdus pa dang / /sems bskyed pas ni gso sbyin dang / /gsad pa gsum yang de bzhin te/ /rnam 'byed dge 'dun lhag ma 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag cig 'gron pa mang po dang lhan cig ljongs spyod du dong ba dang / de dag de'i tshe gso sbyin la bab nas de dag gis sa gsing ma'i phyogs shig mthong nas de dag 13—341

gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag tshur shegaX /sa gsing ma'i phyogs pha bi la gso sbyin⑧bya'o zhes der de dag gso sbyinasabyed pa la zhugs pa dang / 'grodakyipa mang po dag 'das nas de dag kyang phyi bzhin 'dong ba las bar dusarkun pos bcom ste gtsug lag khang du phyin pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis mthong ste bde bar 'ongs sam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bde bar 'ongs sam/ ci bde bar spyad dam zhes smras pa dang / bde bar ga la spyad/ ci nyes/ bdag cag ni rkun posakyibacom mo/ /de lta bur gyur pa dge slong rnams la smras pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsing ma la chags pa'i phyir gso sbyin ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis grong dang nye ba'i 'khor du gso sbyin⑧rgyas shig ces gsungs pa dang / de7las dge slong phyed ni grong du zhugs phyed ni phyi rol du 'khod pas de dag ma 'dus par gyur nas gso sbyin ma byas te/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang ⑩/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang grong na gnas pa rnams ni grong du gso sbyin byos shig /de bzhin du dge slong rnams gso sbyin bya ste gso sbyinaphul ma sdod cig /sdod na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag cig tshong pa'i 'gron pa mang po dang lhan cig tu lam du zhugs pa dang / dge slong gis tshong pa la bzhin bzangs bdag cag gso sbyin byed kyis de'i bar du skad cig sdod cig ces smras pa dang / de dag gis 'phags pa rnams 'di phyogs na rkun pos 'jigs kyis7phyi bzhin spyon cig bsdad do zhes smras pa dang / der sdod grang der sdod grang snyam nas dge slong rnams phyi bzhin du 'brang zhing de dag dong ba 13—342

las nam nangs so/ /dge slong rnams kyis de ltar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams gso sbyin gyinyetshe gso sbyinasam byas par ma 'gro shig /yang na 'gro bzhin du gso sbyinakhubyos shig /dge slong dag gis 'gro bzhin du gso sbyin0byed pa la zhugs pa dang / tshong pa rnams kyis 'phags pa bdag cag ni rkun pos 'jigs pas cang mi smra bar 'gro na khyedakhuci'i phyir ca co byed ces smras nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong de0dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gso sbyin rgyas par ma byed par mdor byos shig /dge slong rnams kyis mdor byed pa la zhugs pa dang / 'onakhukyang tshong pa de dag gis dpyasashenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems bskyed pa tsam gyis byin gyis rlobs shig /de bas na dge slong rnams chos gos byin gyis brlab pa dang / gos bsngo ba dang / gso sbyin dang / tshul nas byung ba 'di bzhi ni sems bskyed pa tsam gyis 'grub bo/ /de yang 'di ltar bya ste/ sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag ste/ sems bskyed par byos la gso sbyin byin gyis rlobs shig /de nas tshig tu yang brjod par bya ste/ deng dge 'dun rnams kyi bco lnga'i gso sbyin te④/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba'i yang bco lnga'i gso sbyin te⑩/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i bar chad kyi chos rnams kyang7yongs su dag go zhes rang gis brjod delogaso sbyin byin gyis brlabs la/ gang gi tshe dge 'dun 'dus pa phrad pa de'i tshe dge 'dun dang lhan cig tu gso sbyin bya'o/ /de ltar lan gnyis de ltar lan gsum du brjod de gso sbyin de ltar bya'o/ /gso sbyin mi bya ba ni ma yin no/ /ma byas 13—343

natu'adas pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong dag cig gzhongs7spyad pa spyod pa na rkun pos zin nas de dag gis kye bsam rlag ②tu 'khod de ci byed kyis④/ mgo reg 'di dag gsadasnyedo zhes smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis bsams0pa/ bdag cag ni gsad par chad paraXlta snyam nas de dag gis rkun po la kye ci'i phyir nged gsad ces smras pa dang / rkun pos smras pa/khyed la rgyal po dang / phyug po dang / tshong dpon dang / ded dpon rnams rab tu dad pas khyed kyis de dag la smras pa dang / de dag gis nged la gnod par byed do zhes smras pa dang / de na dge slong gzhon nu cig gis brdzun du smras pa las byung ba'i nyes pa ltung ba byung ste/ des tshe dang ldan pa rnams bdag gis 0ltung ba byung ba bshags pa de'i bar du bsdad par ci gnang zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis de ltar na gnas 'di nyid du shogs shig ces smras pa dang / des dge slong gi mdun du 'chags pa la zhugs te/ dgongs shig tshe dang ldan pa rnams/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba shes bzhin gyi brdzun smras pa las byung ba'i ltung ba'i nyes pa mchis te/ bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa'i mdun du bshags so/ /mthol lo/ /mi 'chab bo/ /bshags shing mthol na bdag la bde bar 'gyur gyi/ ma bshags ma mthol na ni ma yin no/ /des smras pa/ nye bar mthong ngam/ mthong ngo / /phyin chad sdom par dam 'cha'am dam 'cha'o/ /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum du smras pa dang / rkun po de thams cad kyis thos nas de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa khyed rnams brdzun mi smra'am / bzhin bzangs mi smra'o zhes smras pa dang / de dag mngon 13—344

du dad nas 'phags pa rnams de ltar na/ denganyel su la yang ma smra shig ces smras pa dang / nad med cig su la yang mi smra'o zhes smras te dong nas de dag gtsug lag khang du lhags pa dang / the tshom skyes nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams nags tshal gyi dbang po rkun po'i drung du bshags pa yin gyisakhude la the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong gzhan zhig ljongs spyad pa spyod pa la rkun pos zin nas de dag gis bsamanyenag tu 'khod de ci byed kyisakyimago reg 'di dag gsadasnyedo zhes smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis bsams pa/ bdag cag ni gsad par chad parabalta snyam nas de dag gis rkun po la kye ci'i〈phyir nged gsadasaces smras pa dang / rkun pos smras pa/ khyed la rgyal po dang / phyug po dang / tshong dpon dang / ded dpon rnams mngon par dad pas na khyed kyis de dag la smras pa dang / de dag gis nged la don med par byed do zhes smras nas0/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ thong shig dang su la yang mi smra'o/ /de dag gis de ste khyed kyis bco lnga'i dus na gcig tu 'dus shing 'don pa de nged cag la rgyas par smra bar dam 'cha' na gtang ngo zhes smras pa dang / de na dge slong cig gzhung kha don du lobs pas de bsad kyis 'jigs pas skrag pas so sor thar pa myur du bton pa dang / de dag mngon par dad nas 'phags pa khyed kyis de thams cad yang dag par bzung ste srung ngam/ zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa 'di ni ston pa'i bka' yin na ci'i phyir yang dag par 'dzin cing mi srung zhes smras pa dang / de dag 13—345

gisatu'aphags pa rnams legs kyisakhubazhud la su la yang ma gsungasanyeshig ces smras pa dang / nad med cig mi smra'o zhes smras te dong nasasade dag gtsug lag khang du phyin pa dang / de dag the tshom skyes te de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas0/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong rnams dunags tshal gyi dbang po rkun po'i drung du kha thon bklags ⑦pa ni legs par bklagasalgepa yin gyis7de la the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste0/ dge slong dag cig yul be'u zhes bya ba nas ljongs spyad pa spyod cing dong ba dang / rkun pos zin nas de dag gis kye bsam rlag tu 'khod de ci byed kyis mgo reg 'di dag gsad do zhes smras pa dang / de la rkun po cig dge slong gi rgyus shes pas des de dag mthong ba dang / snying rje skyes nas des de dag thar bar bya ni ma ④nus kyi 8snying brtse ⑫ba'i phyir kye 'di dag gsad ⑩de ci rung gis rtswa tsom brngas pa la bcings yite rdzas phrogs ⑥la dong dang de nyid rang bkres shing nyam chung bas gdungs te srog dang bral grang zhes smras pa dang / de'i nang nas gcig gis smras pa/ kye 'di de skad(nyesmra na ji ltar bya zhes smras pa dang / kha cig gis smras pa/ de ltar bya ba ni legs so zhes nas de dag gis de la phrogs nas rtswa dum brngas ⑥pa la bcings te dong ngo / /yul be'u zhes bya ba'i rgyal po 'char po dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang ri dgas shor ba'i phyir dong ba dang / de dag gis de dag rgyang ring po nas mthong nas des blon po la kye snang ba pha bi ri dgas ma yin nam zhes dris pa dang / des lha ma 'tshal to zhes smras nas rgyal po der nye bar song nas mi yin par mthong ba dang tso/ des kye mu stegs chagacer bu pa yin 13—346

nam ci zhes smras pa dang / de dag las gcig gis0lha de bzhin no zhes smras pa dang / de dag lasnyedage slong gi⑧rgyas shes pa zhig gis smras pa/ lha de ni mu stegs gcer bu pa ma lags kyisaX/ lha shākya'i bu'i dge slong ngo / /ji ltar shes/ lha de ltar logs gcig ni gnagazha /gnyis pa ni dkar ro zhes smras pa dang / de nas rgyal pos de la dris pa/ 'phags pa khyod ci'i phyir 'di ltar 'dug /lha bdag cag rkun pos bcom mo/ /'phags pa 'o na ci'i phyir de ltar 'dug /lha 'di ltar bcings so/ /'phags pa 'di 'dra bar bcings pa ci'i phyir gcadabade mi 'dong / lha bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag gi bslab par bcas pa sa bon gyi grong ⑦dang srog chags kyi grong bshig gam bshig tu bcug na ltung ba'o zhes bya ba'i bslab pa'i bcings pas ⑧bcings so zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po de dad cing mngon par dga' nas des de dag bkrol7te re re la yang chos gos gsum gsum bskon no/ /de dag gtsug lag khang du phyin pa dang / bdag cag gis rgyal po'i mdun du de ltar ltung ba smras so zhes te the tshom skyes pa dang / des de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams la rgyas par smras nas dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol te⑩/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po 'di ni rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi gtso bo yin pas na gang smras pa de ni legs par smras pa yin gyis de la the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa nongs pa dang bcas pas nongs pa dang bcas pa'i mdun du nongs pa bshags su rung ngam u pā li mi rung ngo / /13—347

de stetudangos po mi mthun na ni rung ngo //gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong gcig la dge 'dun gyi lhag ma'i nyes pa byung nas de 'gyod pa skyes pa dang / de skyasabo bseng bsengasnyepor gyur la rid cing nyam chung ste/ byakyil lus ma brtasalgepar gyur nas de la dge slong dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod ci'i phyir skya bo bseng bseng por gyur la rid cing nyam chung la rmya ste lus ma brtas par gyur pa de'i nad smos shig ces smras pa dang / ⑧de cang mi smra nas nam de dang mdza' ba'i dge slong gis7mthong ste dris pa dang / des de la rgyas par smras pa dang / des tshe dang ldan pa de lta na dge slong rnams la brjod kyis shogs shig ces smras so/ /de ltar brjod na bdag nyid mchi'o zhes smras pa dang / des de lta na tshur shog /yul gzhan du dong la der de dag bshags so/ /zhes smras pa dang / des kyang khas blangs nas de dang de lhan cig tu yul gzhan du song ba las de lam phyed du dus 'das pa dang / dge slong des bsams pa/ gang gis don gyi phyir bdag 'gro ba de ni dus 'das na da ci'i phyir 'gro/ phyir ldog go snyam nas de phyir log pa dang / de la dge slong dag gis bde bar 'ongs sam/ tshe dang ldan pa bde bar 'ongs sam/ ci khyed bde bar spyad dam zhes smras pa dang /de ngu bar gyur nas de la dge slong dag gis tshe dang ldan pa ci'i 8phyir ngu zhes smras pa dang / gang bdag dang lhan cig tu song ba'i dge slong de dus 'das pa'i phyir ro zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa ci'i phyir ngu / 'dus byas thams cad ni chos nyid kyis de bzhin no zhes smras so/ /des de ni nyes pa dang bcas bzhin du dus 'das so zhes smras pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis 13—348

des dmyal bar ring du gnas par gyur pasanyen ngu ba 'di ni rigs so zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams rigs kyi bu de ni nyes pa de las phyin te②/ ngas ni bsam pa las nyes pa phyin par gsungs kyis7chad pa'i las kyis ni ma yin no/ /de lta bas na gang de ltar rang bzhin gyis ngo tsha ba dang ldan pa des gcig gi mdun du shogs shig par gnang ngo / /des ni gcig gi mdun du shogs shig /de la the tshom dum byed cig ces gsungs pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba ma yin pa skye bo tha dad pa mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma lta bu 'dzin pa kha cig dang /dge 'dun gyikhuganas brtan dang / grags pa dang / bsod nams chen po kha cig gis ma brtags pas na dge 'dun gyi lhag ma'i nyes pa byung ste/ de dag chad par spyod pa la lhan cig spyod pasnyedang / nye gnas dang bram ze dang khyim bdag dang gzhan yang rung nyung ngu thos pa'i dge slong rnams kyis kyang dpyas/kha cig ni mi dga' bar gyur te/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gis kyang ①phyis mi bya bar ⑩shin tu bsam pa brtun 7te gcig po'i mdun du shogs shig /'di la the tshom tsom byed cig /rkyang pa'i nang nas sgo dang po'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'o// //mdor na/ gzhag pa'i rigs pa gzhag par bya/ /bdun lon nas kyang 'gro bar bya/ /mnyam du ma zin de bzhin te/ /gang gi ko ba mi rung ba'o/ /13—349

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi ①kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la gtsug lag khang skyong gi resarkyubab bo/ /yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dze ta'i tshal du 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo gang na ba der song ste drung du phyin pa dang / rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas chos7nyan pa'i phyir mdun du 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos mdo sde la zhugs nas de las phye nas cung zad tsam zhig rgyas par bshad nas/ mdor 'chad pa la zhugs pa dang / rgyal pos 'phags pa bdag la brel ba med kyis rjomador ma bshad cig ces smras so/ /de bzhin du tshulan gnyisakyilan gsum du smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos rgyal po chen po khyodashel brel ba med kyang bdag la brel ba yod do zhes smras pa dang /'phags pa kun dga' bo ci zhig brel ces smras pa dang / khang skyong bya dgos so zhes smras pa dang / 'phags pa kun dga' bo yang las kyi res mdzad dam/lha bdag ni dge 'dun gyi nang du gtogs pas na las bgyi 'tshal lo zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos 'di bdag gis7bya ba yin no snyam du bsams nas/ de bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni rgyal po rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba ste/ gang bdag gis bgyi ba'i las ni bdag bgyid do/ /gang nang gi btsun mos bgyi ba'i rigs pa yang nang gi btsun mos bgyid do/ /gang gzhon nus bgyi ba'i rigs pa yang gzhon nus so/ /gang blon po'am/ blon po chen po'am/ dmag dpon nam/ grong mi'am/13—350

gzhongs7pa yang rung ste gzhongasalgepa nyid kyisakhulas bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang bla na med pa'i chos kyi rgyal po ste/ e ma'o bcom ldan 'das brtse ba can gyis kyang gzhag par 'os pa gzhag la las kyi res mi bsko bar ci gnang zhes gsol pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis gsol0pa bzhin bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas zhal gyis bzhes so/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis kyang cang mi gsung bas zhal gyis bzhes par rig nas rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo song la mnyan du yod pa na gnas shing 'khod pa'i dge slong thams cad 'dun khang du sdus shig ces gsungs pa dang / btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das las0mnyanakhute mnyan du yod pa na dge slong ji snyed gnas pa de⑥thams cad 'dun khang du bsdus nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /①tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa mnyan du yod pa na dge slong ji snyed gnas shing mchis pa de thams cad 'dun ⑩khang du 'dus te mchis lags na/yi bcom ldan 'das kyis da dus la bab par dgongs shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'dun khang gang na ba der bzhud de byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi mdun tson gdan bting tsob la bzhugs te bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag deng 8ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal nga'i drung du 'ongs te/ e 13—351

ma'o bcom ldan 'das gzhag pa'i rigs pa rnams ni zhog la/ las kyi res7la bka' stsal pa'i mi rigs so zhes zer gyisarkyukhyed cag gis deng phan chad gzhagasnyepa'i rigs pa rnams las la ma bsko bar zhog cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhag pa'i rigs pa rnams las la ma bsko shig ces gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis gang gzhag par0rigs pa mkhushes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma lta bu 'dzin pa dang / mang po 'chad 0pa dang / dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan dag ni gzhag par rigs pa'o/ /de la mdo sde 'dzin pa ni de nyid las so/ /de bzhin du 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang /la ma lta bu 'dzin pa dang / mang po la 'chad pa dang / dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan dag kyang de nyid las yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma lta bu 'dzin pa de ni de nyid las yin no zhes gsungs pa dang / drug sde dag gis mdo sde'i le'u gcigasnyeganyis bklagasashenas nged cag ni mdo sde 'dzin pa yin pas na nged la las kyi res ma dbab cig ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang mdo sde thams cad 'dzin pa de ni mdo sde 'dzin pa ste/ de ni las la ma bsko shig de bzhin du pas pham pa gcig gam gnyis lhogs pa dag gis nged kyang 'dul ba 'dzin pa'o/ /de bzhin du rab tu byed pa gnyis bklags pas kyang nga ni ma lta bu 'dzin pa yin gyis las kyi res la ma bsko shig ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang 13—352

'dul ba thams cad 'dzin pa dang / ma lta bu thams cad 'dzin pa ninyelas la ma bsko shig /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ de'i tshekhuyul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ri brags kyisagrong dag cig log nas dmag ru gcig btang ba dang / de dag gis slar bcom btags nas lhags so/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du btang yang slar btags bcom nas lhags so/ /blon po dag gis gsol pa/ lha ri brags kyi0grong dag gisamathu ni cher gyur/ lha'i mthu ni 'gribs0na de la lha nyid gshegs na ni ri brags kyishegrong de dag kyang gdod khugs par 'gyurasnyigyi gzhan gyis7mi nus so zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos nga'i yul na ji snyed mtshon cha'i mthus 'tsho ba de thams cad ma 'khod par sheg shig ces dril chen po bsgrags so/ /de nas rgyal po mthu chen po dang lhan cig tu grong rdal der lhags nas thams cad bskor te 'khod do/ /'on kyang de dag nags tshal stug po la brten nas ma phebs pa dang / blon pos lha khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin de bsod nams rab tu rgyas shing lha rnams kyis yongs su zin pas de tso'adir mchis na gdon mi 'tshal bar ri brags kyi 'grong phebs par 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang / de nas rgyal pos khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la bsti stang 8cher byas nas khyim bdag khyod kyi ngo blta ⑩bar 'dod do zhes yi ge spring ngo / /de yi ge de thos ma thag tu rings bzhin du song ste ri brags kyi grong rdal der phyin to/ /'on kyang grong rdal de ma phebs0nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin de ring du thogs par gyur nas/ de dge slong rnams ma mthong ba'i phyir skya bo bseng bseng po rid cing lus ma brtas par gyur nas/ rgyal pos mthong ste dris pa/ khyim bdag khyod bu dag dran nam 13—353

zhes smras pa dang / des lha bdag bu7dran pa ni ma lags kyi/ 'phags pa rnams blta bar 'tshal ba'i slad du'o zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos blon po dag la ngas bka' stsal pa skad du ma zer bar ci nas 'phags pa rnams 'dir byon pa'i thabs su sbyor cig ces yi ge spring ba dang / blon po dag gis yi ge bklags nas gros7byed pa la zhugs te/ kye de la thabs ji ltar bya zhes smras pa dang / blon po rgan po gzhan zhig gis de lta blasasnyede'i thabs shig bdag gis sbyar la dgye0bar bya'o zhes smras nas/ des dze ta'i sgo na arasnyiḍa tshangs sbyin gyi skyedakyimos tshal zhig yod pa rnyings te⑦/ mda' lta bu'i tshal du gyur pa de bcos legs byas/0 mchod rten gyisadag ra nas skyed mos tshal der yur ba drang ngo zhes srad bu bres pa dang / de dag nyid la gnod pas na lha lta zhing 'dong bar 'gyur ro zhes te/ de nas de dag gis skyed mos tshal rnying pa de 'chos pa la zhugs8/ dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten gyi dbus su srad bu bres na srad bu 'di'i rgyud bzhin du yur ba brko'o zhes smras pa dang / dge slong gtsug lag khang na gnas pa dang / nyin par spyod du dong ba de dag 'dus te blon po de'ichagan du dong nas bzhin bzangs 'di ci zhig rtsom zhes smras pa dang ske/ 'phags pa rnams lhas bdag cag la nga'i pa'i skyed mos tshal rnying pa chos7shig dang / nga derawe'ong ngo zhes yi ge mchis pas na 'di dag bdag cag gis phyi bdar bgyis te der chu drang ba'i yur ba brko'o zhes smras pa dang /ci khyed kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra 〉dang sen mo'i mchod rten gzhigashegam/de ltar ma byed cig ces smras pa dang / 'phags pa dag lha'i bka' bzhin ni bdag cag gis mi bgyir mi rung ste/ bdag cag la mgo gnyis su ma mchis 13—354

kyis7lha'i bka' bcag tu mi rung ngo zhes smras pa dang / bzhin bzangs nged kyis lha la gsol gyisasnyode'i bar du sdod cig ces smras pa dang / 'phags pa bdag cag gis bsdad kyis ③gsol ba mdzad du gsol zhes smras pa dang /bzhin bzangs lha 'dug pa der ji srid yod/ 'phags pa lam ring ngo /bzhin bzangs zhag gcig nas bdun gyis slar 'khor tam/ slar mi 'khor to//de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ltar na dge slong dag sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi phyir zhag bzhi bcur byin gyis rlobasakyil mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'dong bar gnang ngo / /dge slong dag gis ji ltar byin gyis brlab pa masnyeshes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stan rnams thing ste gaṇḍi rdungs la dris pa'i lan glon⑧pa'i dge slong cig bskos7te dge 'dun thams cad 'dus nas 'khod pa dang / sngar dge slong gcig gam gnyis sam/gsum yang rung dad par gyis0te/ sangs rgyas srung dang chos byin yidang /dge 'dun sde khyed rnams gnas 'di'i mtshams kyi nang du dbyar snga ma'am/ phyi ma yang rung tshul du tsozhugs pa las dge 'dun gyi don gyi phyir zhag bzhi bcur byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du dong la khyed dbyar gyi gnas 'dir te/ dbyar 'dir gnas par dad dam zhes bsgo la/ de ste dad na de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba dang las byos shig /gson cig btsun pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ sangs rgyas srung dang / chos byin dang / dge 'dun sde 'di dag mtshams kyi nang gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma'am phyi ma tshul du zhugs pa las/ 'di dag dge 'dun gyi don gyi phyir zhag bzhi bcur byin gyis 13—355

brlabs te/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'dong zhing 'di dag dbyar gnas 'di lags te/ dbyar 'dir gnas na de ste dge 'dun rnams kyis bzod cing dus la bab na dge 'dun gyis gnangatul/ dge 'dun gyis sangs rgyas srung dang /chos byin⑧dang / dge 'dun sde dag zhag bzhi bcur skos shig /sangs rgyas srung dang / chos byinasnyedang / dge 'dun sdes dge 'dun gyi don gyi phyir zhag bzhi bcur byin gyis brlabs te mtshams kyi phyi rol du dong la/ de dag dbyar gnas 'di lags te dbyar 'dir gnas so/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las kyang 'di bzhin du byos shig /gson cig btsun pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ sangs rgyas srung dngas/ chos byinasnyedang / dge 'dun sde 'di dag dge 'dun gyi don gyi phyir zhag bzhi bcur byin gyis brlabs te mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'dongakyizhing / 'di dag dbyar gnas 'di lags te/ tshe dang ldan pasarnams las gang la sangs rgyas srung dang / chos byin7dang / dge 'dun sde dag gis dge 'dun gyi don gyi phyir zhag bzhi bcur bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang mi bzod pa de dag ni smras shig /dge 'dun gyis sangs rgyas srung dang / chos byin dang / dge 'dun sde 'di dag dge 'dun gyi don gyi phyir zhag bzhi bcur byin gyis brlabs te mtshams kyi phyi rol du mchis la de dag dbyar gnas 'di lags te dbyar 'dir gnas par dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang bas na cang mi gsung ste de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /gang la dge 'dun gyis zhag bzhi bcur bskos pa de dag byin gyis rlobs te/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du dong shig de la the tshom du ma byed cig /byin gyis brlab pa ni 'di bzhin du gyis shig /dge slong gcig gi mdun du thal mo sbyor la 'dug ste 13—356

tshig 'di skad du dgongs shig /tshe dang ldan pa bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mtshams kyi nang gnas dbyar snga ma'am phyi ma yang rung zla ba gsum mtshungasalgepa las/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi don gyi phyir zhag bzhi bcur byin gyis brlabs te mtshams kyi phyi rol du mchis la bdag gi dbyar 'di lags te dbyar 'dir gnas so/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du smos shig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa zhag gcig tu ②byin gyis brlabs la mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi bar rung ngam/u pā li rung ngo / /de bzhin du zhag gnyis sam/ zhag gsum mam/ zhag bzhi'am/ zhag lnga'am/ zhag drug gam/ zhag bdun nam/ zhag brgyad dam/zhag dgu'am/ zhag bcu'am/ zhag nyi shu'am/ zhagasasum cu'am/ zhag bzhi bcu'i bar du byin gyis brlabs te mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'gro bar rung ngo / /btsun pa zhag bzhi bcu phan chad byin gyis brlab par rung ngam/ u pā li mi rung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ u pā li mtshams kyi nang du ni zhag mang du gnas par bya'isnyimatshams kyi phyi rol du ni zhag nyung ngu gnas par bya'o/ /yang gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis zhag gcig tu byin gyis brlab par byos shig ces gsungs na/ bu'i mdun du byin gyis brlab par bgyi/ u pā li de0ni dge slong gcig gi gan du'o/ /de bzhin du zhag gnyis sam/ zhag gsum mam/ zhag bzhi'am/ zhag lnga'am/ zhag drug gi bar du byin gyis brlabasnyepar bya'o/ /zhag drug phan chad nas zhag bzhi bcu'i bar du ni dge 'dun la gsol te bskos na dge 'dun nam gang zag gi mdun du yang rung ci dga' bar byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan 13—357

pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa pags7pa mi rung ba de'i sha yang mi rung ba lags sam/ u pā li pagasalgepa mi rung ba de'i sha yang mi rung ba'o⑧/ /de'i rgyus pa dang / rus pa dag kyang mi rung ba'o/ /rkyang me'i sgo dang po'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa'o// // 'dul ba gzhung dam paX bam po sum bcu rtsa0dgu pa/ mdor na/gzugs can snying po mal gos dang / /phyi mo dus 'das de bzhin te/ /bya rog 'ug pa bya rgod dang / /de dag bza' bar mi bya 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan dkyika gnas pa na bzhugs pa'i tshe gang gi tshe rgyal po ma skyes dgra lha sbyin gyis ⑦bslus nas de'i pha chos can chos bzhin du rgyal po byed pa 'tsho ba dang phral ba de'i tshesamal gos dag mthong ba dang ngu bar gyur nas/ blon po dag gis lha rgyal po bgres po ni 'phags pa dag la dgyes na gzims cha 'di dag kyang dge 'dun la dbul ba'i rigs so zhes smras pa dang / des mal gos de dag gtsug lag khang du phul lo/ /dge slong dag gis de sgo khang du bting ste bzhag go/ /de7dus phyi zhig na rgyal pos gtsug lag khang du 'ongs nas des de mthong ba dang ngu bar gyur to/ /blon po dag gis 'phags pa dag khyed la sbyin ⑩pa ni ⑩mi mthong bar bya ba'i phyir na sgo khang du bting ba 'di ni nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur to zhes smras pa dang / de dag cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis sgo khang du ma gding shig ces bka' stsal nas/ yang thog tu bting ba dang / de nyid nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur 13—358
