nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yang thog tu gdingatubar ma byed cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / gnas khang du bting ste'ubazhag go/ /ma dad pa dag gis rgyal po'i mal gos ni dge slong dag gis nges par btsongs te zos pas na de sngon snang na dasami snang ngo zhes dpyas pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/tshes brgyad dam/ bcu bzhi'i tshe yang thog tu thingasal zhog shig /ma dad pa dag gis mthong nas lha'i mal stan dag ni dge slong dag gis btsongs nas zos te med do zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yon du phul ba'i dngos po 'di ni rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i yin no zhes mtha' ma la yi gerasabris te zhog shig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ de'i tshe na yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi phyi mo sdug cing yid du 'ong ba zhig dus 'das pa dang / de phyir phyung ste bsregs nas/ shi ba'i cho ga byas te nang par sngar gos kyang gsher/skra yang gsher bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po nang par sngar skra yang gsher/ gos kyang gsher bzhin du 'dir ci la 'ongs/btsun pa bdag gi7phyi mo rab tu sdug cing yid du 'ong ba zhigashedus 'das pa dang / de phyir phyung ste bsregs nas shi ba'i cho ga bgyis te/ de'i phyir nang par sngar gos kyang gsher/ skra yang gsher bzhin du 'dir mchis so/ /rgyal po 13—359

chen po phyi mo rab tu sdug gam/ btsun pa rab tu sdug cing yid du mchi ste/btsun pa phyi mo sos par byas bal glang mang po 'tshal zhes mchi ba zhig mchis na yang bdag gis bal glang mang po yang gtong ngo / /de bzhin du rta mang po dang /shing rta mang po dang / rgyal srid phyed 'tshal na yang phyi mo sos na rgyal srid phyed kyang gtong phod do/ /btsun pa bdag gis de la de bzhin du mya ngan dang / de bzhin du nyon mongs pa dang / de bzhin du mya ngan gyis gzir bzhin du bsgrims kyang phyi mo sdug cing yid du 'ong ba dus 'das pa dang / bdag gis 'di snyam du bsams sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa ni ngo mtshar che ste/ sems can thams cad dang / srog chags thams cad dang /'byung po thams cad 'tsho ba'i mtha' ni 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar ni 'chi bsnyel thug pas na skyes na 'chi'o zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa ni ngo mtshar che'o zhes gsol pa dang / rgyal po chen po de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/sems can thams cad dang / srog chags thams cad dang / 'byung po thams cad kyangasa'atsho ba'i mtha' ni 'chi bar 'gyur te/ mthar 'chi ba la thug pas na skyes phan chad mi 'chi ba med do/ /rgyal po chen po gang rgyal rigs che zhing mtho0ba dang / bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba dang / khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba de dag kyang 'tsho ba'i mtha' ni 'chi bar 'gyur te/ mthar 'chi ba la thug pas na skyes phan chad mi 'chi ba med do/ /yang rgyal po chen po rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskurasnyib skye bo mang po la dbang zhing brtson 'grus thob0pa/ sa gzhi chen po'i dkyil 'khor yang rab tu btul cingasheganas par byed pa de lta bu dag kyang 'tsho ba'i mtha' ni 'chi bar 'gyur te/ mthar 'chi ba la 13—360

thug pasanyen skyes phan chad mi 'chi ba med do/ /rgyal po chen po yang 'di ltar rgyal po las drang srong du gnas na gnas pa 'bras bu rang lhung za bshertsa ba dang 'bras bus 'tsho ba de lta bu yang 'tsho ba'i mtha' ni 'chi bar 'gyur te/ mthar 'chi ba la thug pas na0skyes phan chad mi 'chi ba med do/ /rgyal po chen po 'di ltar yang lha tshe ring po kha dog dang ldan pa mang ba gzhal med khang mthon po na 'dug kyang de dag gnas de nas 'chi 'pho ba'i chos su 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar yang rgyal po chen po dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ bya ba bsgrubs pa khur bor ba/rang gi don thob pa/ srid par sbyor ba zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka' la sems kyisasnyernam par grol ba de dag gi lus kyang rje0ba'i chos su 'gyur rotu/ /yang 'di ltar rgyal po chen po rang sangs rgyas bse ru 'dra ba/ bdag gcig pu dulasab/ bdag gcig pu zhi ba/ bdag gcig pu mya ngan las zlo ba de dag kyang lus rjesheba'i chos su 'gyur ro/ /yang 'di ltar rgyal po chen po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stobs bcu dang ldan pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ khyu mchog gi dam pa/ seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa de lta bu'i sku yang rje ba'i chos su 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po rnam pa de lta bu thams cad kyang de bzhin du rig par gyis shig /gang sems can thams cad dang / srog chags thams cad dang / 'byung po thams cad kyang 'tsho ba'i mtha' ni 'chi bar 'gyur te/ mthar 'chi ba la thug pas na skyes phan chad mi 'chi ba med de8/ sems can thams cad kyang 'tsho ba'i mtha' ni 'chi bar 'gyur te/ ji ltar las byas de yis ni/ /bsod nams sdig pa'i 'bras bur 'gro/ /sdig pa'i las ni dmyal bar lhung / /bsod nams byas 13—361

pasatumatho ris 'gro/ /kha cig lam la bsgoms pas ni/ /zag pa med par mya ngan 'da'/ /sangs rgyas dang ni rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas kyisani nyan thos rnams/ /lus nisnyernam par 'dor 'gyur na/ /skye dgusam rabs smos ci dgos/ /de nas yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangasalgenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung nas song ste/bdag gi khyim du phyin pa dang / phyi mo'i mal gos stong par mthong nas yang sdug pa shi ba'i mya ngan gyis sems 'khrugs nas blon po dag la smras pa/ kye ngas mal gos 'di mthong nas rab tu mi dga' ba skyes kyis ⑦song la 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dag la 'di phul cig /de dag gis kyang dze ta'i tshal du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dag la phul ba dang / dge slong dag gis sgo khang du bting ste ⑧bzhag go/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na rgyal po deshegatsug lag khang du 'ongs nas des de mthong ba dang / de ngus so/ /blon po dag gis 'phags pa dag gis 'di mi bstan pa'i phyir khyed lasnyedabul na sgo khang du bting ba de nyid nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur to zhes smras pa dang / de dag cang mi zer bar 'dug nas/de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo khang du ma gding bar yang thog tu thing shig /de yang nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yang thog tu ma gding bar gnas khang du thing shig /de gnas khang du bting ba dang / ma dad pa dag gis rgyal mo'i mal gos ni dge slong rnams kyis btsongs te zos gor ma chagatso /snga na ni snang na da mi snang ngo zhes 13—362

'phya btudang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi'i⑧dus su yang thog tu thingasal zhog shig /ma dad pa dag gis mthong nas/'di ni lha mo'i mal gos ma yin gyi/ dge slong dag gis nges par btsongs te zos so zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis phul ba'i gos so zhes yi ger bris te0zhog shig /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod par ser ba drag po zhig babasnyenas der ri dgas dang bya mang zhig shi'o/ /skye bo mang po dag tho rangs sngar langs nas ri dgas dang bya gang bzar rung ba la sogs pa ni bsdus te khyer/bya rog la sogs te bzar mi rung ba ni bor ro/ /drug sde rnams chos kyis mang du za zhing ring du nyal lo/ /de dag ring zhig nas namakhulangs te thos ma thag tu myur du rings par dong nas de dag gis bya rog dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rgod dang / bya chu skyar mo dag blangs te 'ong ba bram ze dang khyim bdagashegis mthong nas de dag gis 'phags pa 'dis7ci zhig bya zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis bza'o zhes smras nasaX/ 'phags pa 'di dag ni bzar mi rung gis bor cig kye gzhan rnyed na yang blang na 'di ci'i phyir mi bza'/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bya rog la sogs pa sha bzar mi rung ba'i sha ma za shig /zos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo dang po'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa'o// //13—363

mdor na/ khyi dang khra dang 'ug pa dang / /mi sha za ba'i bya dag dang / /rta dang dre 'u0wa dang ni/ /spre'u rnams bza' bar mi bya 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mu ge byung nas khyim pa dag khyi'i sha za ba la zhugs pa dang / drug sde dag mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la dong ste/ khyim gang nas gang du 'ongs pa de dang der 'phags pa cung zad tsam yang ma mchis so zhes smras pa dang / de nas yang khyim bdagakhugazhan zhig tu 'ongs pa dang / de na rje'ushenang du0khyi sha zhig 'tshod de khol zhing 'dug go/ /khyim bdag gi chung mas 'phags pa cung zad kyang ma mchis kyis bzhud cig ces smras pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ rje'ukenang na khol zhing 'dug pa de ci yin/ 'phags pa 'di ni khyi sha'o/ /ci khyed cag khyi sha za'am/ 'phags pa mu ge byung bas na 'tshal lo/ /de ltar na nged cag kyang byin cig /'phags pa khyed kyang gsol lam/ kye nged cag gi srog khyed la rtenashen khyed cag za na nged cag kyang ci'i phyir mi bza'akhru/ de dag gis byin no/ /de byin pa dang khyer te song ngo / /khyi dag gis snar bsnams pa tshor nas de dag gis bskor cing / bdag bdag gi 8skad kyis zugs shing du ste phyi bzhin du 'brang ba bram ze dang khyim bdage gis mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci'i slad du khyi dag gis gtses bzhin du 'dong / de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag bsod snyoms khyi sha cung zad cig rnyed do/ /'phags pa ci khyed cag khyi'i sha za'am/ kye 'di lta bu bsod snyoms mi rnyed pa'i dus na nged cag ci ltogs bzhin du 'chi'am/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 13—364

kyis dgongs pa/ gang dge slong dag gis khyi sha zos pas nitunyes pa'i dmigs su gyur te/ de bas na dge slong dag khyi sha ma za shig /dge slong dag gis khyi sha zos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ drug sde dag gis khra dang / 'ug pa dang / bya mi sha za ba de dag gi sha yang za ba dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag ma dad pa dag 'phya bar gyur nas/de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to②/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khra dang / 'ug pa dang / mi sha za ba dag gi⑧bya'i sha ma za shig /dge slong dag0gis khra dang / 'ug pa dang /mi sha za ba dag gi bya'i sha zos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ ma byin par len pa dag gis yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi dre'u0zhig brkus te khrid nas nags stug po'i nang du bsad de sha khyer nas mgo sug bor te dong ngo / /drug sde rnams chos kyis goms pa ni nang par sngar langs nas khang steng du byung ste0phyogs bzhir bltas nas dud pa gang na che ba dang / bya rgod gang na lding ba phyogs bzhir bltas nas der dong ngo / /de dag gis nags stug po na⑧bya rgod lding ba mthong nas/de dag nags stugashepor rgyug cing rings par dong ba dang / nags stug po de na dre'u'i mgo dang rkang lag dang mjug ma dag mthong nas/ de dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bo rdul khrod pa zhig rnyed na blang ngam zhes pa dang /legs kyis blang ngo zhes nas de dag gcig tu bsdus pa dang / dre'u rdzi yan man tshol bas mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ni drang srong gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin na ci'i phyir ngan du spyod pa mdzad/ nged cag gis ci zhig 13—365

nyes zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po'i dre'u ni khyed cag gis bsad do zhes smras pa dang / sdig pa zhi bar gyur cig nged cag ni mi gsod do/ /'o na sus bsad ces pa dang / ma byin par len pa dag gis bsad de/ nged cag gis ni mgo dang / rkang pa dang / mjug ma dag rdul khrod par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de dag gis ci 'phags pa khyed cag dre'u sha bsnams ①sam zhes smras pa dang /za'o zhes smras pas de dag 'phya bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gang dge slong dag srog chags dre'usasha zos pasani nyes pa'i dmigs su 'gyur te / de bas na dge slong dag gis srog chags mig zlum gyi sha ma za shig /de ste zos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ drug sde dag gis wa'i sha zos pa dang /bram ze dang khyim bdag gis mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa 'di ci lags/ wa'i sha'o/ /ci 'phags pa dag kyang wa'i sha bsnamasakyisam/ za'o zhes smras pa dang /de dag 'phya bar gyur nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'phya ba ni lus te/ dge slong dag de bas na wa'i sha ma za shig /dge slong dag gis wa'i sha zos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dze ta'i tshal na spre'u zhig shing gshenas shing kur rgyu ba las lhung nas dus 'das te/ drug sde dag gis rdze'u7zhig gi nang du bcug ste 'tshed pa dang / bud med gzhan zhig bu chung ngu zhig stor nas de tshol zhing dze ta'i tshal du 'ongs na/ drug sde rnams rje'u'i nang du spre'u btsos 13—366

pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas des drug sde dag gis bdag gi bu 'dir ma btsos sam snyam bsams te rtog pa la zhugs pa dang / ji tsam zhig na lhung lhung khol ba dang spre'u'itulag pa gyen du byung ba dang / des7brang brdungs te kyi hud bu kyi hud bu zhes smras pa dang / de'i rkang pa yang byung ste/ kyi hud bu kyi hud bu zhes yang smras pa dang / drug sde dag gis ci'i phyir de ltar byed ces smras pa dang / des rkang lag byung ba 'di ni bdag gi bu'o zhes smras pa dang / ji tsam nas mjugasnyem yang byung ngo / /drug sde dag gis ci khyod kyi bu 'jugasnyem yod dam zhes smras pa dang / de skyengs te smras pa/0 'phags pa 'di ni spre'u'am /de dag gis smras pa spre'u'o/ /'phags pa dag spre'u sha yang bsnamasakhusam/des za'o zhes smras pa dang / de dag 'phya bar gyur nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag spre'u ni mi sha dang 'drasal/ de bas na dge slong dag spre'u'i sha ma za shig /dge slong dag gis spre'u'i sha zos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo dang po'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa'o// //mdor na/ phor bu gos dang pags pa dang / /'dab ma'i phor bus mi sbyin no/ /lcags kyi sbu bu ma gtogs par/ /nor bu khar bas btang ba 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na mnyan du yod pa na dge slong gzhan zhig na ste/ de rab tu nad kyis gzir nas de sman pa'i drung du song ste nad med cig ces nas bzhin bzangs bdag ni rnam pā 'di lta bu zhig tu na 13—367

bar gyur na sman gyi thabs ston cig ces smras pa dang / sman pas 'phags pa mas gtangatuba'i sman gyis shig ces smras pa dang / des bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo zhes smras pa dang / 'phags pa khyed kyisaston pa ni thugs rje can lags kyisalgerjes su gnang bar 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste sman pas bsgosal des sos par 'gyurasnyen mas gtangakhub byos shig de la the tshom du ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis mas gtang ba'i sman thong shig ces gsungs pa dang / de dag gis phor bus blugs pa dang / bo ste ma rungasnyenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phor bus ma blugs shig ces gsungs pa dang / gos kyi mtha' mas blugs pa dang de yang nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur nas/— bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gos kyi mtha' mas ma blugs shig ces gsungs na/ pags7pa'i nang nas blugs pa dang de yang nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pags pa'i nang nas ma blugs shig ces gsungs pa dang /'dab ma'i phor bu'i nang nas blugs te/ de yang nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dab ma'i phor bu'i nang nas ma blugs par spu bu'i nang nas blugs par gyis shig /des lcags kyi spu bu nas blugs pa dang / de nang du bcug na rab tu tsha zhing rtsub par gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lcags kyi sbu bu ma gtogs par nor bu'i spu bu'atsho/ khar ba'i sbu bus gtang bar gyis shig /rkyang pa'i sgo dang po'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa drug pa'o// //13—368

mdor na/ bu ram shing dang zho zhag 'bru mar dang / /gso mnyebasregs pa'i thug pa dang ni mar/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu sdong po7lo mar bcas/ /thug pa thams cad blud par bya / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'aphur ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun patsho sman gcig las de nyid snga dro ba de nyid phyi dro ba ⑤de nyid zhag bdun pa/ de snyed nam 'tsho'i bar du rung bar 'gyur bakhemachis sam u pā li bu ram shing ni snga dro'i'o⑦/ /de'i khu ba ni phyi dro ba'o/ /bu ram ni zhag⑧bdun pa'o/ /bu ram shing dang bu ram bsregs pa'i thal ba ni nam 'tsho'i bar du'o/ /u pā li zho ni snga dro ba'o/ /zho'i chu ni phyi dro ba'o/ /mar ni bdun pa'o/ /zho bsregs pa'i thal ba ni nam 'tsho'i bar du'o/ /u pā li sha ni snga dro ba'o/ /tshil7bu ni bdun pa'o/ /sha bsregs pa'i thal ba ni nam 'tsho'i bar du'o/ /u pā li til ni snga dro ba'o/ /til gyi mar ni bdun pa'o/ /til bsregs pa'i thal ba ni nam 'tsho'i bar du'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong zhig na bar gyur nas sman pas mthong ste/ 'phags pa gso ma'i thug pa byos la 'thung shig ces smras pa dang / des de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams la smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ltar sman pas bsgo ba de bzhin du gyis shig de la the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong gzhan rludag cig yang na 13—369

bar gyur nas de dag kha cig la ni sman pas yungs kur ①gyi thug pa 'thung shig ces bsgo/ kha cig la ni rtsa ba'i thug pa 'thung shig ces bsgo/ kha cig la ni sdong bu'i thug pa 'thung shig ces bsgo/ kha cig la ni 'bras bu'i thug pa 'thung shig ces bsgo ba dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das lasagasol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na ngas rjes su gnang gis ②sman pas nad pa la lung bsgo na thams cad kyi thug pa'ang 'thung shig de la the tshom du ma byed cig /rkyang pa'i sgo dang po'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa'o// //mdor na/ bu ram chu dang btung ba de bzhin te/ /zhag bdun bzha ga par gyur pa dang / /gzhan gyi phyir yang bsngo ba dang / /rjes su phan gdags mya7bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'akhur ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas te gzhongs spyod cing gshegs pa dang / de dag ri brags kyisagrong gzhan zhig tu phyin te/ ri brags kyi7grong de na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gnas pa de gdul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ bcom ldan 'das ri brags kyi grong der byon pa dang / khyim bdag des bcom ldan 'das mthong nas de dad pa skyes te bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du 'ongs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang / khams dang rang bzhin mkhyen nas ji ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba'i 8chos de lta bu bshad nas khyim bdag des thos pa dang 'jig tshogs su lta 13—370

ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ①ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugos pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /ji tsam dge slong de dag lam gyisangal bas gzir nas log pa'i lha khang dang / bkad sa dang / skyedashemos tshal dang / shing drung dag tu glos phab ste nyal zhing 'khod pa0dang / khyim bdag de rab tu dad pa thob pas na bkad sa dang / lha khang dang / shing drung dag tu rim gyisasnyedage slong dag la phyag bya ba'i phyir song ba dang / dge slong dag gnas na nyal zhing 'dug pa des mthong nas/ 'phags pa dag bstan pa la0shin tu brtson par bgyi ba la ci'i slad du na gzims shing 'khod ces smras pa dang / de dag gis khyim bdag lam gyisangal bas gzir zhingashenyam chung ste dge ba'i phyogs spyod par mi nus so zhes smras pa dang / des 'phags pa rnams de ltar na ni phyi dro bu ram gsol bar bcom ldan 'das kyisalgeganang na/ bdag 'tshal te mchis gsol cig ces smras pa dang / de dag las kha cig na de khyim bdag de lags kyis bza' bar bgyi'o/ /kha cig gis tshe dang ldan pa khyim bdag 'be ra tra si dag gis bu ram bza' ba la brten nas des dgra bcom pa mngon du gyur te/bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin rjes su gnang na bdag cag ni de ltarasnyelam gyi ngal bas gzir7te/ 'jig rten na ma dad pa dag ni grong na 'khod bzhin du za'o zhes mi dga' bar 'gyur gyis0gud du 'dong ngo zhes smras pa dang /kha cig gis yang tshe dang ldan pa de ltar 'dong na bcom ldan 'das la zhu'o zhes smras nas / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol tos//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dubu ram ni thams cad du bza' bar bya ste/ de la the tshom du ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad du bu 13—371

ram zo shig ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong detudag gis zos pa dang / de dag lam gyisangal bas skom gyis gdungs par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu ram gyi chu gyis la 'thung shig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bu ram chukhuzhag bdun par byin gyis brlabs te 'tshal na0rung ngam/ u pā li mikhurung ngo / /btsun pa ji tsam gyi0bar du bzhag la btung bar bgyi/ u pā li ji tsam na dang bar gyur te skyur por ma gyur cing rang bzhin ma nyams pa'i bar du'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gso sbyin dang /tshul nas byung ba dang / chos gos byin gyis brlabasalgepa dang / gos bsngo ba dang / gang zag gcig po mgron7du bos pa dang / 'di lnga ni rang gis bsams pas 'grub bo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dge slong de dag gang du mgron du bos pa der de las gzhan du yang mgron du bos sam de las lhag par yang rung ste/ gcig tu ni bdag nyid/ gnyis su ni bdag gi sems btang nas gzhan gtang ba'o/ /mu ge'i dus la bab ste dge slong rnams bsod snyoms kyis shin tu phongs par gyur to/ /dad pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gis dge slong gnas brtan dag zas la mgon du bos pa dang / khyim bdag cig la khas blangs te gzhan btang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'/ de lta bas na ngas mu ge byung zhing sdug bsngal la rnyed dka' ba'i dus na/ ji snyed du mgron du bos pa de thams cad bdag gir bya bar gyis de la bdag kyang zo shig /dge slong dag kyang bgo bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag bram ze dang khyim bdag gzhan gyi der dong ba dang / de dag gis 'phags pa khyed ni bdag cag 13—372

gis mgron ①du ma bos kyi ②'di zhes ③bgyi ba'i gnas brtan bdag cag gis spyan drangs so zhes smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsolasapa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bdag nyid song la byin len byas te 0kham gnyis dusam gsum zo la 'di skad du khyim bdag dge slong 'di dag zas kyis brel te/ 'di la sbyin gyisalgerjes su yi rang bar gyis shig ces smras shig /de bzhin du gnyis sam gsum mam ⑨ji snyed mgron ⑩du bos pa thams cad la byin cig /thams cad de ltar byas nas tha mar mgron du bos pa ni ji tsam 'grangs par bza' bar bya ste/ 'di la the tshom du ma byed cig /rkyang pa'i sgo dang po'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa'o// //mdor na/ mar ram de ste 'bru mar ram/ /gzhan yang bzhag par gyur pa dang / /mig sman gyi ni gab tshe dang / /yangs pa can dang rung ba'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong gzhan zhig rlung nad kyis btab pa des sman pa'i gan du song ste/ bzhin bzangs bdag la 'di 'dra ba'i nad kyis btab na sman ston cig ces smras so/ /des 'phags pa mar 'di tsam zhig gsol dang 'tsho bar 'gyur ro zhes smras so9/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag la smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste sman pas mar 'thung shig par bsgo na btung bar bya'o/ /dge slong des 'thungs pa dang nyin par bde yang mtshan 13—373

mo yang rlung nad langs so/ /dge slong dag gis sman pa la dris pa dang / des mtshan mo yang 'thung shig ces smras so/ /dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan mo yang 'thung ①shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / des mang du bsags srinas zhag bdun du byin gyis brlabs te deshesos par gyur to//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong gzhan zhig nad kyis btab nas de yang sman pa'i drung du song ste/ nad med cig ces byas nas bzhin bzangs bdag la 'di 'dra ba'i nad cig gis btab na sman gyi thabs ston cig ces smras so/ /des 'phags pa 'bru mar 'di tsam zhig 'thungs0na sos par 'gyur ro zhes bsgo ba dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag la smras pa dang /dge slong dag gis kyangasnyibacom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste sman pas 'bru mar 'thung shig ces bsgo na 'bru mar 'thung shig /dge slong des 'thungs pa dang / nyin par sos kyang mtshan mo yang rlung nad de dulangs so/ /dge slong dag gis sman pa la dris pa dang /des mtshan mo yang 'thung shig ces bsgo'o/ /dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtshan mo yang 'thung shig /des 'bru mar bsags te zhag bdun du byin gyis brlabs nas 'thungs pa dang sos par gyur to//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong gzhan zhig nad kyis btab pa dang / de yang sman pa'i drung du song nas nad med cig ces smras nas/bzhin bzangs bdag la nad 'di lta bu zhig gis btab na sman gyi thabs ston 13—374

cig ces smras so/ /des mar ram 'bru mar 'di tsam zhig 'thungs na sos par 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang / de bshes nyung bas btsal kyang ma rnyed nas yang sman pa'i drung du song nas bzhin bzangs khyod kyis bsgo yang kho bos 'bru mar yang ma rnyed na mar lta ga la rnyed gzhan lta cung zad ci rung ston cig ces smras pa dang / des 'phags pa 'di zhes bya ba'i dge slong zhig gisatu'abru mar sbyar na②/'di zhes bya ba zhig gis mar sbyar gyis7de'i gan du song dang / gal te sbyar ba de'i lhag pa0yod kyang srid do zhes smras pa dang / de dag gi drung du song nas bslangs na/ de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa de zhag bdun las 'das te sbagasasnyipar gyur pas med do zhes smras pa dang / de de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag la smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nad pa'i thabs rtogs la mar ram 'bru mar gzhan ci yang rung bzhag pa yang blas bza' bar bya ste/ de la the tshom du ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis mar ram 'bru mar ram gzhan ci yang rung bzhag pa yang blas zo shig⑧ /de la the tshom du ma byed cig ces bka' stsal nashebyin len byed pa med do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byin len byed pa'i mi med na byin len ma byas kyang blas ⑩tho shig /gang gi tshe na ba na gnang ba de ⑪ sos nas byam spyod cig /spyad na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis mig sman gyi snod gang tshe chongs shig ces bka' stsal na/ ci 'dra ba bcang bar bgyi/ u pā 13—375

li rin po che las byas pa ma ①gtogs so/ /yang zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis yul yangs bsnyen mi rung ba rnam pa bcu spongasal/ rung ba'i khang pa byin gyis brlabasrepar gyis shigasaces bka' stsal naX/ ci btsun pa khang pa 'og rung bar byin gyis brlabs na khang pa'i steng yang rung bar byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ram/ u pā li ji ltar steng gi bzhin du ngos kyi yang brjod par bya'o/ /rkyang pa'i sgo dang po'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa'o// // mdor na/ rtsa sdong lo ma 'bras bu rnams/ /thams cad chang gis sbags pa dang / /kha zas med par bkrus pa dang / /yang na zas ngan de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i dngos po shing n+ya gro dha'i kun dga'asher ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po zas gtsang masakhushākya'i rigs re re zhing yang shākya lnga brgya zhig bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨g.yog tu phul ba dang / de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu phyung ngo / /de dag sngon lus chang gis gsos pas na de dag chang med nas lus la nad zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la kun dga' bo ci'i phyir na shākya dag /rnyi rnyi bor gyur ces bka' stsal pa dang / de ltar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das la zhib mor gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ltar na ngas gnang ba ni chang du 'gyur balgem ba dang sdong po 0la sogs pa bskams la phye mar gyis ④te ras dkar po'i nang du thum por gyis la chang gi mthu zhil ba rdza ma ma gang ba'i nang du lhugs shig de nas slar phyung ste lag pa 'khrus la chu kha zas med pa dang bsres 8te 'dang bar 13—376

tshogs la 'thung shig /de skom na snga dro yang rung / phyi dro yang rung ste the tshom ma byed par 'thung shig /de ltar byos7dang de dag chang la sred pa dang 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong khyed ston pa nga la dmigs na ni chang ma 'thung shig /ma blud cig /rtsasamachog gis kyang ma reg shig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan⑧du yod pa na ste/ dge slong gzhan zhig na bar gyur nas de la sman pas zas ngan pa byin cig ces bsgo ba dang / de la dge slong kha cig gis ni shes kyi kha cig gis mi shes pa de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa u pā li lasadris pa dang / des de dag zhib tu smras so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dge slong swa tekhul zas ngan pa byin cig ces gsungs pa⑥ni ci de yang byin len bgyi 'tshal lam/ u pā li de yang byin len byos shig /su lasakhubyin len bgyi/u pā li de ni dge bsnyen dad pa las so/ /rkyang pa'i sgo dang po'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa ste/ sgo dang po rdzogs so// //mdor bsdus par na/ snod dang chos gos gnyi ga dang / /ko sa la dang sar pa de bzhin te/ /bsgrags dang chos gos sna tshogs dang / /lhan cig pa yang dge slong ma rnams ni/ /tha mar byas te bsdus pa'i mdor gsungs so/ /mdor na/ snod dang yo byad gtsug lag khang / /'gron pa mang bcom gos rnams dang / /gos dang gdugs dang de bzhin shing / /dur khrod pa dang de bzhin spangs/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na khyim bdag 13—377

gzhan zhig gis ri brags kyi ①gong gzhan zhig tu yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig brtsigs nas phyogs bzhi'isridage 'dun la phul lo/ /de na mal stan dang / snod spyad mang du gyur/ dge slong ni nyung ngu gnas te②/de'i nang nas kha cig gis tshe dang ldan pa dag mal stan dang snod spyad dang / yo byadasam spyad na de dag chud zos par 'gyur gyis⑤/ de dag las bdag cag la spyad par ci0tsam dgos pa de tsam zhig bcangs la/ de'i lhag ma rnams ni gtsug lag khang gzhan du dbul lo zhes smras nas/ de dag gis de bzhin byas so/ /dzi tsam zhig na bsod snyoms pa gzhan zhig gzhongs7spyad pa spyod cing gtsug lag khang der 'ongs pa dang / dge slong de dag gis ngal bsor bcug nas de yang dge 'dun de dag gi nang na rgan pa zhig ste/ gtsug lag khang du lam gyi ngal bsoshenas des de dag la tshe dang ldan pa mal stan mchis sam zhes smras na/ med do zhes smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis ji ltar yin pa de la zhib tu smras so/ /de gding ba med par sa la de bzhin du nyal nas nang par sngar langs te⑩/ lde mig kyog po dang / lde mig khyer nas khyim bdag de'i khyim du song ba dang / de nas khyim bdag des de la bde bar byon tam zhes pa'i tshig brjod nas stan khyer te phyir byung ba dang / bsod snyoms pa de spyod lam zhi ba'i tshul du 'dug go/ /bsod snyoms pas kyang de la nor las bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po bdun gyi yon tan rgyas par brjod pa dang / khyim bdag gis 'phags pa bdag gis de thams cad bgyis so zhes smras pa dang / bsod snyoms pas khyim bdag khyod kyi gtsug lag khang na mal stan chadag yod med de/ mdang nga yang gding ba med par sa'i steng na de bzhin du nyal nyal te 'dir 13—378

'ongs so/ /khyedakhun re desathams cad bdag gis de bzhin du bgyis so zhesalgezer na/ 'di ci'unyes zhes smras pa dang / khyim bdag gis 'phags pa kho bos ni der mal stan dang snod spyad dang / yo byad rnams mang du sbyar na 'phags pa de dag gis gtsug lag khang gzhan du gdon ma zos par btang ngo zhes smras pa dang / des khyim bdag nyid kyisasnyegatsug lag khang gi lde mig kyog po dang /lde mig ngo shes sam zhes smras pa dang / 'phags pa shin tu 'tshal to/ /des de bstan pa dang / des 'phags pa bzhud cig bdag kyang mchi'o zhes smras so/ /desasnyebasod snyoms bsod payidang / khyim bdag kyang rjes bzhin du 'ongs nas/ des dge slong rnams bsdus nas 'phags pa bdag gis 'dir mal stan dang / snod spyad dang / yo byad mang du phul na de dag gar mchis zhes smras pa dang / des ji ltar gyur pa de dag thams cad khyim bdag la smras pa dang / des nyes pa ngor brjod de smras pa/ khyod kyis ma legs par byas te/de yang der bas na da ci slar blang 'du rung ngam bya'on te mi rung de dag gis smras pa/ mi rung ngo / /'phags pa kho bos ni der ma phul gyis song la slar long shig /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gtsug lag khang gzhan du ma dbul cig /ji ltar dmigs pa de bzhin spyad par bya'o/ /gzhan du na gang gis byin pa la rin thang bzhin du phob shig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ drug sde rnams 'gron pa mang po dang lhan cig tu gzhongs spyad pa spyod cing dong ba dang / de dag chos kyis rdul gyis 'jigs pa na yang na ni 'gron pa dag gi mdun du dong / yang na phyi 13—379

bzhin dongatungo / /ji tsam na 'gron⑧pa mang po rnams rkun pos bcom nas skye bo mang po rnams kyis nor borasate bros pa dang / rkun po rnams kyis nor kun bkur ma nus nas de dag gis bzang ba bdams0te khyer te dong ngo / /drug sde rnams 'gron ⑤pa mang po'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs te dong ba las gnas der phyin pa dang / de dag gis nor mang po bor ba mthong ste/ de nas dga' bo nye dga' bo phyag dar khrod pa rnyed kyis blang ngo zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis de las kyang gos rnams bdams te khyer ro/ /'gron⑧pa mang po ramasnyemada' dang lam srungs su bcas te slar log pa de dag gis drug —sde dag gis7khyer ba rnams ngo shes nas/ de dag gis gang rkun po rnams kyis bor ba de yang dge stong mgo reg rnams kyis brkus so zhes bsams so9/ /drug sde rnams la kha ngan du 'phags pa dag drang srong gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa 8de lta bu'i log par spyod pa dag spyod pa zhes spyos te nyes pa ngor brjod pa dang / de dag gis 'gron pa mang po rnams rkun pos bcom ste nged kyis ni ma yin gyi/ nged kyis phyag dar khrod kyi gos rnyed do zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis phyag dar khrod kyi gos ni ma lags so zhes smras pa dang / de lan med nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams 'gron pa mang po 'phya ba ni lus te/ de bas na dge slong dag gis 'gron pa mang po bcom pa'i gos ma bkur cig /dge slong dag gis 'gron pa mang po bcom pa'i gos khyer na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dad par gyur pa de dag gis 'phags pa dag ci bder snoms shig ces smras na dge slong 13—380

dag the tshom du gyur nas mi len to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste ci bder khyer cig ces smrasasnyen/ longasal the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni rgyal po'i khab na ste/ dge slong drug sde dag gis bsil bakhutshal gyi durasakhrod du dongasnyib dang / shi ba'i yo byad gdugs dang / shing dang0/gos dag mang po bor ba de dag gis mthong nas de'i nang nas gcig gis dga' bo nye dga' bo laphyag dar khrod kyi gos rnyed kyis bkur ro zhes smras pa dang /dga' bos legs soshelegs kyis bkur ro zhes smras nas de dag gis blangs te dong ngo / /dur khrod kyi srung ma rigs ngan dag 'ongs nas des bsams pa/dur khrod 'di na cung zad kyang med pas na kha cig gis dur brkus par gdon mi za'o snyam bsams nas/ yang 'di snyam du gang gis brkus pa de brnyogs pas slar yang 'ong bar cigadon mi zas tsomangon par gab ste 'dug go snyam du bsams te tsonags stug po'i nang du zhugs nas nyin gcig bzhin du sdod cing 'dug pa dang / drug sde dag zhag bdun nam brgyad lon te dga' bo nye dga' bo bdag cag gis dur khrod du ma dong nas da ring zhig lon te cung zad tsam rnyed kyang srid kyis yang 'deng ngo zhes smras pas de dag dong ngo / /ji tsam de na gos dang / gdugs dang / shing dag bor ba de dag gis blang bar brtsams pa dang rigs ngan nags tshal stug po na 'dug pa des mthong nas brgyugs 0te 'ongs nas/ des 'phags pa dag bdag cag phu nu dang / gnyen dang grogs po dag rgyal po'i bka' bzhin du byed pa yang dur khrod kyi gos 'di'i phyir yin na khyed cag gis0ci'i phyir bdag po yod pa'i dur khrod kyi shi ba'i yo byad dag bkur bar bya zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis bzhin bzangs nged cag 13—381

gis ni phyag dar khrod pa'i gos blangs so/ /des 'phags pa 'di la de dag phyag dar7khrod kyi gos yin na rab tusalegs so zhes smras pa dang / de dag lan med nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gisashebacom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag rigs ngan 'phya ba ni yus te/ de bas na dge slong dag bdag po yod pa'i dur khrod nas phyag dar khrod kyi gos ma len cig /dge slong dag gis bdag po yod pa'i⑧dur khrod kyi phyag dar khrod pa'i gos blangs na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dad par gyur pa dag gis de la 'phags pa dag ci bde bar khyer cig ces smras pa dang / dge slong dag the tshom du gyur te ma blangs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de stekyibade bar long rgyashig ces zer na blang bar bya ste de la the tshom du ma byed cig /rkyang pa'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dang po'o// // 'dul ba gzhung dam pa9 bam po bzhi bcu pa/ mdor na/ gos la sogs pa shing bal dang / /lha khang nas 'phrog de bzhin te/ /dge 'dun gyi ni chos gos gsum/ /gang zag dag las bslang mi bya/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'achar ba na bzhugs te/ drug sde dag bzhon pa mang po'i shing rta dang lhan cig lam du zhugs nas lam gyi phyed du phyin pa dang / shing rta gcig gi srog shing chag nas tshong pa des srog shing yang brjes nas srog shing chag pa bor te song ngo / /nye dga' bos shing rta'i srog shing de blangs te lam po che'i bzhi tsomador bor nas 13—382

smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bo 'di ni bdag cag gisanyesrog shing dbang phyug ces bya ba'i lha rten du bca' ba'i phyir bcugs so zhes byas te dong ba las khyim bdag gzhan dag gis kyang der stegs bu brtsigs so/ /gzhan zhig gis kyang de la gsol ba btab stekhya/ gal te bdag gis7don 'di dang 'di lta bu zhig grub na bdag gis 'dir khang pa brtsigs la bram ze brgya rtsa brgyad la 0ston mo bya'o zhes smras pa las de yang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang ldan pas de'i de yang grub nas des desaji ltar dam0bcas pa thams cad bsgrubs nas de log pa'i lha khang du gyur te lha khang pas kyang byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas tshong pa 'gron pa mang po dag cig lam der zhugs pa dang der gos dang / bal dang /shing bal dag mang du phul lo/ /drug sde dag slar log pa'i tshe lha khang de rab tu rgyas par mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bo shing rta'i srog shing dbang phyug gos dang / bal dang / shing bal dag rab tu mang shing phun sum tshogs pa de bkur ro zhes desnyedag gis blang bar brtsams pa dang / lha khang pa dag lhags te/ de dag gis 'phags pa dag lha khang 'di ni bdag cag gi steng ⑨'di ni las dang byi dor bdag cag byagis bgyis na lha'i gos rnams ci'i phyir len cing dbrog /khyed cag ma byin par len pa ma spangs sam zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis bkren pa 'di ji ltar khyed kyi lha khang nged cag gis shing rta srog shing chag pa zhig rten thabs su btsugs te bzhag go/ /zhes smras so//lha khang pa des ku cho bton pa dang / de nas nye dga' bo khros nas de rdog pa gcig brgyab nas bsnyel bar byas so/ /de nas de snyems shing dregs pa rnams spa gong nas 'phags pa khyed dam gzhan gyis byas par gyur nas yang bdag 13—383

cag ni ①'di la rten ②cing 'tsho ba yang 'di la bltas srin ci'i phyir khyed kyis 'phags pa'i chos ma yin pa byed ces smras pa dang / de dag ma spobs te cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ④pa/ dge slong dag log par lta ba'i⑧lha khang na gnas pa dag 'phya ba ni yus te/ de lta bas na dge slong dag0gis lha khang bdag po yod pa'i gos la sogs pasheblang bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis〈lha khang bdag po yod pa'i gos la sogs pa blangs na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur phro/ /log pa'i lha khang pa dad pa gzhan zhig gis ci bder spyod cig ces smras pa dang / dge slong de dag the tshom skyes te ma blangs nasayi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te ci bder byas pa ni blang bar bya ste/ de la the tshom du ma byed cig /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyisalgend pa la skyel cig ces gsungs pa dang / ji tsam zhig na dge slong zhig na bar gyur pa de'i nad g.yog gis tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun la cung zad cig phuli cig ces smras pa dang / des kyang bdag la cung zad tsam yang med mod kyi chos gos gsum dbul lo zhes smras pa dang / de cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de 8chos gos gsum phul nas de dag gis btsongs te bgos so/ /dge slong de phyir0sos te langs nas chos gos gsum gyis phongs par gyur te/ de ltar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gisalgegasol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge slong la dge 'dun gyi phyir chos gos gsum ma bslang shig bslangs na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun gyis kyang ma blang shig /13—384

de ste blangs na yang ma 'ged cig /bgos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo gnyis pa'itumado'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis sonya// //mdor na/ gnyi ga la yang gnang ba dang / /rnam pa tha dad rjes su gnang / /sum cha dang yang dge tshul dang / /dge slob ma dang dge tshul ma/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa nashedze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs go /dge slong drug bcu zhig ljongs rgyu ba spyod cing ri brags kyisagrong zhig tu phyin nas de na khyim bdag dad pa zhig gnas pas7des de dag de'i khyim du bshos la spyan drangs nas des dge slong re re zhing ras yug re re dbul lo snyam du bsams gyi/ /de dag zanakhuza ba la zhugs pa dang / dge slong ma drug bcu zhig kyang ljongs rgyu ba spyod cing ri brags kyilogrong der phyin pa dang / bsod snyoms slong ba la zhugs so/ /gzhan zhig gis khyim bdag 'di'i khyim na dge slong dag bshos gsol gyis7der bzhud cig ces smras pa dang / de dag der dong ste de dag gis kyang zan zos pa dang / de nas khyim bdag des ras yug drug bcu zhig rgan rims kyi mdun du bzhag go/ /dge slong dag ji lta bur bgo ba mi shes nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge 'dun sde gnyis kyis 'thob pa yin gyis0/ dge 'dun sde gnyis su gos shig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan cig gis gtsug lag khang zhig brtsigs te/ des de'i zhal bsros te/ dge 13—385

'dun sde gnyis bshos gsol nas rnyed pa yang mang du phul te dge slong dag gis bgos pa dang / dge slong dag nged cag la ni chos gos gsum dgos kyis①/dge tshul pha dag gisastod g.yogs dang mthang gos su zad na / ji ltar bdag cag dngasamanyam par bgo zhes 'phya'o⑤/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dang dge slong ma ni skal ba mnyam par bgos shig / dge tshul pha dang zha dge tshul ma dang / dge slob ma dag lasani sum cha cig byin cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge tshul pha dag la sum cha cig byin cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / ji tsam zhig na dge tshul pha gzhan zhig lo nyi shu yang tshang zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par yang 'dod na de la dge slong gis tshe dang ldan pa lo nyi shu tshang na ci'i phyir bsnyen par rdzogs par mi byed ces smras pa dang / des kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis ni bdag cag gi rnyed pa 'di lta bur bcas na stod g.yogs dang mthang gos su mi ldang na chos gos gsum lta ci smosabya/ ji ltar bsnyen par rdzogs par bya zhes smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge tshul pha bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa dang / dge slob ma la sum gnyis byin cig /dge tshul pha dang dge tshul ma gzhan ni skal ba sum char zad do/ /rkyang pa'i sgo gnyis kyi mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa'o// //mdor na/ ko sa la na drug bcu dang / /brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang / /sgra can zin dang dpal sbed dang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod 13—386

rten de bzhin7te/ /gdugs dang bris pa de bzhin sbyar/ /zan la mgron⑧du bos pa 'o②/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ko sa lar ljongs rgyu zhing spyod pa na ri brags kyi grong gzhan zhig tu byon nas ri brags kyisagrong de na khyim bdag cig gnas pas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun du bcas par0khyim du bshos la spyan drangs so/ /dge slong ma drug bcu zhig ljongs rgyu ba spyod pa na ri ci brags kyi grong der phyin nas de dag kyang der zan zos pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang lhan cig tu bshos gsol nas/khyim bdag des ras yug brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum zhig rgan rims kyi mdun du bzhag go/ /dge slong dag gis ji ltar bgo ba mi shes nas dge slong ma dag gis de la gzhan byar ci yod/ sngon yang dge 'dun sde gnyis bshos gsol cib las bdag cag gisasnyernyed pa'i phyed thob na da yang bdag cag la rnyed pa'i phyed byin cig ces smras so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang du dge slong ma mang la dge slong pha nyung na der rnyed pa dge 'dun gnyi gar bgos shig /rgeng na dge slong pha mang la dge slong ma nyung na der mgo grangs bzhin du bgos shig/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ khyim bdag cig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dag bshos la spyan drangs so/ /dge slong gi dge 'dun dag ni dong / bcom ldan 'das ni gtsug lag khang na bzhugs te bshos tshur mnos so/ /rnam pa lnga'i phyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang tson bzhugs shing bshos mnos te gsol lo/ /lnga gang zhe na/ lha 13—387 5 ci

rnams la chos 'chad par bzhed pa yin/ nad pa dag gzigs par bzhed pa yin/ mal stan dag gzigs par bzhed pa yin/ nang du yang dag 'jogatul 'jug par bzhed pa yin/ nyan thos rnams kyisa'adul ba la bslab pa'i gnas 'cha' bar bzhed pa yin no/ /don 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyisakhunyan thos rnams kyi ④'dul ba la bslab pa'i gnas bca' ⑤bar bzhed pa'i phyir gtsug lag khang na bzhugs shing bshos mnos te gsol lo/ /khyim bdag de durgan pa dag la ⑦mngon par dad nas der largan rims su mar dang / mar las btsosalgepa'i bca' ba rnams brims/ bar ma dag la ni 'bru mar dang 'bru mar las btsos pa'i bca' ba dag brims/ gzhon nu la ni 'bru mar gyi tshigs ma dag brims so/ /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa sgra can zin bcom ldan 'das kyi skyabashos mnos te/ des bcom ldan 'das kyi bshos mnos nas 'ongs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis0sgra can zinasnyel dge slong gi dge 'dun tsobasod pa'i zas kyis tshim par byas sam zhes smras ⑩pa dang / des gsol pa/ btsun pa rgan pa'i rnams tshim mo/ /sgra can zin khyod ci'i phyir rid cing nyam chung zhing de skad zer ba smos shig /des tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'bru mar gyis ni mthur 'gyur te/ /mar gyis kyang ni mdangs su 'gyur/ /'bru mar tshigs kyi tshod mas ni/ /mdangs ma mchis na stobs lta zhig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgra can zin ci yin pa de smos shig /des de ltar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das la zhib mor gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sgra can zin chal de na gnas brtan su zhig 'dug ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das mkhan po mchis so/ /sgra can zin la dge 13—388

slong shā ri'i bus ni 'og ma dag ma brtags pas na ngan du zos pa yin rnal/ /de lta bu labyung ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun dag bsdus nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi mdun du gdan btingakhub la bzhugs te/ nyan thos rnams kyi0'dul ba la bslab pa'i gnas bca' ba'i phyir dge slong dang rgyadage 'dun gyi gnas brtan dge slong gis dumatshungs par spyad pa'i chos ngas bca' ste/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan dge slong gis zan 'brimasnyepa'i tshe snyoms par brims7shig ces bsgo shig des tshod ma sna re re la'ang smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lan tshwa'am dang por gang brims pa de'i tshe smos sheg /thams cad la ni ma yin no/ /dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan dge slong gis ji lta bur mtshungs par spyad pa'i chos bzhin ma byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gis 8zan zos pa smad 'do zhes thos nas/ des bdag gis zan zos pa 8ston pas 0smad na 'di ltar 'dug pa'i tsomi rigs so zhes bsamasalgenas des skyugs te btang ngo / /dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la zan zos pa smad pa dang /des slar skyugs pa la gzigs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di 'ba' zhig ma yin gyi sngon 'das pa'i dus na yang ngas de la zan zos pa smad pa dang / de'i phyir skyugs so/ /dge slong dag nyon cig (sngon byung ba ni grong khyer gzhan zhig na mang po 'chad pa'i bram ze zhig gnas te/ de bram ze'i bu dang lhan cig tu ljongs rgyu zhing spyod pa na ri brags 13—389

kyi7grong zhig tu phyin nas desardzing zhig gi 'gram du bram ze des bram ze'i bu der bzhag nas cungakhuzad cig sdod/ nga grong du phye la sogs pa bslangs te slar 'ong ngo / /de de na 'dug pa dang / khyi sha can zhig rdzing du chu grog 'thung du 'ongs so/ /de la bram ze'ikhubus kye skyes bu bdag kyang chu grog cig gsolakhucig ces smras so/ /des kyang lo ma la snod drubs shig ces smras pa dang / des snod drubs so/ /des de la khyi'i pags pa las ༷byas pa'i sgye'u'i ⑧nang nas byung ba'i phye byin no/ /de snum pa dang bram ze'i bus phye 'di snum na ci zhig ces dris pa dang / 'di ni pags pa las sgye'u byas pa'i mthu ste/ des sgye'u dag ci las byas pa zhib mor byas na/ bram ze'i bu des ma go'o/ /bram ze de slar 'ongs nas des bram ze'i bu khyod song la chu grog rgyu slongs shig ces smras pa dang / des chu grog 'tshal lags so zhes smras jo9/ /sus byin mi pha bis byin no/ /des pha bi ni khyi sha can te⑩/ des khyod la phye byin na de khyod kyis sdig par gyur to zhes smras nas/ des de la rab tu smad pa dang / des zos pa slar skyugs so/ /dge slong dag mi shes sam/ gang mang po 'chad pa'i bram ze de ni da ltar gyi nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na bram ze'i bu de ni da ltar gyi dge slong shā ri'i bu stetsho/ de'i tshe na yang ngas zas zos pa la rab tu smad nas des skyugs so/ /da 'dir yang ngas zos pa la rab tu smad nas 'dir yang skyugs par gyur to//gleng gzhi ni rgyal po'i khab na ste/ de'i tshe na rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na khyim bdag me skyes kyi sring mo'i khyo gcer bu pa'i dge bsnyen dpal sbed ces bya ba zhig 'dug ste/ khyim bdag me skyes dad pa des 'di snyam du dpal sbed 'di 13—390

dge 'dun dag la yon 'bul du bskul lo snyam bsams nas/ des de la dpal sbed dge 'dun dgatul mchod pa dang / yon phul cig dang khyod kyi bsod nams su 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /dpal sbed kyis smras pa②/ ngas kyang dge 'dun dag lasnyemachod cing yon dbul bar byaX/ khyod kyis kyang gang po la sogs te rab tu byung ba'i dge 'dun dag la mchod cing bshos gsol cig /me skyes kyisasnyi'adi snyam du bsams pa/ de ste khas ma blangs na dpal sbed kyis kyang dge 'dun la mchod pa'i bar chad du 'gyur na/ sems can thams cad la sbyin pa lta nyes pa ①med kyis tshugacer bu pa'i dge 'dun dag ⑧zas ①byin te bdag gis des dge 'dun la mchod cing yon 'bul ba'i bar chad mi ⑩bya'o snyam du yibasams nas 8des zas tsosbyin no zhes khas blangs nas dpal sbed kyis 'di snyam du bdag gis dang por sangs rgyas la sogs te dge slong gi dge 'dun dag sngar bshos gsol na ni me skyes kyis phyis zan byami sbyin gyis byagang po la sogs te rab tu byung ba'i dge 'dun dag bshos sngar gsol pa dang / ngas phyis zas sbyin no snyam bsams nas/ me skyes la 'di skad ces smras so/ /me skyes khyod kyis dang po zan byin cig dang / ngas kyang phyis dge sbyong gi ta ma dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dag la7zan sbyin no/ /des kyang khas blangs nas de nas khyim bdag me skyes kyis gang po dag gang na 'dug pa der phyin nas gang po dang lhan cig rab tu dga' zhing mgu yiba'i gtam sna tshogs dag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag me skyes kyis gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang po khyod sang bdag gi0khyim du gcer bu pa mang po dang / dge 'dun dang lhan cig tu bshos gsol gyis khas long 13—391

shig /gome pos bsams pa/ khyim bdag 'di ni gor ma chag par dge sbyonganyegi ta ma la sun par gyur nas bdag cag la rab tu dad par gyur te de ni bdag cag gi rnyed pa rab tu rnyed pasaste/ gang po bdag cag gi dge 'dun gyi rigs la rab tu dad par gyur to snyam nas des khas blangs so/ /de nas khyim bdag me skyes de dag spyan drangs nas song ngo / /de nas khyim bdag me skyes kyis de'i nub mo rab tu bsod pa'i bca'akhub dang bza' ba'i kha zas dag sbyar nas/ nang par sngar langs tekhulangs nas stan bting / ril ba dag chus bkang ste bzhag nas gang po dag la spyan 'dren pa'i0dus gsol pa/ kye gang po bshos rnams bshams kyisarkyudus mkhyen par mdzod cig /de dag dong ba dang / dpal sbed kyis de'i gnas su 'ongs te smras pa/ 'phags pa gang po dge sbyong gi ta ma ni khyim bdag gi khyim du bzhud de de nang du bzhud kur sgo'i them pa la zhabs bzhag nas 'dzum pa ston te/ de nas nyan thos kun dga' bo zhes bya bas stod g.yogs phyogs gcig tu gzarayi/ pus mo g.yas 8pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te thal mo sbyar nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos dag ni rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ btsun pa ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen gyis ⑩'dzum pa mdzad ces zhus pa dang / des kyang kun dga' bo de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos dag ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa ston par mi mdzad de/ de ji lta bur dgongs pa bzhin lung bstan to zhes smras nas/ de la skye bo mang po dag kyang rab tu dad par gyur gyis7khyod kyis kyang khyim bdag me skyes kyi khyim du 'gro ba'i tshe de ltar bya ba'i rigs so/ /'on 13—392

kyang skye bo mang po dag rab tu dad par 'gyur ro/ /des khas blangs so/ /de nas gang po gcer bu pa mang pos bskor nas khyim bdag me skyes kyi khyim du phyin pa dang / khyim bdag me skyes kyi sgo'i them pa la rkang pa bzhag ste rta gad7du bgad pa dang / de'i nang nas gcer bu pa gcig cigakhugis rkang pa la btud de bcom ldan 'das skyes bu dam pa khyod lta bu rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pasami mdzadakyido zhes dris pa dang / kye chu bo dregs bral gyi 'gram na spre'u pho zhig gis spre'u mo zhig mthong nas de la sems rab tu chags te spre'u mo de la rgalasalo snyam nas brgyugs pa dang gredakyide shing gi rtse mo nas rdeg 'chosasnyenas dus 'das so/ /de'i tshetung 'di snyam du sems te/ sems can 'di ni 'dod pa'i rgyus sdug bsngal ba cher gyur to snyam mo/ /de skad du kha nas byung ma thag tu khyim bdag me skyes kyis thos nas des bsams pa/ bu zan mo'i bu gang po ni khab 'tshong ba slar khab rdung ba'i khyim du khab 'tshong bar sems pa bzhin te/ ji nas 'di la kyal ka zhig bya'o snyam nas de dgane dbyug gu can mang po thams cad bde bar 'dug pa dang / khyim bdag des gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bca' ba dang bza' bas phor pa bkang nas steng du tshod ma blugs te byin no/ /gang po gcig po la ni phor pa'i zhabs su tshod ma blugs nas steng du 'bras chan gyis g.yogs te byin no/ /gcer bu pa phal dag za zhing 'dug pa dang gang pos bsams pa/ gor ma chag par des ni nga la ston par dmigs te/ des tshod ma zhim po dang kha zas bzang po sbyin par bsams so snyam nas ji tsam tshod ma brims zin pa dang / des bsams pa/ de ni brel bas brjed kyis bdag gis bskul lo snyam nas des bos nas khyim bdag nga la ni 'bras chan bla'aba' 13—393

zhig 'ongs kyis ①tshod ma ni med do zhes smras pa dang / des slar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ mi mthong ba ni mthong bar byed/ /mthong bar bya ba mi mthong ste/ /dregs bral 'gram gyi spre'u mthong la/ /phor bu'i nang gi tshod ma min/ /gang po yang de'i gdong bltasalgepa dang / des phor bu'i zhabs nashetshod ma 'dug pa bstan te/ gang po khyod kyis chu bo dregs bral gyi 'gram na spre'u 'dug pa ni mthong / phor bu'i nang na tshod ma 'dug pa nisnyem mthong ngo zhes smras pa dang / des bsams pa/ 'dis bdag skyengs par byas kyisasheci nas kyang 'jig rten 'di nas0pa rol gnyi gar phan par mi 'gyur ba de ltar sbyin pa'i yon tan brjod do snyam du bsams pa dang me skyes kyis de skyengs par shes nas sbyin pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i tshe de'i mdun du mkhu'adug go/ /des zan zos nas sbyin pa'i yon tan bklagasalgepa/ sbyin bdag gis ni sbyin pa'i dus/ /dge sbyong gzhan ni za ba'i dus/ /lhag ma gzhan la 'ong ba'i dus/ /bsod nams mi dge yod ma yin/ /sgo ba zhig 'dug pa des sbyin pa'i yon tan brjod pa la nyan nyan te thos nas khros pa 'di 'dra ba'i sdig can zas zos la bsrung yang mi nus te/ 'di 'dra ba'i sbyin pa'i yon tan lta ga la srid kyis7bu zan mo'i bu 'di la kyal ka zhig bya'o snyam nas des 'bras khu bum pa gang sgo drung du pho'o/ /sgo gtan gyi gdang phyed tsam drangs te bzhag pa dang gcer bu pa de phyir byung ba dang 'bras khu las gred de klad pa sgo gtan la phog nas khrag byung ngo / /de nas sgo ba des mthong ste/ tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ sgo gtan phyung ba'i dus la bab/ /'bras khu pho ba'i dus bab pas/ /mgo bo snad pa'i dus yin gyis⑥/ /dge dang mi dge'i dus med do/ /de klad pa la khrag zag 13—394

bzhin du khyim bdag dpal sbed gang na ba der song ste drung du ①phyin pa dang /dpal sbed kyis ②mthong nas btsun pa gang po ②ci nyes zhes dris pa dang /des smras pa/ me skyes kyis 'di 'dra b.rasreganod pasabyas so/ /dpal sbed kyis smras pa dngakyi/ khyod ni gsonasapor thar gyis7sdod cig dang / ci nas 'di ltar dge stong gi ta ma nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas par kho bo'i khyim nas gson bzhin du phyir mi 'byung bar byas mi dgar ma byed cig /dpal sbed kyis bsams pa/ 'di'i dgra la lan glan gyis spyan 'dren du 'gro'o/ /de ste dge sbyong gau ta ma de thams cad mkhyen pa yin na ni mgron du bos kyang khas len du mi btub bo/ /de ste thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin na ni khas len to snyam du bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig tu dga' ba'i gtam sna tshogs byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag dpal sbed kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye gi ta ma sang bdag gi 8khyim du dge slong gi dge 'dun dang lhan cig bshos la gshegs par zhal gyis bzhes shig ces spyan drangs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/gang gis nga las bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ba de 'di ltar byed do/ /de ste ngas khas ma blangs na ni bden pa'i bar chad dag tu 'gyur te/ ji nas khas blang ngo snyam nas gshegs par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /dpal sbed kyis bsams pa/'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin te/ de ste thams cad mkhyen pa yin na ni 'di ltar khas mi len pa'i rigs na/ ji nas 'di thams cad mkhyen du mi 'gyur bar dgra'i lan glan no snyam nas de nas de khyim du song ste/ de'i khyim 13—395

gyi sgo kur7dong chenakhupo brkosashenas nang du shing ka di da'i me mdag dud pa med pas bkang nas de'i steng du rtswas g.yogs nas sas bkab ste bzhag go/ /dug rnon pos bza' ba dang btung ba sbyar to/ /de nas me skyes kyi sring mos dpal sbed la jo bo cisazhig mdzad ces dris pa dang / des smras pa/ dgra gsad par bya'o/ /jo bo la dgra su mchis/ dge sbyong gi ta ma'o/ /ji0ste jo bo khyod kyi rgyadagra bcom ldan 'das yin na mdza' bo su zhig mchis kyis ②jo bo 'di lta bu 'phags pas 0chos ma yin pa'i las bya bar mi rigs par soms shig ces smras pa dang / de nas dpal sbed kyis bsams pa/ 'di yang me skyes kyi gnyen du 'ong ste dge sbyong gi ta ma la dad pas na gsang shor bar 'gyur ro snyam nas des mo mdzod kyi nang du bcug ste sgo lcags bcug nas bzhag go / /gang po la sogs pa gcer bu pa thams cad bos nas ngas dgra bsad pa la ltar shog shig /dge sbyong gi ta ma gsad pa'i phyir sgor dong chen po brkos nas nang du seng ldeng gi me mdag gis bkang ste bzhag /kha zas dang skom gyi nang du'ang dug rnon pos bkang ngo / /de dag yid rab tu dga' nas myur zhing rings7su dong ste yang thog gi steng du 'dzegs te 'khod nas deng bdag cag bde bar 'khod do/ /dge sbyong gau ta ma me'i dong gi nang du ji ltar tshig pa dang / dug rnon pos rab tu zhen pa dang / yan man du sa la ji ltar 'gyel ba dag blta'o/ /dpal sped kyis gdan bting nas bcom ldan 'das spyan 'dren pas dus gsol te/ gau ta ma bshos kyang sbyar lags kyisaci/ kye gi ta ma dus la bab par dgongs shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod song la dge slong dag la 13—396

'di skad du ①dpal sbed kyi khyim du de bzhin gshegs pa ma gshegs par dge slong su yang sngar ma 'dongakhushig/ btsun pa de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes7tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das las mnyan te④/ dge slong dag la tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal sbed kyi0khyim du de bzhin gshegs pa ma gshegs par sngar dge slong su yang ma 'dong shig0ces bka' stsal to zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro'i dus na ⑦sham thabs mnabs/lhung bzed dang / chos gos bsnams te/ dge slong mang pos bskor nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis ⑧mdun 0du byas te dpal sbed kyi khyim gang na ba de logs su gshegs so/ /de nas 'od ma'i tshal na gnas pa'i lha bran rnams sdug bsngal zhing yid mi dga' bas gzir te/ myur zhing rings par bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs te snying rje'i tshig gis 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das dpal sbed kyi khyim du gshegs pa'i mi rigs so zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha de na gnod pa ci zhig yod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal sbed ni bcom ldan 'das la ma rung bar bgyi ba'i slad du bshams so zhes smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha de bzhin gshegs pa ni gnod pa thams cad dang bral na des nga la gnod pa ci zhig byar yod/ lha bran gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das des bcom ldan 'das dgrongs pa'i slad du dong chen po'i nang du seng ldeng gi me mdag gis bkang ngo zhes smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha gang 'dod chags kyi me dang / zhe sdang gi me dang / gti mug gi me dag kyang ye shes kyi chus btab na 13—397

zhi bar 'gyur②/ me'i nang na tha ma des ci zhig byar yod kyis〈mya ngan ma byed par 'dug shig /lha bran gyis gsol pa/ de gcig pu ma lags kyi gzhan dag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das dgrongasalgepa'i slad du bya bsasbyar te/ dug rnon po mi bzad pas kha zas dang btung ba'i nang du sbyar to zhes smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha dug gi gnyen po ye shes kyis 'dod chags kyi dug dang / zhe sdang gi dug dang / gti mug gi dug kyang rab tu btang /rab tu skyugs0/ rab tu bor na dug gi nang na0tha ma des byar ci zhig yod/bdag slar log la bdag gi las la nan tanakhubyos shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu byon pa dang / rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i lha dag gis snga ma bzhin du gsol pa dang / lha de dag la bcom ldan 'das kyis lha0snga ma bzhin du bsgo ste slar bkye'o/ /de nas dpal sbed kyi khang pa'i sgor byon pa dang dpal sbed kyi khyim gyi lhas snga ma bzhin du gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis lha de dag kyang lha snga ma bzhin du bsgo ste slar bkye'o/ /de nas dpal sbed kyi chung mas bsams pa/ da ni bcom ldan 'das sgo dang por phyin cing da tsam ni dong gi steng du zhabs gzhog go/ /da tsam ni dong gi kha rtswas g.yogs pa'i steng nas lhung ste 8da tsam ni bcom ldan 'das me'i nang du lhung bas dud pas kyang 'tshal/ mchi ma yang byung / me lces chos gos tshig pa'i dud pa'ang byung ngo snyam nas mi dga' ba des khang pa'i nang du bcug pas yid mi dga' ba skyes nas mig mchi mas gang zhing ngo 'dzum ciganags nyenas brtabs mi dge ba la rtog ste ngu zhing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la phan pa la rab tu 'jug pa'i yid kyis sgo bar mar byon 13—398

nas me'i7dong gi steng du zhabs bzhag pa dang / de nas me'i dong gi steng du zhabs bzhag ma thag tu de thams cad kyang ②mtshe'u pad mo ②can du gyur te/ud pa la dang / pad mo dang / ku mu da dang / puṇḍa dri0ka dag gis ni khebs/ bya ngang pa dang / kā raṇḍasnyidang / ngur pa la sogs pa chu na spyod pa'i bya rnams kyis brgyan te/ bya de dag kyang skad sna tshogs 'byin pa ni ji ltar lha'i rdzing man da ka bzhin no/ /nam mkha' la gnas pa'i lha dag gisashekyang lha'i me tog ku mu da dang / lha'i me tog kha dogashedang ldan pas steng nas gtor to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das pad ma'i snying po'i steng dag tu zhabs bzhag ste dpal sbed kyi khyim du byon pa dang / khyim bdag dpal sbed ngo mtshar che ba'i mig gis bgrad de bltas nas/ btsun pa gang po bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul la ltos shig ces smras pa dang / gang po mi dga' ba'i bzhin du 8bsgyur nas/ khyim bdag dge sbyong gi ta ma la dad dam de'i sgyu ma la dad dam zhes smras pa dang / dpal sbed kyis smras pa/ btsun pa gang po de ltar 'di lta bus bsgrub du rung na ni khyod kyang thams cad mkhyen pa na sgyu ma de lta bu byos la ston cig /de lta bus nga dang nga'i mdza' bo dang phu nu dag kyang bsgrubasnyepar gyis shig /cigang pos bsams pa dgos pa ma grub par gyur te/ slar 'gro'o snyam nas des de la spyos te khang pa'i steng nas babs te skyengs nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon du 'byung bar ma nus te/ de nas 'gros dal zhing bags kyis song nas gdong yang sa la bltas te dpal sbed kyi khyim nas byung ste bros te song ngo / /de nas khyim bdag dpal sbed khyim bdag me skyes kyi sring mo gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ sgo lcags phye ste bzang mo tshur shog /de bzhin 13—399

gshegs pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshol7cig ces smras pa dang / des bsams pa/'di bdag lakhuslu bar byed do snyam nas snying rje ba'i tshig gis dal nas smras pa/sdig pa'i grogs pos bslus ②te bsad na bdag la bgam du ci zhig yod ces smras pa dang / des bzang mo bden par zer te bgam pa ni ma yin gyisabya/bcom ldan 'das dgrongasasnyepar ma nus pas/ dkyibacom ldan 'das la mngon du 'byung bar mi nus kyis/ da khrid la song shig ces smras pa dang / de nas dpal sbed kyisachung ma de dga' ba skyes nas mgu ba'i yid kyis dpal sbed khrid de bcom ldan 'das gang nab der song nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi7zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bzod par mdzod cig /khyim bdag 'di mi dge ba'i grogs pos bslus pas na bcom ldan 'das la mi dge ba'i rnam pa 'di lta bu dag bgyis so zhes smras pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis glang po che'i sna 'dra ba'i phyag brkyang nas gsungs pa/ khyim bdag longs shig dang bzod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la ni mdza' ba dang dgrar bye brag mi 'byed/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni mdza' ba dang /dgrar bye brag mi 'byed/ tsan dan dang ste'ur mtshungs so zhes gsungs pa dang / de nas khyim bdag dpal sbed de bzhin gshegs pa la rab tu dga' ba skyes nas/ mos pa'i yid kyis bcom ldan 'das la cung zad cig gzhes shig /bdag gis bshos da gdod sbyar ro zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de bzhin gshegs pa la spyan 'dren pas dus gsol te⑩/ go ta ma bshos dag kyang sbyar lags kyis8/ kye gau ta ma dus 13—400

mkhyen par mdzod cig ces zer na da yang ci'i phyir na 'di skad du smra/ des gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag ni mi dge ba'i grogs po la lta b.ratugyur pa'i blos log par lta ba gsum du 'gro ba'i sdig pas de la gzhol te kun la sdug par 'gro ba gnyis kyang bgags nas bcom ldan 'das la gnod par bya ba'i phyir zhugs so zhes smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de bzhin gshegs pa ni gnod pa thams cad dang bral na ci'i phyir nga la gnod par 'gyur/ btsun pa bdag gis dug rnon pos zhal zas dang / skyems kyi nang du sbyar gyis7de dag pho la gdod sbyar ro zhes smras pa dang / —bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gang 'dod chags kyi dug dang / zhe snang gi dug dang / gti mug gi dug kyang rab tu skyugasasashing bor na dug ngan pa 'di lta bu ci zhig byarasnyeyod kyis gang sbyar ba de khyer te shog shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi mdun dukhugadan bting ba la bzhugs te/bzhugs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong dag la 'di skad du nam rgan rims su 'byor tshogs so zhes skad ma phyung gi bar du su yang zan ma za zhig par sgosashig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos dge slong dag la tshe dang ldan pa dgashebacom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa ni rgan rims su 'byor tshogs so zhes skad ma phyung gi bar du su yang zan ma za zhig ces byung ngo / /de nas dge slong gi dge 'dun de dag bde bar 'khod nas/ kha zas dag bsnyen pa dang / 'phrul dang kha rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gyis dpal sbed kyi khyim du rgan rims su 'byor tshogs zhes skad phyung ba dang / kha zas dang skom dag kyang dug med par gyur to//13—401

dpal sbed de dogs bzhin du kha zas dang skom dag 'brim ①zhing bsams pa/rgan rims nas gzhon nu dag gi drung du 'ongs pa dang / dakhutsam dge slong rgan rims dag ni dug rnon pos 'gyel gor ma chag go/ /gzhon nu nas yang rgan rims kyisadrung du 'ongs nas yang 'di snyam du sems te/ de'i blo yang de lta bur skyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das ni 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang /gti mug gi dug spangs kyi/ nyan thos thams cad kyikhum yinasasnyam du bsams nas/ de ltar dge slong dag0thams cad kyis bshos gsol na gcig la yang gnod par ma gyur to/ /chung ngu na de'i lhag ma zos pa dag la yang gnod parasnyem gyur to0/ /de nas khyim bdag dpal sbed phyi phyir dad pa skyes so/ /de chung ma dang gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das bshos gsol nas/ lhung bzed phyung ste phyag bcabs par shes nas stan dma' ba zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos nyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal sbed dang chung ma'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang /rang bzhin dag mkhyen nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i chos rab tu rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad do/ /khyim bdag dpal sbed kyis de thos nas 'jig tshogs su lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum smras te/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phan btags pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ sdug pa dang /mdza' bo dang / gnyen dang / 'khor gyis kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lhas kyang ma bgyis/ snga ma'i mi dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge 13—402

sbyong dang / bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi mchikhum dang khrag gi rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i ri las ni bsgral/ngan song gi sgo ni bcad/ mtho ris kyi sgo ni phye ste/ bdag ni lha dang mi'i gnas su bzhagakhugo zhes smras nas/ yang gsol pa/ nyes pa mang ba ma rungs pa/ /ngan du 'gro ba'i lam rnams te/ /khyod kyisamathus ni de dag bcad/ /mtho ris 'gro ba'i sgo phye bsod nams can/ /mya ngan 'da' ba'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /khyod la brtanasapas thob pa nyes bral ba'i/ /bdag gi mig ni dag cing rnam par dag /'phags pasnyedagyes pa'i gnas bzhi0thob/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho pha rol rga'adzo/ /skye bo lha min lha dang mi yisasnyemachodanyu/ /skye ba na ba rga shi rnam par bral/ /srid pa stong du'ang rnyed par shin tu dka'acha/ /thub pa khyod mthong deng ni 'bras bur ldan/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par rgal te mngon par rgal lo da ni bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang /dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchisatso/ deng phan chad nam mtsho'ichabar du srog dang bsdos te skyabs su mchi nas mngon du dad kyis/ bdag la dge bsnyen du zung shig /btsun pa deng phan chad mu stegs can gcer bu pa dang / gcer bu ma dang / gcer bu pa'i nyan thos rnams la ni sgo bcadas/bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen pha0dang / dge bsnyen ma la ni sgo dbye'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag dpal sbed la chos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par bstabs/ yang dag par gzengs bstod/ rab tu dga' bar byas nas gdan las bzhengs te bzhud do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 13—403

gtsug lag khang du byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gudashedu gdan bting ba la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyisasnyedage slong dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim bdag dpal sbed kyi khyim du de lta bu'i gnod pa dag byung ba de la der de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen par ma gyur na gor ma chag par dge slong rab tusamang po zhig dug gis dus byasalgepar 'gyur/ khyim bdag desakhungan du spyad pas mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal bar ltung ngo / /de bas na dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi dge slong la mtshungs par spyod pa'i chos bca'o/ /dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan dge slong gi rgan rims su 'dug nas kha zas dag bshams te 'ongs pa dang / sngar chung ngu na lan tshwa tsam yang ma blang shig sargan rims su 'byor tshogs zhes skad ma phyung bar blangs na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ de'i tshe na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis gtsug lag khang chen po zhig rtsig 8pa la zhugs pa las8/ des phyed tsam brtsigs pa dang dus 'das so/ /de'i bu khyim gyi bdag por gyur nas dge slong dag gis de'i gan du song ste bzhin bzangs khyod kyi phas gtsug lag khang rtsig pa la zhugs pa dang / de yang phyed tsam zin pa dang dus 'das so/ /de ni khyod kyis mjug bsgrub pa'i rigs so zhes smras pa dang / de dad pa chung ste gtsug lag khang de ni che bas na de tsam rtsig sus nus kyis0/ de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na ni chen po de bshig la chung ngur bskyungs te bgyi'o zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ — de ste rtsig mi nus na shig la chung ngur 13—404

byos7shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis gtsug lag khang chung ngu zhig rtsig parakhuzhugs pa las/de yang phyed tsam zin pa dngasnyedus 'das so/ /de'i bu yang khyim gyi bdag por gyur nas/ de la0dge slong dag gis de la bzhin bzangs khyod kyisaphas gtsug lag khang phyed0brtsigs nas lus pa de khyod kyis mjug sgrubasasheshig ces smras pa dang / de rab tu dad pa zhig ste〈'phags pa dag bdag ni cher bgyid par dad na de ni chung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang na snga ma bshig la chen po zhig brtsig go zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dngashe/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de ste nus na chung ngu bshig ste cher brtsig par gnang gis ⑩de la the tshom du ma byed cig /de bzhin du khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis mchod rten chen po zhig brtsig par byas pa las phyed tsam zin pa dang de dus 'das so/ /de'i bu yang khyim gyi bdag por gyur nas de la dge slong dag gis bzhin bzangs khyod kyi phas mchod rten phyed tsam brtsigs shing 'dug na de khyod kyis mjug sgrubs shig ces smras pa dang / de yang ma dad pa zhig ste 'phags pa de tshe chos pas rtsig par mi nus na/ de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na de la bdag gis de slar bshig la chung ngur bgyi'o zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag gtsug lag khang ni tsochen po las chung ngur bsgyur 8du yang rung cher yang rung ṣka/ mchod rten ni chen po las chung ngur ma skyung shig /chung ngur byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis 13—405

yang mchod rten chung ngu zhig rtsig tunyezhugs pa las phyed tsam zin pa dang de dus 'das so/ /de'i bu yang khyim gyi bdag por gyur nas dge slong dag gis de la bzhin bzangs khyod kyi phasasamachod rten rtsigashetu zhugs pa las phyed tsam zin pa dang de'angasnyedus las 'das na/ da0khyod kyis mjug sgrubs shig ces smras pa dang / de yang rab tu dad pa zhig ste/ bdag ni cher dad pa lags kyisani/de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis cher bskyed par bgyi'o zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste7chung ngu bshig ste chen por byed nus na gnang gis byos shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /mchod rten dang gdugs rnyings shing zhig pa yang de bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / gzhan zhig gis gdugs phab nas slar ma bsgrubs kyi bar du dus 'das pa dang / cibacom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rjes ma ma zin gyi bar du snga ma dbab par ma byed cig /de bzhin du sku gzugs 'jim pa la byas pa dag rnyings nasabya/ dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas ma byas pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dang 'dra ba'am/ de las lhag par ni byos shig /chung ngu ni ma yin no/ /de bzhin du ri mor bris pa dag kyang ri mo byed pa dang / dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas ri mor ma bris nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byid na de nyid kyi rgyud slar bris shig /de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi bka'i glegs bam dag byid par gyur nas⑥/ dge slong dag gis the tshom skyes nas ma bris pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byid na sangs rgyas kyi 13—406

bka' slar bris7shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /rkyang pa'i sgo gnyis pa'ikhumado'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa'o// // 'dul ba gzhung dam pa/③ bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ mdor na/gsar busasnye'ajug par bya ba dang / /'khor rnams rnam pa lnga yis dang / /yon dang snod dang rol mo dang / /dge bsnyen dag ni bsgrags pa 'o/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzam bu'i grib ma dkyibazhugs pa'i sku gzugs la dus kyi mchod rten chen po dang bcas parakhubyos la/grong khyer gyi nang du bkur bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis sus bkur bar mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong gzhon nu dag gis khyer cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gzhon nu dag gis khyer cig par bka' stsal pa dang / de 'khor med par gyur pas na mi mdzes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dang /dge slong ma dang / dge slob ma dang / dge tshul dang / dge tshul ma'i 'khor lnga dang chos shig /dad pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag gis yon phul na bus kyang ma blangs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis blang bar byos shig /gzhon nus blang ngam rgan po rnams kyis blang ba de dag gis ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgan po rnams kyis long shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong de dag gis bkur bar byos shig dang / dge slong gnas brtan dag gis khyer te ngal bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pazha dge slong gnas 13—407

brtan dag gis bsrungasanyel gzhan gyis bkur bar gyis shig /dge slong dag gis rol mo medakhupar dong ba dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na ni sku gzugs gshegs pa'i tshe bdag gis rol mo sbyar ro zhes smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de ltar na gnang gis7sbyor cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa dge slongasarol mo bgyirasnyenang ngam/u pā li mi rung ngo / /nam mchod pa'i dus na 'di skad du bzhin0bzangs ston pa la mchod par byos shig ces sgo shig /rkyang pa'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa'o// //mdor na/ sgrogasalgepar byed dang snod sbed dang / /shing rta tha dad byed pa dang / /snod rnams bged pa dad pa dang / /mdo'i tshigs su bcad par brjod pa'oyi/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dus ston chen po gyis la shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma na bzhugs pa'i sku gzugs grong khyer du gshegs par rgyas par byos shig ces bka' stsal pa dang /dge slong dag gis bram ze dang khyim bdag dag la ma sbran par dong ngo / /de dag gis e ma'o 'phags pa dag nged cag la sngar sbran na ni nged kyis yon rnams sta gon bya ba zhig ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhag bdun nam brgyad kyi snga rol nas dus kyi mchod ston chen po byed do zhes grong khyer 13—408

dang / tshong dusatudang / srang dang / lam dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo dag tu bsgrag⑧par byos shig /de dag gis dus ston no dus ston no zhes bsgrags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhag dus thob la zhag 'di snyed cig na dus ston byed do zhes sgron cig /de ltar byas kyang 'jig rten thams cad kyis ma thos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gro ga la brisasal bal glang gi steng du zhog rsā/ tshong dusasnyedang / srang dang / lam dang /lam gyi bzhi mdo dag tu bsgrags par gyis shig /gang gi nyin mo bcom ldan 'das kyi0dus ston chen po byed pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gnas brtan dang / gnas brtan dag gis ni yon rnams srung shig /gzhon nusnyernams kyis ni7khyer cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / des khyer te bab bab tu bor ba dang / ma byin par len pa dag gis brkus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ snod spyad sbed pa'i dge slong skos shig /bsko ba ni 'di ltar bsko'o/ /stan bting la gaṇḍi brdungs shing7dris pa la lan glon pa'i dge slong bskos te⑩/ dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams tshogs shing 'khod pa dang / sngar ni dad par byos shig /khyod ming 'di zhes bya ba dge 'dun gyi snod sbed par bsko na dad dam zhes dris tebya/ dad na des kyang dad do zhes smros shig /de'i 'og tu dge slong cig gis gsol ba dang las byos shig /gson cig btsun pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi snod sbed par dad na/ de ste desnyedage 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang shig dang ming 'di zhes bgyi ba snod sped par bskos te/ snod sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi snod sbed debya/13—409
