'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las kyang 'di ltar bya ste/ gson cig btsun pa'i dge 'dun rnams ming 'di zhes bgyi ①ba 'di dge 'dun gyi snod sbed par dad de/②dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di snod sbed par bsko ste ③ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi snod sbed na tshe dang ldan pa'i rnams las gang la ming 'di zhes bgyi ba snod sbed du bskokhubar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsungakyishig /gang la mi bzod pasnyedag ni smos shig /dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di snod sbed par bsko gho/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang bas na cang mi gsung ste/ de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /der yang rnyed pa dag mang7du byung nas dge slong ma dag gis 'phags pa dag bdag cag la rnyed pa'i skal ba stsol7cig ces smras kyange dge slong dag gis ma byin no/ /de dag gis phyi de nyin mo shing rta gzhan zhig bshams pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gis 'phags ma dag shing rta 'di nyid dam 'on te gzhan zhig ces dris na8/ dge slong ma de dag gis kyang rnyed pa mang du gyur to/ /dge slong ma dag gis rnyed pa dang bkur stinel ngoms par gyur pa dge slong dag gis mthong nas 'phags pa khyedagye kyis kho mo cag la rnyed pa0ma byin mod kyi/ bdag cag gis kyang shing rta logs shig tu bshams pas bdag cag la yang ③rnyed pa tsomang du thob par gyur to zhes 0smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ dge slong dag gang nyes pa'i dmigs su gyur pa ni dge slong ma dag gis dus ston gyi tshe shing rta gud du bshams pas de bas na tsodage slong dang dge slong ma dag gis shing rta logs shig tu mi bsham ⑦par dgongs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/13—410

dge slong dag dge slong mas ni7mi rigs par byas te②/ de bas na dge slong mas dus ston gyi tshe shing rta logs shig tu ma shom shig③ /dge slong ma dag gisakyidus ston gyi tshe shing rta logs shig tu bshams na dbyin byas pa dang / nye ba'i nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /snod de dag de bzhin du 'dug pa dang dge slong dag gis ji ltar bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bgosasnyishig ces gsungs pa dang / de dag0ji ltar bgo ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ snod bgedasapa'i dge slong cig sko7shig /bsko ba ni 'di ltar bya'o/ /stan thing ste gaṇḍi rdungs la dris pa la lan glon pa'i dge slong skos la dge 'dun thams cad 'dus te 'khod pa dang sngar dad par rgyas shig /khyod dge 'dun gyi snod bged par bskonen dad dam zhes dris la/ de ste dad do zhes zer na de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba dang las byos shig /gson cig btsun pa'i dge slong rnams/ snod bged pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi snod bged par dad na/ de ste dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang la dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di snod bged par skos shig /ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi snod bged de 'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las kyang 'di ltar byos shig /gson cig btsun pa'i dge 'dun rnams ming 'di zhes bgyi ba snod bged par dad nas dge 'dun gyi snod bged de/ dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi snod bged 0par tshe dang ldan pa rnams gang dubazod pa ni cang ma gsung shig sami bzod pa ni smos shig /dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di snod bged par bskos te/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang 13—411

bsanyen cang mi gsung ste de de bzhin⑧du 'dzin to/ /rkyang pa'i sgo gnyis kyishemado'i tshigs su bcad pa drug pa'o// //mdo bar ma ste/ rnam pa tha dad byas dang yon/ /gang gi tshe na gcig las lhag /gang gisatshe na gnyis lasalgegacig /bdag gir bya bar mi rung ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'akhur ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe dus ston chen po byung ba na rnyed pa mang po dang ldan par gyur nas/ dge slong dag gis ji ltar bya ba'i thabs mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gos sbed pa'i dge slong gis stan thing la gaṇḍi brdungasashete dris pa la lan glon7pa'i dge slong bskos skyal dge 'dun thams cad 'dus shing 'khod yipa'i nang du btsong bar bya'o/ /de dag gis bus rin thang gdab par ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis thob shig /de dag gis de nyid nyor bcug pa dang / de nyid la nyor ma gzhug shig /dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis rin cher btab ste sus kyang ma nyos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ cher ma gdab shig ces gsungs pa dang shin tu chung ngu btab bo/ /shin tu chung ngu yang ma gdab par ran par thob shig /gang gis thog mar rin thang bskyed pa de nyid nyor chug ces smras pa dang de la ma btsong bar gang gi tshe rin thang sus kyang ma bskyed na gdod de nyid la tshong shig /drug sde dag gis rin cher btab ste rin cher bslangs na dge 'dun gyi don gyi phyir nged kyis rin thang bskyed do zhes smras pa dang / bcom ldan 13—412

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang nyo ba des rin thang skyedatucig /gzhan gyis rin thang bskyed na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis rin thang bskyed de nyos nas bkrus shing bgos so/ /rin len pa la de nyid slar byin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rin mkhu'ongs kyi bar du de la ma sbyinasacig /rin ma byin par bgos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo gnyis kyi mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa'o// //mdor na/ gtsug lag khang ni zhig pa dang0/ /lci ba'i phyir ni dben par bya/ /nam zhig 'jigs par gyur pa na/ /skad cig brnya bsnyedage 'dun gyi/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gnas khang lnga rtseg tu byos shig /dri gtsang khang ni bdun rtseg sgo khang yang bdun rtseg tu byos shig ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong ma'i gnas khang ni sum rtseg boX/ /dri gtsang khang ni lnga rtseg gozha/ /sgo khang yang lnga rtseg bos/ /steng gi lcid kyis rtsig pa 'jig tu byed de/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ steng ma'i rim gcig phri shig /'on kyang 'jig par gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin du rim gnyis nas bzhi'i bar du phri la 'og khang gcig pu zhog shig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong rnams la 'jigs pa dag byung nas/ gtsug lag khang stong par byas te/ dge 'dun gyi mal stan yang 13—413

bor nas bros te dong ba dang / ma byin par len pa dag gis brkus⑥so/ /brkus pas dge slong dag phongs par gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gisakhubacom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi mal stan bor te ma 'dong shig /gang du dongasab der khyer cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang du 'dong bar khyer cig ces bka' stsal pa dngas/ dge slong zhig gis bgo bsnyedag khyer te dge slong dag dang lhan cig tu bros te dong ba dang / de na nub mo dge slong zhig gis tshe dang ldan pa 'di ni dge 'dun gyi nang na nga ni0rgan te ji ltar rgan rims su dbang ngo zhes smras pa dang de byin no/ /des de byin nas ji tsam nam nangs pa dang / des bsgo ba 'disarkyukhyer cig ces smras pa dang / des smras pa gang gi tshe bsgo bar7bgos pa de'i tshe na ni khyod rgan pos khyer la da bkur ba'i tshe ni nga la sbyin nam khyod nyid khyer cig /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gis 'jigs pa'i tshe khyer 0khyer ba 8de nyid kyi'o/ /gang gi tshe 'jigs pa med par gyur na yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ngo zhes slar ma phul ba dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag re zhig ngas dge 'dun gyi mal stan dag gnang gi gtan du ni ma yin gyi/ 'jigs pa dang bral na slar phul la rgan rims su byin cig /rkyang pa'i sgo gnyis kyi mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa'o// //mdor na/ dze ta'i tshal du mchod ston tshe/ /rnga chen gyis ni 'du bar bya/ /13—414

gral ni cholatubar 'khod pa dang / /dge slong las ni zhal tar bsko/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasasadze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te②/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin pas bcom ldan 'das la de ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis dus ston ༷chen po rgyabagyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag ngas gnang gis byos shig /de dze ta'i tshal du dus ston byas pa dang / dge slong dag mnye'adus par gyur nas7bcom ldan 'das kyis mchod ston chen po byed na gaṇḍi dang / rnga dang / dung bus shig dang / dge slong dag gdugs tshod la bab par dus rig par 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag rnga dang dunganedag gi sgras brdegs na chol bar 'khod do/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong las zhal ta ba bskos te ci nas rgan rims su 'khod cig /ji ltar rgan rims su 'khodanepa dang / nam zas dag rgan rims nas brims te/ gzhin nu'i gan du phyin tsam nas gdugs tshod kyang yol te/dge slong dag zas kyi bar chad du gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pasnyedang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/lnga brgya phreng du gyis la kha zas ni rgan rims kyi mdun du zhig shig /dge slong dag gis de bzhin du byas pa dang khyim bdag ni bza' ba 'brim pa la rku'o/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'brim pa'i spyan pa dge slong skos shig /de dag kyang kha zas kyi bar chad du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 13—415

stsal pa/ de dag sngar7zan byin la phyis zhal takhubyed du chug shig /rkyang pa'i sgo gnyis pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa'o// //mdor na/ dge slong ma ni mang du gyur/ /dge slong dang posheyi rang dngas/ /gcig dang gnyis dang mang po dang / /bu chung rab tu dgar7gyur pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'asher ba na bzhugs te/ ri brags kyishegrong gzhan7zhig na khyim bdag zhig gnas pa des dge slong ma mang zhig bshos la spyan drangs nas ji tsam zhig na dge slong gcig cig 'gron pa mang po dang lhan cig tu ljongs rgyu ba spyod cing ri brags kyi grong der phyin pa dang / de der bsod snyoms la zhugs na de na gzhan zhig gis de la 'phags pa khyim 'di na dge slong ma dag bshos gsol zhing 'khod kyis der bzhud cig ces smras pa dang / de yang der song nas dge 'dun ma'i gnas brtan sbom mo dga' ldan 'dug ste/ des 'phags pa de ste sbyin pa'i yon tan brjod nus na ni rgan rims su bzhugs shig /de ste mi nus na phyogs gcig tu bshos bsnoms la bzhud cig ces smras pa dang / de skyengs nas des bsams pa de ste bdag gis sbyin pa'i yon tan brjod kyi bar du 'dug na ni 'gron pa mang po dag kyang dong bar 'gyur gyis phyogs gcig tu zan zos te 'gro'o snyam nas phyogs gcig tu zan zos te song ngo / /rim bzhin du mnyan du yod par phyin pa dang / dge slong dag gis tshe dang ldan pa bde bar 'ongs sam/ ci bde bar spyad dam zhes smras pa dang / des smras pa/ga la zhig bde bar spyad/ dge slong mas kyal ka byas so/ /de ji ltar byas 13—416

zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa rgyas par dge slong dag la smras so/ /dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang na dge slong gcig dang dge slong ma gcig gnas7pa de nasadage slong de gral kyangasadang po/ chu yang dang po/ zan yang dang por zo shig /gang na dge slong ma gnyis sam/ gsum mamakha/ de lasashelhag pa zhig la dge slong gcig cig 'ongs nakhudage slong gcig pu de stanasheyang dang po/ chu yang dang po/ zan yang dang por zo shig /gang de ste dge slong ma dag 'ba' zhig na yang rtag tu gral gyisadang por sten cig lhag par zhog la 'khod cig de ste dge tshul pa zhig 'ongs na yang de der 'dug la zo sheg /de ste des mi nus par gyur na yang dge slong mas sbyin pa'i yon tan lhogs shig /dge slong mas de ltar ma byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin pas dze ta'i tshal du dus ston chen po byas nas bu dang chung ma dge 'dun la yon du phul ba dang / dge slong dag gis ji ltar bya ba mi shes nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag la dris shig /dris pa dang / pha des smras pa/'phags pa dag rin thang chod cig dang bdag gis glung gsol lo/ /drug sde dag gis de la 'gran cing spel ba la zhugs pa dang / de'i nang nas chung ma bu chung ngu ma can gyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi rkang pa la btud de jo bo bdag gi bu chung gis bdag ma gtang shig ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 13—417

kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sems can gyi nang na bud med las snying chung ba med kyis7'jigs par ma bya shig /de bsakhudage slong gis bud med kyi rin thang ma gcod cig /bcad na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin bdag gis ②ji ltar dga' zhing dga' ste byin ④bzhin du longs ⑤sheg /rkyang pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa rdzogs skokhya// //mdor bsdus par na/ yo byad bus pa blun pa dang / /gang gi ba dang de yi ste/ /de ltar khye'u las bslang mi bya/ /mgon med zas7sbyin de bzhin te/ /spu0gri dang ni 'khor rnams dang / /chu dang bsdus par gsungs pa 'o/ /mdor na/ yo byad rnams dang gnang ba dang / /u pā lis ni dris pa ste/ /ji ltar byin gyis brlab par bya/ /yid gcugs tshigs bcad mdor gsungs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te0/ dge slong dag ljongs rgyu ba spyod pa na na bar gyur te/ kha cig la sman med nas lhung bzed btsongs kyang khyim bdag gis ma nyos nas dus 'das par gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nasaX/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis yonyebyad dang gos chongs shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis yo byad dang gos chongs shig ces gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis bkrus nas kha bsgyur te bcangs pa dang rin chung ngur gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ma bkrus kha ma bsgyur/ sar ba btags ma thag chongs shig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u 13—418

pā lis zhusalgepa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gis yo byad bcu gsum chongs shig ces bka' stsal ni ②ji ltar byin gyis brlab ③par bgyi/u pā li so sor byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ chos gos 'di ni sbyar mar byin gyis brlab ste/ bya ba zin pa yongasasnyesu spyad pa'o/ /de bzhin du stod g.yogs dang mthang gos dang / sham thabs dang / sham thabs kyi 'theb dang / stod chags dang / stod chags kyi 'theb dang / gdong phyis dang / lus phyi bsnyedang / g.yan pa'i gos dang / skra bzed dang / g.yogs ma dang / ras chen te7gos 'di ni yo byad kyi gos su byin gyis brlabs te/ na ba la dgos te bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i phyir byin gyis brlabalgebo/ /yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis yo byad bcu gsum byin gyis rlobs shig ces bka' stsal na/ de las lhag pa'i gos rnams ji ltar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ u pā li de ni slob dpon dang / mkhan po dang / yid gcugs pa rnams la bsngos la bcang bar bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar bsngo bar bya'o8/ /dge slong gcig gi mdun du 'dug la 'di skad smos shig /dgongs sheg tshe dang ldan pa bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gos 'di lhag par bsngo ste/ bsngo ba'i rigs pas na mkhan po la bsngo ste/ mkhan po yid bcugs pas bcang bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /rkyang pa'i nang na sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa dang po'o// //mdor na/ bus pa blun la sogs shes pas/ /bcu gnyis kyi ni gang zag 13—419

dang / /de bzhin rnam par dbye ba dang / /tshul bzhin7pa ni gsum pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa nasadze ta'i tshal mgon medakhuzas sbyin gyi kun dga' ④ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa gang zag du'i slar ⑤bzlog pa mi brtsanaX/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ u pā li bcu gnyis te/ bus pa dang /blun po dang / mi gsal ba dang / mi mkhas pa dang / ngo tsha med pashedang /khon⑧du 'dzin pa dang / mtshams kyi phyi rol na 'dug pa dang / spangs pa dang / tshig mi brtan pa dang / spyod lam las 'gal ba dang / tshul bzhin du mi gnas pa dang / bslab pa byin pa'o/ /yang zhus pa btsun pa ji tsam gyis na byis pa lta bu nas ji tsam gyis na bslab pa stsal ba'i bar du lags/ u pā li gang log par bsam pa sems pa dang / log par smra ba log par smra ba dang /bzlog dka' bar bzlog pa yin te⑩/ u pā li da ltar bgyis par 'gyur ro//btsun pa ji tsam na glen pa lags/ mdo sde mi 'dzin pa/ 'dul ba mi 'dzin pa/ ma lta bu mi 'dzin pa ste/ 'di tsam gyis na/ u pā li glen pa yin no/ /btsun pa ji tsam gyis na mi gsal ba lags/ u pā li gang mdo sde yang 'dzin/ 'dul ba yang 'dzin/ ma lta bu yang 'dzin mod kyi/ 'on kyang mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / chos mngon du bya ba'i don mi shes pa gho/'di tsam gyis na u pā li mi gsal ba yin no/ /btsun pa ji tsam gyis na mi mkhas pa lags/ u pā li gang mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / ma lta bu yang 'dzin/ de dag gi don kyang shes mod kyi0/ gzhan shes par byed mi nus pa ni u pā li mi mkhas pa ste/ 'di tsam gyis na u pā li mi mkhas pa yin no/ /13—420

btsun pa ji tsam gyis na ngo tsha med pa lags/ u pā li denyeni phas pham pa bzhi las gang yang rungakhunyes pa byung bar gyur pa ste/ u pā li de ni ngo tsha med par gyur pa'o/ /btsun pa ji tsam gyis na khon⑧du 'dzin pa lags/ u pā li desnyekhro ba dang / thab0mo dang / gzhan yang gang dang gang du 'thab pa'i sgor gyur pa ste/ uXpā li de tsam gyis na khon7du 'dzin pa'o/ /btsun pa ji tsam gyis na mtshams kyi slad rol na mchis pa lags/ de ni u pā li dge slong gi mtshams kyi phyi rol na 'dug pa ste/ u pā li de tsam gyis na mtshams kyi phyi rol na 'dug pa'o/ /btsun pa ji tsam gyis na spangs pa lags/ u pā li de ni dge 'dun gyis gsol pa dang bzhi'i las kyis spangs pa ste/ u pā li de tsam gyis na spangs par gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /btsun pa ji tsam gyis na tshig mi brtan par gyur pa lags/ u pā li de ni tshig mi brtan par gyur pa dang /brdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub po dang / tshig khyal par smra ba'o/ /u pā li de tsam gyis na tshig mi brtan par gyur pa'o/ /btsun pa ji tsam gyis na spyod lam las gal bar gyur pa lags/ u pā li de ni dge 'dun gyi nang nas langs te song ba'o/ /u pā li de ltar na spyod lam las gal bar gyur pa'o/ /btsun pa ji tsam gyis na tshul bzhin la mi gnas par gyur pa zhes bgyi/ u pā li de ni mi spyod pa ni spyod dge slong gi bslab pa la mi slob pa'o/ /u pā li de tsam gyis na tshul bzhin la mi gnas par gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /btsun pa ji tsam gyis na bslab pa stsal bar gyur pa zhes bgyi/ u pā li de ni dge slong la dge 'dun gyis dugasol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis nam 'tsho'i bar du bslab pa byin par gyur pa ste/ u pā li de lta bu ni bslab pa byin par 13—421

gyur pa'o/ /yang gsol pa/ btsun pa ji tsam gyis na gang zag gis slar bzlog pa la brtsan0pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ u pā li rnam pa gsum stenya/ tshul bzhin la gnas pa dang / tshig brtan⑧pa dang /spyod lam las ma galasaba'o/ /rkyang pa'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'o// //mdor na/ gang gi0phyir ni bya ba dang / /gang zag kyang ni bcu gnyis ni0/ /bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa dang / /khyim pa yin par khas blangs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u༅pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gang la las bya ba de'i slar bzlog pa mi brtsan⑧rna zhes bka' stsal na⑨/ btsun pa gang zag bcu gnyis so sor bsgo ba'i tshe de dag 'di skad du mchi ste/ tshe dang ldan pa dag nged cag la ni ma sgo shig ces mchi na ci de dag gis slar bzlog pa yang mi brtsan nam/ u pā li brtsan no/ /de'i chad pa'i las la ngas dgongs te gsungs so/ /btsun pa bsnyen par rdzogs par bgyid pa khyim pa lags par khas blangs na bsnyen par rdzogs pa 8zhes bgyi'am bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa zhes bgyi/ u pā li bsnyen par rdzogs par yizin kyang khyim pa yin par 0khas blangs na/ de yang bsnyen par ma rdzogs palo)zhes bya na bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'i tshe lta smos kyang ci dgos/rkyang pa'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa'o// //snye 13—422

mdor na/ tshil0bu dag ni mi rung ba/ /lnga po gang gis rkang mi bsku/ /dbang phyug bsgrag⑧par bya ba dang / /zhing gi⑧dngos po dge 'dun gyi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi rung ba rnam pa lnga'i lham ma 'chang shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde dag gis mi rung ba rnam pa lnga po de dag gi latshil bus rkang pa byugs nas yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bal glang gi drung du dong ste/ rdzi phyogs su 'khod pa dang / bal glang dag gis dri tshor nas bros pa dang / de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag zungasashig ces smras pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis gzung bar mi nus so/ /bzhin bzangs nged kyis gzung ngam/ 'phags pa dag zung shig nged la ci sbyin/ bca' ba'i rin sbyin5)no/ /des de dag gi mdun du song ste rdzi mi ldang ba'i phyogs su 'dug pa dang / bal glang de dag kyang 'khod do/ /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci khyed rig pa mkhyen namanya/ bzhin bzangs nged rig pa mi shes mod kyi/ nged kyi bal glang cang shes kyi tshil bus rkang pa bskus pas so/ /'phags pa dag rgyal po'i bal glang mchog dag bros par gyur nas0/ khyed kyis rgyal po la gnod pa byas par mi 'gyur ram zhes smras nas de dag nyes pa ngor brjod cing 'phyas 'dogs te mi snyan par zer ro/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis bal glang cang shes kyi tshil gyis rkang pa byug par ma byed cig /dge slong gis bal glang cang shes kyi tshil gyis rkang pa la byug na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar bal 13—423

glang cang shes pa bzhin du rta cang shes dang / seng ge dang / stag dang /gzigatul sogs pa rgyas par brjod par bya'o/ /glengasnyegazhi ni rgyal po'i khab na ste/ de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo gang na ba derashesong ste drung du phyin pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas rgyal po gzugs can snying pos tshe dang ldan pa kunasredaga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pasakun dga' bo seng ge'i gdan bshams pa 'di ci zhig bgyi ci deng chos bsgrags sam/ de'i tshe gso sbyin gyi0dus la bab ste/ de rgyal po chen po dge slong gis mtshungs par bzung bsnyelags kyi khyim pas mtshungs par bzung bshem lags so/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te song ngo / /mkhyen bzhin du 'dri ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la ci'i phyir rgyal po chos ma mnyan par song zhes smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das la zhib mor gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis nyes so/ /de ste rgyal po gzugs can snying po so sor thar pa thos par gyur na nges par de sngon pas kyang mngon du dga' bar 'gyur te/ dga' nas dga' ba'i dbang gis bya ba byed du gdon mi za'o/ /de bas na ngas gnang gis 'di 'dra ba'i skyes bu dam pa dad pa de dag la ni thos par gyis sheg /gzhan yang rab tu phyug la ma dad/ dbul la rab tu dad de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bu dag la'ang thos par gyis shig /gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa gro zhin bye ba 13—424

nyi shu pa zhes bya ba skya bo bseng bseng po skomanyezhing rid la rmya zhing lus nyam chung bar gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs te/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo ci'i phyir na gro zhinasabye ba nyi shu bsnyezhes bya ba skya bo bseng bseng po skom ④zhing rid la rmya zhing nyam chung bar gyur/des bcom ldan 'das de dang po btsas nas thugasapa 'ba' zhig gis lus bskyed pa lags so zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de lta bsakyin ngas gnang gis gro zhin bye ba nyi shu pa la thug pa ludasnyecig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gro zhin7bye ba nyi shu pa la tshe dang ldan pa gro zhin bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod ni thug pa 'thung sheg par gnang ngo zhes bsgo ba dang / des smras pa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo bdag gcig pu la'am/ de ste dge 'dun thams cad des smras pa/ khyod gcig pu'o/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo 'dis glengs pasalgen tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag gis kyang 'di skad du gro zhin bye ba nyi shu pa bstan pa la rab tu byung nas sngon grong khyer tsam pa na lo legs par gyur pa'i tshe/ bal glang bdun gyis drang ba yang spangs te rab tu byung na da thug pa tsam la yang chags so zhes zer gyis /bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi phyir dge 'dun thams cad kyang thug pa gnang na bdag kyang gzod 'tshal bar bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ltar na gnang gis gro zhin bye ba nyi shu pa'i phyir dge 'dun thams cad kyang thug pa 'thung shig /gang gi tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying po bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun rnams thug pa 'thung bar gnang ngo 13—425

zhes thos nas des dge 'dun la sa bon bum pa stong gis btabanyepa'i zhing dag phul ba dang / dge slong dag gis ma blangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi phyir na⑧blang bar bya ste de la the tshom du ma byed cig /de bas na zhing las byung bsnyernams dge 'dun gyis spyad par gyis shig /rkyang pa'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa'o// //mdor na/ gding dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa0dang / /dge tshul pasnyedang gsar bu dang / /snyoms zhugs dang ni mi gnang ba/ /bslab pa byin pa gnyis pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'akhur ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa dge slong dang khyim pa gnyis lhan cig tu gding ba gcig la mchis su rung ngam/ u pā li de ni mi rung mod kyi/ de lta bu'i rkyen cig byung na gnang ngo / /btsun pa dge tshul pha dang /dge slong gsar bu dang / ma ning dang / za ma dang / dge slong ma sun phyung ba dang / pha bsad pa dang / ma bsad pa dang / dgra bcom pa bsad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba dang / mu stegs can dang / mu stegs can du song ba dang / rkun gnas dang / so sor gnas pa dang / mi gnas pa dag la sogs pa dang gding ba gcig gi steng na lhan cig tu mchis par rung ngam/ u pā li de ltar ni mi rung mod kyi/ de lta bu'i rkyen cig byung na gnang ngo de bzhin du stan gcig gam/ khri gcig gam/khri'u gcig gam/ par tangasagacig tu7mi rung mod kyi/ de lta bu'i rkyen cig 13—426

byung na rung ngo / /btsun pa khyim pa dang stegs bu la stan bting ba'i steng na lhan cig tu mchis par rung ngam/ mi rung mod kyi/ de lta bu'i rkyen cig byung na rung ngo / /par tang dag btingasheyang mikurung mod kyi de lta bu'i rkyen cig byung na par tang dag bting bar gyur pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de bzhin du dge tshul pha dang / dge slong gsar bu nas so sor gnas pa'i bar du ste/ de bzhin du gnas la nyes pa'i dmigasalgem byung gi0bar du0lhan cig tu 'dug na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bslab pa stsal ba gnyis shig stan gcig gi steng na lhan cig mchis su rung ngam/ u pā li de ni mi rung ngo / /rkyang pa'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa'o// // 'dul ba gzhung dam pa/⑧ bam po bzhi bcu rtsasheganyis paX/ mdor na/mi bslang ba dang khri'u gcig /brel bar gyur pa'ang de bzhin te/ /cung zad brel bar gyur pa dang / /rtswa dang shing yang dge 'dun gyi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kurno dga'achar ba na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dge slong dag khri'u'i7steng na btso blag gi las byed cing 'dug pa dang / drug sde dag de nyid du 'dug cing gnod par byed de⑩/ de dag brel bzhin du bslang ba dang de dag la gnod par gyur nas/de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong btso blag gi las byed cing brel ba la dge slong dag gis ma bslang shig /bslang na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//13—427

gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong dag zas7za zhing 'khod pa rnams la drug sde dag gis rgan rims bzhin du bya'o zhes bslang ba dang / dge slong dag ldang du ma btubasnyenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ji ltar rgan rims bzhin du 'dug shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar rgan rims bzhin rdu 'dug shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / drugo sde dag phyis 'ongs nas dge slong snga ma zas za zhing brel ba dag bslang ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis dge slong zas ②za zhing brel ba dag ma bslang bar gud du 'dug par bya ste/ bslangasnyen 'das pa dang bcas pa'oX/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa ji tsam gyis na dge slong dag zan za zhing brel ba zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chung ngu lan tshwa'am/ shang ce'amanya/ la sgyug kyang rung brimasalgepar gyur pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong zas za zhing brel ba la ma bslang shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde dag rgan rims kyis dang por 'dug nas/ zas za zhing ched du brel bar byed pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis gral ma yin par 'dug la zas za zhing brel bar ma byed cig /byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag gral rimasacal mkhas par gyis shig /de las gzhan du na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun gyi btso blag gi bum pa dang /gzhong khung dag dge slong gis blangs nas btso tho)blag gi las byed pa dang /drug sde dag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag nged rgan pas nged sngar dbang ngo zhes smras nas / tshon rtsi dag pho ste khyer ba dang / dge slong dag brel bar gyur nas/ de 13—428

ltaratugyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pazha dge slong dag gisashebum pa'am/ gzhing khung dag brel ba la ma blang bar bya ba rnams zin nas gdong long ༷shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gis bum pa'am/ gzhong khung dag brel ba la ma bslang shigasaces bka' stsal pa dang0/ drug sde dag gis bsams bzhin du snod rnams tshon cung zad tsam zhig gis labrel bar byas te bzhag pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshon rtsi thams cad snod gcig gi nang du blugs la dgos na blang bar gyis shig /dge slong gis snod dag gi nang du tshon rtsi cung zad kyis brel bar bya dzee/ ma bzhag sheg /bzhag na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis dze ta'i tshal shing thags kyis bskor ba dang / khyim bdag dag gis bcag cing bcag cing khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ma bkur cig ces bsgo shig /de dag gis bsgo ba dang / shing dang rtswa yang bor te dong ngo / /de dag chud zos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ spyad du mi rung ba dag ni tshang mang du skyol cig /lhag ma dag ni las gsar du byed pa la phul cig /drug sde dag gis las gsar du byar rung ba'i shing dag gshegs nas mer bus te btso blag gi las byed pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ las gsar du byar rung ba'i shing dag ni ma bud cig /bus na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa drug pa'o// //13—429

mdor na/ mgon med zas sbyinanyegyi ni〈rgyan②/ /'dug pa blang bar mi bya 'o0/ /snod spyad lag na thogs pa dang / /lham yang phyi bar bya ba 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'akhur ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis de ste gnang na bdag gis dze ta'i tshal yang dbul bar bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyisasprebaka' stsal pa/khyim bdag ngas gnang gis phul cig /des shing gang pho'i ming du bya ba la ni pho'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ gang mo'i ming du bya ba la7ni mo'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / dge slong dag gis ji ltar bya ba mi shes nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag nyid la dris shig /de dag gis khyim bdag nyid la dris pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa ji ltar bsngosarwa)pa de bzhin du mdzod cig /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang shing po'i ming du bya ba dang /gang shing mo'i ming du bya ba rnams kyi7rgyan so sor bsdus la thum por byos te zhog shig /nam dus ston gyi tshe yang de bzhin du brgyananepar gyis shig /rtsig pa'i ni ri mo'i yo byad du byos shig /bsro khang gi rtsig pa dang / ka ba dag gi ni las gsar du byos shig /de'i sa'i ni dge 'dun gyi snang mar byos shig /nad pa'i sman khang gi rtsig pa dang / ka ba'i de dag ni las gsar du byos shig /de'i sa'i sman gyi yo byad byos shig /tshang mang gi rtsig pa dang 13—430

ka ba'i ni de dag las gsar du byos shig /de'inyesa'i ni dge 'dun gyisabashos su gyis shig /chu gang gi rtsig pa dang / ka ba'i⑧las gsar du gyis shig /de'i sa'i ni skom du brims7shig /dugs khang gi rtsig0pa dang / ka ba'i ni de'i las gsar du gyis shig /de'i sa'i ni dugs khang du gyis shig /bkad sa'i khang pa'i rtsig pa dang / ka ba dag gis7ni las gsar du gyis shig /de'i sa'i ni snum pa'i zong gyis shig /khyams dang / stegs bu dang / 'chag sa dang / sgo khang dang / yang thog gi rtsig pa dang / ka ba dag gisasnyeni las gsar du gyis shig /de'i sa'i ni dge 'dun spyir bgos7shig /gang rdzing bu'i ba de ni phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi spyir zhog shig /dge slong spong ba'i khang bu'i nang na 'dug cing dge ba'i phyogs spyod pa dang / drug sde dag der 'ongs nas nged rgan no zhes zer nas de dag bslang ste btang ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgan rims so zhes dge slong gis dge slong 'khod pa la ma bslang shig /bslang na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag bya ba byas nas stan las langs te 'chag cing 'dug bzhin du gzhan gyis stan blangs nas ma ster nas dge slong dag brel bar gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bya ba byas nas stan las langs na stan ma 'dzin cig /dge slong dag ring zhig tu stan las7'dug nas langs te 'chag pa dang / de'i sar drug sde dag 'dug nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/der ma 'dug shig /langs te 'chag tu 'gro na yang de'i steng du chos gos sam/13—431

pus 'khyud7cig zhog la chogs7shig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong dag snod rnams thogs bzhin du gtsug rgyalag khang du 'ongs pa dang / de nas dge slong gcig gis thogs bzhin du phyag byas pa dang / de'i ril ba chagasapar gyur to/ /gzhan zhigasnyekyang khang bzangs kyi0ka ba la lham brdabs pa dang / dge slong dag 'phya bar gyur nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas dge slong lam du 'jug pa'i mtshungs par spyodasapa'i chos bca'o/ /dge slong lam du 'jug pas chu mthong na lhung bzed dang chos gos phog ste phyogs gcig tu zhog la/ de nas gos dag kyang sprugs te khrus byos la/ de nas rkang pa dang / lag pa khrus la chu yang chu chags kyis tshogs te ra dashegasher bas lham phyis la de'i 'og tu lag pa bsnyal nas bla 'og gi bgo ba legs par gyon la spyod lam zhi bzhin gtsug lag khang du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de las gzhan du na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa'o// //mdor na/ spu gri'i bdar dang sen mo bcad/ /smang tsher rkang pa'i rten dang ni/ /bshang bar bya dang gci ba'i gnas/ /bya ba byas pa mi bcang ngo /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga'achar ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyi phyir spu gri'i snod chongs shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde dag gis dge 'dun gyi spu gri khyer te bya ba byas kyang spu gri blangs nas byad dung bya ba yod ces 13—432

zer nas spu gri mnyester ro/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ spu gri bya ba byas nas ma 'chang shig /bcangasasnyen 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /spu gri ji lta ba desnyebazhin du bdarasredang / sen mo bcadasapa dang / smang tsher dang / rkang pa brten pa rnams so/ /drug sde desnyedag gis gci ba'i gnas su zhugs te bya ba byas kyang da dung ⑨yang slar 'jug go zhes smras nas/dge slong lhags pa'i rnams 'jug tu mi ster to0/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis gci ba'i gnas su zhugs te bya ba byas na dge slong dag la ma bgags shig bgags na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /bshang ba'i sar yang de bzhin no/ /rkyang pa'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa'o// //mdor na/ g.yog dang dus ston chen po dang / /rnyog pa can gyi chu dang ni/ /phye las brdzis dang skyo ma dang / /sder bsdus de bzhin bsgrags pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis de ste gnang na bdag gis sen mo dang dbu skra'iglumachod rten la dus ston chen po bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ltar na gnang gis gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la dus ston gsol cig ces bka' stsal 13—433

pa dang / dge slong dag dus ston chen po'i tshe 'dus nas de dag rdzing bu'i nang du0lhung bzed rnams bkrus pa dang / gtsug lag khang nakhuganas pa dang /dge bsnyen dag gis kyang mar dang / 'bru mar dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi'i bum pa rnams kyang rdzing du rgyabakrus pas na lhung bzed rnams dang bum pa de rnams kyi snum dag gis chu'i steng du zhag chags par gyur te/ de la dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas chu mi 'thung ngo / /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/desasakha zas kyi bya ba byed mi nus kyis0dkrugs la 'thung shig /de la the tshom dusam byed cig /chu de kho ra khor yug tu skye bo mang po dag gis dkrugs pas na thams cad kyang rnyog pas gang ste gdong gi gzugs brnyan yang mi snang bar gyur/ chu tshags kyang rnyog pas 'gags nas chu mi zag pa dang / de dag la gnod par gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang na gdong gi gzugs brnyan mi snang ba der lhung bzed chung ngu'am snod gzhan gyi 0chus la shing tog ka ta ku'i 'bras bu chug ste skad cig sdod la rtogs shig dang nges par gdong gi gzugs brnyan yang snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu med na zan gyi chang bu chug shig /de snum med pas zhigs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phye mar du gyis la der chug shig /chu ba tshwa can du gyur nas dge slong dag the tshom skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de ste des lan tshwa'icabya ba byed nus na byin len byos la 'thung shig /de ste bya ba byed mi nus na chus la 'thung shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /rkyang pa'i 13—434

sgo gsum pa'i mdo'inyetshigs su bcad pa dgu pa'o// //mdor na/ chu dang zho las chur gyur dang / /bum pa bum bu'angasade bzhin te/ /lag pa bsnyal nas 'thungasab dang / /dge tshul pha la'ang rnamasabazhir bya/ /lhung bzed dang ni gdong bkru dang / /bsod snyoms pa la rnam pa gnyis/ /rgyags dang 'bras bu me togasnyedag /phongs na rung gis bza' bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag khron pa'i nang nas chu bcus te de dag gis btsags na 'bras canasabrul ma dang khur ba'i dum bu dag byung ngo / /de dag the tshom skyes nas chags pa dang dum bu dag kyang 'khru bar gyur nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ des kha zas kyi bya ba byed mi nus kyis phyung ste bor la tshogs shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /dge slong dag rdzing nas chu 'chu ba dang der chu'i bum pa dang sbrang rtsi'i bum pa dag bkrus pa dang / dge slong dag gis kyang lhung bzed snum can dag bkrus so/ /de dag gi snum gyis chu'i steng zhag tu chags par gyur/ zho'i 'brum bu dag kyang snang bar gyur nas/ dge slong dag the tshom skyes te ma bcus pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ des kha zas kyi bya ba byed mi nus kyis chus shig /phyi dro ⑩mi 'thung nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'thung shig bum pa tsodang ril ba yidag gi nang du mi ldugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ der lugs shig dge slong dag cig lam du zhugs 13—435

te dong ba dang / de na7chu med de khyim bdag gisashesnod nas chu 'gron⑧pa mang po la byin pa dang / dge slong dag gis 'thung du ma btub ste④/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste gzhan med na rtogs la 'thung shig /de dag bum pa dang ril ba'i nang du mi sdugs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ der yang lugs shig /phyi dro mi 'thung ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'thung sheg lam na rdo chu sgom yod pa dang / ⑤dge slong dag the tshom skyes te chu ma blangs pa dang / bcom ldan ci'adas kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams rdo chu sgrom ni bkru bkru ba yin gyis0/ rtogs la 'thung shig /ril ba dang bum pa dag tu mi sdugs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ derasheyang lugs shig /phyi dro mi 'thung ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'thung shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /de bzhin du shing sgrom dang rkyal pa'i nang na 'dug pa yang rtogasashel 'thung shig /phyi dro dang / ril ba dang / bum pa'i rinang du yang lugs shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /dge slong dag gis dge 'dun la chu brims pa dang / de na dge slong dag gis tshe dang ldan pa chu rgyun lhung bzed kyi nang nas ma chad pas na bzhag par gyur to zhes smras te/ de dag gis ma blangs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag 4)gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khu ba thams cad kyi rgyud ni thur du 'bab kyi steng du mi 'gyur gyis 'thung la de la the tshomanem byed cig /de bzhin du 'o ma dang / zho dang / zhi'i chu dang / dar ba dang / rtsab mo dang / tshwa la sogs pa la rgyas par brjod do//13—436

gleng gzhi ni mnyan7du yod pa na ste/ dge slong dag ljongs rgyu zhing spyod pa las ba langashegi lhas su phyin pa dang / de dag la de na chu med de/ de dag gis zhi'i chu byin pa dang / dge slong de dag the tshom skyes nas mi 'khru'o/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang na chu med pa〈zho'i chu dang / dar ba dang bas khrus shig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig /dge slong dag gis ba lang rdzi la bum pa brnyas pa dang / de dag gis mar gyi bum pa dang / 'o ma'i bum pa dag rnyed na de dag the tshom skyes nas ma blangs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bum pa la rnam pa lnga ste/ bshang ba'i bum pa dang /gci ba'i bum pa dang / chang gi bum pa dang / 'bru mar gyi bum pa dang /mar gyi bum pa'o/ /de la snga ma gsum0ni ma bzhag pa yang ma bzhag shig /gzhag na ni rgyang ring por borakhucig /'bru mar gyi bum pa dang / mar gyi bum pa ni me'i nang du bsregs la de nas lci ba'i ril bu'4/ ba lang gi lci bas rung bar gyis la chu chus7te/ de snga dro dang phyi dro yang spyod cig /de la the tshom du ma byed cig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong gzhan zhig gis bum pa'i nang nas chu 'thungs pa dang / bung bas zos so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bum bu'i nang nas chu ma 'thung shig /'thung na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /sngar lag pa snyol la kha khrus te/ gdod 13—437

chu 'thung shig /bum bu'i kha gabatumed par ma bzhag shig /de bas na ngas gnang gis bum pa'i kha gab ②chongs shig bcom ldan 'das kyis bum bu'i kha gabasrechongs shig ces bka' stsal na/ dge slong dag0gis kha gabasnyiji lta bu bcang ba0mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shing las byas pa'am/ rdo las byas pa'am/ sa las byas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lag pa snyol la chu 'thung shig ces bka' stsal na/ lam du zhugs pa dgashegacig la chu nyung bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'dabalgem rang lhags pa tshol la de'i nang nas 'thung shig /de yang med par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bag yod bzhin du shing la chags pa las 'thung shig /de yang med par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dben par 'dug la bum bu nyid nas 'thung shig /gzhan gyis ma mthong ba dang mdzes par gyis shig /dge slong dag ngas phongs pa na gnang ba de ma phongs pa'i tshe na ma spyod cig /spyad na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong dag ljongs rgyu ba spyod cing dong ba las de dag gis rgyags dge tshul pha byadag la bskur ba de tsodag ma theg nas de dag gis theg la bskur cig ces smras pa dang / dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas ma bteg go/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ theg shig dge tshul pha dag ngal nas phog ste slang zhes smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis ma phog nas/de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom 13—438

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phog shig dge tshul pas ma bzung bzhin gdegatupa dang / dbab pa dag byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge tshul phas ma gzung bar gdegasapa dang / dbab pasam byed cig /dge tshul phabadag gis bdag cag chad de ngal bsosarkyukhyed kyis cung zhig khyer cig ces smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis ma khyer ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tha gus bcingasakyil tha gu'i rtse mo dge tshul phas zung ste phyi bzhin⑧'brang du chug la dge slong gis khyer cig /dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas de la mi za ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de la the tshom du ma byed par zo shig /dge slong 'gron7pa mang po dang lhan cig tu 'grogs te lam du zhugs pa dang / 'gron pa mang po dag rkun pos bcom pa dang / dge tshul gyis rgyags rnams bor nas bros te dong ngo / /dge slong dag gi rgyags ma khyer nas de nyid na bor zhing 'dug pa dang / 'gron pa mang po dag gis 'phags pa khyed kyi rgyags ni rkun pos ma khyer ro zhes smras pa dang / dge slong dag dge tshul pha dag la deng la rgyags long ste shog shig ces smras pa dang ⑥/ de dag skrag nas 'dong du ma btub ⑥ste khyed nyid ci'i phyir mi 'dong / nged cag rkun pos gsad mod ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ long la gzod dge tshul phas byin cig /dge slong dag gis the tshom skyes nas de dag ma zos pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de la the tshom du ma byed par zo shig /klung rgal bar gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge tshul pha dag la khyed nyid 13—439

kyis khyer7te rgalakhubar nus sam zhes dris la de ste nus zhes zer na legs sonya//de ste mi nus so zhes zer na rgyags bdag cag gis khyer la rgol cig /de la dge slong dag gis rgyags dag pha rol du bsgral bar bya na dge tshul phas bsgral bar gyis la brtag0par gyis shig /de ste dge tshul pha yang mi nus na dge slong dag gis rgyags pha rol du sgrol la/ de'i 'og tu dge tshul pasnyeyang bsgral0bar gyis shig /de ste gnyi gar nus na dge tshul pha dang / rgyags lhan cig tu bsgral bar gyis shig / gnyi ga⑧lhan cig tu bsgral ba dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas ma zos so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas0/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de la the tshom du ma byed par bza' bar gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag lhung bzed du zo shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong zhig gis lhung bzed bkrus nas mthe bos brdabs na sgra mi gsangasnyenas/ dge slong de la the tshom skyes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgyu med par lan gnyis lan gsum du bkru bas khrus la mthe bos brdabs na sgra gsang bar byung na/ de la the tshom du ma byed par zo shig /dge slong gzhan zhig gis lhung bzed bkrus te/ de bu ga na zas kyi tshigs ma zhig mthong ba dang / de the tshom skyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de la shing bus brus te lan gsum gyi bar du rab tu khrus la de la the tshom du ma byed cig /dge slong gzhan zhig gis yang lhung bzed gas pa zhig gi nang du khu ba dron po zhig blangs pa dang / de'i 'phro nas snum byung ba dang / zhag steng du byung ba dang / dge slong de the tshom skyes nas /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ steng gi zhag zhoms la btung bar gyis 13—440

shig /dge slong cig rlung nad kyis btab nas des phyi dro khu ba zhig 'thungs te①/ nub kur lhung bzed de'i nang du skomakhubatung zhes byas pa dang / lhung bzed kyi nang du snum langasasnyenas de'i steng du zhag chags pa dngas/ dge slong de the tshom skyes nas skom yang ma 'thungs li/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/lag pa dang kha bkrus nas0snum zhoms te 'or te de la the tshom du ma byed par 'thung shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis kha khrus shig ces bka' stsal nani/ dge slong dag kha cis7bkru ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/lci ba'am sa'am shing gi shun phrags la sogs pa gzhan gyis so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa ji tsam gyis kha bkrus pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kha dang rma gnyis mtshungs te rtag tu zag pas ma 'bags pa mi nus med kyi lan gsum du kha bkrus te chu bor ba ni kha bkrus pa zhes bya'o/ /dge slong cig gis bsod snyoms bslangs te gnas khang du bzhag nas phyi rol du byung ba dang / khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis de'i steng du zas shig blugs te bzhag pa dang / ji tsam bsod snyoms pa de 8slar 'ongs na tsobasod snyoms kyi steng na zas gzhan zhig blugs par mthong ste/ de the tshom skyes te zan ma zos so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste byin len byed pa yod na byin len byos la zo shig /de ste med na steng gi sar pa de log shig tu 'or la the tshom du ma byed par zo shig /dge slong gzhan zhig gis bsod snyoms blangs (sprenas gnas khang du bzhag ste/13—441

phyi rol du song ba dang / de khyim pa zhig gis rig par mthong ste dge slong de the tshom skyes nas ma zos so/ /de ltar7gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de la ci'i phyir reg ces dris la/ des rtswa sbrangasalgem dag bsalakhuba'i phyir reg ces zer na byin len byos la zo shig de ste 'dod pa'i phyir reg go zhes zer na de yang phyed0mar gos la byin len byos te de la the tshom du ma byed par zo zhig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag rgyags khyer cig ces bka' stsal ⑤na/khyim pa0dang dge tshul pha dag med nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sbyin pa'i bdag po spro ba skyed cig /sbyin bdag kyang med na bdag nyid kyis slar khyer la de khyim pa dang rjesakhul zo shig /de ste de la med na skal ba gnyis su chod la khyim pa la byin te/ des khyer na ni de'i skal ba slar slongs7te byin len byos la zo shig /bdag gi skal ba ni de la byin7cig /de ste de ltar yang ma 'byor na nyi ma dang po'i tshe ni bsnyung bar 'dug shig /phyi de nyin par byin len byed pa med na stag gi spar thabs gcig zo shig /yang phyi de nyin mo yang byin len byed pa med na stag gi spar thabs gnyis zo shig /de ste zhag bzhi'i nyin mo yang byin len byed pa med na ji tsam 'grangs pa'i bar du zo sheg/de la the tshom du ma byed cig /de ste rgyags med na 'bras bu rang lhung7ba de longs la gdugs tshod la bab kyi bar du khyer te song la de ste khyim pa dang phrad na skal ba gnyis su chod la gcig ni de la byin te/ de'i skal ba slar bdag gis slongs la rung bar byos te0zo shig /bdag gi de byin cig /de ste ma phrad na 13—442

snga dro'atso/ phyi dro yang rung / rung bar bya ba'i phyir sgyu med na srog dang 'bral bas/ the tshom du ma byed par zo shig /de ste yang lhung ba med na shing la 'dzegs te thogs shig /yang na sprugs la byang phyogs kyi dus su bsngos7te zo shig /de bzhin du rtsa ba la sogs pa yangashes la sa rang gis brkos te phyung la the tshom du ma byed par zo shig /ngas khyedakyil phongs pa'i tshe gnang ba de ma phongs pa'i tshe ma spyod cig /spyad na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo gsum pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu ste sgo gsum pa rdzogs skokhya// //mdor bsdus pa ste/ sa bon bum pa rkun po rku ba dang / /lus kyis reg pa de bzhin te/ /'bras canakhulan tshwa song ba dang / /bu ram shing dang rgyan 'brusadang / /glo0bur 'ongs dang gnas pa'o/ /mdor na/ sa bon dumanyepa shing rta gru/ /khur dang 'o ma tshong pa de bzhin te/ /bya rog sbrang ma btso blag las/ /u pā li bzhi chog kun shes pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs te0/ gang gi tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bum pa stong gi sa bon btab pa phul ba de'i tshe dge slong dag gis de'i thog zos nas zhing yang tha bar bor te rtswa ku sha'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po phyi rol du byung bas de dag mthong nas/des blon po la kye sus 'di ltar zhing kun tha bar bor nas ku sha'i gnas su gyur ces smras pa dang / des lhas 'phags pa dag la bum pa stong gi sa bon gyis btab pa phul ba da de dag gis legs par blangs pa de dag gzigs mod ces smras pa dang / rgyal pos ji0'phags pa de dag gis thun shas su yang0ma 13—443

btang ngam zhes de dag gis dge slong dag la smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas①/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi zhing dag ni thun shas su thongakhushig /dge slong dag gis thun shas su byin no/ /zhing pas zhingashegashin pa'i rnams ni thams cad bdag cag khyer yang de dgasregisasaskal ba ma blangs pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nasaX/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhing shas kyi skal ba longasashig /dge slong dag gis blangs te de nyid du bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/skal ba gtsug lag khang du skyos shig ces gsungs pa dang / sngar zhing pa nyid kyis der bskyasalgebo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sngon du zhing bdag gis der skyos shig /de dag skyed pa na yang brkus so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ srung ba'i dge slong rnams skos shig /shing rta'i nang du skyed (sprepa las shing rta chag kyang dge slong gis grogs ma byas pa dang /khyim bdag mi dga' bar gyur nas smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di ni ci khyed cag gi na khyed kyis ci'i phyir grogs mi bya/ des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shing rta la phyugs 'debs pa'i sa ma gtogs par der bskyab dang zhing pa'i grogs gyis sheg /dge slong gzhan zhig na bar gyur nas/ shing rta pa dag gis shing rta'i steng du zhon cig ces smras pa dang / de the tshom skyes nas ma zhon nas/ bcom ldan 'das 13—444

kyis bka' stsal pa/ na na shing rta la zhon cig /de la the tshomatum byed cig /gru'i nang na mthun ②shas kyi skal ba skyed pa las gru yang chag par gyur nas/dge slong dag gis grogs ma byas pa dang / khyim bdag mi dga' bar gyurasanas smras pa/ 'di ni khyed kyiphun/ khyod kyis ci'i phyir grogs mi bya/ de dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gru'i dngosam gtogs par phul ba'i grogs dang zhing pa'i grogs gyis shig /dge slong gzhan zhig yang klung gi 'gram nas song ba las na bar gyur nas mnyan pas 'phags pa 'di'i nang du zhugs zhes smras pa dang / de the tshom skyes nas nang du ma zhugs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dngo ma gtogs par nang du zhugs pa de la the tshom ma byed cig /gzhan yang khur gyis bskyas pa las de chad par gyur nas/ des 'phags pa 'di mar phobanyeshig ces smras pa dang / dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas ma phog go/ / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang 9 bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phog cigs /dge slong dag gis phab nas slar ma bteg pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ji ltar phog pa ⑩bzhin du theg cigaci /lha gang gi sgor bor te dong ba dang / ma byin par len pa dag gis brkus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nang du skyos shig /dge slong gis sus tsonang du byabaskyab mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim pas so/ /khyim pa med na dge tshul phas so/ /dge tshul 13—445

pha yang med nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bdag cag nyid kyis nang du skyos shig /dge slong dag gisatubaskyas nas bdagakhugis bskyas pa yin no snyam nas ma zos pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsolashenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de la the tshom ma byed par zo shig /dge 'dun gyisazangs kyi nang du me cher 'bar bas 'osnyem la sogs pa ni khol/ rung bar byed pa ni sgor song nas bo ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de phyi rol du ma 'gro shig /de ste0rkyen cig byung nas phyi rol du song na ma gal ⑦pa dag phyir drongs shig /'on kyang de bzhin du lud pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdag ma dgashephyir dbyung bar gyis shig /mdag ma phyir phyung yang lud pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos gos kyi tha mas g.yobs shig /'on kyang lud par gyur nas bdag nyid kyis gzar bu long la dkrug par gyis shig /dge slong dag ngas 'phongs pa la gnang ba de ma phongs pa'i tshe ma spyod cig /spyad na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sman dag kyang dge tshul pa'am/ lha gang na gnas pas dkrug par gyis shig /de yang phyi rol du song na de'i thabs snga ma bzhin no//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ tshong pa mang po dag cig gis sangs rgyas dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la sogs pa bshos la spyan drangs so/ /de dag sgos bshos sbyar te dro sar bskyas tsonas ma drangs kyi bar du tshong khang du me shor te de dag me gsod du song ba dang / gdugs tshod yol la thug nas/dge slong dag gis ji ltar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom 13—446

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i sems kyis yongs su btang bas na/dge slong dag de la the tshom ma byed par bza' bar bya'o/ /zos nas byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi dus su byin gyis rlobs shig /dge 'dun gyis dronyesar bya rog mchus zas la rig pa dang / dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas zan ma zos so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mchu'i than korakhu'or la de la the tshom ma byed par zo shig /dge slong dag gis lhung bzed kyi kha zas kyisanang du bya rogashegis reg nas de dag kha zas ma zos pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i mchu'i than korakhu'or la the tshom ma byed par bza' bar gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru0ci la yang the tshom za ste/ nam gru the tshom can nam gru the tshom can zhes ming du gyur to/ /de bshang sar 'ongs pa dang / sbrang ma zhig mthong ngo / /phyis yang de dang 'dra bshezhig bskos na⑧zas kyi steng na 'dug pa mthong ba dang / des tshe dang ldan pa dag bshang sa na mthong ba'i sbrang ma des 'dir 'ongs te kha zas la 'bags te ma rung bar byas so zhes smras pa dang / de thos pa dang dge slong mang zhig gis zas ma zos par gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams sbrang ma ni mthon dman kun du rgyus des gang du reg pa de 'or la de la the tshom du ma byed par zo shig /dge slong dag tshon rtsi'i las byed de8/ de dag sems 'khrul bas tshon rtsi'i bum pa yin no snyam nas des dge 'dun gyi 'bru mar gyi bum pa dang / mar gyi bum pa dag steng du bteg ste khyer ba dang / de na gang gi tshe ngo shes pa de'i tshe na 13—447

'greng bzhin du bor nas chaganyepa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/thang ma skas la 'dzegasalgepa las cungakhuzad tsam zhig ni 'dzegasalgemang du lasasnyen slar bobs la gnas gar bde bar ma 'gyel bar zhog shig / de ste0thang ma skas la mang du 'dzegs la thung du 'dzeg⑧dgos na steng du 'dzegasakhul gnas bde bar ma 'gyel bar zhog shig /dge slong dag the tshom skyes nas ma zos pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nasayi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de la the tshom ma byed par zo shig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa bzhag pa rnam pa du 'tshal du rung / u pā li rnam pa gnyis kyis te/ ngo tsha ba med cing bslab pa la mi mos pa dang / gang la ngo tsha yod kyang dran pa nyams pa stekhya/ de gnyis kyis bzhag pa rung gis gnyi ga zo shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byol song gi skye gnas su gyur pa'i sems can la sbyin pa byin na ni rnam par smin pa brgyar re bar bya'o/ /tshul khrims ngan pas zin pa'i mi la sbyin pa byin na ni rnam par smin pa stong du re bar bya'o/ /tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i skyes bu gang zag la sbyin pa byin na ni rnam par smin pa brgya phrag stong du re bar bya'o/ — /phyi rol gyi drang srong 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba dag la sbyin pa byin na ni rnam par min pa sa ya brgya stong du re bar bya'o/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byed par zhugs pa la ni tshad med do/ /rgyun du zhugs pa la de bas kyang tshad med do/ /lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du byed par zhugs pa la de bas kyang tshad med do/ /lan gcig phyir ldog 13—448

par rgyun du zhugs pa la de bas kyang tshad med do/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du byed par zhugs pa la de bas kyang tshad med do/ /phyir mi7'ong ba'i rgyun du zhugs pa la de bas kyang tshad med do/ /dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byed par zhugs pa la de bas kyang tshad med do/ /dgra bcom pa la de bas kyang tshad med nakhurang sangs rgyas dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ②lta smos kyang ci dgos bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa dag gis dge slong dag mchod rten la phyag 'tshal du dong ba la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag bskur ba dang / dge slong dag rnam pa de lta bu'i rkyen byung nas de dag gis gang du bskur bar0bskur ma nus so/ /de dag gi nang nas kha cig gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa ni gzhan du bsngos la gzhan du dbul bar ma byed cig ces byungasnyi/ kha cig gis yang smras pa/ de la gzhan byar ci yod/bcom ldan 'das la zhu'o/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dngakhu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnamasalge rnam pasabazhi la ni nges par dbul dgos te byang chub pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo dang / cho 'phrul chen po dang / 57yul nas gshegs pa'o/ — /'di dag la bsngos nas gzhan du sngo bar ma byed cig /de las gzhan du bsngos pa'i rkyen rnam pa de lta bus na gzhan dag tu bsngor rung gis de la the tshom ma byed cig /dge slong rnams ngas phongs pa'i tshe gnang ba de bzhin du ma phongs pa'i tshe ma spyod cig / de ltar 8spyad yin 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/13—449

btsun pa dge slong gnyis shig 'khruganyepar gyur/ rtsod par gyur/ 'thabasnyepar gyur pa de la gang mdasapar gzung / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa gang tshul khrims dang ldan pa'o/ / gnyi ga tshul khrims dang ldan pasnyen gang mang du thos pa'o/ /tshu gnyi ga mang du thos na gang chog shes pa'o/ /gnyi ga chog shes na gang cher chog shes pa'o/ /gnyi ga cher chog shes na u pā li gnyi ga cher chog shes pa las cher chog shes pa ni〈med de mi srid do/ /gnas med de de gnyis lta bu la ni 'khrug pa'am/ rtsod pa'am/ 'thab par 'gyur ba 'byung ba'i gnas ma yin no/ /rkyang pa'i sgo'i mdo bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang po'o// // 'dul ba gzhung dam pazha bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ mdor na/rkun po gnas dang7za ma dang / /sngar 'khrugs pa la rnam pa bzhi/ /bslab pa byin pas tshul shing brims/ /de dag dge 'dun dbyen mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med pa 'khozas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa u pā lis zhus pa/ btsun pa tshul shing brims pa rkun gnas kyis tshul shing brims na dge 'dun gyi dbyen du 'gyur ram/ u pā li mi 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa ma ning dang za ma dang / dge slong ma sun phyung ba dang / pha bsad pa dang / ma bsad pa dang / dgra bcom pa bsad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis chakhrag phyung ba dang / mu stegs can dang /rdzimu stegs can du song ba dang / tha dad du gnas pa dang / ci mi gnas pa dag 13—450

gis tshul shing brims na dge 'dun gyi dbyin du 'gyur ram/ u pā li mi 'gyur ronyu/ /btsun pa sngar ②'khrugs pa bzhis tshul shing brims na dge 'dun gyi dbyin du 'gyur ram/ u pā li mi 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bslab pa byin pas tshul shing brims na dge 'dun gyi dbyin du 'gyur ram/ u pā li mi 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'o// //mdorasnyen/ lus la reg dang rngul zanasredang / /char pa 'bab parasnyebacad mi bya/ /tshang mang dang ni bshang gci sal/ /ma rung nas ni mi dorasnyeb 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshalashemagon med pa la zas sbyin pa'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis dge 'dun gyi mal stan dag kyang lus la reg par bgos8/ rkang pa nas mgo'i bar du thang chad par bgos pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la zhus nasaX/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag gis dge 'dun gyi tsomal stan lus la reg par ma bgo shig /bgos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag dge 'dun gyi mal stan lus la reg par ma bgo sheg ces bka' stsal pa na⑩/dge slong dag gis ji ltar bgo ba mi shes nas/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gang zag gis rngul zan 8gyi steng du shes bsnyen du dal nas khad kyis bgo bar gyis shig /drug sde dag gis dge 'dun gyi gos bgos nas dbyar char gyi nang na bla gab med par 'dug go/ /de char gyis ma rung bar gyur nas/ de ltar 13—451

gyur panyedage slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis dge 'dun gyi gos gyon lasnyedabyar char gyi nang na bla gab med par ma 'dug sheg /'dug na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag cigis dge 'dun gyi gos bgos nas tshang mang du 'jug ste/ de dudasapas ma rung bar gyur nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag gis dge 'dun gyi gos gyon nas tshang mang du 'gro bar ma byed cig /song nasa'adas pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis dge 'dun gyi mal stan dag bgos nas bshang gci'i sar song ba dang / bshang gci'i gzerasnyem dag gis phog nas ma rung bar7gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge 'dun gyi mal stan gyon nas bshang gci'ishesar ma 'gro shig /song na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ dge slong rnams dge 'dun gyi mal stan rdol ba dang / ral ba rnams gar bab bab tu 'dor te de dag mi spyod pa dang / de nyid ma rung bar gyur nas de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi mal stan cung zad rdol tam/ ral na ma dor bar rdol na ni lhan pas glon cig ral na ni slar drubasnye par gyis shig /de'i nang na rnyings pa dag ni khol phyung la sar pa glonanecig /de rnying pa las rung ba yod na me mar gyi snying por gyis shig /der yang mi rung na ba glang gi lci ba'am sa dang 13—452

bsres7la ka ba'i ser ga'amanya/ rtsig pa'i ser ga dag gishezhal zhal du gyis shigadu /sbyin par byed pa dang / yon bdag gisayun ring du spyadakyipar 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa'o// //mdor na/ kha zas de ste me mar dang / /byug par bya dang lham rnams dang / /gos dang gdugs dang shingasnyedag dang / /rtsa ba smanashernams tha ma 'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs sonya/ /mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig 'dug ste/ des yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs te 'khor mang po'i dge slong dag cig la phul lo/ /de 'khor drug bcu dang der dbyar tshul du zhugs so/ /tshul nas byung nes lhan cig spyod pa dang / nye gnas dag ljongs dang / phyogs gang dang gang du 'khod pa de dang de dag nas de'i rkang pa la phyag bya bar lhags nas/ de dag gis de'i rkang pa la phyag byas te dong ba dang / des tshe dang ldan pa rnams nga khyim bdag 'di zhes bya bas mgron du bos kyis khyed 'di nyid du 'khod cig ces smras pa dang / de dag gis smras pa mkhan po mchi'o/ /des smras pa/ 'o na 'khod de zan zo la deng shig /de dag gis smras pa/ zas dang yo byad khyer te mchis la/ de nyid bdag cag 'tshal lo/ /des 'o na legs kyis de bzhin du byos shig ces smras pa dang / zas dang yo byad dag khyer te dong ngos/ /de bzhin du kha cig gis me mar gyi mar/ kha cig gis ni rkang pa byug pa/ kha cig gis ni lham dag /kha cig gis ni gos dag /kha cig gis ni gdugs dag /13—453

kha cig gis ni shing dag /kha cig gis ni rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu'i sman rnams khyer te dong ba dang / ring po ma lon ①par gtsug lag khang de yo byad kyis brel bar ⑧gyur nas dge slong de khyim bdag gangasnyen ba der song ste phyin pa dang / khyim bdag khyod kyi0yo byad dag ni zad do zhes smras pa dang / 'phags pa de nasnyedage slongakhunyung la yo byad mang du phul na ci'i phyir myur du bas zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis rgyas par smrasalgenas/ des 'phags pa bdag gis ni de na bzhugs pa rnams kyi phyir phul na/ de dag gzhan na gnas la ci'i phyir gzhan du spyod ces nyes pa ngor brjod do/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams yon bdag de 'phya ba ni yus te/ de bas na dge slong dag gis gzhan du gnas shing gzhan gyi khyer ba ma spyod cig /dge slong dag gzhan du gnas la gzhan gyi spyad dang / de dag ji tsam spyad pa thams cad rin thang bzhin du phob shig /rkyang pa'i sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa'o// sku //mdor na/ mtshan ma dang yang mngon mtshan dang / /par tang dag dang ri mo can⑩/ /khri 'u rkang pa ri mo can/ /ral tshems bya ba dbyar mo khang / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan du yod pa na mi spun gnyis shig rab tu byung ste/ de las gcig ni zhal ta'i gnas khang na 'dug go/ /gcig ni dze ta'i tshal na'o/ /ji tsam na zhal ta ba de don zhig 13—454

gi phyir ri brags kyi7grong du song ngo / /dge slong de phu nu bo blta ba'i phyirashebago ba de bgos nas de'i thad du song ngo / /des dge 'dun gyi bgo ba'i⑧nang du gang zag gi bgo ba de bzhag nas gtam 'dzer cing 'khod do/ /de nas nor te dge 'dun gyi bgo ba zhig gyon te song ngo / /de nas zhal ta ba de slar 'ongs nas de na bgo ba chung ngu zhig mthong steX/ des tshe dang ldan pa ci dge 'dun gyis rnyed pa grub pa'am zhes smras pa dang / des smras pa/ dge 'dun gyikhurnyed pa cang med do/ /bgo ba 'di su'i 'di dgashedage 'dun gyi'o/ /des smras pa/ nged cag⑧ni che/ 'di chung na/ 'dir su yang bgo ba gyon te ma 'ongs sam/ 'dir bdag gi phu nu bo zhig 'ongs so/ /song la dris shig de song nas dris te des bltas na hudage 'dun gyi yin nas/ des smras pa/bdag gis 8nor te dge 'dun gyi ni bdag gis khyer/ bdag gi ④ni de na 'dug pa'i rigs so/ /des de khyer de 'ongs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi ni mtshan ma thob shig /dge slong dag gis ji ltar mtshan ma gdab pa mi shes nas0bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong 'di zhes bya bas phul ba'o zhes yi ger bris shig /dge slong gis dge 'dun gyi dang / gang zag gi gnyi ga de bzhin du bris so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang zag gi ni mngon mtshan thob shig/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyi'am/ gang zag gi yang rung ste/ ri mo can ni gding ba med kyi bar du 13—455

ma spyod cig ces bka' stsal pa①/ dge slong dag gang zag gi par tang stan byedakupa la zhugs pa dang / de'i nang nas kha cig gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ni7ri mo can las0rnyed pa ni gnang gis/ bdag nyid kyis byas pa0ni ma yin no zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan zhig gis yang byas pa'i dngos po spongs shig ces smras pa dang / de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bas na dge 'dun gyi ni par tang ri mo can rnyed dam byas na yang rung ngo / /gang zag gis ni gzhan gyis byin na yon bdag nyid la bsngosasnyen 'chang bar gnangashegi/ rang byed du ni mi gnang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun la ni par tang ri mo can rnyed pa'am/ byas pa'ang 'chang du gnang gi/ gang zag la ni gzhan gyis byin pa de nyid la bsngos na 'chang du gnang ngo zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong gzhan zhig gis khri'u rkang pa ri mo can zhig bdaganyegis ni ma byas gzhan gyis byin pa 'chang ngo / /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis7bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas ri mo can ni dgongs te gsungs kyi/ khri'u rkang pa ri mo can la ma yin gyisa.i/ de bas na dge 'dun gyis khri'u rkang pa ri mo can rnyed dam byas kyang rung gnang gi/ gang zag la ni rjes su mi gnang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong ma dbyar tshul nas byung nas ljongs rgyu ba spyod cigasnyeces gsungs pa dang / dbyar tshul du zhugs nas khang pa'i ral tshems dag ma byas par dong nas de dag gis ral tshems ma byas pas ma rung bar gyur to//de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom 13—456

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong ma dbyar tshul du zhugs na ral tshemasanyem byas nasa'adas pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgosabazhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa'o// //mdoraphun/ song nas slar 'ongs7sbyin pa med/ /byinakhunas phyir yang 'ongs par gyuralpi/ /dge 'dun gyis kyang sbyin par bya/ /gang las bskyis par gyur pa 'o⑧/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'ishedze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim pa zhig gis gnyen zhig dus 'das te mchod pa'i phyir rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyis drangs nas dur khrod du bskyal te/ de slar0khyer te 'ongs nas/ dge slong dag la phul ba dang / dge slong dag gis ma blangs so/ /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ song na slar 'ongs pa zhes byos la long shig /kha cig ni dbul te phul ba de slar yang brnyas pa dang / dge slong dag gis ma ster to//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste slar slong na byin cig /des brnyas nas de slar 'gyod pa skyes nas mi des slar yang phul ba dang / dge slong dag gis ma blangs te/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de nas slar yang 'ongs so zhes byos te long shig /de la the tshom dang khro bar ma byed cig/gleng gzhi 0ni mnyan chadu yod pa na ste/ zhal ta byed pa'i dge slong zhig gis dge 'dun blagyi phyir khyim pa zhig la 0nor zhig bskyis pa dang / de dus 13—457

las 'das so/ zhade dus lasakhu'adas so zhes thos nas des gtsugashelag khang du 'ongs nas dris pa/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba zhig ga re zhes smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis smras pa/ de dus las 'das so/ /des smras pa/'phags pa bdag gi nor zhig desasrebaskyis so/ /dge slong dag gis smras pa/song la de nyid la dosasnyishig /des dge 'dun gyi phyir khyer gyi pha ma dang bdag gi7phyir ma lags kyisarkyukhyed kyis stsol cig /de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ste dge 'dun gyi phyir des khyer bar shes na⑨/ dge 'dun gyis skyin pa byin cig /dge slong rnams ngas las gsar du byed pa'i mtshungs pa'i dge slong gi chos bca'o/ /las gsar du byed pa'i dge slong gis bskyi ba dag rgan zhing rgan pa dag la dris la long 0shig /las gsar du byed pa 8rnams kyis mtshungs par spyad pa'i chos bcas pa bzhin du ma byas na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /rkyang pa'i sgo bzhi pa'i mdo'i tshigs su bcad pa drug pa'o// //mdor na/ bu ram shing dang dge slong rnams/ /za zhing bgo ba phan gdags pa/ /mi bgo ba dang bzhi pa dang / /skar ma bstan par mi bya 'o⑩/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na ⑩ma ta'i tshal mgon 8med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge 'dun dag gis bca' ba bu ram shing zhig0rnyed de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge tshul pha dag la sum cha byin cig ces bka' stsal nas/ de dag la bu ram shing gi sum cha re re byin 13—458

nol/ /dge slonganyedag rganakhurims su 'khod nas gral nyisanyerim du gyur pas/slar yang rgan rims kyi thog tu 'ongs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sgra can 'dzin bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste/ de bu ram shing gi dum bu za zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du mig lta zhid 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sgra can⑧'dzin bu ram shing 'dod dam/des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi7sku skal las bcad de dum bu gcigatsode la byin nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams bu ram shing gi bya ba byas te/ gtsug tsolag khang du 'ongs pa dang ⑫/8tshe dang ldan pa sgra can 'dzin bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du 'ongs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sgra can7'dzin bu ram shing gi bza' bas tshim par gyur tam/ desalgegasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag gi spernyed pa ni sum cha cig 6)stsol cig ces bka' stsal pas ga la tshim mod kyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' dustsal pa des na gdod 0tshim par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun dag bsdusalge nas dge slong dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal pa / ngas gos kyi thob pa ni dge tshul pha dag sum cha cig byin cig ces byas kyi(nye/ kha zas kyi 'thob ⑥pa dag ni mtshungs par bgos nye shig /chung ngu na shing bu la sa'i lo5)ma tsam yang mnyam par bgos5nyeshig /de las che chung ngu bgos na 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ④ni mnyan du yod pa na ste/ mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag gnas pa de dus dus sumanyam ta'i tshal5)du 'gro ba las dge slong zhig gis de la 13—459

nor las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi dngos po bdun rgya cher snyananyepar bshad pa dang / de dad pa skyes nas gtsug lag khang zhig brtsigs7te/ der dge slong gang dag gnas pa de dag kha zas 'phral 'phral du sbyorashebar byed pa las des de dag gis/ kha zas kyi rgyur kār 6khupa ṇa dag cig byin pa las/ de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa bdag cag bsod snyoms la 'gro bas chos gos kyis brel gyi zas kyis ni ma yin gyisal/ kār ṣā pa ṇa ni chos gos kyisaphyir bgo'o/ /⑨dge slong bdag cag las su yang khyim bdag de'i khyim du ma 'dong shig ces de dag gis dam bcas so/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na bsod snyoms pa zhig ljongs rgyu ba spyod cing mnyan du yod par phyin te/ de khyim bdag de'i gtsug lag khang du 'ongs nas/ dge slong dag gis de ngal sor bcug ste/ gnas dang mal stan dag byin nas des bsams pa de ring la ngal bso zhing zan yang gral du zos la nang par ()nas bsod snyoms bslang5)ngo snyam du sems shing 'dug pa las/dge slong gzhi na 'khod pa dag lhung bzed dang chos gos khyer te bsod snyoms la dong ba dang / bsod snyoms pa des bsams pa/ gzhi na gnas pa'i dge slong dag ni de ltar phongs pa lta na/ bdag kyang de 'dra bar 'gyur gyis bsod snyoms slong du 'gro'o snyam nas/ des lhung bzed dang chos gos dang lde mig dang / lde mig kyog po dang 9 sgo lcags kyang khyer nas mnyan du yod par rim gyis ⑥bsod snyoms la zhugs pa las khyim bdag de'i khyim du 'ongs nas/ des de la bde bar phyin tam zhes tshig tu smras/ stan bting / rkang pa la phyag byas nas de'i mdun du 'dug go/ /de de'i mdun du 'dug nas des de la nor las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi dngos po bdun du yon tan bshad 13—460

pa dang / khyim bdag des smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis de thams cad bsgrubs lags so/ /bsod snyoms pas smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis cung zad kyang sbyar ba med de/ khyod kyishegatsug lag khang na thog mar kha zas med dzo/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa ci gsung / brdeg gis der mang du phul na/'phags pas gzhan zhig tu byon te nor ba snyamanya/ bsod snyoms pa des smras pa/khyim bdag khyod kyis ④gtsug lag khang gi lde mig dang lde mig kyog po dag shes sam/ 'phags pa 'tshal lo/ /des lde mig dang lde mig kyog po dag bstan pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pasasnyide'i don glo bar chud do zhes smras pa dang / bsod snyoms pas de khyer nas slar song ngo / /khyim bdag kyang de'i phyi bzhin du song ste gtsug lag khang du 'dug nas ji tsam dge slong dudag bsod snyoms khyer te 'ong ba mthong ste mthong nas des 'phags pa khyed cag ⑦gang nas byon ces smras pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag spyod yul gyisadad pa bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa kār ṣā pa ṇa gar mchis/ khyim bdag gnas khang na yod do snoms te spyon/ de dag gis phyung ste byin no/ /des smras pa/ da spyod yul gyi dad pa skyed du bzhud cig /de dag gis ma spobs nas/ cang mi zer bar 'dug nasatso/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag khyim bdag de 'phya ba ni yus te/ de bas na rnam pa bzhis ni ma bgo shig /de ni mchod rten thams cad kyi dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi dang / nad gsos ⑩kyi rin thams cad dang ⑥/ zas nar ma thams cad do//13—461
