legs par gding bar bya①/ de nas dus su bsgo'am/ gaṇḍi brdungs kyang rungakhuste/ lag pa g.yon pas ni mkhan po'i lag bsnyenas bzung / lag pa g.yas pas ni mar me thogs te mkhan po mdun du byas la gso sbyin gyi0gnas su 'dong bar bya'o/ zhaso sor thar pa'i mdo bklags zin na0mkhan po'i drung du song la/ mkhan po ci gshegs sam/ chos gsan cing bzhugs zhes dri bar bya/de ste 'gro na lag pa g.yon pas mkhan po gzung ⑦/ lag pa g.yas par ⑧ni mar me thogs te mkhan po mdun du byas la gtsug lag khang du 'dong bar bya'o/ /de ste dugs khang du khrus byed pa zhig tu gyur na nang par sngar langs nasalgemakhan po deng dugs khang du khrus mdzad kyis char gsol zhes bsgo bar bya/ lhan cig spyod pas mkhan po'i phyir dugs khang du 0stan dang 8khri'u dang / ril ba spyi rings dang / khrus ras dang dugs khang gi yo byad gzhan gang yang rung ste khyer te mkhan po mdun du byas nas dugs khang du 'dong bar bya/ 'ongs nas kyang chos gos phyogs gcig tu bzhag la mkhan po las mi nye mi ring bar 'dug par bya/ nam mkhan po rngul bar gyur na de na lhan cig spyod pa des de la rim bzhin rjes su las rnams bya ste bkru bar bya'o/ /bkrus nas mdun du bcug ste/gtsug lag khang du bskyal bar bya/ de'i 'og tu bdag nyid bkru bar bya/ de ste lhan cig spyod pa de mkhan po'i drung nas dge ba'i chos mi 'phel bar gyur na mkhan po la bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di la gtad du gsol zhes smos shig /mkhan pos kyang dge slong de la dge slong 'di ci 'dra/ 0de'i rjes su 'brang ba dang drung na 'dug pa ci 'dra/ 'di'i lung rnams ston tam/de ste mi ston/ rjes su ston tam/ de ste mi ston pa brtag par bya/ dpyad 13—714

par bya/ de bzhin du brtagasashedapyad nas de ste rung ba zhig tu gyur na/ de la gtad par bya/ de ste rung ba ma yin na gzhan la gtad par bya'o/ /de ste mkhan po nyid rung ba ma yin la tshul dang mi ldan na ma zhus par song yang bla ste/'di ni lhan cig spyod pa'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /slob dpon gyi bya ba gang zhe na/slob dpon gyis nye g.yog⑧rnams shes par bya ba nas snga ma bzhin te/ phyogs gang na nye g.yog de nyon mongs shing 'dug pa zhig tu gyur na phyogs de nas dgug par bya/ dgugasatu gzhug par bya ste/ 'di ni slob dpon gyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /nye g.yog gi bya ba gang zhe na/ nye g.yog gis slob dpon la ston pa'o snyam du 'du shes mngon du bzhag la rim gro bya ba nas/ snga ma bzhin ma zhus kyang 'gro bar bya ba'i bar du ste/ de ni nye g.yog gi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /dge tshul gyi bya ba gang zhe na/ dge tshul gyis mkhan po dang slob dpon la ston pa'o snyam du 'du shes mngon du bzhag la rim gro bya ba nas snga ma bzhin no/ /de ste mkhan po'am/slob dpon sdig pa ⑤lta bar gyur na rang gis slar gtang bar bya/ yang na gtong du 'jug0par bya ste/ de ltar spro ba skyes na ni de bzhin legs/ ma skyesakun 'das pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /der yang dge tshul phas ji ltar mkhan po dang / slob dpon la byung zhing gyur pa'i rnams ji ltar gyis shig ces spro ba bskyed par bya ba de bzhin du mkhan po dang / slob dpon gyis kyang dge tshul pha la byung zhing gyur pa'i rnams ji ltar bya zhes spro'ub bskyed par bya'o/ /de la zhu ba rnams ni ma gtogs so/ /dge tshul pas mkhan po dang / slob dpon gyi stan gding ba la sogs pa bya ba snga ma bzhin te bdag nyid tha mar bkru bar bya ba'i bar du'o/ /'di ltar dge tshul phas rtswa sngon po med par bya/ me tog 13—715

rnams btog /'bras bu rnams btog /so shing rnams sbyin/ lhung bzed kyi gzhi lo ma rnams sbyin/ rung bar bya①/ dge slong rnams la byin len⑧du gzhug par bya/ mdzes pa dang / bag yod par bsgrub par bya/ de ste dge tshul pha de mkhan po dang slob dpon gyi drung nas dge ba'i chos 'phel bar mi 'gyur ba nas/ snga ma bzhin ma zhus kyang song yang blakhuba'ikhubar du ste/ 'di ni dge tshul pha'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /nan tan du bya ba gang zhe na/ de ste dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra b.rasnyiganod pa zhig byung na der dge slong gis ji ltar de mi shor zhing zin par bya/ de ste rnam grangs gang gis kyang zin par ma gyur na gzhan dag la ni bab bab tu smra bar mi bya'i⑧/ thog mar rgyal po'i gnang ba rnams la bsgo bar bya0/ de'i 'og tu btsun mo dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / ded dpon dang / zhang blon dang / zhabs 'bring ba rnams la bsgo bar bya/ de la nan tan du bya ba ni ji 8nas tshig gis bstan pa tsam gyis thar bar 'gyur gyis de la gsang ba'i las rnams mi 'byung bar bya ste/ de ni nan tan du bya ba zhes bya'o/ /phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong gi bya ba gang zhe na/ phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong gis snga na mo'i dge sbyong las ring nas kyang ma yin/ shin tu bsnyen de yang ma yin/ phrag pa sbyar zhing yang mi 'gro bar bya/ khyim gyi nang du 'jug na yang gtam glo bur du de la mi bya/ phyi nas smra bar bya/ des bsgo ba rnams bya/ bkur ster bya8/ bdag dman par byasa'ajigs pa dang dbang du 'gyur bar bya/ dge sbyong snga na po chos ma yin pa zhig smra na slar dgag par bya/ chos bzhin du smra na rjes su yi rang bar bya/ de la chos bzhin pa'i rnyed pa zhig byung na blang bar bya ste 'di ni phyi bzhin 'brang 13—716

ba'i dge sbyong gi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /grong du nye bar 'gro ba'i bya ba gang zhe na/rigs su ston pa'i dge slong gis dregs par mi bya/ nga rgyal mi bskyed/ mi brtan par mi bya/ byung rgyal du mi smra/ mi gtsigs7par mi bya/ yang dag par shes par bya/ nye bar gzhag par bya/ sems mi g.yeng bar bya/ dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / spyod lam mdzes par bya/ shin tu bsdamasapa dang /shin tu bkab pa dang / sgra chung ba dang / mig gnya' shing gang tsam las mi g.yeng bar bya/ bkur ster rgyabacas/ bdag nyid dman par bcas/'jigs pa dang / dbang du 'gyur bar bcas/ yid dman pa dang /sems phyags ma dang 'dra bar bya/ rnyed pa dang bkur ste la 'dod par mi bya/phan par byed pa de ni grong du 'gro bar byed pa'isabya ba zhes bya'o/ /grong dushe'agro ba'i0bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong grong du 'gror 'dod na shes bzhin du 'gro bar bya/ dran pa nye bar gzhag par bya/ sems mi g.yeng bar bya/dbang po bsdam par bya/ yid mi g.yeng bar bya/ snga phyi la 'du shes pa dang /bla 'og la 'du shes gzhag /dge slong dran pa nyams bzhin du grong du 'gro na nyes pa'i dmigs rnam pa lngar rig par bya ste/ dge slong 'khod pa rnams la ma bsgo bzhin du grong du dusalgem yin par 'jug pa dang / ma brtags par stan la 'dug pa dang / rig pa'i skyes pa med bzhin du bud med la chos tshig lnga'am drug las lhag par ston pa dang / bud med dang lhan cig gnyis su skyabs yod pa dben pa na 'dug par byed pa dang / sman dang nad du bcas pa'i grong du nan gyis stan la 'dug par byed pa'o/ /dge slong dran pa nyams bzhin du grong du 'gro na gzhan yang nyes pa'i dmigs rnam pa lngar rig par bya ste/ phyi phyir 13—717

bud med la blta7ba dang / lta ba las kyang gtam dusa'adzer ba dang / gtam zer ba las chags par gyurasapa dang / chags par gyur pa las tshul bzhin mi byed pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la mi byed pas na ma dad bzhin mi tshangs par spyod par0'gyur te/ nyes pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba'amadzo/ yang na bslab pa phul nas slar babasalgepar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag bzhin du grong gi nang du 'jug na nyes pa'i dmigs de lta bu 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ de ni grong du 'gro ba'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /grong du nye bar song ba'i bya ba gang zhe na/grong du song ba'i dge slong gis gtam sna tshogs mi smra/ gtam ngan pa mi bya/chos kyi gtam smra bar bya/ gtam rgyud mi chad par bya/ khyim pa'i7rnams la chos kyi gtam yang dag par bstan8/ bstabs/ yang dag par gzengs bstod par bya/ rab tu mgu bar bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab pa'i gnas 'dzin du gzhug /dus khrims la gnas pa dang / tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa dang / sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang / sdom pa dang / skyes bu dam pa bsnyen pa'i chos nyan pa dang/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa dang / chos dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos la nan tan du byed pa dang / lam ma yin pa la lam ma yin par de ltar yang dag par bsgrag par bya/ ye shes dang lta ba rnam par sbyang bar bya ste/ de ni grong du nye bar song ba'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /grong du nye bar song ba'i gnas brtan gyi bya ba gang zhe na/ grong du song ba'i dge slong gnas brtan gyis de na dge slong gsar bu rnams la bsgo bar bya/ rjes su bstan par bya/ ci0rgyags pa dang / dregs pa dang / lus la 'tshog pa dang / rtsed mo mi byed par bya/ dga' bar 'gyur ba la gzhug par byas/ ji 13—718

ltar mtshungs par spyod pa bcas pa la gzhug par bya/ de dag gis kyang des ji ltar bsgo ba dang / rjes su bstan pa'i tshig rnams la mnyan par bya ste/ de7grong du song ba'i gnas brtan gyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhi na gnas pa'i bya ba gang zhe na/ gzhi na gnas pa'i dge slong gis mdangs bzang ba dang / khro gnyer dang bral bar byargya/ dran pa thog mar 'gro ba dang / thog mar smra bar bya ste/tshur spyon bde bar byon namakhuzhes tshig snyan pa dang / tshig yid du 'ong ba dang /mgu bar 'gyur bas smra bar bya/ glo bur du lhags pa'i dge slong dag mthong nasalgemadza' ba'i tshul gyis mdun du bsu bar bya/ snyan pa'i tshig gis rab tu dga' bar bya/ bde ba la reg par spyodakyidam/ bde bar lhags sam zhes dri bar bya/ de ste rgan pa zhig yin na ni de la phyag byas nas lhung bzed dang chos gos blangs te gtsug lag khang gi nang du bcug la stan la ⑦gzhag par bya/rkangasapa bkru zhing bla mar bya/ skom na chu grang mo blud par bya/ ji ltar nus shing mgu bar 'gyur ba'i chos bzhin bsgyur bar bya/ ji ltar rigs pa bzhin mal stan rnarmes kyang sbyin par bya/ ji srid du 'dug pa de la pha dang / phu nu dang / bu ltar 'du shes mngon du gzhag cing gzung bar bya'o/ /na na yang g.yel bar mi dor te⑩/ de ni gzhi na gnas pa'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /ngal bso ba'i bya ba gang zhe na/ glo bur du 'ongs pa'i dge slong gis gtsug lag khang du 'ongs na des gzhi na gnas pa'i dge slong dag 0las mal stan gyi tsornams brkam zhing rings thabs su dgug par mi bya/ snang ba'i gnas su 'dug par bya/ spyod lam bzang bar bya/ legs par bgo bar bya/ legs par bsdam par bya'o/ /'di yang ngal bso ba'i bya ba yin te/ gzhi na gnas pa'i dge 13—719

slong dag gis dge slong glo bur du lhags7pa mthong na de ste ngo shes na ngal bso bar bya/ ji ltar mtshungs par spyod pa'i chos bcas pa bzhin du mtshungs par spyad par bya/ de ste ngo mi shes na bab bab tu ngal bso bar mi bya/ dge slong dag la yang tshe dang ldan pa 'di su'i lhan cig spyod pa yin/ 'disaspyod pa ji ltasabu zhes dri bar bya'o/ /de ste de'i spyod pa dang / spyod yul dang / tshul khrims dang / sdom pa dang / mtshungs par spyod pa'i0rnams rtogs na gdodaphungal bso bar bya'o/ /de gcig pu la gtsug lag khang gtad par mi bya/ dge 'dun gyi mdzod dang / bang ba dang kha dge 'dun gyi mal la dbang du gzhug par mi bya/ shin tu rtogs par byas la gdod yid gcugs par bya ba de ni ngal bso ba'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /bar snang gi bya ba gang zhe na/ bar snang thams cad ni mtshams gcig pa ma yin te/ der gnas pa dang / 'di na gnas pa lhan cig tu las bya zhing bskyo ba yang mi brtsan⑧/ 'di na gnas pa dang de na gnas pa dag lhan cig tu las byas par mi 'gyur/ bskyos pa7yang mi brtsan no/ /dge slong skya rengs ma shar bar chos gos med bzhin du steng du mi 'byung / dbyar tshul du zhugs na yang zhag bdun nam/ zhag bzhi bcur byin gyis ma brlabs par nam mkha' la byung zhing gnas par mi bya'o/ /de ste byung zhing gnas na chos gos dang bral bar 'gyur la dbyar kyang zhig par 'gyur te/ 'di ni bar snang gi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /gtan pa'i bya ba gang zhe na/gtan pa la yon tan lnga ste/ zhag gcig gis bral ba med/ zhag bcu'i 'da' ba med/ zla ba gcig gis 'da' ba med/ ji snyed du dgos pa'i gos rnams byin gyis ma brlabs 8kyang 'chang du rung / stod g.yogs dang 13—720

mthang gos kyis ljongs rgyu bar rung ngo / /gzhan yang gtan pa la yon tan rnam pa lnga ste/ 'dus shing za ba med/ yang yang za ba med/ phyi ma la mnyebasgo bar 'gro ba med chos gos jikhudagos pa tshol du rung / ston zla tha chungasasnyenas dpyid zla ra ba'i bar du dbyar tshul du zhugs pa'i dge slong dge 'dun gyi rnyedakhupa ma bgos shing bzhag pa de yang rgyagatan pa bting ba rnams kyis ma dad na gzhan la mi sbyin no/ /de ni gtan pa'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /chu tshags kyi bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong chu tshags med na lam du zhugs shing 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /de ste chu rgyun du 'bab la de yang rung bar gyur de duchu gzhan dang ma 'dres pa zhig gam/ khron pa rung ba zhig gam/ rgyang grags phyed phyed du gtsug lag khang rgyun chags par yod pa ma gtogs te0de ni chu tshags kyi byasab zhes bya'o/ /'chag sa'i bya ba gang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'chag sa rnam pa gnyis rjes su gnang ste/ bsam gtan la zhugs pa dang / kha ton la zhugs pa'o/ /bsam gtan la zhugs pa'i 'chag sa ni khru bcarkyubargyad do/ /kha ton la zhugs pa'i 'chag sa ni khru bcu gnyis te de ni 'chag sa'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /'chag pa'i bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong 'chag par 'dod na des drag tu yang ma yin/dal nas 'chag par bya/ shes bzhin du 'chag par bya/ dran pa nye bar gzhag /dbang po nang du gzhag /yid phyir mi dbyung bar bya/ rdeg mi 'chos par bya/ phan tshun mi 'khyor bar bya/ drang por 'chag par bya/ de ste drang por 'chag mi nus na srad bu bre bar bya/ srad bu bres7pa la spu bu bcug nas de la 'ju zhing 'chag par bya ste/ 'di ni 'chag pa'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /'phyen gyi bya ba gang zhe na/ ston pa'i mdun du mi gtang / mchod rten gyi 13—721

drung du ma yin/ mkhan po dang slob dpon gyi drung du ma yin/ bla ma'i drung du ma yin/ bla mar bya ba'i drung du ma yin/ grong gi nang du skye bo'i mdun du ma yinas phyi phyir gtang bar mi bya/ de ste yang phyi phyir gtongakhub zhig tu gyur na gnas gud du song la gtang bar bya'i/ de'i rkyen gyis gzhan la mi bde bar 'gyur bar mi bya ste/ 'di ni 'phyenakhugyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhar ba'i bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gzharasnyi'adod na rno ba'i yo byad kyis gzhar0bar mi bya/rtswa bsdus pas mi bya/ lo ma'am/ ra da'am/ 'jam pa gzhan gyis gzharasnyebar bya ste/ de ni gzhar ba'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /bshang ba'i bya ba gang zhe na/dge slong gis bab bab tu bshang bar mi bya/ rtsig pa'i drung du ma yin/ shing gi drung du ma yin/ shes bzhin du phyogs gcig tu bshang bar bya'o/ /de ste phyi phyir bshang ba zhig tu gyur na bshang ba'i gyo mo drung du gzhag par bya/ yang na khung bu brko bar bya ste/ 'di ni bshang ba'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /bshang sa'i bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong bshang sar 'gro bar 'dod pas snga na 'dug pas tshor bar bya ba'i phyir se gol gtogs par bya/ sngon du zhugs pas lud pa dbyung bar bya/ shes bzhin du nang du 'gro bar bya/ chos gos legs par brdzes nas 'dug par bya/ bshang sa'i khung bur rkang rten gnyis la legs par brtags nas dbus su 'dug par bya/ bshang ba mi 'ong ba la nan gyis gzir bar mi bya/ 'ong ba la'ang dgag par mi bya ste/ de ni bshang sa'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /bshang sa'i khung bu'i bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong bshang bar 'dod na dal nas bags kyis shes bzhin du bshang bar bya/ bshang sa'i khung kha rnams susnyigos shing chags par mi bya ste/ 'di ni bshang sa'i khung bu'i bya ba zhes bya'o//13—722

bshang sar gnas brtan gyi bya ba gang zhe na/ bshang tshar dge slong gnas brtan gyis gsar bu 'dug pa slar bslang bar mi bya/ bshang sar 'dug pa las slar bslang bar mi byatub ni chung dukhubashang sa'i nang du zhugs pa las slar bzlogashepar mi bya ste/ de ni bshang sar gnas brtan gyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /bshang sa'i khor yug gi bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong bshang sa'i nye 'khor na 'greng bar mi bya/ 'dug par mi bya/ 'chag par mi bya/ lung bsgokebar mi bya/ lung nod par mi bya/ dran par mi bya/ slar 'dri bar mi bya/ rnal 'byor dang yid la byed pa mi bya/ gtam la zhugs shing mi bya/ lhung bzed kyi las mi⑧bya/chos gos kyi las mi bya/ so shing 'cha' bar mi bya/ lag pa dang rkang pa bkru bar mi bya/ bya'o cogashethams cad kyang bshang sa'i phyogs kun tu mi bya'o/ /bshang sa'i gnas su nges par bya ba'i rnams ni ma gtogs te/ 'di ni bshang sa'i nye 'khor gyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /gci ba'i bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gis bab bab tu gci bar mi bya/ rtsig drung du gci bar mi bya/ shing drung du gci bar mi bya/ shes bzhin du phyogs gcig tu gci bar bya'o/ /de ste gcin snyi bar gyur na gcin snod gyo mo gtad par bya/ yang na khung bu bsko bar bya ste/'di ni gci ba'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /gci ba'i sa'i bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gci byasar 'jug par 'dod na des snga na 'dug pas tshor bar bya ba'i phyir se gol gtogs nas snga ma bzhin te/ mi bro ba la ni mi gzir0/ bro ba la ni mi dgag pa'i bar du ste/ 'di ni gci ba'i sa'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /gci ba'i khung gi bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gis gci sa'i khung khar bags kyis shes bzhin du gci bar bya/ gcin khung gi khar mi gtor ba dang / mi stes par bya ste/13—723

de ni gci sa'i7bya ba zhes bya'o/ /gcisasar gnas brtan gyi bya ba gang zhe na/gci dusar dge slong gnas brtan gyis gci sar dge slong gsar bu gci zhing 'dug pa bslang bar mi bya/ gci sar 'dug pa las mi bslang bar bya ba ni chung ngu na gci sar zhugs pa yang bzlog par mi bya ste/ 'di ni gci sar gnas brtanakhugyi bya ba zhes bya ba'o⑤/ /gci sa'i nye 'khor gyi bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gci sa'i nye 'khor du 'greng bar mi bya ba nas snga ma bzhin te/ gci ba'i nye 'khor gyi bya ba ni ma gtogs so zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de ni gci ba'ikyisa'i nye 'khor gyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /bkru ba'i bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gis ma bkrus kyi bar du ston pa la ltar0'gro bar mi bya/ mchod rten la ma yin/mkhan po dang / slob dpon la ma yin/ bla ma la ma yin/ bla mar bya ba la ma yin te/ phyag mi bya/ kha ton mi bya/ lung mi bsgo/ blang bar mi bya/ dran par mi bya/ kun dri bar mi bya/ grong du 'jug par mi bya/ zas la 'dug spror mi bya/ skyo ma la 'dug par mi bya/ thug pa la 'dug par mi bya/ 'thungasheb la 'dug par mi bya/ chos bshad pa la 'dug par mi bya/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi mal stan la 'dug par mi bya/ na bar gyur na ni nyes pa med de/yang na mi'i lha chu yin par gyur tam/ de ste chu ma 'byor tarkya/ de ste bkru bar mi rung ba'i sman cig btang ba ni ma gtogs te/ de ni bkru ba'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /bkru ba'i gnas kyi bya ba gang zhe na/ bkru ba'i gnas su 'gro ba'i dge slong gis se gol gtogs nas snga ma bzhin bkru ba'i gnas kyisnyedabus su 'dug par bya ba'i bar du ste/ 'di ni bkru ba'i gnas kyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /bkru ba'i gnas su rkang pa bzhag pa'i gnas kyi bya ba gang zhe na/ khrus byed par 13—724

'dod pa'i dge slong gis bkru ba'i tshe bkru ba'i gnas su kha chus mi dgang ba dang / chus ma gsher bar bya ste/ 'di ni bkru ba'i gnas kyi rkang pa bzhag pa'i gnas kyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /khrus kyi sar gnas brtan gyi bya ba gang zhe na/ khrus sarashedage slong gnas brtan gyis khrus sar dge slong gsar bu bslang bar mi bya/ khrus la zhugs pa las mi bslang ba ni chung ngu na khrus sar zhugs pa lasashebazlog par mi bya ste/ de ni khrus sar gnas brtan gyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /khrus sa'i nye 'khor gyi bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gis khrus sa'i nye 'khor du 'greng zhing 'dug par mi bya ba nas snga ma bzhin khrus sa'i nye 'khor du bya ba'i⑧rnams ni ma gtogs pa'i bar du ste/ de ni khrus sa'i nye 'khor gyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /mchil ma'i bya ba gang zhe na/ de ni0dge slong gis sgra dang bcas par mchil ma dor bar mi bya/ lce dril bar sos mnan par mi bya/ ston pa'i spyan sngar ma yin/ mchod rten gyi drung du ma yin/ mkhan po dang / slob dpon gyi drung du ma yin/ bla ma'i drung du ma yin/ bla mar gyur pa'i drung du ma yin/ zan za ba na ma yin/ 'thung ba la ma yin/ yongs su las bya ba'i sar ma yin/dge slong gis bab bab tu mchil ma dor bar mi bya/ mchil ma borasnyenas phyal bar mi bya ste/ yang na rkang pas nyes shig /yang na sas khob shig /dge slong gis mchil ma phyi phyir dor bar mi bya'o/ /de ste phyi phyir 'dor na de'i rkyen gyis gzhan mi bde bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir gnas gzhan du 'gro bar bya ste/ de ni mchil ma'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /mchil ma'i snod kyi bya ba gang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la mchil ma dor ba'i phyir mchil ma'i snod rnam pa gnyis gnang ste/ rdza mkhan gyis byas pa dang / bdag nyid kyis byas pa'o⑩/ /13—725

dge slong gisatumachil ma'i snod dusakhudus su brtag par bya/ bskam par bya/dben par gzhag par bya/ shin tu bkru bar bya/ ci nas de'i rkyen gyis phyi phyir tshol bar mi 'gyur bar bya ste/ de ni mchil ma'i snod kyi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /so shing gi bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gis so shing ring po bca' bar mi bya/shin tu thung ba'ang masayin/ shin tu sbom pa yang ma yin/ shin tu phra ba yang ma yin/ yun ring du yang ma yin/ ston pa'i spyan sngar ma yin/ mchod rten gyi drung du yang ma yin/ mkhan po dang / slob dpon gyi thad du yang ma yin/bla ma'i thad du yang ma yin/ bla mar gyur pa'i drung du0ma yin/ me khang du ma yin/ bkad sar ma yin/ 'chag sar ma yin/ dugs —khang du ma yin/rkang pa bkru ba'i sar ma yin/ gnas khang du ma yin/ rimasakhang du ma yin/sgo khang du ma yin/ bshang sar ma yinadu/ rtsig pa'i drung du ma yin/ shing drung ⑦du ma yin/ gtsug lag khang gi phyag dar bya ba'i khor niyug tu ma yin/skye bo mang po 'du ba thams cad du yang so shing 'dor bar mi bya/ dge slong gis rnam pa gsum dben par bya ste/ bshang ba dang / gci ba dang / so shing bca' ba'o/ /dge slong gis so shing 'chos nas/ de bzhin du mi dor gyi chus bkru bar bya/ yang na rdog pas mnye bar bya/ sa la drud par byas te⑩/ 'di ni so shing gi bya ba zhes bya'o/ /so drud pa'i bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gis so shing rnon pos drud par mi bya/ bag med par nang du gzhug par mi bya/ dal nas bags kyis shes bzhin du drud par bya/ so rnyil drud par mi bya ste/ 'di ni so drud pa'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /lce bzhar ba'i bya ba gang zhe na/dge slong gis lce bzhar ba rnon pos bzhar bar mi bya/ bag med par nang du 13—726

gzhug par mi bya/ bags kyis dal nas shes bzhin du lce bzhar bar bya/ lce'i sha bzhar bar mi bya ste/ 'di ni lce bzhar ba'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /rna spabasaXbru ba'i bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong gis rtse mo rnon pos rna spabs bru bar mi bya/bag med par nang du gzhug par mi bya/ bags kyis dal nas shes bzhin du rna spabs bru bar bya/ rna ba'i sha bru bar mi bya ste/ 'di ni rna spabs bru ba'i bya ba zhes bya'o/ /kun spyad pa gang zhe na/ dge sbyong gi yo byad thams cad mtshungs par spyod pa ni spyad pa'o/ /mi spyad pa gang zhe na/ de ltarakhubazlog pa ni mi spyad pa'o/ /ma lta bu'i bya ba'i phung po zhes bya ba'isriphung po gsum pa rdzogs te/ ma lta bu rdzogs so// // btsun pa 'dul ba'i lus gang lags/ dmigs pa gang lags/ byin gyis brlabs pa gang lags/ mtshan nyid gang lags/ gleng gzhi gang lags/ngo bo nyid gang lags/ 'bras bu gang lags/ u pā li 'dul ba'i lus ni dmigs pa'o/ /dmigs pa ni nan tan no/ /byin gyis brlab pa ni lus dang ngag dang yid do/ /mtshan0nyid ni las so/ /gleng gzhi ni bsgrags pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid ni nyes0pa'o/ /'bras bu ni mtho ris dang thar pa'o/ /'dul ba gzhung dam pa rdzogs te/ u pā lis kun dris pa rdzogs sos// // zothams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dul ba gzhung ni dam pa 'di//'phags pa nye ba 'khor gyis ni/ /ma 'ongs pa yi gang zag gi/ /ma rtogs la sogs bsal ba'i phyir/ /gzhi dang rnam 'byed la sogs kyi/ /'grel bshad nges pa don gyi lung / /zhus nas rgyal bas bka' stsal to/ /de dag rnams kyang 13—727

gang zhe na/ /spyi'i sdom la/ zhu ba 'dul byed gcig las 'phros/ /lnga tshan bcu drug tshan dang ni/ /gleng gzhi rkyang pa gtam gyi gzhi/ /ma na pi ka ma mo dang / /lus sogs ston pa tha ma ste/ /le'u dag tu yang dag 'dod/ /thog mar zhus pa de yang ni/ /rnam 'byed nyung ba sde bzhi dang / /rang byungashel sogs gzhi rnams kyi/ /gtan la 'bebs pa dag tu 'dod/ /de nyid dris lan zhes kyang bsgrags/ /de nas 'dul byed dag yin te/ /pham pa bzhi dang lhag ma yi/ /spyanasagyi ltung ba yan chad dag /gtan la 'bebs par byed pa yin/ /de nas gcig las 'phros pa ste/ /gcig nas bcu yi bar du yin/ /gcig las 'dzegs pa zhes kyang bsgrags/ /de nas 'dul ba lnga tshan te/ /lnga lnga ston phyir lnga tshan no/ /bcu drug sde tshan ston pa'i phyir/ /de nas 'dul ba bcu drug tshan/ /gleng gzhi la ni sgosalnga las/ /dang po bzhi la sdom gyi ni/ /tshigs bcad bcu bcu'o lnga pa la/ /sdom gyi tshigs bcad drug yod de/ /gleng gzhi dag la brten pa'i phyir/ /gleng gzhi zhes ni btagasalgepa yin/ /rkyang pa sgo bzhi re re yang / /tshigs bcad bcu bcu'o de nyid la/ /sil bu zhes bya bslab pa'i gzhi/ /rigs mi mthun pa phra mo rnams/ /ston phyir don dang ldan pa yin/ /'dul ba gtam gyi dngos po ni/ /ldebs kyi tshul du byung ba ste/ /sdom gyi tshig gis bsdus pa med/ /mū la zhes pa'i sgra yi don/ /gzhi dang rtsa ba dngos po la'ang / /'jug phyir gtam gyi gzhir yang 'gyur/ /ma na pi ku'i sgo dang po/ /tshigs bcad bcu yin gnyis pa la/ /tshigs bcad bcu dang lhag tsam yod/ /shin tu phra zhibasache bas na/ /bram ze'i bu mo lta bu zhes/ /don dang mthun pa'i mtshan yin no/ /'dul ba ma mo lta bu la/ /bsnyen par rdzogs 13—728

pa'i phung po dang / /rab tu ldan dang bya ba yi/ /phung po gsum du shes par bya//ma dang 'dra phyir ma mo 'o/ /lus dang dmigs pa byin brlab dang / /mtshan nyid gleng gzhi ngo bo dang / /'bras bu'i don rnams tha ma ste/ /u pā li yis zhus pa ni/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs pa yin/ /mtshan gyi grangs kyi rim pa dang / /mtshan gyi bshad pa de yin pas/ /de ltar bsdogs nas blta bar bya/ /de ltar na gzhung dam pa'i brjod bya don gyi lus ni de dag nyid yin la/ rjod byed gzhung gi lus ni zhu ba ma rdzogs pa la 'grel par/ 'phags pa nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa'i gzhung rgya gar yul pa yang 27lo ka nyis stong tsam gyi tshad cig la lan spyod pa kho na'o zhes yul kha cig na zhu ba ma rdzogs pa la shasalo ka nyis stong las med pa'ang bshad mod kyi/ bod du 'gyur ba'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa la shashelo ka sum stong drug brgya ste bam po bcu gnyis dang / zhu ba rdzogs pa la sha0lo ka khri lnga stong dgu brgya ste/ bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum yod pas spyir bsdoms na shasnyilo ka khri dgu stong lnga brgya ste/ bam po drug bcu rtsa lnga yod do// //bsod nams chen po'i dpal gyis phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang mtshungs pa rgyal po chen po'i bla'i mchod gnas bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung lugs mang du thos pa/ rig pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dge ba can/ lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug /gangs can gyi rgyud kyi mkhas pa chen po/ sdom brtson dam pa shākya'i dge slong 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ bka' 'gyur legs par bzhengs pa rnams las 'di dag ni mkhan po chen po mchims kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa zhal bzhugs pa'i dus na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dul ba 'dzin pa zhing mo che ba byang chub 13—729

seng ges gnyer mdzad nas/ lung phran tshegs kyi bam po bcu gnyis ma tshang ba dang / gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bam po bcu gnyis dang / sdom tshig yi ge tshar gnyis ma tshang ba rnams bsam yas mchims phu la sogs pa dbus gtsang gi gtsug lag khang rnams nas btsal te/ la stod 'ol rgod kyi gtsug lag khang du gnas brtan dharmā seng ges lung sde bzhi tshang bar bzhengs pa snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs te/ de la dpe phyi mdzad nas bzhengs pa dang /gzhan yang chu mig ring mo'i gtsug lag khang dang / rung7klung shod grog gi gtsug lag khang gi 'dul ba lung la sogs pa rnams la gtugs te snga zhus legs par bgyis nas bzhengs pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba legs par gsungs pa dam pa'i chos 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'o/ /de'i bka' 'gyur gyi dpe phyi rnam par dag pa rnams/ mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang nas gdan drangs te/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sku chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i nang blon chen po mgar stong btsan yul zungs kyi rgyud pa/ gtsug lag gnyis kyi mdzad pas/ bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs tog la g.yel ba mi mnga' zhing / 'gro ba mang po'i mgon skyabs dam par gyur pa dpal ldan rgyal ba'i sde yis/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i gnas skabs dang / mthar thug gi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas shing / phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ bod khams su smon lam gyi stobs can mnga' bdag lha btsan po byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / lo paṇa skyesalgemachog khyad par can rnams kyi bdag rkyen la brten nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab thog mtha' bar du dge zhing sgro skur gyi 13—730

mtha' dang bral la gzhung lugs ngan pa'i dri mas dben pa mdo sde dang / rgyud sde'i phyogs snga phyir bod du 'gyur ro cog rnams mi'i dbang po tho genyen the mur gyi ring la/ ti shrisakun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bstan pa skyong ba'i dus/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa lnga brgya bdun pa'i mthar nye ba/ 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa gdul bya'i ngor zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ lo sum stong bzhi brgya brgyad bcu 'das pa me mo phag gi lo gsar gyi zla ba tshes grangs gza' skar bzang po la dbu btsugs te/ rgyal ba'i sras po rig pa 'dzin pa byang chub dpal ldan gyis/ bstan pa la shes nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan pos kun nas bslangasnyenas zhal ta'i rim pa rnams dang / rgyu'i dngos po bzang zhing mang la kha na ma tho ba med pas mthun pa'i rkyen bsgrubs nas/ bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal na len dra dang mtshungs pa sprul pa'i rgyal po se chen gan gyi dgos kyi lha khang dpal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang chen por legs par bzhengs te/sde snod kyi tshul la cung zad blo kha phyogs pa thang po che ba'i btsun pa kun dga' 'bum gyis kha ta dang / zhus dag gi dang dos pa bgyis shing / gzhan yang dad pa dang brtson 'grus che zhing blo gros gsal ba'i sdom brtson dam pa mang du thos shing sde snod 'dzin pa mkhas pa rnams kyis/ rgya gar skad la sogs pa legs ⑤par sbyar ba'i skad sor bzhag rnams ni sngon gyi lotstsha ba chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bye brag tu rtogs byed chen po dang / sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa la sogs pa la brten nas dag par byas shing / bod skad rnams ni yul skad dang /'phral skad ngan pa rnams dang ma 'dres par bod yul gyi sngon gyi brda dumes mkhan po rnams dang / sgyur byed dam pa snga phyir byon pa rnams kyi brdashegasar 13—731

rnying dang / skad gsar bcad la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas da drag ①dang / ma mya dang / sa stsogasakhul sogs pa yod med rnams mkhas pa rnams kyis ji ltar mdzad pa ltar brdashedon ma nor bar dag par bgyis nas/ gzhi dung gi sa gzhi ltar dkar 'jam mkhregs pa lho rgyal po lha khang gi sho gu la/ dam che zhing mdangs gsal ba utpal 0sngon po lta bu rgya nag chen po las 'ongs pa'i snag tshas/ 'bur dkyus tshugs gsum lasnyemakhas pa'i mthar phyin0pas yi ge'i rig byed la slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob pas dag snyoms mdzes par bzhengs pa dpon dpal bzang rin chen dang / sangs rgyas grags la sogs pa dbus gtsang gi yi ge pa yid gzhungs shing mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par bris pa la zhus dag lan gsum du bgyis te bzhengs pa rnams/ sa mo glang gi lo bkra shis lo gsar gyi zla ba la legs par grub cing / 'bras bu dang bsgrub pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya phrag drug dang / lung mngon pa'i dus kyi bzhi brgya brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis 'das la/ lhag ma mngon pa'i lo bco brgyad dang / mdo sde/ 'dul ba/rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i lnga brgya phrag gsum ste/ stong lnga brgya bcosabargyad bstan pa'i lhag mar yod pa'i dus su bka' 'gyur legs par grub pa rnams las 'di dag ni lung sde bzhi'o/ /'dul ba lung phal che ba la dge slong pha ma'i so sor thar pa dang / zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bzhengs pa med mod kyi 'on kyang so sor thar pa gnyis rnam 'byed gnyis7kyi rtsa ba yin zhing / rnam 'byed gnyis ni so sor thar pa rnam pa gnyis kyi 'grel pa yin la/ zhu ba ma rdzogs pa ni zhu ba dag shos yin pa'i phyir lung rnam 'byed so so'i dbu dang / gzhung bla ma ma rdzogs pa dbu nyid du bzhengs li/ /lung sde bzhi'i go rims ni gzhi dang / rnam par 13—732

'byed pa dang / de dag gi dka'arkyuba'i gnas zhus lan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa gzhung bla ma dang / de dag tu ma tshang ba kha skong ba phran tshegs so/ /don gyi go rims de ltar yin yang mkhas pa rnams kyis gzhi dang / rnam par 'byed pa'i rjes la phran tshegs dang / de'i rjes la gzhung dam pa nyid bris shing / ka cog la sogs pas mdzad pa'i mtshan byang dkar chag lasakhukyang rim pa de kho na ltar 'byung bas 'dir yang gzhung dam pa mjug nyid du bris so/ /'di rnams kyi bam po'i grangs ni shashelo ka sum brgya la bam po rer byas nas lung gzhisal bam po brgya dang dgu/ dge slong pa'i rnam 'byed la bam po brgyad bcu rtsa gsum dang bam po sum cha/ dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed la bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad/phran tshegs la bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu/ gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa la bam po bcu gnyis/ zhu ba rdzogs pa'i gzhung dam pa la bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum ste/bsdoms na gzhung dam pa la bam po drug bcu rtsa lnga yod pas spyir lung sde bzhi chad pa la bam po sum brgya bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi dang bam po sum cha yod do/ /sngar ma tshang ba rnams tshang bar bzhengs pa'i tshul ni phran tshegs dang / zhu ba ma rdzogs pa'i mjug dag tu bris zin pa'i phyir de dag tu blta bar bya'o// /zha ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tun te ṣānta thā ga to hya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dri ma hā shra ma ṇa/sa ⑦13—733

〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ud pal/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉 la 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉phyir/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉bcu/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 rnam 'byed gnyis/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉snyo/ 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rim/732 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dga'/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉chag sas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉chags las/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sho/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 na/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 de ltar bsod nams dpal gyis rab mtho ba/ /'dzam gling mi dbang chen po'i mdzad pa ltar/ /mchog gi blo gros mtshungs pa med pa des/ /sdom brtson dam pa dge sbyong chen po de'i/ /zugs dgongs bla med rdzogs par bya phyir dang / /bstan pa spel phyir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung / /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ji snyed 'gyur ro cog /legs par bzhengs par gyur pa de dag las/ /'di ni ston pa'i gsung rab bstan pa yi/ /rtsa ba legs gsungs dam chos 'dul ba lung / /de ltar dpal ldan lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /gsung rab rin chen tshul bzhin bzhengs pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba ston na'i zla 'od dang / /mkha' ltar dag cing yangs pa gang thob des/ /'gro kun phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba yi/ /bstan pa rin chen phyogs dus kun khyab cing / /gne 'dzin skyong dang bsrung ba dam pa rnams/ /skye dgu'i dpal du yun ring bzhugs gyur cig /gang gis gsung rab dri med 'di bzhengs pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras po byang chub dpal ldan yang / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag dam par ni/ /sa chen steng 'dir yun ring bzhugs gyur cig /khyad par du yang nges pas sa skyong ba'i/ /mi dbang yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /sgron med sku tshe ring zhing chab srid brtan/ /byams brtse'i thugs kyis 'gro ba skyong gyur cig/srid 'bangs rnams kyang phan tshun byams ldan zhing / /nad dang mu ge 'thab rtsod las sogs pa/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i gnod pa kun zhi nas/ /tshe ring 'byor ldan bstan la dad gyur cig /gang dag 'di la sgo gsum gus pa 13wa 870

par byed pa de dag kyang / /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing / /skye zhing skye ba'i skye ba thams cad du'ang / /'khor lo bzhi dang yon tan rnam bdun dang / /rnam smin brgyad ldan dal 'byor lus thob nas/ /mthong dang bsgom pas spang bya'i nyon mongs dang / /shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags bcas pa kun/ /spong byed gnyen po lam lnga sa bcu rnams/ /rim gyis bgrod nas kun mkhyen thob par shog /gang gis dgag sgrub gnang ba'i gnas ston cing / /mtha' nyis spyod pa spangs nas 'khor ba las/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims gsal byed pa/ /legs gsungs dam chos 'dul ba'i bkra shis shog/ // 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 ye dharmānye tu — tha ma ṇa/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 thams cad mkhyen pa la ma hā shra ma ṇa/ (zhes pa'i g.yung drung rtags bar gyi yi ge rnams 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉la chad/)

༄ga /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/①༄ho /rgya gar skad du/ ārya bha dra tsarya pra ṇi dhā na rā dzā/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ 'jam dpal gzhin nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnamasal/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag③ /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyis yon tan rab 13—873

brjod cing / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / /sil snyan rnams dang byug patugadugs mchog dang / /mar me mchog dang bdug pa dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / /phye ma'i phurasam ri rab mnyam pa dang / /bkod pa'i khyad par 'phags pa mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ /bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dbang gis na/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang / /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan 'das ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir//bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang / /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa//thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur/ /gang 13—874

yang ma byon de dag rab myur bar/ /bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas spyon/ /phyogs bcu ga la'i zhing rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rgya cher yongs su dag par gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang / /sangs rgyas sras kyis rab tu gang bar shog /phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur/ /'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni/ /'thun par gyur cing re ba'ang 'grub par shog /byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing / /'gro ba kun du skye ba dran par gyur/ /tshe rabs kun du 'chi 'pho skye ba na/ /rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag par/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam par thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson te//byang chub sems ni namasashekyang brjed ma gyur/ /sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur pa dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog /las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las/ /grol zhing 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang / /ji ltar pad ma chus mi chags pa bzhin/ /nyi zla nam mkha' thogs pa med ltar spyad//zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing / /'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyad/ /byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /sems can rnams kyi spyod dang 'thun par 'jug /bzang po spyod pa dag ni rab ston cing //13—875

ma 'ongs bskal pa kun du spyod par gyur/ /bdag gi spyod dang 'thun par gang spyod pa/ /de dag dang ni rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang / /spyod pa dag dang smon lam gcig tu spyad/ /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams//de dag dang yang rtag tu phrad par shog /de dag bdag gis namanyekyang yid mi 'byung / /sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams/ /mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal ba blta/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun du mi skyo bar/ /de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /byang chub spyod pa kun du snang bar byed/ /bzang po spyod pa rnamakhupar spyad pa yang / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun du spyadashepar bgyi/ /srid pa thams cad du ni 'khor ba na/ /bsod nams ye shes dag ni mi zad rnyed/ /thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin rnam thar dang / /yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod cing blta bar bgyi/ /de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang / /sgra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis/ /rgyal ba kun dbyangs yan lag rnam dag pa/ /'gro ba kun gyisasrebasam pa ji bzhin dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi/ /dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba thams cad dag⑤ /'khor lo'i tshul rnams rab tu skor ba yi/ /de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs mi zad la/ /blo 13—876

yi stobs kyis bdage kyang rab tu 'jug /ma 'ongs bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang / /skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi/ /gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /skad cig cha shas kyis ni zhugs par sbyang / /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge gang / /de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta/ /rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnamanyethar stobs kyis 'jug /gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod pa/ /de dag rdul gcig steng du mngon par bsgrub/ /de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug /gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /de dag rim par 'tshang rgya 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston/ /mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o/ /kun du myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang / /kun nas sgo yi theg pa'i stobs dag dang / /kun du yon tan spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang / /kun du khyab pa byams pa dag gi stobs/ /kun nas dge ba'i bsod nams stobs rnams dang / /chags pa med par gyur pa'i ye shes stobs/ /shes rab thabs dang ting 'dzin stobs dag gis/ /byang chub stobs rnams yang dag sgrub par byed/ /las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag byed cing / /nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu 'joms par byed/ /bdud kyi stobs rnams stobs med rab byed cing / /bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyi/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par 'grol/ /chos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing / /ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /smon lam rgya mtsho rab tu rdzogs par byed/ /sangs rgyas rgyal13—877

mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing / /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi skyo spyad par bgyi/ /gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba yi/ /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam bye brag rnams/ /bzang po spyod pas byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /de kun ma lus bdag gis rdzogs par bgyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /gang gi ming ni kun du bzang zhes bya/ /mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par spyad pa'i phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing / /spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag dang / /bsngo ba'ang bzang po mkhas pa ci 'dra bar/ /de 'drar bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /kun nas dge ba bzang po spyad pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gyi ni smon lam spyad par bgyi/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig /yon tan rnams kyang tshad gzung med par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas nas kyang //de dag 'phrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa/ /rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba mchog rnams kyang / /zhing gi rdul snyed bskal par phul ba bas/ /gang gis bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di thos nas/ /byang chub mchog gi rjes su rab mos shing / /lan cig tsam yang dad pa skyed pa ni/ /bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pa/ /des ni ngan song thams cad spangs par 'gyur/ /des ni 13—878

grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong / /de dag rnyed pa rab snyed bde bar 'tsho/ /mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ongs/ /kun du bzang po de yang ci 'dra bar/ /de dag ring por mi thogs de bzhin 'gyur/ /mtshams med lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ /gang gis mi shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis bzang po spyod pa 'di brjod na/ /myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ /ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang / /rigs dang kha dog rnams dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de mi thub/ /'jig rten gsum po kun na'ang mchod par 'gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro/ /song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dug ste/ /byang chub sangs rgyas 'khor lo rab tu skor/ /bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thams cad 'dul/ /gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'di/ /'chang ba dang ni ston tam klog pa yis/ /de yi rnam par smin pa sangs rgyas mkhyen/ /byang chub mchog la som nyi ma byed cig /'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' btudang / /kun du bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag gi ni rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo / /dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu7bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang / /thams cad ma lusakhumangon sum 'gyur bar shog /de 13—879

dag ma lus bdag gis yongs su bskang / /'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad ma dam pa shin du mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal las mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas/ /sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang / /sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam btab pa yis/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa//des ni 'gro ba'i dge ba'i smon lam rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byor bar shog /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bsngos pa yis/ /bsod nams dam pa mtha' yas gang thob des/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal chu bor bying ba rnams/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog /smon lam rgyal po 'di mchog gtso des ni/ /'gro ba mtha' yas kun la phan byed cing / /kun du bzang pos brgyan pa'i gzhung grub cing / /ngan song rgyud gsum ma lus stongs par shog /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ rdzogs sto// //13—880

༄tshon /'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong lha mig ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang yang / /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan 'gro thams cad zlog bgyid cing / /mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /bdag gis de dag bshags par bgyi/ /bdag las rnam pa gsum gang gis/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa de/ /bdag gi kun mkhyen sa bon te/ /bdag gi byang chub mi zad shog /phyogs bcu dag gi zhing rnams su/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa gang byung ba/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen pa'i yi rang bas/ /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la yi rang 13—882

ngo / /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni ye shes mchog thob shog /phyogs bcu dag gi phyogs rnams na/ /sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog /'tshang rgya bgyid par skul ma 'debs/ /byang chub dam par sangs rgyas shing / /sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas/ /srog chags kun la sman slad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni/ /sdug bsngal sems can thar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying gyur cing / /sred pa'i srad bus dam bcings pa 'ching ba kun gyis bcings bdag la/ /rkang gnyis mchog rnams gzigs su gsol/ /sems kyis dri mar bgyis pa la/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni smod mi mdzad/ /sems can rnams la byams thugs ldan/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang / /gang dag 'das dang ma byon pa/ /de dag rjes su bdag slob cing / /byang chub spyad pa spyod gyur cig /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas/ /'gro drug sems can thar bgyid shog /mngon shes drug po mngon bgyis nas/ /bla med byang chub reg gyur cig /ma skyes pa dang mi 'byung dang / /rang bzhin ma mchis gnas ma mchis/ /rnam rig ma mchis dngos ma mchis/ /stong pa'i chos ni rtogs par shog /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po ltar/ /sems can ma mchis srog ma mchis/ /gang zag ma mchis gso ma mchis/ /bdag ma mchis pa'i chos rtogs shog /bdag 'dzin bdag gir 'dzin par ni/ /dngos po kun la mi gnas par/ /sems can kun la bde slad du/ /ser sna ma mchis sbyin gtong shog /dngos po dngos po ma 13—883

mchis pas/ /bdag gi longs spyod lhun grub shog /dngos po thams cad rnam 'jig pas/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sa 'am yang na chu 'am me/ /rlung gi khams ltar mi gnas shing / /bzod pa'am khro ba ma mchis par/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i brtson 'grus kyis / /brtan spro le lo ma mchis shing / /stobs dang ldan pa'i lus sems kyis//brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting ①'dzin dang / /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang yang / /rig gsum mngon sum bgyis pa yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa dang / /'od dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /de ltar spyad pa spyod byed cing / /byams pa grags dang ldan pa yis/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs byas nas/ /sa bcu po la rab tu gnas/ /'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam/ rdzogs sto// //13—884

tshog /rgya gar skad du/ a gra tsarsā pra ṇi dmakun/ bod skad du/mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye dgu kun la sman dang bde slad du/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sangs rgyas rnams la 'dud/ /de dag la ni rjed cing mchod par bgyi/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cing / /byams pa dang ni 'jam dpal mnga' bdag tog /chos kyi blo gros dpa' bo bdud rtsi gsung / /dpa' bo de dag phyag 'tshal mkhyen pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang mi dbang rnams la 'dud/ /thugs rje ldan zhing 'jig rten don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba mi mkhyen mi gzigs mi mnga' ba/ /mi dbang thugs brtse byams la gnas pa yi//rgyal ba de kun bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sngon gyi srid pa dag tu bdag nyid kyis / /sdig pa'i lam rnams gang bgyis bdag gis bshags/ /de bzhin lus 13—886

ngag yid kyis bgyis pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /shākya thub dang mi 'khrugs 'od dpag med/ /de dag gis ni phrin las yongs sbyangs dang / /'chags dang bshags pa mkhyen cing rtogs gyur ltar//de bzhin bdag gis sdig pa bshagasari par bgyi/ /thams cad dga' mdzad skyes bu dam pa gang / /byang chub zhugs pa kun la gsol ba dang / /ngan song bzhi po myur du zhi gyur cig /mi khom 'joms par bgyid cing rgyu bar shog /sangs rgyas bzang spyod dri med mnga' bdag dang / /de bzhin lhun po'i dpal dang nyi ma'i sgron/ /de dag bsod nams yi rang mkhyen pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang bsod nams rjes yi rang / /phyogs bcu dag na7sbyin pa spyod pa gang / /de bzhin tshul khrims ting 'dzin spyod rnams dang / /shes rab sgom dang bsod nams stobs kun la/ /byang chub yon tan don du yi rang ngo / /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan mtha' yas dang / /chos bstan byang chub 'jog bgyid thams cad la/ /byang chub yon tan don du yi rang ngo / /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /'jig rten rgyal ba gang bzhugs kun la bskul/ /phyogs bcu dag na byang chub rnyed pa gang / /de dag tshangs brgyas ji ltar gsol pa ltar/ /rgyal rnams bzhugs shing chos mchog ston gyur cig /rgyal kun bskal pa mang por bzhugs par shog /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /mi rnams thams cad mchog dang bla med pa/ /'jig rten sgron ma bde gshegs myur gyur cig /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal mchod gang dang / /las dge rnams la yid rang gang lags dang / /sdig pa'i las rnams bshags pa gang lags dang / /rgyal ba rkang gnyis dbang rnams mthong gang dang / /bdag 13—887

gis dge ba cung zad ci bgyis pa/ /lus dang ngag dang sems las byung yang rung / /bdag gis bgyis dang bgyid dang bgyid 'gyur gang / /thams cad skye dgu sman slad stsal bar bgyi/ /ji ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams mkhyen nas / /stsal pa legs par stsal cing legs rgyas pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis skye dgu sman slad stsal/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /bdag gis 'gro la stsal ba gang lags pa'i/ /bsod nams 'bras bu bla med ci mchis pa/ /theg pa chen por yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag la byang chub 'bras bu grub par shog /mtshungs pa ma mchis kun nas sgo mo rnams/ /'gro ba'i don du bdag la mngon sum shog /'jam dpal gyi ni rjes su slob bgyid cing / /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam gdab par bgyi/ /mi gcig tsam gyi ched du'ang mnar med pa'i/ /tshor ba thams cad bdag gis myong bar gyur/ /bskal pa du mar bdag ni spro bar bgyi/ /'gro ba thams cad mya ngan med par shog /sems dmyal gshin rje'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal dang / /dud 'gro'i gnas rnams mi'i sdug bsngal dang / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phung po mtha' yas dang / /bdag la bab gyur 'gro ba bde bar shog /rgyal ba rnams kyi zhing ni rnam dag dang / /sems can rnam dag ye shes rnam dag dang / /rgyal ba rnams kyi smon lam mtha' yas gang / /smon lam de kun bdag la grub par shog /bdag gi smon lam nyams par ma gyur cig /bdag ni nams kyang skyo bar mi 'gyur shog /byang chub mchog ni bdag gis thob bar du/ /bskal pa du mar bdag ni spro bar shog /mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ rdzogs sto// //13—888

༄ /mar me'i lo rgyus dang smon lam gyi mdo/①༄tshog /mar me'i lo rgyus dang smon lam gyi mdo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis ston pa mdzad pa'i dus na / rgyal po gser gyi lag pa zhes bya bas/ bcom ldan 'das mar me mdzad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa khyod sngon gyi dus na dge ba'i rtsa ba ci zhig spyad na da ltar mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan te/ sku las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'byung ba'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po nyon cig /ngas so so'i skye bo'i dus na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ lus la ras bal gyi le'u til mar gyi nang du btsos pa stong btsugs te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la gtan pa med pa'i mchod par phul pas da lta rang nyid sangs rgyas mar me mdzad ces bya bar gyur pa yin no zhes gsungs pa 13—890

dang / de la rgyal po chen po shin tu yid rangs te/ de nas rgyal po des rang gi lag pa g.yas pa ras bal til mar gyis btsos pas dkris te me btang nas lag pa g.yon pa bar snang la brkyang ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / bdag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das mar me mdzad dgongs su gsol lo/ /'gyod pa med pa'i sems kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du dmigs te/ gtan pa med pa'i mchod par bsngos nas smon lam 'debs te/ 'di skad do/ /mar me'i snod ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten gyi khams tsam du gyur cig /snying po ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab tsam du gyur cig /'od kyis ni srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba yan chad nas/ gzhan yang lcags ri chen po'i phyi rgyab na sems can rang gi las kyi sgrib pas bsgribs pa'i mun nag chen po'i nang na rang gi lag pa brkyang bskum yang mi mthong ba'i gnas tshun chad snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /yun ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas ji srid bzhugs pa de srid du gnas par gyur cig /grangs ni phyogs bcu 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med pa re re'i spyan lam du gsal bar gyur cig /mar me 'di gzugs med pa'i gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /de ltar gsal ba'i mod la gzugs med pa'i lha rnams mar me'i 'od kyis bskul ma thag tu mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i skye mched bzhi las grol te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan la sogs pa snyoms par 'jug pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas su gsal bar gyur cig /gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams ting nge 13—891

'dzin kyis dga' bde rtse gcig pa nyams su myong nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par gyur cig /mar me 'di 'dod khams kyi lha rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /'dod khams kyi lha rnams kyang lha'i 'dod pa'i longs spyod la sems ma chags shing rang gi sems la lta zhing bsam gtan bzhi rims kyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di lha ma yin rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /lha ma yin gyi nga rgyal dang / khro gtum dang sems kyi gdug pa zhi nas tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan nas zhi gnas kyi sems yid la byed pa dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di gling bzhi'i mi rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /gling bzhi'i mi rnams kyang sdug bsngal brgyad las thar nas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di byol song rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /byol song de dag gcig la gcig za ba dang / brdeg brdung dang / gsad pa dang / bkol ba'i sdug bsngal dang / blun rmongs las thar shes rab rnam pa gsum dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di gshin rje'i 'jig rten du snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /gshin rje rnams gsodatugacod byed pa dang / brdeg brdung gi las las thar nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrags pas sems can thams cad gtong ba'i sems 'byung bar gyur cig /mar me 'di pre ta'i gnas su gsal bar gyur cig /pre ta rnams kyang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal las thar nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyi thugs rje chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis zas dang skom gyis phongs pa rnams longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang ldan zhing sbyin pa'i pha rol tu 13—892

phyin pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di na raka7rnams kyi gnas su gsal bar gyur cig /na rakasnyeni sngon gyi las ngan pa'i rnam par smin pas tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba nyams su myong ba las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs rje'i byin gyi rlabs kyis dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal tshad med pa las thar nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'dis 'dzam bu'i gling gi phyi rol mun nag gi nang na 'thoms pa'i sems can rang gi lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ba yang mi mthong ba'i gnas su gsal bar gyur cig /de dag sngon gyi las ngan pa'i rnam par smin pas zas dang skom 'dod pa las nam mkha' la rang gi lcags kyi sen mo yod pas brnyabs pas zas dang skom ma rnyed nas/ rang gi lus zin pa dang sha bcad de za ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi thugs rje'i byin gyis mun nag chen po'i⑧'thoms pa las thar nas bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skye bar gyur cig /gzhan yang mar me 'di klu'i gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /des klu rnams gti mug dang ser sna'i mdud pa bkrol te gtong ba'i blo dang ldan zhing nam mkha' lding gis 'jigs pa dang / me dang / bye tshan la sogs te 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las thar nas/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro zhing srog 'tsho ba'i zhi gnas kyi chu'i thig le snying la gnas nas klu rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di lto 'phye chen po'i gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /des lto 'phye chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi nas dga' ba rgya mtsho rnam par 'phrul ba'i shugs dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'dis 'dzam bu'i gling gi spyir gnas pa'i sa bdag dang / lha 13—893

dang / klu dang / sa bdag gi rgyal po pi ta li dang / sa'i rgyal mo chen mo dang / rgya mtsho chen po dang / mtsho bran dang / rdzing dang / khron ge la gnas pa dang / klung chen po dang / klung phra mo dang / chu mig dang / lum la gnas pa dang / gangs ri mthon po'i rgyud la gnas pa dang / ri nag po dang / g.ya' dang / sha spang dang / spang ri dang / nags chen po dang /shing gcig pa dang / gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten dang / grong khyer dang / ljongs na gnas pa'i gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /de dag so so'i 'khrul pa'i rtog pa thams cad byang nas dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang7ldan te/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan nas thar pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /de ltar deng mar me 'di'i yon bdag gis kyang gtan pa med pa'i mchod pa 'di phul bas/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad kyi zhabs drung du skyes te/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad kyi dpal mgon du gyur cig /rgyal po gser gyi lag pas mdzad pa'i mar me'i smon lam gyi mdo/ rdzogs sto// // 13—894

༄ga /'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las gsungs pa'i smon lam/①༄tshon /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga chen sgra yis ni/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'jig rten gsum 'di na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal gshin rje'i sdug bsngal dang / /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sdug bsngal zhi bar shog /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /'jig rten rmongs pa thams cad zhi gyur cig /ji ltar thub dbang 'jigs med 'jigs zhi ltar/ /sems can 'jigs med 'jigs dang bral bar shog /ji ltar 'khor bar kun mkhyen thub dbang po/ /'phags pa'i yon tan kun dang ldan pa ltar/ /skye dgu ting 'dzin byang chub yan lag gi/ /yon tan ldan zhing yon tan rgya mtshor gyur / /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'disayis ni/ /sems can thams cad tshangs pa'i sgra ldan gyur/ /sangs rgyas dam pa byang chub mchog reg shog /chos kyi 'khor lo dge ba skor gyur cig /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab bzhugs par shog /13—896

'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston gyur cig /nyon mongs 'joms gyur sdug bsngal sel bar shog /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug zhi gyur cig /sems can gang dag ngan song sar gnas te/ /rus pa'i lus la me lce rab 'bar ba/ /de dag rnga chen bsgrags pa thos gyur cig /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo zhes tshig thos shog /sems can kun gyis tshe rabs brgya dag dang / /tshe rabs stong phrag bye bar skye dran shog /thub pa'i dbang po rtag tu dran gyur cing / /de dag gi ni rgya chen gsung thos shog /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rtag tu 'grogs rnyed gyur/ /sdig pa'i las rnams rnam par spong b.ratushog /bya ba dge ba rnams ni spyod gyur cig /mi dang lha dang srog chags thams cad kyi/ /de dag bsam dad smon lam gang yin pa/ /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /de dag rnams kyi de kun rdzogs gyur cig /sems can gang dag sems dmyal mi bzad skyes/ /lus la me lce kun tu rab tu 'bar/ /skyabs med mya ngan bcas shing yongasaku'akhyam pa/ /me rnams ma lus rab tu zhi bar shog /sems dmyal yi dgas mi yi 'jig rten na/ /sems can sdug bsngal mi bzad drag po gang / /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /de dag rnams kyi sdug bsngal kun zhi shog /rten med dpung gnyen med pa dang / /skyabs med par ni gyur pa dag /de rnams la ni skyob pa dang / /dpung gnyen rten mchog bdag gyur cig /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis dam pa dag /thugs brtse thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs/ /gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /bzhugs pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis sngon chad sdig pa'i las/ /shin tu mi bzad gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu'i spyan sngar bdag mchis te/ /de 13—897

dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /pha ma dag tu mi 'dzin dang / /sangs rgyas rnams su mi 'dzin dang / /dge ba dag tu mi 'dzin pas/ /sdig pa bdag gis gang bgyisatudang / /phyug⑧pa'i rgyags pas dregs pa dang / /rigs dang longs spyod rgyags pa dang / /gzhon pa'i rgyags pas dregs pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /nyes bsams nyes par smras pa dang / /nyes par bgyis pa'i las rnams dang / /nyes pa'i dmigs su ma bltas pas/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /byis pa'i blo yis 'jug pa dang / /mi shes mun pa'i sems dang ni/ /sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang gyur dang / /nyon mongs rnam par 'khrug sems dang / /rtsed mo dga' ba'i dbang nyid dang / /mya ngan dang ni nad dbang dang / /nor gyis mi chog nyes pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /'phags min skye bo 'dre ba dang / /phrag dog ser sna sgyu dang ni/ /g.yo dang dbul ba'i nyes pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /phongs pa byung ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /'dod pa rnams dang 'jigs rgyu dang / /phyug po ma yin gyur pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /g.yo ba'i sems kyis dbang nyid dang / /'dod dang khro ba'i dbang dag dang / /bkres dang skom gyis nyen pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /bza' ba dag dang btung ba dang / /bud med rgyu dang gos kyi phyir/ /nyon mongs gdungasab sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sdig /nyes par spyad pa rnam gsum bsags/ /'di 'dra'i tshul gyis gang bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang chos rnams dang / /de bzhin nyan thos rnams la yang / /13—898

gus pa ma lags gang bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /gang yang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang /gus pa ma lags bgyis pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /dam chos smra ba rnams la yang / /gus pa ma lags bgyis pa dang / /chos la'ang gus par ma bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /bdag gis rtag tu mi shes pas/ /dam pa'i chos ni spangs pa dang / /pha ma rnams la ma gus gang / /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /blun pa dang ni byis pa dang / /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal dregs pas bsgribs bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /bdag ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ /stobs bcu rnams la mchod par shog /bdag ni phyogs bcur sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal kun las 'don gyur cig /sems can bsam gyis mi khyab kun/ /sa bcu dag la 'god par shog /sa bcu dag la gnas nas kyang / /thams cad de bzhin gshegs gyur cig /ji srid sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /de kun thar bgyid nus srid du/ /sems can re re'i phyir yang ni/ /bskal pa bye bar spyod par shog /gser 'od dam pa zhes bgyi ba / /las rnams thams cad byang byed pa/ /zab mo dag ni ston pa 'di/ /sems can de dag ston gyur cig /gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su/ /sdig pa shin du mi bzad bgyis/ /lan cig rab tu bshags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyur/ /gang gis las kyi sgrib pa rnams/ /myur du yang dag zad 'gyur ba/ /gser 'od dam pa dge ba yi/ /bshags pa 'di dag bshags nas ni/ /rin chen 'byung gnas mchog bcu po/ /sa bcu la ni 13—899

gnas par shog /sangs rgyas yon tan snang gyur cig /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho chu bo dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho zab mo de/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsam yas kyis/ /thams cad mkhyen du rdzogs par shog /ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong rnams dang / /gzungs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab dang / /dbang stobs byang chub yan lag gis/ /stobs bcu dam par 'gyur bar shog /dgongs pa'i thugs kyis sangs rgyas rnams/ /bdag la rnam par gzigs su gsol/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /nongs par rab tu gzung du gsol/ /bdag gis bskal pa brgya rnams su/ /sngon chad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /de phyir bdag ni mya ngan sems/ /longs dang mya ngan 'jigs pas gzir/ /sdig pa'ishelas la 'jigs par bgyid/ /yid ni rtag tu dman par gyur/ /gang dang gang du 'gro bgyid pa/ /bdag ni gang du'ang dga' ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thugs rjer ldan/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'jigs sel bas/ /nongs pa rab tu gzung du gsol/ /'jigs pa dag las bdag thar mdzod/ /bdag gi nyon mongs las rnams kyi/ /dri ma de bzhin gshegs pas shol/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag la ni/ /snying rje'i chu yis bkru bar gsol/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /sngon chad bdag gis gang bgyis dang / /da ltar bdag gi sdig pa gang / /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /nongs par bgyid pa'i las rnams kun/ /slanakhuchad mi bgyid bsdam par bgyi/ /bdag gis nongs par bgyis pa gang / /sdig de bcab par mi bgyi'o/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum po rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag 13—900

'chags so/ /lus kyis bgyis dang ngag gi las/ /yid kyis rnam par bsamasanyepa dang / /las rnams bcu po bgyis pa dag /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /mi dge'i las bcu spangs nas su/ /dge ba bcu po bsten bgyis la/ /sa bcu la ni bdag gnas shing / /stobs bcu mchog tu 'gyur bar shog /bdag gis sdig pa'i las gang dag /mi 'dod 'bras bu thob bgyid pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir gang dag dang / /'jig rten khams ni gzhan dag tu/ /gang rnams dge ba'i las bgyid pa/ /de dag kun la yid rang ngo / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang / /bdag gis bsod nams gang bsgrubs pa/ /bdag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ /byang chub mchog la reg par shog /srid 'gro nyam dar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin du mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mi nyams spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /skye ba nyam nga srid pa nyam nga dang / /'jig rten nyam nga g.yo sems nyam nga bar/ /lus kyi spyod pa nyam nga sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bsags de 'chags so/ /byis pa blun byas nyon mongs nyam nga dang / /sdig pa'i grogs dang phrad pa nyam nga dang / /srid pa nyam nga 'dod chags nyam nga dang / /zhe snang gti mug mun pa nyam nga dang / /dal ba'i nyam nga dus kyi nyam nga dang / /bsod nams sgrub pa nyam nga dag gis kyang / /rgyal ba mi mnyam mngon sum mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi / /sangs rgyas gser mdog ri snang ri rab 'dra/ /yon tan rgya mtsho 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba de dag rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /rgyal ba de dag 13—901

kun la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gser mdog gser ni dri ma med pa'i gser gyi 'od/ /dri med rnam dag bai drurya'i yan lag spyan/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma dpal gzi grags 'bar 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer dag gis mun pa mun nag bsal/ /yan lag rab tu dri med rab bzad rnam par mdzes/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma yan lag dri med gser 'dras khyab/ /nyon mongs mes gdungs yid can 'bar ba'i me 'dra la/ /thub pa'i zla ba'i 'od zer dra bas tshim par mdzad/ /mtshan mchog sum bcu7gnyis kyis dbang po yan lag mdzes/ /dpe byad bzang po dag gis yan lag rnam par mdzes/ /dpal gzi bsod nams 'bar 'khrugs 'od zer dra ba yis/ /'jig rten gsum na mun khrod nyi ma bzhin du bzhugs/ /dri med rgya chen kha dog sna tshogs bee druryal/ /skya reng dmar dang dngul dang shel bzhin yan lag dmar/ /'od zer dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs legs brgyan pas/ /thub chen khyod ni nyi ma bzhin du de yis mdzes /mya ngan 'khrugs pa 'chi chu rga ba'i rbatsarlabs can/ /'khor ba'i klung chen longs pa'i chu bor lhung ba la/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mchog tu rtsub cing shugs drag pa/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i 'od zer mang po rnams kyis skems0/ /yan lag gser gyi mdog tu rnam par snang / /ye shes 'byung gnas 'jig rten gsum kun mchog /rab mdzes mtshan gyi yan lag rnam spras pa/ /sangs rgyas gser sku 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i chu ni dpag med dang / /ji ltar sa la sa rdul mtha' yas dang / /ji ltar ri ra ba rdo mtha' mtshungs med dang / /ji ltar nam mkha'i mtha' ma mtha' yas pa/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas te/ /sems can kun gyis shes par mi nus so/ /bskal 13—902

pa du mar gzhal cing bsams kyang ni/ /yon tan mtha' ma shes par mi nus so//chu ni skra'i rtse mo'i tshad tsam dang / /rdor bcas rir bcas rgya mtshor bcas pa ni/ /bskal par bgrangs na shes par nus kyang srid/ /sangs rgyas yon tan pha mtha' shes mi nus/ /yon tan kha dog snyan dang grags pa dang / /dge ba'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa'i sku lus dang / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcusatubargyan pa yis/ /sems can thams cad de 'drar gyur par shog /bdag ni dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten mi ring sangs rgyas 'gyur bar shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston gyur cig /sems can sdug bsngal mang gzir thar byed shog /stobs bcas sder bcas bdud las rgyal gyur cig /chos kyi 'khor lo dge ba bskor bar shog /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab gnas gyur cig /bdud rtsi chu yis sems can tshim byed shog /ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal bas rdzogs pa ltar/ /pha rol phyin drug bla med rdzogs par shog /nyon mongs 'jomakhuzhing sdug bsngal sel gyur cig /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug zhi byed shog /tshe rabs brgya dang tshe rabs bye ba stong / /bdag ni rtag tu tshe rabs dran par shog /thub pa'i dbang po rtagatu dran gyur cig /de dag rnams kyi gsung rgya che thos shog /bdag ni dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas 'grogs pa rnyed par shog /sdig pa'i las rnams rnam par spong gyur cig /dge ba'i 'byung gnas dgashernams sbyong b.rabashog /zhing rnams kun na srog chags thams cad kyang / /'jig rten dag na sdug bsngal kun zhi gyur/ /sems can dbang po ma tshang yan lag nyams/ /de kun de'u re dbang po tshang bar shog /gang dag nad btab nyam chung lus nyams dang / /phyogs bcu dag 13—903

na skyabs med gyur pa rnams/ /de kun myur du nad las thar gyur cig /nad med stobs dang dbang po rnyed par shog /gang dag rgyal po chom rkun sgre'u bsdigs gsang thug dang / /sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs brgya yis phongs gyur pa/ /sems can nyams7thag gyur cing sdug bsngal de dag kun/ /'jigs mchog mi bzad brgya po de las thar gyur cig /gang dag brdegs ②shing bcings pas bcings gzir ba/ /phongs pa sna tshogs dag na gnas gyur cing / /nyon mongs stong phrag du mas dkrugs nas kyang / /'jigs pa mi bzad mya ngan sna tshogs rnyed/ /de dag thams cad bcings las grol gyur cig /brdegs pa dag ni bdegs las thar bar shog /gsad pa rnams kyang srog dang ldan gyur cig /phongs gyur thams cad 'jigs pa med par shog /sems can gang dag bkres sred skom gyis gzir/ /de dag zas skom sna tshogs rnyed par shog /long bas gzugs rnams sna tshogs mthong gyur cig /'on pas yid 'ong sgra rnams thos par shog /gcer bu rnams kyis sna tshogs gos rnyed gyur/ /sems can dbul pos gter rnams rnyed par shog /nor 'bru rin chen sna tshogs mang po yis / /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan par shog /gang yang sdug bsngal tshe rabs gnod ma gyur/ /sems can thams cad blta na sdug pa dang / /gzugs bzang mdzes shing tshul du shes par shog /rtag tu bde ba du ma stsogs gyur cig /yid kyis zas skom rab 'byor bsod nams dag /bsams ma thag tu de dag grub gyur cig /rdza rnga cang te'u pi bang sgra snyan dang / /chu mig mtshe'u rdzing bu lteng ka dag /gser gyi pad ma ud pal pad ma can/ /zas skom gos nor mu tig nor bu dbyig /rgyan gser rin chen sna tshogs bee drurya / /13—904

de dag bsams ma thag tu grub gyur cig /'jig rten gang na'ang sdug bsngal sgra ma byung / /sems can gcig kyang mi 'phrod mthong ma gyur/ /de dag thams cad kha dog rgya chen dang / /phan tshun du ni 'od byed 'gyur bar shog /mi'i 'jig rten phun sum tshogs gang yod/ /de dag bsams par skye bar de dag gyur/ /bsam pa thams cad bsams ma thag tu yang / /bsod nams 'bras bus yongs su rdzogs par shog /spos dang phreng ba dag dang byug pa dang / /gos dang phye ma me tog sna tshogs dag /ljon shing dag las dus gsum 'bab par shog /sems can de dag len cing dgar gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa bsam yas thams cad dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dang / /rdul bral dri med brtan pa'i chos la yang / /phyogs bcu rnams su mchod pa byed par shog /'gro ba dma' ba thams cad spong gyur cig /mi khom brgyad po dag las 'das par shog /dal ba'i rgyal po dam pa thob gyur cig /rtag tu sangs rgyas 'grogs pa thob par shog /rtag tu mthon po'i rigs su skye bar shog /nor dang 'bru'i mdzod rnams 'byor gyur cig /snyan dang grags dang gzugs dang kha dog gis/ /bskal pa du mar legs par brgyan par shog /bud med thams cad rtag tu phor gyur te/ /dpa' zhing rtul phod mkhas shing gsal bar shog /de kun rtag tu byang chub phyir spyod gyur/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod par shog /phyogs bcu dag na rin chen shing dbang drung / /sangs rgyas bder bzhugs rin chen bee drurya'i①/ /khri la bzhugs pa dag ni mthong gyur cig /chos bstan pa yang de dag thos par shog /bdag gis sdig pa'i las rnams bsgrubs pa ni/ /srid pa nyam ngar sngon chad gang bsgrubs pa/ /13—905

sdig las gang dag mi 'dod 'bras thob pa/ /de dag thams cad ma lus zad gyur cig /sems can gang dag srid par bcings gnas kun/ /'khor ba'i zhags pa'i thag pas dam bcings pa/ /shes rab lag gis bcings pa bkrol bar shog /sdug bsngal rnams las thar gyur thub gyur cig /sems can gang dag 'dzam bu'i gling 'di dang / /gang dag 'jig rten khams ni gzhan rnams na / /bsod nams sna tshogs zab mo rnams byed pa/ /de dag kun la rjes su yi rang ngo / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bsgrubs7pa yis/ /bdag gi rjes su yi rang bsod nams des/ /bdag gi smon grub 'bras bu yod par shog /byang chub rdul bral bla med thob gyur cig /gang dag rtag tu dri ma bral ba dang / /dri med yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod pa dang / /yongs su bsngo ba brjod pa 'di yis ni/ /bskal pa drug bcur ngan song spong bar 'gyur/ /tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa 'di dag gis/ /skyes pa bud med bram ze rgyal rigs las/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste rgyal ba gang bstod pa/ /tshe rabs kun du skye ba dran par 'gyur/ /yan lag dbang po kun gyis yan lag brgyan/ /bsod nams yon tan sna tshogs rnams dang ldan/ /mi dbang rgyal pos rtag tu de mchod de/ /de dang de dag tu ni de 'drar 'gyur/ /gang dag rna ba'i bu gar bshags pa 'di ni grag gyur pa/ /de dag sangaso rgyas gcig gi gan nas dge ba byas ma yin/ /gnyis la ma yin bzhi la ma yin lnga min bcu la min/ /de dag sangs rgyas stong gi gan nas dge ba byas ma yin/ /'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las gsungs pa'i smon lam/ rdzogs rdzob// //13—906

bsdur mchan/896 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mjug byang las blangs te bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈li 〉〉la gzhir bzung nas 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gsum dang dpe bsdur byas yod/②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉de/897 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉 bar/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉 sa/898 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bgyid/ ②〈〈co 〉〉rgyugs/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gtung // / sdu/bye/rdidī ༷/'i/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉sgron/blo 2 ①〈〈co 〉〉cu/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉durya/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉rgya/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉skoms/ 9༷ ①〈〈co 〉〉cus/ ②〈〈co 〉〉'joms/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dge/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉spyod par/9 4 ①〈〈co 〉〉nyam/ ②〈〈co 〉〉'jigs/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉durya/ 〈〈co 〉〉ḍūrya/blo 5 ①〈〈co 〉〉ḍūrya'i/9༷6 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/ ②〈〈co 〉〉so/ci13wa 907

༄ga /'phags pa stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa las gsungs pa'i smon lam/①ci ༄tshon /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten 'di 'am yang na 'das pa dang / /mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i lhar gyur pa/ /mi mchog de dang 'dir ni mtshungs pa med/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs / /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas/ /shes pas shākya thub des rab tu phye/ /bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus byas ma yin pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab tu bstan/ /ston pa bla med rnal 'byor rtagashesgrub pa/ /rdo rje lta bu'i mig gnyis lam mthong ba/ /ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /tsho13—909

bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing / /gang zag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni/ /drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs med pa/ /bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas shes gsungs/ /de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'gyur te/ /zhing rab gshin las sa bon btab pa bzhin/ /'di ni dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing / /gi ta ma'i bstan la 'jug byed pa/ /de dag thos nas bdud rtsi mchog thob ste/ /mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa/ /de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni/ /'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang | /the tsom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /gcig char spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs//bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed cing / /blo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed la/ /de ltar de la lta bas 'dzin mi byed/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po sar btsugs pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi dam pa mthong ba yi/ /gang zag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de bzhin no/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /shes rab zab mos shin tu bstan pa yi / /'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam sgom zhing / /lus kyang sbyin par yid 13—910
