la byas pas ni/ /de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang phrad mi 'gyur/ /de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba/ /lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa nyid/ /de ltar kun du sbyor ba rab btang ba'i/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba①/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni dge bar shog /ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal dingasa'adir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni dge bar shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal dingasa'adir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal ding 'dir dge bar shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur de/ /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag⑤ /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod par shog /'di ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /shin du bden pa gsung zhing brdzun med pa/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig /rdzogs sangs0rnam par sangs rgyas tshe/ /'jig rten skyong bas phyogs bzhi nas/ /snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su/ /bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang / /mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa/ /lha'i snod mchog de dang ni / /bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams/ /ston pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa/ /13—911

bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir gyur par shog /de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis/ /lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra/ /blangs nas ston la rab phul ba/ /bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams/ /bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis / /nad pa rnams kyis nad sel cing / /nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa//sman rnams bdud rtsir gyur par shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang / /gtsug tor can gyis stobs rnams dang / /thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang / /log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang / /gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang / /'od srung gi ni rdzu 'phrul dang / /shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir gyur par shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang / /rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang / /dgra bcom rnams kyi mthu dag dang / /gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang / /shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang / /mod gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang / /ma 'gags pa'i mig dang ni/ /'od srung sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / / kauṇḍi n+ya'i7sngar tho ba dang / /kun dga' bo'i thos pa dang / /tshangs pa yi ni byams pa dang / /brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong gi yul rnams dang / /dbang phyug chen po'i stobs dag dang / /sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang / /'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang / /de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis②/ /bdag gi dug ni dug med shog /'phags pa stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa las gsungs pa'i smon lam/ rdzogs sgom// //13—912

༄ga /rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bden tshig①༄tshog /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rnam gzigs mya ngan 'tshang la gnas/ /rgyal ba gtsugashetor pad ma dkar po'i drung / /thams cad skyob pa sa la'i drung na gnas/ /bram ze 'khor ba 'jig ni shir sha'i drung / /sangs rgyas gser thub u dum ba ra'i7drung / /'od srung n+ya gro dha'i drung na gnas/ /shākya thub mchog khyad par gnas drung du/ /phyin nas byang chub thob gyur gau ta ma/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul chen po de dag la/ /mngon par dad pa'i lha gang 'khod pa dag /lha rnams de dag yid dga' mgur gyur nas/ /rtag tu dge zhing zhi bar byos// //sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang gnyis khyed rnams bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /lam du zhugs rnams bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde 13—914

legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /khyed cag kun du bde legs shog /de dag sdig par ma gyur cig /nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin/ /rgyu skar thams cad bzang po yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che/ /dgra bcom thams cad zad pa med/ /bden pa'i tshig gis kun du bde legs su gyur cig /rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bden tshig /cardotha/ba/ khunya7// //bsdur mchan/914 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mjug byang las blangs te bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈li 〉〉la gzhir bzung nas 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gsum dang dpe bsdur byas yod/②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 ma/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ri'i/915 ①〈〈co 〉〉so/13—915

༄ga /yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/①༄tshon /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad pa/ /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang gis bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'khor ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cig /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /snyo 13—917

gtsang zhing slu ba mi mnga' ba/ /gsung gtsang gtsang bar mdzad pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing / /don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams dang / /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos nas/ /sems can thams cad rab dga' des//khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /byang chub snying por gang zhig gis/ /sa rnams rnam drug g.yor gyur cing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa gsungs pa gang / /thub pa'i grags pa 'byung ba des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang gis mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing / /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin lhar bcas bde legs dang / /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ /khyed la dus kun sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu ngag dang / /lha rnams kyis ni bsams pa yis/ /khyed kyi don 'dod gang yin pa①/ /don de di ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'od dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la'ang bde legs shing / /khyed rnams kun du bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas lha ni stong rnams kyis/ /yongs su bskor te gshegs mdzad kyis/ /sdang sems ldan pa rnams byer cig /snying rje'i 13—918

bdag nyid can rnams 'khor/ /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /dgra bcom slob pa'i bden tshig gis/ /'jig rten mi phan byed pa rnams/ /grong khyer 'di ni gtong gyur cig /sems can kun dang srog chags kun/ /'byung po kun dang khyed cag kun/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig ldan gyur cig /thams cad nad ni med gyur cig /kun gyis bzang po mthong gyur cig /gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur cing / /sa 'am 'on te bar snang gnas pa rnams/ /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams bgyid cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod gyur cig /'dul ba lung gi cha shas yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rdzogs sgotsho// //ci bsdur mchan/917 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mjug byang las blangs te bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈li 〉〉la gzhir bzung nas 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gsum dang dpe bsdur byas yod/918 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 pa/919 ①〈〈co 〉〉so 13wa 919

༄ga /bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/①༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ swa ste gā thā/ bod skad du/ bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha cig nye bar song nas su/ /lhas mchod pa la zhus byas7te/ /sangs rgyas chen po thub pa che//ci zhig smras na bde legs 'gyur/ /des ni tshig de gsan gyur nas/ /'jig rten rtsa lag bka' stsal pa/ /gang zhig rtag tu brjod byed pa/ /nga yi bde legs 'gyur de nyon/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan dang mtho ris na/ /rin chen rgya chen mchog ni gang yod pa/ /des ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen la//cig kyang grangs dang bgrang dang char mi phod/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni7shin du bde legs shog /zhi 'gog bdud rtsi shin du gya rnam gang / /shākya thub pas mnyam bzhag 13—921

thugs chud pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa yod min te/ /de mngon byas na phyin chad mya ngan med/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ninyeshin du bde legs shog /rgyal bas gang dag gang zag brgyad gsungs pa/ /de dag rnams ni skyes bu zung bzhi ste/ /sbyin gnas de dag sa steng shin du dkon/ /de dag rnams la byin na dpag med 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni7shin du bde legs shog /dam pa gtso bo mchog sbyin gya rnam pa/ /'od mchog dpa' bo dam pa mchog gi gnas/ /shes rab dam pa mchog gi dam pa mchog /mchog min mchog mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /ting 'dzin dam pa bar chad med pa gang / /mtha' yas blo ldan de bzhin gshegs gsungs pa/ /ting 'dzin de bstan rdo rje dper byas pa/ /ting 'dzin de dang mtshungs pa'i ting 'dzin med/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin rtse bde legs shog /ji ltar sgo gtan dam zhing rab dam ste/ /stobs chen rlung bzhi dag gis mi bskyod pa/ /de ltar mkhas pa bden bzhi mthong gnas pa/ /'jig rten smra ba rnams kyis 'dir mi g.yo/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag 13—922

med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /thams cad zil gnon kun mkhyen thams cad gzigs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa stobs rnams kun dang ldan/ /kun gyi dam pa 'dzin pa kun dang bral/ /bsam pa⑥kun mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan cig /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /srid pa 'gog cing mi g.yo 'gyur ba med/ /skyon med 'jigs pa kun las rnam par grol/ /shin du 'gag cing gya rnam nges par 'byung / /shin du dri med zhi ba blos mi 'phrogs/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /shin du sdug bsngal ston cing bde sbyin pa'i/ /bden rnams mthong ste gang dag bag yod pa/ /bden pa rin chen rnams la dogs bral ba/ /de dag skye ba brgyad pa phyis mi len/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /dam pa rnams kyis dam pa don dam mkhyen/ /mchog dang mchog min mkhyen cing don dam brtson/ /gzhan gyis mi 'phrogs dam pa thugs chung rtogs/ /shin du sdug bsngal rnams kyi dpung gnyen mchog /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /13—923

bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /'dun pa bskyed nas rnal 'byor ldan gyur cing / /gau tam bstan la rtag brtson rab grol zhi/ /gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dag zhi der reg /'di la de reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /bden pa mthong bas brjed pas brgya lam na/ /gal te sdig pa 'ga' zhig byas gyur kyang / /de ni de 'tshal ba'i 'os min te/ /chos nyid 'di ni mi g.yo gnas phyir ro/ /skre mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni7shin du bde legs shog /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /sangs rgyas dang ni lhag pa'am mtshungs pa med/ /lha dang mi yi ston pa bla na med/ /ston pa ded dpon sman pa rnams kyi mchog /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /so ga'i zla ba dang por thub pa yis//nags khrod chos kyi dam pa rab brnyes pa/ /chos de dang ni lhag pa 'am mtshungs pa med/ /'di la de rig grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /sdig pa rnying zad gsar du byas med na/ /rims nad med pas 'jigs med mya ngan bral/ /srid pa 'gags pas rtsa ba mi bskyed pa/ /bstan pa mar me bzhin 13—924

du 'bar bar 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin du rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin du bde legs shog /bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rdzogs stokhya// // cibasdur mchan/921 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈li 〉〉la gzhir bzung nas 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gsum dang dpe bsdur byas yod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉 byas/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉na/922 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉na/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉na/922 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 pa/924 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉na/925 ①〈〈co 〉〉so 13wa 925

༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ swa sna yashegā thā/ bod skad du/ bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i drung du ni/ /lha zhig nye bar song nas su/ /gang gis rtag tu bde legs pa/ /bdag gis zhu yis bcom ldan gsungs/ /dam pas de dag gsan pa dang / /'jig rten 'dren pas lung bstan pa/ /gang gis kun du bde legs su/ /'gyur ba lha khyod legs par nyon/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /dad pa mi g.yo legs rab bstan/ /gang zhig dge ba tshul khrims can/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig pha dang ma dag dang / /bu dang bu mo bran dag la/ /rtag tu legs par bsnyen bkur ba/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig dgra bcom grags pa la/ /legs par rab dang yon 'bul dang / /lha yi bka' bzhin byed pa dag /de 13—927

dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang gis lus dang ngag dang ni/ /yid la nyes byas med pa dang / /gang zhig rnam gsum rab bsdams pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'byung po thams cad la/ /tshad med kun du mi 'khrugs pa/ /byams pa'i sems ni sgom byed pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal kun spang phyir/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /bde ba 'dren pa legs sgom pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang gis 'dus byas thams cad kyi/ /stong nyid rtag tu legs mthong zhing / /de ni sems la gnas gyur pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur / /gang gis lus kyis dri med chos/ /mngon sum byas nas rgyu ba dang / /dgra bcom rnam grol sems ldan pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang gis 'dod chags zhe snang dang / /gti mug rnams dang chags bral zhing / /ye shes 'khrug med skyes gyur pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /mgon po yang srid spangs pa yi sangs rgyas khong du chud gyur pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ rdzogs stonya)// //13—928

༄tshog /shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lha mi⑧bkra shis don sgrub cing / /phyogs rnams bkra shis byed pa des/ /khyed kyi don rnams grub gyur cig /thams cad myur du 'thun par shog /phreng ba mgo la 'dug pa ltar/ /lag pa g.yas na dpal yod shog /g.yon na'ang dpal ni gnas gyur cig /yan lag kun na'ang dpal yod shog /tshong pa dag nisnyenor tshol zhing / /phyogs bcu dag tu 'gro ba rnams/ /rnyed pa chen po rnyed gyur cing / /de dag bde ba skyid par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /shar phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /smin drug dang ni snar ma dang / /mgo dang lag dang nam so dang / /rgyal dang skag ces bya ba ste/ /de dag rnams ni shar phyogs pa/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni④/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /13—930

shar phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun du bsrungs/ /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /yul 'khoratubasrung zhes grags pa ste/ /de ni dri za kun gyi bdag /nyi ma lhan cig bsrung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod pa/ /mkhas shing ming yang 'thun pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de rnams khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /shar phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang / /don grub ma dang mi pham dang / /dga' mchog ma dang dga' sde dang / /dga' can ma dang dga' 'phel ma/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /shar phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /gzhi 'dzin ces bya'i mchod rten yod/ /rgyal ba skyob pa dgra bcom pa/ /de rnams kyis ni bzhugs shing mkhyen/ /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas/ /nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /lho phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /mchu dang gre dang dbo dang ni/ /me bzhi nag pa lnga pa yin/ /sa ri dang ni sa ga ste/ /de dag rnams ni lho phyogs pa/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /lho phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun du bsrungs/ /de dag bdag po rgyal posani / /'phags skyes po zhes bya bar brjod/ /de ni grul bum kun gyi bdag /gshin rje lhan cig bsrung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod la/ /mkhas shing 13—931

ming yang 'thun pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de rnams khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /lho phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /dpal ldan ma dang grags ldan ma/ /grags pa thob dang grags 'dzin dang / /legs par langs dang rab ldang dang / /legs par sad dang bde sgrub ma/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /lho phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /pad ma zhes bya'i mchod rten yod/ /rtag tu gzi brjid kyis kyang 'bar/ /rtag tu thams cad gsal byed pa/ /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas / /nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /nub phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yis/ /rgyu skar khyer la skyong gyur cig /lha mtshams dang ni snron dang yang / /brtson 'grus brtan ldan snams dang ni/ /chu stod chu smad byi zhin dang / /gro zhin de ni bdun pa yin/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /nub phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun du bsrungs/ / de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /mig mi bzang zhes bya bar shes/ /de ni klu rnams kun gyi bdag /chu lha lhan cig bsrung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod la / /mkhas shing ming yang 'thun pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /nub phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhon nu 13—932

brgyad yod de/ /rna cha skra7'dres ma dang ni/ /pad ma dkar dang skya reng dang / /cha med gcig dang dgu pa dang / /rol dang gnag dang stabs myur srid/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /nub phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /nub ces bya ba'i ri bo yod/ /nyi ma zla ba gnyis ku'ang nub/ /nub pa'ang khyed la nor sbyin 'gyur/ /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas/ /nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /byang phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /mon gru dang ni mon gre dang / /khrums stod dang ni khrums smad dang / /nam gru dang ni tha skar dang / /bra nye ste ni bdun pa yin/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /byang phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun du bsrungs/ /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /mi la zhon pa lus ngan po/ /gnod sbyin kun gyi bdag po ste/ /nor bzangs lhan cig bsrung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod la/ /mkhas shing ming yangasa'athun pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /byang phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /rab chags lha mo gtong lha mo/ /sa dang de bzhin pad ma can/ /rgyal po che la nyer gnas dang / /de dang khrel yod dpal ldan ma/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /byang phyogs 13—933

logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /spos ngad ldang ba'i ri bo yod/ /gnod sbyin 'byung po rnams kyi gnas/ /rtse mo sna tshogs blta na sdug /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas/ /nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad po/ /phyogs bzhi dag na bdun bdun gnas/ /lha yi bu mo sum bcu gnyis/ /phyogs bzhi dag na brgyad brgyad gnas/ /dge sbyong brgyad dang bram ze brgyad/ /yul rnams na ni grong rdal brgyad/ /dbang por bcas pa'i lha brgyad rnams/ /de dag khyed la kun du bsrungs/ /khyed cag 'gro na'ang bkra shis gyur/ /ldog pa na yang bkra shis shog /gnyen la lta ba bkra shis shog /gnyen gyi lta ba'ang bkra shis shog /dbang bcas gnod sbyin rgyal che dang / /dgra bcom pa dag snying brtse bas /thams cad du ni bkra shis dang / /bdud rtsi shis pa thob par shog /tshangs pa dang ni de bzhin nor rgyas dang / /zag pa med pa rnam par grol rnams dang / /klu dang gnod sbyin rtag tu snying rjes bsrungs/ /ston brgya mtshungs par tshe ni skyong bar shog /'phags pa rgya cher rol pa'i mdo'i tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po'i le'u las/ 'byung ba shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/rdzogs same// //13—934

jug /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/①༄༄gi /rgya gar skad du/ rad na tri swa ste mi ga lokhugā thā/ bod skad du / dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste / /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam 'phel ba/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang bsrungs ma'i byin brlabs kyis/ /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur 13—936

༄ga /lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa gsum gyis bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/①༄tshog /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /thugs rje chen po mnga' ba 'od srung rigs skyes pa/ /rnam par rgyal bar gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /gser thub bsgribs pa med par rab tu gzigs pa de/ /rin chen sna tshogs gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /gsod skyabs gser gyi ri bo 'bar ba 'dra ba de/ /rtse mo mchog tu gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /thams cad mnga' ba dgra bcom dri ma gsum sel ba/ /mdzod spu'i rtse mor gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas gtsug tor dgongs pa zil gyis mi non pa//13—938

rin chen sna tshogs gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /rnam par gzigs pa skyes bu'i zla ba mi yi mgon/ /rin chen rgyan du gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /shin du rgyas pa don dam mkhas shing brtan pa de/ /ma la ya yi rtser gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig zhabakra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas ston mchog thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ /dri med zla bar gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /grags pa dri ma med par mgon po pad ma'i bla/ /dri ma med par gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /mgon po mar me mdzad pa 'od snang mnga' ba de/ /'od zer dra bar gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa'o// //dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas grags pa'i dam par mtshan btags pa/ /nor bu'i gtsug tu gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten sgron ma blo zhes mtshan btags pa/ /sbyangs pa'i lam du gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sgribs〈med gzigs pa 'dzum pa'i spyan du mtshan btags pa/ /brgyan gcig ldan par gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /13—939

'jig rten sgron ma mar me mdzad ces mtshan btags pa/ /rnam par rgyal bar gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /bde gshegs yang dag don gzigs pa zhes mtshan btags pa/ /dri med rtse mor gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rang byung mchog ces mtshan btags pa/ /rin chen spos su gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten sgron ma dbyig gi lha zhes mtshan btags pa/ /dri med sna tshogs gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'gro ba med pa smra ba'i stag ces mtshan btags pa/ /thams cad tshalanyedu gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /yon tan kun mnga' dpal gyi rgyal bar mtshan btags pa/ /dga' ba'i rgyan du gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten phan brtson dka' thub drag por mtshan btags pa/ /kun nas mchog tu gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /ces bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa'o// //dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /chags pa med pa'i zla bar mtshan gsol mtshan btags pa/ /pho brang mchog tu rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dirasayang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /ye shes mtha' yas dbang zhes bya bar mtshan btags 13—940

pa/ /kha dog gser du rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /kun du mtha' yas spyan zhes bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /pad ma'i rtse mor rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /yan lag rin po che zhes bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /rin chen mdzod du rab gshegs pa//des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /dpal rab rgol ba'i stag ces bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /dbang po'i khang par rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /yon tan thams cad ston pa'i nyi mar mtshan btags pa/ /me tog snying por rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yangabakra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /yan lag 'od zer mtha' yas par ni mtshan btags pa/ /shing gis brgyan par rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /mgon po the tsom 'joms pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan de/ /rin chen khang par rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /mi yi seng ge ye shes sgron ma mtha' yas pa/ /spos kyi rtse mor rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyis 'byung gnas 'od mnga' ba/ /nor bus brgyan par rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ rdzogs skokhya// //13—941

ca༄ga /lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ de ba pa ri bṛtstshasami ga la gā thā/ bod skad du/ lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mgon po phyogs cig bzhugs pa na/ /lha cig dpa' bo chen po la/ /phyag 'tshal 'di skad tshig gsol to/ /dge ba don du gnyer ba na/ /lha dang mi rnams so so nas/ /bkra shis dag ni brjod bgyis na/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dge ba don du gnyer ba na/ /lha dang mi rnams so so nas/ /bkra shis rnams ni brjod byed pa/ /de dag bkra shis brjod par bya/ /yul bzang gnas dang grogs mchog dang / /sngon chad bsod nams byas pa dang / /sems ni legs par gtad byas pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /sbyin dang shin du snyan smra dang / /yang dag don la rnam nges 13—943

dang / /khrims ldan rnams dang mtshungs sbyor ba/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin//byis pa rnams la mi brten dang / /mkhas pa rnams la brten pa dang / /mchod 'os rnams la mchod byed pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /pha ma bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / /zhi dang tshangs par spyod pa dang / /'byung po kun la snying brtse ba/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /sdig pa'i las las ldog pa dang / /dge ba'i las la brten pa dang / /bag yod pa dang rtag mkhas pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /nga rgyal med dang khengs med dang / /chos shes 'thun pas 'tsho ba dang / /rtag tu byas pa gzo byed pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin//mi smod de bzhin bzod pa dang / /'phags pa rnams dang 'thun sbyor dang / /dus skabs su ni chos nyan pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /le lo med dang mang thos dang / /chos la legs par rnam nges dang / /de bzhin sems la rnyog med pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /gang zhig sems can thams cad la/ /byams pa'i sems ni rab sgom zhing / /dpag tu med de mi 'khrugs pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /gang zhig 'phags pa'i bden rnams la/ /shes rab mig ni rnam sbyangs dang / /tshul khrims nongs par ma gyur pa/ — /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /'phags pa'i bden pa mthong ba dang / /tshangs par spyod pa sgom pa dang / /mya ngan 'das pa 'thob 'gyur ba/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin / /gang zhig 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /ma rig pa yang rnam spangs dang / /shes pa mi 'khrugs skye 'gyur ba/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /'jig rten chos rnams kyis bskyod kyang / /gang gi sems ni mi g.yo dang / /dri med zhi dang mya ngan med/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /de dang 'di ni ci 13—944

༄ga /sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra zhis tshigs su bcad pa/①༄tshog /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan rnam par gzigs ni rgyal rigs gzi brjid can/ /tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du/ /shi ri sha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /ding 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /bde gshegs gtsug tor mnga' ba rgyal rigs rdzu 'phrul can/ /tshe lo bdun khri'i dus na su ku'i grong khyer du/ /shing mchog sun dha'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /ding 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /rgyal ba thams cad skyob pa rgyal rigs blo gros can/ /tshe lo drug khri'i dus na grong khyer mnyam med du/ /shing mchog sā rgyala'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /ding 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /thub pa 'khor ba 'jig ni bcom ldan bram ze'i rigs/ /tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du/ /shi ri 13—946

sha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /ding 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /'dren pa gser thub bslab pa mchog ldan bram ze'i rigs/ /tshe lo sum khri'i dus na grong khyer bde ldan du/ /u dum ba ra'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /ding 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig ci /skyob pa 'od srung rgyal rigs bla med yon tan can/ /tshe lo nyi khri'i dus na bā rā ṇa sī ru/ /n+ya gro dha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /ding 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /'gro mgon shākya thub pa rgyal rigs brtson 'grus can/ /tshe lo brgya pa'i dus na ser skya'i grong khyer du/ /a shwa tha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /ding 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /sangs rgyas rabs bdun bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa gang / /phyogs dus kun gyi bde gshegs byin rlabs rmad byung ba/ /chos dbyings rnam dag rten 'brel stobs ldan mi 'gyur ba/ /dingatu'adir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ rdzogs sgonya// //13—947

༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ mi ga la gā thā/ bod skad du/ bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad ma rgyas pa'i mdab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ bkra shis des ni skye dgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa'i chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub 13—949

par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dgyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba①/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'di gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lha yis bskor ba'i bkra shes gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum bi'ikhutshal/ /lha mang dag gis bsten par mgon po bltam pa na/ /srid pa'i mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /lhums nas bltam pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shes des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa che ba'i lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge bsgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer mchog nas mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shes pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /bai drurya ltar sngo ba'i rtswa bting steng bzhugs te/ /dkyil mo dkrung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram na tsa sha'i phreng gis yongs bskor ba/ /shin du rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu yi rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed 13—950

shog /shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul te sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr drang srong mchog bzhugs te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang / /lha yul deng 'dir shin du rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams bya byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang / /'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa rgyal ba'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba mchog tu nyer gshegs pa/ /man dā ra ba'i me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs 13—951

pa'i stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dkon mchog gsum dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rdzogs sgonya// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o//bsdur mchan/949 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈li 〉〉la gzhir bzung nas 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gsum dang dpe bsdur byas yod/95 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 bkra shis gang byung ba/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈be 〉〉ba'i/952 ①〈〈co 〉〉so 13wa 952

deb bcu gsum pa/krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe sdur dang dpe sgrig zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkram/bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi glog rdul rtsis 'khor khang gis par gzhi bsgrigs/pe cin ta yun ho par 'debs 'gan tshad kung sis dpar btab/ཿ shā / 0shāḥ/ /rdo/dri /dri // tre/ / /rdo///152sku/kā/gra/lha/rngo/rdo/cho /86—8
